source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/w-Xd\_jRd83w?&wmode=opaque)

**Gift Cards** are a powerful new way to engage your customers, boost sales, and build loyalty - all within your existing payments ecosystem. With fully customizable Gift Card Products, you can design and sell beautiful, branded digital cards that reflect your business identity. From choosing artwork and denominations to setting expiry dates and terms, you have complete control over how your Gift Cards look and function.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Gift Cards?](#What-are-Gift-Cards?)
  - [Key Benefits of Gift Cards](#Key-Benefits-of-Gift-Cards)
  - [Prerequisites to Using Gift Cards](#Prerequisites-to-Using-Gift-Cards)
  - [How to Create a Gift Card Product](#How-to-Create-a-Gift-Card-Product)
  - [How to Sell Gift Cards](#How-to-Sell-Gift-Cards)
  - [How to Send Gift Cards (No Payment)](#How-to-Send-Gift-Cards-(No-Payment))
  - [How to Track Gift Card Orders](#How-to-Track-Gift-Card-Orders)
  - [How Customers Redeem Gift Cards](#How-Customers-Redeem-Gift-Cards)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Gift Cards?**

Gift Cards give your business a powerful way to drive sales, reward loyal customers and simplify promotions. With this feature you can create branded Gift Card Products, sell or send them, and track every issued card in a dedicated **Gift Card Orders** page - all from inside your **Payments** section.

Whether customers are purchasing a gift for someone special or you’re rewarding loyal clients with complimentary credit, Gift Cards make every transaction more personal. They can be sold through a dedicated checkout or embedded on your website, shared through a QR code, or sent directly to contacts with a custom message. Every card issued is automatically tracked under **Gift Card Orders**, giving you clear visibility into balance, status, and redemption - while offering your customers a seamless, delightful way to pay.

With Gift Cards you can:

- **Create Gift Card Products** with your branding, denominations, expiry dates and more.
- **Sell Gift Cards** from a dedicated checkout, embedded on your site, or via QR code.
- **Send Gift Cards directly** to contacts without collecting payment (great for promotions or service recovery).
- **Track every issued card** from the **Gift Card Orders** page with status, balance, and details.
- **Let customers redeem Gift Cards seamlessly** at supported checkouts with automatic balance display and fallback payment collection when needed.

---

## **Key Benefits of Gift Cards**

- **Flexible Selling Options:**Dedicated checkout, embed, QR code, or add to existing checkouts.
- **Scheduled Delivery:** Choose immediate delivery or schedule for a future date.
- **Operational Visibility:**Track orders, code, amount, and status under Gift Card Orders.
- **Brand Consistency:** Use gradients or upload artwork so cards match your brand.
- **Gifting Built In:** "Myself or Someone Else" flows make it simple to buy for others with scheduled delivery.
- **Frictionless Redemption:**Recipients can redeem on supported checkouts with their code or link.

---

## **Prerequisites to Using Gift Cards**

- Access to **Payments → Gift Cards** in your account.
- At least one Gift Card Product created.
- Active checkouts (Forms, Funnels, Payment Links, Invoices, Store, Calendars etc.) to support redemption.
- (Optional) Artwork and terms & conditions for your Gift Card branding.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058723085/original/J0HIn4_gKXFAw4Wumc3ROWAHjTecM3ZbUA.png?1763545571)

---

## **How to Create a Gift Card Product**

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to Gift Cards

In the left menu, click the **Payments**tab. Then in the top ribbon, click **Gift Cards** to open the Gift Cards dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059743397/original/KwY56sj5jUXMOc_MDBKuivCtgubSPB4xpw.jpeg?1764703978)

#### **Step 2:**Create Gift Card

Click the blue **+****Create Gift Card**button.For a first time user, only the option to create a card would be visible. Orders, Sell/Send options and other details would come up once the first gift card product is created.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059746397/original/3_s4qQtEqYpduNe64j44eCsV717VbFnqtg.png?1764709447)

#### **Step 3:**Add Details

Fill in the Basic Information details. Key attributes include (but are not limited to):

- Name and description
- Terms & Conditions
- Expiry date for the Gift Card Product (applies to all Gift Card Orders for this product)
- URL to redemption instructions

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059746470/original/p31AcDEMX2FmCtIG6L2-9-xf3ukhs5wsPA.jpeg?1764709621)

#### **Step 4:** Customize the Gift Card

Choose how the card looks so it aligns with your brand. You have two options:

- **Create a Gradient:**Pick brand‑aligned colors and a gradient style/direction.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059746632/original/zy941ahel2IEjOyCpvUmPUYsZt1hUkigOQ.jpeg?1764710085)
- **Upload Custom Artwork:**Upload a high‑resolution image (e.g., PNG or JPG) that matches your branding.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059746674/original/0kewnxsutJzKU8V5wkd7xg-Dm-WV60Erqw.jpeg?1764710168)

#### **Step 5:**Set Values, Tax & Category

- Add one or more denominations (e.g., $25, $50, $100).
- Set Quantity (Inventory).
- (Optional) Enable automatic taxes.
- (Optional) Assign a Category to help filter and report on promotions.

```
Tip: Inventory definition separately for every denomination is not possible today. Once the inventory is defined, it applies individually to each denomination i.e. if quantity = 100 with 2 denominations, each denomination gets 100 i.e. a total of 200 gift cards.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059746723/original/uC6glt04uVaBVn07d3Rk1eYHAT30X5l12g.jpeg?1764710304)

#### **Step 6:**Review and Save

Review the summary and preview. When everything looks right, click **Create Gift Card** to finish.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059746744/original/aiK6EHe7qM4FmpMagvEXNCdpcZZboX66cQ.jpeg?1764710355)

### **Editing, Archiving and Deactivating Gift Cards**

You can edit, archive, or deactivate a Gift Card Product at any time.

- **Edit:**Update denomination, quantity (inventory), terms, expiry, category, or tax behavior. Updates apply to future issuances.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059748723/original/vD3xJYhtRszHu11M04nC30wxCKMIeyHzAg.png?1764715237)
- **Delete:**Archive gift card products you are no longer using.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059748745/original/1klQBsXDvLjlCL_ouUbe27VyBKm3dnhnRQ.png?1764715302)
- **Deactivate:**When deactivated, their Sell and Send actions are disabled, and the dedicated checkout link or Store (where this gift card was added as a product) stops working immediately. On any other checkout if the gift card was added as a product, it would still continue to be sold unless manually removed.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059748731/original/htdTxdPTOykic4Uxtzei-ctBXTQGaFXMUg.png?1764715259)
- **Activate:**Re‑enables sales and sending for the gift card product. If you removed the product from existing checkouts, add it back where needed.  
    
  **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059748765/original/XdRR0YSK3KLHLXDHZ_Yiah1brTqFQoEA0w.png?1764715334)**

---

## **How to Sell Gift Cards**

You can sell a gift card through its own checkout or by adding it to your existing selling workflows (Funnels, Forms, Stores, Websites, Payment Links, Invoices, and Calendars). This allows you to sell gift cards wherever your customers already buy!

When a customer completes a purchase, HighLevel creates a Gift Card Order and delivers the gift card based on the delivery option selected at checkout (immediate or scheduled).

```
Important: Gift Cards can also be sold through QR codes and existing HighLevel checkouts! For a detailed breakdown of multiple ways to sell gift cards and their respective deliveries, refer the following article: How to Sell Gift Cards
```

### **Selling Gift Cards Through the Dedicated Checkout**

Follow the steps below to sell Gift Cards through the dedicated checkout:

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to Gift Cards

In the left menu, click the **Payments**tab. Then in the top ribbon, click **Gift Cards** to open the Gift Cards dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059743397/original/KwY56sj5jUXMOc_MDBKuivCtgubSPB4xpw.jpeg?1764703978)

#### **Step 2:** Choose a Gift Card

Locate your card you would like to open the Dedicated Checkout Link for. On the Gift Card tile, click **Sell**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059743528/original/Kbns5kMT0R0_z-MD-yL0gfqu4UTPXCm6EQ.png?1764704005)

#### **Step 3:**Share the Dedicated Checkout

There are multiple ways to share the dedicated checkout:

- **Copy the Checkout Link:**Click the **Copy** icon to copy the Live Mode Checkout Link to your clipboard. Share this link with your customers so they can purchase the gift card  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059743575/original/JIUq3St7m2YyMPz92xc7owIkaUt7cCNIfA.png?1764704124)
- **Copy the Embed Code:**Click the **Copy**button to copy the embed code. Use this code to embed the dedicated gift card checkout directly onto any external webpage  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059743590/original/EvMEcU2J2_owDUEBM_MEgNYUUoIo5_y-JQ.png?1764704168)

### **Customer Experience When Using the Dedicated Checkout**

This summary describes the flow that buyers will go through when purchasing a gift card using the Dedicated Checkout.

#### 

#### **Step 1:** Select a Denomination

The buyer selects one of the available values (e.g., $10, $25, $50, $100).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059744101/original/NHiEq61v1kgUCAZO7z2yt2ggYdwmv5_I9Q.png?1764705089)

#### **Step 2:**Select Who the Gift Card is For

The buyer chooses who the gift card is for by selecting **Myself** or **Someone Else**

- **If the gift is for someone else:** the checkout collects the recipient’s name and email, plus the sender’s name and email.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059744145/original/-SEp_FfXP6nTDr6lbEmTFjzoEemqUB0qUA.png?1764705189)
- **If the gift is for myself:**the checkout collects the buyers name and email.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059744200/original/qoBBbuYn3v1oKVw9LTyL6epAAG7XdousGA.png?1764705258)

#### **Step 3:**Add Delivery Date

Choose Deliver Now (immediate) or Schedule for later and pick a date (and time, if shown).

Add an optional message for the recipient.

```
Live mode Gift Cards are redeemable on live checkouts; test mode Gift Cards on test checkouts. Vice versa is not possible. Click here to learn more about Test Mode for Gift Cards
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059744271/original/mawGikEpWNEBjkqLWxpIlx-c7hUJklXxdQ.png?1764705382)

#### **Step 4:**Complete Payment & Confirmation

The buyer selects an available **payment method** and clicks **Pay**.

Once payment is confirmed, the buyer is able to download the gift card from this screen. If buying for someone else, the recipient receives the gift card via email at the chosen time (immediate or at a scheduled date)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058725317/original/iUREh0wl2njmWMxArQBt-HPZlbVnWTsfQw.png?1763546304)  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058725331/original/3fXJl4mkgaOcNCmfqAIU3IlsEWntjbiq8w.png?1763546312)

---

## **How to Send Gift Cards (No Payment)**

Sending Gift Cards is a powerful feature that allows businesses to issue gift cards directly to any customer, without requiring a purchase or payment.

Sending a gift card creates a **one-time, prepaid credit** and delivers it to a chosen recipient via email, SMS, PDF, or QR code, without requiring the contact to purchase it. This is ideal for make-goods, loyalty gestures, VIP perks, and internal tests. Redemption happens on supported HighLevel-powered checkouts where gift cards are accepted. The Send flow works exclusively in **Live Mode** currently, ensuring only real, fully functional gift cards are delivered.

```
Important: For a detailed breakdown of multiple ways to send gift cards and the respective deliveries, refer the following article: How to Send Gift Cards
```

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to Gift Cards

In the left menu, click the **Payments**tab. Then in the top ribbon, click **Gift Cards** to open the Gift Cards dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059743397/original/KwY56sj5jUXMOc_MDBKuivCtgubSPB4xpw.jpeg?1764703978)

#### **Step 2:** Choose a Gift Card

On the Gift Card you want to send, click the **Send** button. You will now enter the Send flow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059744615/original/EijP6fYVZkgf-jIfrb-drWjTsP-fq7iABQ.png?1764706041)

#### **Step 3:** Choose a Contact

Select an existing customer/contact from your list or **Add a Contact**, and click **continue**. Add a personalized message then click **Continue.**You can also use the *'Write with AI'*functionality to draft the message.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058726314/original/1HN63lAZbrzuQhS34MruknGBDpW5jRQBNw.png?1763546721)  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058726321/original/GQRL2ypBuHGsbjnk5cZiVC2gks4Wh2hdIA.png?1763546729)

#### **Step 4:**Select Denomination and Delivery Method

Choose one of the preset denominations configured for the product then select delivery method: Email, SMS, QR via Email, or PDF via Email. When selecting the delivery method, you can also schedule the send date (optional).

```
Note: Only methods supported by the customer's available information (email/phone) will be enabled.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058726359/original/0SHgQufRwhQY4lvq63D4spWXddT_OlEXFQ.png?1763546765)

#### **Step 5:** Review and Send

Before confirming, review the automatically generated email or SMS preview. This includes:

- Gift Card Amount
- Custom Message
- Expiry Date
- Redemption Instructions
- Artwork

Then click **Send Gift Card.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058726445/original/VruiUcx4t52jXQWXxnAZ8iwyK3hTz2LfkQ.png?1763546806)

**Result:** A free Gift Card is issued to the contact - ideal for loyalty, refunds, or special campaigns. This will appear in **Gift Card Orders** but not in the general **Payments → Orders** page (since no payment occurred).

---

## **How to Track Gift Card Orders**

All issued Gift Cards (whether sold or sent) are listed under **Payments → Gift Cards → Gift Card Orders**.

The gift card orders page lists all the sold or sent gift cards along with their statuses, balances, filters and contact details. All cards on this page are clickable and open up a detailed page for that order.

```
Tip: The generic Payments → Orders page only shows paid orders. Gift Cards sent directly without payment do not appear there. Use the Gift Card Orders page is your central hub for every card issued or purchased.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058727985/original/MiqnSulsGtG2CoQfRGkeU_jICA8dlJpXFQ.png?1763547579)

### **Gift Card Dashboard**

The Gift Card Dashboard gives you a quick snapshot of your overall gift card performance. You can view high-level metrics such as:

- **Total Gift Cards Issued** (sold + sent)
- **Total Value of Gift Cards Issued** for the selected time period
- **Average Gift Card Order Value**for the selected time period
- **Number of Unique Customers** who purchased or received gift cards in the selected time period
- **Top Denominations** issued, including the most popular denomination and a Top 5 chart

These insights help you understand customer behavior, track gift card adoption, and plan better inventory or promotional strategies.

```
For a detailed breakdown of each metric, chart type, and how to interpret this data, read the full Gift Card Dashboard guide here: How to Track Gift Card Performance (Analytics and Metric tracking)
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058727853/original/57IAR4a0G5LaEr8nS129MPNLl6qPUy8qCA.png?1763547502)

### **Gift Card Order Details Page**

The gift card order details page acts as the single source of truth for all Gift Cards in the account. For each Gift Card Order, businesses can view:

- Purchaser info
- Recipient info
- Denomination
- Expiry date (same as that of the gift card product)
- Remaining balance
- Status (Scheduled, Active, Inactive)
- Hidden Gift Card number (visible inside the order details page)
- Delivery method and delivery schedule
- Transaction reference (for paid cards)

```
For a detailed breakdown of gift card tracking, read the full Gift Card Dashboard guide here: How to Track Gift Card Performance (Analytics and Metric tracking)
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058728028/original/2mSXrbv1vG6Evv2co0jTxjqkPk05XKV9cw.png?1763547604)

---

## **How Customers Redeem Gift Cards**

1. Customer goes to any supported checkout (Forms, Funnels, Payment Links, Invoices, Store, Calendars, Services V2 and only during appointment booking, etc.).
2. Enters their Gift Card Code in the Gift Card field.
3. The gift card is applied and displays:

   - *Gift card applied:*amount used from the gift card
   - *Remaining gift card balance:* amount left in the gift card after redemption
   - *Amount left to pay:*amount left to be paid that’s not covered by the gift card (field only visible if additional payment is required)

```
Note: While gift card is yet to be supported on Memberships, Donation Forms and Rentals, it will not be supported on Services V1 in the future.
```

```
Gift Card redemption is fully supported with Stripe, NMI, Authorize and Square. However, There is limited support for gift card redemption for providers like PayPal, Adyen and custom payment providers. In case of the latter, gift cards can be redeemed on the checkout if the gift card balance fully covers the order/invoice total and the order/invoice does not contain any recurring or subscription product. If gift card cannot cover the full total or if the total has a recurring product, customer cannot redeem the gift card for the purchase.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069536421/original/PMdD08Le4KICncAfPq3LVJlrRJxPH7YH8g.png?1776701677)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065710192/original/Du5YQPa9et_R1bycmhdXWgvGuFTN_IwMyw.png?1772035743)

### **Redemption Rules**

- If balance ≥ order total for one-time products: no extra payment needed.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058728435/original/PvuNZ3kPqO8utHgvJZqgXifebzbEJTVmDQ.png?1763547764)
- If balance < order total or includes subscriptions: checkout captures an additional payment method for the remainder.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058728415/original/vJOLkROU2t8pRQ4TkbI85JQDLrSYPvddAQ.png?1763547745)
- Transaction details now show a separate line item for “Gift Card Balance Used.”  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058728452/original/b-Exp7zEciHxEduwgsDJIyi1QdpM7G8TAg.png?1763547780)  
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058728471/original/M0VfRN00e8-yahN0LJrRj-OZEU1qYO_qsg.png?1763547791)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What’s the difference between Gift Card Orders and the regular Orders page?**  
Gift Card Orders (inside Payments → Gift Cards) track every card issued or purchased. The generic Orders page only records paid transactions.

**Q: Which payment providers can I redeem my gift cards on?**  
A: Gift Card redemption is fully supported with Stripe, NMI, Authorize and Square. There is limited support for gift card redemption for providers like PayPal, Adyen and custom payment providers. In case of the latter, gift cards can be redeemed on the checkout if the gift card balance fully covers the order/invoice total and the order/invoice does not contain any recurring or subscription product. In case of partial payments using gift cards or using gift cards for buying recurring products, the support on PayPal, Adyen and custom payment providers is not yet live.

**Q: Can I set different expiry dates per order?**  
Not yet. All Gift Card Orders for a product share the product’s expiry. Order-level validity is planned for a future release.

**Q: How does inventory work with multiple denominations?**  
Inventory applies per denomination. For example, three denominations with inventory of 50 each = 150 total cards.

**Q: Can I restrict where Gift Cards are redeemable?**  
As of MVP, Gift Cards are redeemable on all products except for when you are trying to buy gift cards. More fine-grained controls (product-level, variant-level) are coming soon.

**Q: Can customers check their balance without starting checkout?**  
Not yet. For now, entering the card number at any supported checkout displays the balance. A dedicated balance-check link is coming soon.

**Q: Can I buy gift cards using gift cards?**  
Not yet. For now, you cannot add a gift card product on checkouts and make the payment by redeeming another gift card. Providing businesses an option to choose to or not to allow gift cards to be used to buy other gift cards is coming soon.

**Q: When can users see the redemption option on checkouts for a sub-account?**  
Redemption option is available only once a gift card order is placed, irrespective of order status, after creating a gift card product. Currently, there is no way to turn-off gift card redemption, but it's in development and coming soon.

**Q: Which checkouts have the gift card redemption option?**

Support checkouts - Forms (Sell Product), Funnels, Payment Links, Invoices, Store, Calendars, Services V2.

Note - While gift card is yet to be supported on Memberships, Donation Forms and Rentals, it will not be supported on Services V1 in the future.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Sell Gift Cards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006986)
- [How to Send Gift Cards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006987)
- [How to Track Gift Card Performance (Analytics & Metric Tracking)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006981)

title_en: How to Use Computer for Managed Agents in HighLevel
source_md:
Computer for Managed Agents in HighLevel allows AI agents to browse websites, create and manage files, and execute scripts to complete tasks beyond traditional CRM automation.

Agents can research information, interact with web applications, generate business documents, and perform multi-step operations from a single conversation. Built-in approval controls, secure website sign-ins, and a shared workspace help you manage agent activity while keeping sensitive actions under your control.

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/ic9oRe8H5btlcuoSNfDJ)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Computer for Managed Agents?](#What-is-Computer-for-Managed-Agents?)
- [Browser, Files, and Terminal Capabilities](#Browser,-Files,-and-Terminal-Capabilities)
- [Approval and Safety Controls](#Approval-and-Safety-Controls)
- [Secure Website Sign-ins](#Secure-Website-Sign-ins)
- [Computer Panel and Waiting on You](#Computer-Panel-and-Waiting-on-You)
- [Shared Computer Workspace and Availability](#Shared-Computer-Workspace-and-Availability)
- [How to Set Up Computer for Managed Agents](#How-to-Set-Up-Computer-for-Managed-Agents)
  - [Step 1: Open Agent Studio](#Step-1%3A-Open-Agent-Studio)
  - [Step 2: Enable Computer](#Step-2%3A-Enable-Computer)
  - [Step 3: Choose Computer Tools](#Step-3%3A-Choose-Computer-Tools)
  - [Step 4: Configure Ask Before Permissions](#Step-4%3A-Configure-Ask-Before-Permissions)
  - [Step 5: Test the Agent](#Step-5%3A-Test-the-Agent)
  - [Step 6: Review and Respond to Approval Requests](#Step-6%3A-Review-and-Respond-to-Approval-Requests)
  - [Step 7: Review the Results and Publish the Agent](#Step-7%3A-Review-the-Results-and-Publish-the-Agent)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Computer for Managed Agents?**

Computer is a capability within HighLevel's Managed Agents that gives AI agents access to a computer environment for working with websites, files, and scripts. Rather than relying solely on built-in CRM actions and connected applications, agents can interact with browser interfaces and use workspace tools to complete tasks.

**For example**, a Managed Agent can browse competitor websites, collect product pricing, compare offerings, and create a report with its findings. It can also navigate web applications, fill out forms, and assist with operational tasks that require several steps.

Computer includes three primary tools:

- **Browser:** Open websites, navigate pages, click buttons, fill out forms, and interact with web applications.
- **Files:** Create, read, edit, and export files within the computer workspace.
- **Terminal:** Execute commands and scripts for data processing, calculations, and other advanced tasks.

Computer also includes secure website sign-ins, configurable approval settings, and activity monitoring controls.

```
Important: Computer currently supports chat and manual runs only. Computer capabilities are not supported for trigger-based executions.
```

---

## **Browser, Files, and Terminal Capabilities**

Computer provides three configurable tools that allow Managed Agents to perform different types of tasks. Understanding what each tool does helps you enable only the capabilities your agent needs.

### **1. Browser**

The Browser tool allows Managed Agents to interact with websites through a browser interface. Agents can navigate pages, enter information, and complete web-based tasks that would otherwise require manual interaction.

Supported activities include:

- Opening and navigating websites.
- Reading and researching website content.
- Clicking buttons and interacting with page elements.
- Entering information and filling out forms.
- Navigating authenticated websites after successful sign-in.
- Completing multi-step tasks across web applications.

You can monitor browser activity and take control when manual interaction is required.

**For example**, you could ask: *"Visit three competitor websites, compare their product prices, and summarize the differences."*

The agent can navigate the websites, collect available information, and prepare a comparison.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084067723/original/i40EXEU1fpZyTh0iHpd3QChOzComqlHzFg.png?1792761520)**

### **2. Files**

The Files tool allows Managed Agents to work with files in the sub-account's computer workspace. Agents can create new files, modify existing files, and produce downloadable outputs.

Supported activities include:

- Creating reports and documents.
- Generating spreadsheets and other business files.
- Reading and modifying workspace files.
- Exporting generated files.
- Reusing workspace files across conversations.

**For example,** you could ask: *"Create a spreadsheet comparing the pricing and features of the competitors you researched."*

The agent can organize the collected information into a structured file.

Files stored in the Computer workspace are different from documents attached directly to an agent conversation. Chat attachments are documented separately in [Managed Agents File Support](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009017-managed-agents-file-support).

### **3. Terminal**

The Terminal tool allows Managed Agents to execute commands and scripts within the computer environment. This is useful when tasks require calculations, data transformations, or operations that are difficult to complete through browser interaction alone.

Supported activities include:

- Running Python scripts.
- Processing and analyzing datasets.
- Executing terminal commands.
- Installing packages required for supported tasks.
- Preparing reports from processed data.

**For example**, you could ask:*"Analyze this sales dataset, calculate monthly revenue growth, and create a summary report."*

The agent can use available tools to process the information and generate an output.

Terminal is disabled by default in the provided configuration example and can be enabled when your agent requires code execution.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084067883/original/ZJmaQLtjkvwOrK01arbktyv0t8I8dkgCmg.png?1792761604)**

---

## **Approval and Safety Controls**

Computer includes configurable approval controls that help prevent agents from performing sensitive actions without your knowledge. The Ask Before settings let you determine which activities require your permission before the agent can continue.

### **Configurable Ask Before Permissions**

You can configure approval requirements for the following activities:

- Submitting forms.
- Making payments or purchases.
- Sending emails or messages.
- Publishing content or going live.
- Deleting files or records.
- Downloading files.
- Visiting a new website.

These controls are configured for the individual Managed Agent.

Payments and deletions always require approval. Other actions can be configured to request confirmation or, where supported, receive permission for the current chat.

**For example**, when an agent needs to open a new website, it may display an approval request identifying the destination. You can review the request and decide whether the agent should proceed.

### **Approving Actions During a Conversation**

When an agent encounters an activity that requires approval, it pauses and presents a request.

To respond:

1. Review the requested action and its destination or affected resource.
2. Confirm that the action matches the task you assigned.
3. Approve the action to allow the agent to continue, or decline it.
4. If an option to allow the action for the current chat is available, choose it only when you want that permission to apply within the stated scope.

**For example**, an agent researching a website might request permission before opening the destination.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084068487/original/jrCDnStmJuEYHJD49Q_IDu6J0m52YXbX_w.png?1792761902)**

### **Data Protection**

Computer includes safeguards designed to protect information accessed within the workspace.

If an agent accesses workspace data and then attempts to transfer that information outside the computer environment, an additional approval may be required.

This helps ensure that potentially sensitive data is not shared externally without user authorization.

```
Important: Review the destination and content of sensitive actions before approving them, particularly when an agent is sending information to external websites or applications.
```

---

## **Secure Website Sign-ins**

Some browser tasks require access to websites that are protected by a username and password. Computer supports secure website sign-ins so agents can continue authenticated tasks without requiring you to share passwords in the conversation.

When an agent encounters a login requirement, it can request credentials through a secure form.

### **How Secure Website Sign-ins Work**

1. The agent navigates to a website requiring authentication.
2. The agent identifies that a login is needed.
3. A sign-in request appears in the conversation or Computer Panel.
4. Select **Add login** to access the secure credentials form.
5. Enter the required website credentials through the secure form.
6. Submit the credentials.
7. Once authentication succeeds, the agent can continue the requested task.

Credentials are handled through the secure sign-in mechanism rather than being sent through chat. The release documentation states that passwords remain protected and are not exposed to the agent.

Saved sign-ins can be reused for subsequent tasks that require access to the same website.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084068375/original/1SKFtFBql1dBJMgbliW_Q_N9v272b41lKg.png?1792761882)**

### **Handling Invalid or Expired Credentials**

If previously saved credentials no longer work, the agent may encounter a login error and request updated credentials.

To resolve the issue:

1. Open the relevant Managed Agent conversation.
2. Locate the sign-in request.
3. Select the available option to update or provide login credentials.
4. Enter the correct credentials through the secure form.
5. Submit the information and allow the agent to retry authentication.

Do not send website passwords directly in the conversation.

---

## **Computer Panel and Waiting on You**

The Computer Panel provides visibility into computer activity, while Waiting on You makes it easier to identify requests that require user intervention. These controls help you monitor ongoing tasks and resolve blocked actions without searching through the entire conversation history.

### **Computer Panel**

The Computer Panel can be accessed through the **Computer** control near the top of the Managed Agent conversation.

The panel provides information about:

- **Computer Status:** Whether the computer is active or inactive.
- **Waiting on You:** Requests that need your approval or input.
- **Recent Pages:** Websites recently accessed by the computer.
- **Allowed in This Chat:** Website permissions granted for the current chat.

The panel also provides access to computer-related activities and controls.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084069054/original/kbXq0k5RkWfcag5JCFZ8pXrEgG6ZKoocPg.png?1792762159)**

### **Waiting on You**

Waiting on You helps you locate agent requests that cannot proceed without your involvement.

Common requests include:

- Approving a sensitive action.
- Providing website login credentials.
- Authorizing access to a website.
- Responding to another required user confirmation.

You can access pending actions from the relevant agent's interface and the Computer Panel.

To handle a request:

1. Open the Managed Agent with the pending action.
2. Locate **Waiting on You** in the agent details panel or Computer Panel.
3. Select the request requiring your attention.
4. Review the action or information requested.
5. Provide the required input or approval.
6. Return to the conversation to monitor the agent's progress.

**For example**, when an agent requires LinkedIn authentication, Waiting on You displays a sign-in request with an Add login action.

### **Taking Control of the Browser**

Computer allows you to take over browser interactions when a task requires manual input or intervention.

When browser activity is displayed in the conversation:

1. Locate the Browser activity card.
2. Select **Take control**.
3. Complete the required browser interaction.
4. Return control to the agent using the available interface controls so it can continue.

This is useful when a website requires direct user interaction or when you want to review the page before proceeding.

---

## **Shared Computer Workspace and Availability**

Computer uses a shared environment at the sub-account level. Understanding how this workspace operates helps you manage files, agent access, and execution expectations.

### **Shared Sub-Account Computer**

Each sub-account has one computer shared across its Managed Agents.

This means:

- Managed Agents within the same sub-account use the same computer environment.
- Workspace files can remain available between conversations.
- The computer is isolated from other sub-accounts.
- Access to the sub-account's Computer environment does not provide access to other sub-accounts' environments.

Individual agents retain their own configured capabilities and approval settings.

### **Persistent Workspace and Automatic Sleep**

The computer automatically sleeps when inactive and resumes when needed.

Workspace files are preserved when the computer sleeps, allowing agents to continue working with previously created files in later conversations.

**For example**, an agent can create a competitor research document during one conversation and use that file again in a later task.

### **Supported Execution Types**

Computer currently supports:

- Direct Managed Agent chat conversations.
- Manual agent runs.
- Testing through the available agent testing interface.

Computer is not currently supported for trigger-based executions, including workflow-triggered runs.

Other Managed Agent capabilities may support automated triggers independently of Computer.

---

## **How to Set Up Computer for Managed Agents**

Properly configuring Computer ensures that your Managed Agent has access to the tools it needs while maintaining appropriate approvals for sensitive operations. The following steps explain how to enable Computer, configure its tools, test a task, and handle requests that require attention.

### **Step 1: Open Agent Studio**

1. Log in to your HighLevel sub-account.
2. Navigate to **AI Agents**.
3. Select **Agent Studio**.
4. Open the **Managed Agents** tab.
5. Select an existing Managed Agent or create a new one.

If you need help creating an agent, see [Setup and Use Managed Agents in Agent Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007931-important-update-agent-studio-is-evolving).

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084069309/original/_bVAf_yywhauPRGjl2JKApAGvvt5nvgh_Q.png?1792762314)**

### **Step 2: Enable Computer**

1. Open the Managed Agent you want to configure.
2. Locate **Capabilities** in the agent configuration panel.
3. Find **Computer (NEW)**.
4. Enable the Computer toggle.

When Computer is enabled, additional configuration options appear beneath it.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084069480/original/O58XlMo4pjciQjc8VAVX6BH4BFmLL7PfGA.png?1792762421)**

### **Step 3: Choose Computer Tools**

Under **What This Agent May Use**, configure which computer tools the agent can access.

1. Enable **Browser** if the agent needs to navigate websites, interact with pages, or fill out forms.
2. Enable **Files** if the agent needs to create, read, or modify workspace files.
3. Enable **Terminal** if the agent needs to execute scripts or terminal commands.

Only enable the tools required for the agent's tasks.

For example, an agent that researches competitor prices and creates comparison documents may need Browser and Files without requiring Terminal.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084069557/original/MXsAUAquzVQRJzXI31dTUCSWfi47UvUOaQ.png?1792762470)**

### 

### **Step 4: Configure Ask Before Permissions**

1. Locate the **Ask Me Before** settings under Computer.
2. Review the available actions requiring approval.
3. Configure the approval requirements based on your agent's responsibilities.
4. Keep additional approval requirements enabled for actions that should be reviewed before execution.

Available controls include:

- Submitting forms.
- Payments or purchases.
- Sending emails or messages.
- Publishing or going live.
- Deleting files or records.
- Downloading files.
- Visiting a new website.

Payments and deletions always require approval.

### **Step 5: Test the Agent**

After configuring Computer:

1. Select **Test Agent**, or open the agent's chat interface.
2. Enter a task that requires one or more enabled Computer tools.
3. Send the instruction.
4. Monitor the agent's activity in the conversation.

For example:

*"Research the prices of three competing products, compare their features, and create a spreadsheet summarizing the results."*

The agent may open websites, collect information, and generate a file, depending on its available tools and permissions.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084069834/original/yg4F9GO1-_a_GhmMgvNpdWJdx_JSmCgyUw.png?1792762573)**

### **Step 6: Review and Respond to Approval Requests**

If the agent needs approval:

1. Review the request in the conversation.
2. Open **Waiting on You** if necessary.
3. Confirm the requested action is appropriate.
4. Approve or decline the request.
5. If authentication is required, select **Add login** and enter credentials using the secure form.

After the necessary approval or input is provided, the agent can continue.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084069877/original/U_7l6y_5vecyu_FZfRsp9i6V5AVgsU2i5Q.png?1792762612)**

### 

### **Step 7: Review the Results and **Publish the Agent****

After the agent completes its task:

1. Review the agent's response.
2. Inspect any generated documents, spreadsheets, or reports.
3. Verify important information before using it in business decisions.
4. Review available Browser activity or task history if additional context is needed.
5. Provide follow-up instructions to refine the result.
6. Select **Publish** if the agent has not already been published.

For example:

*"Update the comparison spreadsheet to include product ratings and highlight the lowest-priced option."*

The agent can continue working with the available computer tools and workspace files.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084070099/original/p45c-1pc7AO2VLkWWiai1hr5yso78Aif5Q.png?1792762743)**

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can Computer run automatically when a workflow trigger fires?**

No. Computer currently supports chat and manual runs only. Although Managed Agents can support workflow and event-driven triggers for other capabilities, Computer is not available during trigger-based executions.

**Q: Can multiple Managed Agents use Computer?**

Yes. Each sub-account has one computer shared by its Managed Agents. The release does not specify how simultaneous computer operations are scheduled, so concurrent task behavior should not be assumed.

**Q: What happens if an agent needs to sign in to a website?**

The agent can request a secure sign-in. You can open the request, provide credentials through the protected form, and allow the agent to continue after authentication succeeds. Passwords should not be entered directly into chat.

**Q: Can I take control of the browser while an agent is working?**

Yes. When browser activity is displayed, select Take control to interact with the browser directly. This is useful for reviewing a website or completing a step that requires manual intervention.

**Q: What happens if I don't approve a requested action?**

The agent cannot complete the action that requires your approval. The request may remain pending until you respond, and the agent's progress on that part of the task may be blocked.

**Q: Will my files disappear when the computer goes to sleep?**

No. Computer preserves workspace files when it automatically sleeps, allowing them to remain available when the computer resumes.

**Q: Can I enable Browser without enabling Terminal?**

Yes. Browser, Files, and Terminal are configurable individually. You can enable only the tools needed for your agent's tasks.

**Q: Why does my agent display Waiting on You?**

Waiting on You indicates that the agent requires additional input, authentication, or approval before continuing an action. Open the pending request to review what is needed.

**Q: Are Computer Files the same as files attached to a Managed Agent conversation?**

No. Computer Files are used to create and manage files within the shared computer workspace. Chat file support allows users to attach supported documents and images to conversations for analysis. The two features have different purposes.

**Q: Can Computer replace MCP connectors?**

Not in every situation. Computer allows agents to interact with websites through a browser, while MCP connectors provide defined tools for integrating with supported external applications. The best option depends on the task and the available integration.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Setup and Use Managed Agents in Agent Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007931-important-update-agent-studio-is-evolving)
- [Managed Agents File Support](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009017-managed-agents-file-support)
- [MCP Connectors for Managed Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008304-mcp-connectors)
- [Managed Agent Activity Feed](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008415)
- [How to Invoke Managed Agents from HighLevel Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008858-workflow-action-invoke-managed-agent)
- [Manage Agency User Roles and Permissions in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002543-how-to-manage-agency-user-roles-and-permissions-in-highlevel)

title_en: How to set up the Client Portal?
source_md:
The client portal is a unified platform designed to provide seamless interactions between clients and their respective sub-accounts. It offers a secure space where clients can view affiliate commissions, participate in community (upcoming) groups, and enroll in membership courses. Through this innovation, businesses can boost customer retention and offer superior service, empowering clients to take necessary actions independently.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Client Portal?](#What-is-the-Client-Portal?)
  - [What are some strong usage cases for this feature?](#What-are-some-strong-usage-cases-for-this-feature?)
  - [What are some benefits of this feature?](#What-are-some-benefits-of-this-feature?)
- [How to set up your client portal?](#How-to-set-up-your-client-portal?)
- [Configuring a custom Domain:](#Configuring-a-custom-Domain%3A)
- [Branding your Client Portal:](#Branding-your-Client-Portal%3A)
- [Set a Default Language (Optional)](#Set-a-Default-Language-(Optional))
- [Invite Clients to your client portal.](#Invite-Clients-to-your-client-portal.)
- [Configure Google Sign-In](#Configure-Google-Sign-In)
- [FAQs](#FAQs)

---

## **What is the Client Portal?**

The client portal is a client-side interface located on the subdomain clientclub.net. It's a centralized platform designed to allow clients and leads to interact with their respective sub-accounts in a streamlined manner.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155001303871/original/rp92ZFYpGylrXy4YqM0xx7AiGLjp2gjPxw.png?1687171974)

**Centralized Platform:** The portal is a hub where clients can access their affiliate commissions, participate in community (upcoming) groups (**upcoming)**, and enroll in membership courses. Having all of these functionalities in one place makes it easy for clients to manage their interactions with your business and services.

**Custom Domains:** The portal offers the flexibility to set up a custom domain for each sub-account for a more personalized touch. This feature enhances the client's sense of ownership and can increase their engagement with your service.

**Brandable Interface:** The portal can be customized to reflect each sub-accounts brand identity. By setting up their preferred logo, favicon, color scheme, and more, sub-accounts can provide a consistent and familiar experience to their leads and clients.

**Improved Communication and Client Autonomy:** The portal facilitates easy and secure communication between you and your clients. Moreover, it empowers your clients by allowing them to take necessary actions independently. This level of autonomy can lead to increased client satisfaction and retention.

**Easy Invitation:** The client portal provides easy ways to invite clients through child apps or by sharing the portal URL directly.

---

### **What are some strong usage cases for this feature?**

**1. Online Education Business (E-Learning Platforms):** If a business offers a variety of online courses across different subjects, the client portal allows students (clients) to access their courses, track their progress, and interact with other students in the community (upcoming) groups. It simplifies the learning process and fosters a sense of community (upcoming) among students.

**2. Software as a Service (SaaS) Companies: For a SaaS company with an affiliate marketing program, the client portal provides affiliates with a single platform to monito**r their referrals and commissions. This transparency can motivate affiliates to promote the software more enthusiastically.

**3. Fitness Industry (Online Training Programs):**If a fitness business offers different online training programs, the client portal can be used for members to access their specific workout plans, participate in fitness communities, and view their progress over time.

**4. Marketing Agencies:** For a marketing agency that manages several clients (each being a sub-account), each client could have their custom domain in the client portal. This allows the clients to feel more ownership over their data and campaigns and streamlines the communication process between the agency and its clients.

**5. Retail E-commerce Businesses:** An e-commerce business can use the client portal to invite loyal customers to a VIP program. The customers can log in to view exclusive offers, track their points or rewards, and participate in special community (upcoming) events.

**6. Event Planning Companies:** Event planning companies can customize their client portal according to each event's branding. Clients can access event-related documents and updates and communicate directly with the planners.

---

### **What are some benefits of this feature?**

**1. Streamlined Access to Information:** By centralizing all key functions and data (like affiliate commissions, community (upcoming) groups, and membership courses) in one place, clients can easily find and access the information they need without navigating through multiple platforms or interfaces.

**2. Improved Client Autonomy:**Clients have the flexibility and power to take action independently. This can lead to increased satisfaction as clients can solve problems or answer their questions without needing to reach out for support.

**3. Enhanced Client Engagement:**Exploring community (upcoming) groups can facilitate better client engagement, making them feel more connected to your service. This sense of community (upcoming) can increase client loyalty and retention.

**4. Consistent Brand Experience:** The branding feature allows businesses to provide a consistent brand experience across all client interactions. Consistency is key to building a strong brand identity, which can further enhance client trust and loyalty.

**5. Easier Client Onboarding:**The client portal simplifies the onboarding process. Instead of sending multiple emails or using multiple platforms, you can invite clients to the portal, where they can find everything they need.

**6. Increased Credibility with Custom Domains:** A custom domain not only gives clients a sense of ownership and familiarity but also increases the credibility of the sub-account in the eyes of the clients.

**7. Efficient Communication:**With a client portal, communication with clients becomes more efficient as you can reach them all in one place, and they can access and respond to the communication at their convenience.

---

## **How to set up your client portal?**

We have implemented a robust client portal system for each sub-account on our dedicated subdomain, clientclub.net. This portal facilitates effective interaction between clients and their associated accounts. However, during the setup process, we offer a flexible feature for each sub-account to personalize its portal by selecting a unique custom domain. This customization allows sub-accounts to reinforce their branding and enhance their client's familiarity with the platform.

To configure a custom domain for your client portal, follow these steps:

Using the left sidebar, navigate to the Memberships tab then open the Client Portal section from the top and select Settings. Proceed to the "Domain Setup." area.

1. ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062739609/original/abS2G3u9bU8x1jbioBIFheo1JVkP05Ly2Q.png?1768483661)
3. Click on the option for a Custom domain and input your desired domain name.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062740344/original/MPaxvmdkkjNsXs0QogGSZ0ngXM5GXj9GAQ.png?1768483832)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062740495/original/RT1GQguoVYLYKVHNMYOYyziItKbKiqEFhg.gif?1768483921)

Before you can successfully set up an A or CNAME record, you must ensure that you have already configured your domain registrar to point to the specific IP address or server provided to you. This is an essential step in ensuring that your domain correctly refers to your server, enabling it to function properly.

A Record, also known as an Address Record, maps your domain to an individual server IP address. On the other hand, a CNAME record, or Canonical Name record, is used to map your domain (or subdomain) to another domain name.

Here's a step-by-step guide on how to add A records and CNAME records:

- Login to your Domain Registrar's dashboard.
- Navigate to the DNS settings.
- Here, you will find an option to add a new record.
- Select the type of record you want to add (A or CNAME).
- Enter the details - for an A record, this would be the IP address **162.159.140.166**
- ; for a CNAME record, this would be the target domain **[preview.clientclub.net](//preview.clientclub.net)**
- Save your changes.

Different registrars might have slight variations in the procedure, so here are some specific guides for popular registrars:

[GoDaddy](https://www.godaddy.com/help/add-an-a-record-19238)

[NameCheap](https://www.namecheap.com/support/knowledgebase/article.aspx/319/2237/how-can-i-set-up-an-a-address-record-for-my-domain/)

[Bluehost](https://www.bluehost.com/help/article/dns-management-adding-an-a-record)

[HostGator](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/how-to-manage-dns-records)

[Google Domains](https://support.google.com/domains/answer/3290350)

**Please note:**

```
It's important to replace the "designated IP address or server" placeholder with your actual IP address or server information in the record. Make sure to fill out this field accurately, as it's essential to correctly configure your domain settings.
```

Once you have entered the DNS records in your Domain registrar, give it a reasonable time to propagate them (depending on your domain registrar), and hit **Update Domain.**

**Once** you update your Client Portal subdomain or custom domain, visitors who use the previous domain see a domain update notice with a link to the new domain. HighLevel also redirects visitors to the updated domain automatically after 30 seconds.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155002194359/original/U4mvBT_4NGPmvVWz7o4MuO9Ngqxz9gW3bQ.png?1688403918)

**Please note:**

```
While the following resources provide a good general overview, the exact time of DNS propagation can vary due to several factors, such as the TTL set for the DNS record, your ISP's update frequency, and geographical factors. Typically, it is suggested to allow between 24 to 48 hours for DNS propagation.  
  
Siteground: "Understand DNS Propagation & Why it Takes so Long"  
GoDaddy: "What factors affect DNS propagation time? | Domains"  
HostGator: "Propagation Times | HostGator Support"  
DomainKing.NG: "DNS Propagation – how long does it take?"  
AccuWeb Hosting: "How long Nameservers propagation could take after ..."  
Namecheap: "DNS Propagation – Explained - Domains"  
Webcentral: "What is the standard DNS propagation period?"
```

### **Start the Migration from Courses Settings**

Migrating from Legacy Memberships to Client Portal gives you access to a more unified setup experience for courses and memberships. The updated settings UI also makes migration prompts easier to find and follow.

To start the migration:

1. Go to **Memberships**.

2. Open **Courses**.

3. Navigate to the settings area for your site.

4. Review the migration message shown in the settings interface.

5. Follow the on-screen steps to move to Client Portal settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071114382/original/D3uWvZ2W3EAINr4yUle-PXK3rAysTXgweg.png?1778579784)

```
Note: Review your branding, domain, email settings, and app settings after migration to confirm everything matches your current setup.
```

---

### **Branding your Client Portal:**

**Access the Client Portal Section:** Start by navigating to the client portal section within your account. This is typically accessed via the left navigation menu when logged into a sub-account.

**Go to Branding Option**: You'll find various options once you're in the client portal section. Locate and select the "Branding" option to begin personalizing your portal.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062741113/original/z0hKBwpmucrVqnU1S3HqqDB8fWS9zx_xOg.png?1768484111)

**Customize the Portal's Appearance:**Within the "Branding" section, you can fully customize the look and feel of your client portal. Here are the options available:  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062742112/original/oQ0XbPtoseJNZhH239y3TNb-LnqN_HAqOw.gif?1768484453)

- | Setting | Description |
  | --- | --- |
  | Portal Name | Enter a name for your portal. This is the name that will be displayed prominently on your portal. |
  | Portal Description | Add a description for your portal. This description will be visible to your clients and should briefly describe your portal or its services. |
  | Brand Color One | Choose the primary color to represent your brand in the portal. This color is often used for buttons, headings, or highlights. |
  | Brand Color Two | Choose a secondary color to complement your primary color. This adds depth and variety to your portal's color scheme. |
  | Favicon | Upload a favicon for your portal. Favicons are small icons that appear in the tab of a browser when your website is open. They should ideally be in a 1:1 aspect ratio, in SVG, PNG, or JPG format, with maximum dimensions of 16x16 pixels. |
  | Portal Image | The "Portal Image" section in the Client Portal allows you to upload your brand's square (1:1 aspect ratio) image in SVG, PNG, or JPG formats. The image dimensions should not exceed 720x720 pixels. This image will serve as the main branding image in your Client Portal. |
  | Logo | Upload your brand logo to be displayed on the portal. Like favicons, logos should be in a 1:1 aspect ratio, in SVG, PNG, or JPG format, with maximum dimensions of 200x200 pixels. |
  | Support Email | Specify an email address your customers can contact for support or questions related to the portal. |
  | Copy Right | You can enter copyright information here. This is typically something like "© 2023 Your Company Name." It helps protect your content and establishes your company's claim over the content. |
  | Save Settings | After making all the desired changes, don't forget to click "Save Settings" to ensure your customizations are applied to your client portal. If you change your mind or need to revert to the old settings, click "Cancel" before saving the settings. |

---

## **Set a Default Language (Optional)**

If you serve users in multiple regions, you can set a default language for your Client Portal.

1. Go to Memberships → ClientPortal → Settings → Language Settings  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063057428/original/14mCWU18cuShtEysr8XzxzqD7QtIq4hu7A.png?1768911345)
2. Select a language, and click Save.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063057820/original/yKY_rITlQPlm7S1RaeHF3ZemxTcX1E1Lng.png?1768911496)
3. Users can still change their own language within the Client Portal from Manage your Account → Language Settings.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063057690/original/6BXQ0xEuWQh6ZCMYHilyWJpoTiRMzOIOnw.gif?1768911475)

---

## **Invite Clients to your client portal.**

Inviting clients to your client portal enhances their experience with your services and fosters a sense of community (upcoming). The client portal serves as a central location for your clients to access important information, updates, and resources pertinent to the services they've availed of from your business. There are two primary methods to invite your clients to the portal:

### **Direct Invitation from Child Applications**

Your portal includes various child applications or services, such as a membership course, community (upcoming) platform, affiliate program, etc. You can extend invitations directly from these specific applications.

**Membership Course:**Existing membership users will have dual accessibility - they can access courses through the traditional method as well as through the client portal upon login. Their current username and password will function in both locations. For those locations with no existing courses, they will need to set up directly in the client portal.

**Community Platform:** (Upcoming)

**Affiliate Program:** You can extend an invitation from the affiliate management system for your affiliates. Head to Marketing> Affiliate Manager> Campaigns> Edit Campaign.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155001318387/original/upkSYyrFfH_LRVUXMfqyPhguj0HIri-VZw.png?1687180644)

Copy the signup link to share with people you want to invite:

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155001318314/original/XgGvnTUxW2C63w34b-1nkipEtNj4qimPww.png?1687180613)

This enables them to sign up as an Affiliate and access all their affiliate-related information through the client portal, such as their referral links, commission rates, and earnings.

**Sharing the Client Portal URL**

If you want to take a more direct approach or invite a large number of clients at once, you can share the URL of your client portal. You can easily copy this URL from the domain setup section of your client portal's settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155001319106/original/_99A6KgauydPRZ4sAlQsshsFoatrEZ3VVg.png?1687181017)

Once copied, this URL can be shared via email, text message, or any other communication channels you use to interact with your clients.

You might consider incorporating this URL into a welcome email or newsletter for new clients or posting it in an announcement on your main website or social media platforms.

Remember, your client portal is a hub for all your services. So, when sharing the URL, make sure to highlight the benefits and resources clients will gain by accessing the portal. This could include exclusive content, direct support channels, access to community (upcoming) discussions, and more.

---

## **Configure Google Sign-In**

Sub-account admins can control whether the **Sign in with Google** option appears on the Client Portal sign-up and login pages.

To manage this setting:

1. Go to **Client Portal settings** in the appropriate sub-account.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077252276/original/hTGW8HpqVPk_kl7a5BEN-3ZJH47ix0mcKQ.png?1785419157)
2. Open **App Permissions**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077252377/original/zrgp7yPeFOMVgTdHVxzxcaNfqSF2RAMPIQ.gif?1785419187)
3. Turn **Google Sign-In** on or off.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077252390/original/fdboWxsMmbqb4-lgXxwK1D06S0F8HDRceg.png?1785419201)
4. Save your changes.

When Google Sign-In is disabled, contacts can continue to access the Client Portal using email and password or a secure code.

This setting applies separately to each sub-account and is available on the Client Portal web platform.

```
Note: Removing Google Sign-In can help businesses align their authentication options with internal privacy, data-handling, or regional requirements. This setting does not by itself guarantee regulatory compliance.
```

---

## **FAQs**

**Q1: I've branded my client portal, but the changes aren't showing up. What could be the issue?**

Answer: It might be due to cache issues. Try clearing your browser's cache or try to view the portal in an incognito window. If the issue persists, please get in touch with our support team.

**Q2: Can I set different branding for different sub-accounts in the client portal?**

Answer: You can set individual branding for each sub-account within your client portal. This feature allows you to tailor the visual elements of each sub-account portal, such as logos and color schemes, to represent its specific brand identity best. To do this, you must navigate to the sub-account, access the "Branding" option, and customize it as your preference.

**Q3: My affiliates are having trouble accessing their stats on the client portal. What should I do?**

Answer: Ensure that the affiliates have the correct login details. Also, check if you've given them the right permissions to access their stats. If the problem continues, contact our support team for further assistance.

**Q4: I've set up the DNS records for my client portal correctly, but it's not accessible. Why?**

Answer: DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate across the internet. It may not be reflected immediately if you've just recently made changes. If it takes longer than 48 hours, please get in touch with your domain registrar for support.

**Q5: I want to customize the favicon for my client portal, but it's not uploading. What's the ideal format and size for the favicon?**

Answer: The recommended aspect ratio for the favicon is 1:1. The favicon should be in SVG, PNG, or JPG format and not exceed 16x16 pixels. If your favicon meets these specifications and you're still facing issues, please get in touch with our support team.

title_en: AI Tools in HighLevel
source_md:
AI Tools • Agents • Automation • Content

AI Tools in HighLevel

HighLevel includes AI tools for internal productivity, customer conversations, phone calls, autonomous agents, workflows, websites, email, content, reputation management, and knowledge-based answers. This guide explains the current AI product lineup, what each tool is designed to do, and how to choose the right option for your use case.

What You'll Learn

Learn which AI products are currently available in HighLevel, how Ask AI, Conversation AI, Voice AI, Managed Agents, Agent Studio, Workflow AI, AI Studio, and the content tools differ, and where to review setup and pricing details.

Important: Features and Pricing Can Change

Some AI products are included with fair-use limits, some are covered by AI Employee Starter, Growth or Unlimited, and others are billed at token cost or by usage.

Before quoting pricing or enabling a client-facing plan, review the current [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing) article and the pricing shown in your HighLevel account.

# What Are AI Tools in HighLevel?

HighLevel AI tools help users create, communicate, automate, analyze, and take action across the platform. Some tools are designed for logged-in team members, while others interact directly with leads and customers or run automatically when a business event occurs.

The current AI ecosystem includes in-app copilots, customer-facing chat and voice agents, agent-building platforms, workflow-generation tools, website and email builders, content and review tools, prompt-testing utilities, and a centralized Knowledge Base used by supported AI products.

## Key Benefits of HighLevel AI

Using the right AI product can reduce repetitive work while improving how teams create assets, respond to customers, manage data, and build automation.

- **Faster Creation:** Generate workflows, websites, emails, social content, images, and other assets from prompts.
- **Scalable Customer Engagement:** Use Conversation AI and Voice AI to support customer conversations, qualification, and appointment booking.
- **Autonomous Operations:** Use Managed Agents to respond to business events and perform supported CRM or connected-app actions.
- **Grounded Answers:** Connect supported AI tools to a Knowledge Base containing approved business information.
- **Safer Testing:** Use Prompt Optimizers, previews, testing panels, and version history before changing production behavior.
- **Flexible Adoption:** Choose free, included, subscription-based, or pay-per-use AI products according to the location's needs.

## Current HighLevel AI Feature List

The products below match the current feature inventory used in HighLevel's AI Product Pricing documentation. Availability, plan coverage, and limits can differ by feature.

| AI Product | Primary Purpose | Typical Starting Point |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Ask AI** | In-app copilot for questions, content, data retrieval, and supported platform actions | A logged-in user enters a typed or spoken prompt |
| **Conversation AI** | Customer-facing conversations, qualification, FAQs, and booking | A lead or customer sends a message on a supported channel |
| **Conversation AI Prompt Optimizer** | Scenario-based testing and prompt improvement for Conversation AI agents | A user configures test scenarios and runs simulated customer chats |
| **Voice AI** | Inbound, outbound, and widget-based voice conversations | A phone call, outbound action, or voice widget interaction |
| **Voice AI Prompt Optimizer** | Real-call testing, evaluation, and prompt optimization for Voice AI | A user runs scenario-based test calls |
| **Agent Studio** | Maintain and optimize existing flow-based agents, tools, routing, testing, and versions | A user opens an existing flow-based agent |
| **Managed Agents** | Natural-language creation of autonomous CRM agents | A user describes the agent's job, triggers, data, and actions |
| **Workflow AI** | Generate, explain, and edit workflows using natural language | A user enters a workflow-building or editing prompt |
| **Funnel & Website AI** | Generate and refine funnel or website pages inside the standard builder | A user chooses Assist, Build, a URL, or an image reference |
| **Email AI** | Create brand-aware email designs, copy, and layouts | A user starts from a prompt or visual reference in Email Marketing |
| **Knowledge Base** | Store approved source material for supported AI retrieval | An admin adds websites, FAQs, files, tables, or rich text |
| **Content AI** | Generate and refine text and images across supported content surfaces | A user enters a content prompt in a supported builder |
| **Reviews AI** | Suggest, automate, and manage review responses and review insights | A new review arrives or a review campaign runs |
| **AI Studio** | Create websites, landing pages, forms, booking experiences, and interactive web projects | A user starts a dedicated AI Studio project from a prompt, template, or reference |

## Which AI Tool Should You Use?

The fastest way to choose a product is to identify who initiates the activity and whether the task is a one-time request, a live customer conversation, or an autonomous business process.

| Use Case | Recommended Tool | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Complete a one-time task inside HighLevel | **Ask AI** | A logged-in user asks the copilot to create, retrieve, summarize, or update supported data and assets. |
| Reply to leads on messaging channels | **Conversation AI** | It is designed for live customer-facing conversations, qualification, and booking. |
| Answer or make phone calls with AI | **Voice AI** | It handles spoken conversations, phone actions, and call outcomes. |
| Run a multi-step business process when a CRM event occurs | **Managed Agents** | Managed Agents can act autonomously based on triggers, Knowledge Bases, CRM tools, and connectors. |
| Maintain or troubleshoot an existing flow-based agent | **Agent Studio** | The visual canvas exposes the existing agent's nodes, routing, variables, tools, versions, and tests. |
| Generate or edit a standard workflow | **Workflow AI** | It converts plain-language requests into workflow triggers, actions, settings, and edits. |
| Create a website, page, form, or interactive front-end project | **AI Studio** | It provides a dedicated conversational workspace for generating and publishing web experiences. |

## AI Assistants and Customer-Facing Agents

These products help users complete work directly or engage leads and customers through messaging and phone conversations.

### Ask AI

Ask AI is HighLevel's built-in copilot for logged-in users. It can answer questions, retrieve platform data, create content and assets, manage supported records, run bulk actions, and coordinate supported tasks across many HighLevel modules through typed or voice prompts.

[Learn more about Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005327-ask-ai-assistant)

![Ask AI panel open in HighLevel](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080913849/original/2oWfK5EM31BGsG3091yZRSb2aCcOu5t90Q.png?1789424545)

### Conversation AI

Conversation AI is a customer-facing messaging agent. It can answer questions, qualify leads, collect information, assist with appointment booking, and respond on supported communication channels. Response modes include Off, Suggestive, and Auto-Pilot, allowing teams to choose between manual review and automated handling.

[Learn more about Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001335-conversation-ai-bot-explained)

### Conversation AI Prompt Optimizer

Prompt Optimizer tests a cloned Conversation AI agent against realistic scenarios without changing the production prompt. It runs customer-style chats, evaluates outcomes, creates prompt variations, and shows a prompt comparison before an approved version is applied. **Availability:** Labs.

[Learn more about Conversation AI Prompt Optimizer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008435-test-optimize-conversations-ai-agents-with-prompt-optimizer)

![Conversation AI Prompt Optimizer showing test scenarios and the production prompt](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078246509/original/YhVLptu1ZcKBi9gEXGBb3wAsWDwxbA9pUg.png?1786541413=)

### Voice AI

Voice AI uses AI-powered voice agents to answer inbound calls, place supported outbound calls, collect information, qualify leads, book appointments, use business knowledge, and trigger supported actions. Voice AI can also support multilingual conversations, working hours, transfers, analytics, recordings, and call logs.

[Learn more about Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003911-overview-of-voice-ai-agents)

### Voice AI Prompt Optimizer

Voice AI Prompt Optimizer runs real scenario-based test calls, evaluates expected outcomes, records tool activity, and generates prompt variations. The live agent remains unchanged until a user reviews the results and selects **Use Prompt**.

[Learn more about Voice AI Prompt Optimizer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007781-voice-ai-prompt-optimizer)

## AI Agent Builders and Autonomous Agents

HighLevel provides both a conversational agent-building experience and a visual flow environment. Choose the approach that matches how much manual control you need.

### Managed Agents

Managed Agents, formerly Super Agents, let users create autonomous CRM agents by describing the desired role in plain language. HighLevel generates the underlying configuration, including triggers, Knowledge Base access, CRM actions, and supported connected tools. Users can refine the agent through conversation, test it, and publish it when ready.

[Learn more about Managed Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007931-setup-and-use-managed-agents-in-agent-studio)

### Agent Studio

Agent Studio is the visual, node-based environment for maintaining existing flow-based AI agents. It supports node editing, Knowledge Base and web-search tools, APIs, MCP tools, conditional routing, variables, testing, and version control.

**Current direction:** Managed Agents is the recommended experience for creating new agents. Agent Studio remains available for editing, testing, and maintaining existing flow-based agents.

[Learn more about flow-based agents in Agent Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006058-overview-of-flow-agents-in-agent-studio)

![Agent Studio dashboard showing existing flow-based AI agents](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080914026/original/liu7zatObodXc6FxF3jUs56JtAVwOY7JZA.png?1789425237)

## AI for Workflows and Automation

Workflow AI helps users build and modify standard workflows faster, while specific Workflow AI actions and external models can add AI reasoning or content generation inside an automation.

### Workflow AI Builder

Workflow AI Builder converts a plain-language goal into a complete workflow with triggers, actions, and structure. Users can refine the result through conversational edits, point-and-edit controls, follow-up prompts, and supported workflow-setting updates.

[Learn more about Workflow AI Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006100-workflow-ai-builder)
