![Workflow AI prompt used to generate an automation](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055142837/original/y7JgKdDfHRoaAODfK9MqJSw4RRPHKY6SNQ.png?1759471506=)

### Workflow AI Actions and External Models

Workflow AI also includes specialized actions such as Decision Maker, Intent Detection, Summarize Text, and Translate. These actions can be priced separately from the free Workflow AI Builder experience. External models used through workflow actions are billed according to the applicable model or provider.

**Do not treat all Workflow AI usage as one pricing category.** Workflow AI Builder and Generate with AI can be included with fair-use limits, while premium actions and external models may have separate charges.

## AI for Websites, Email, and Content

HighLevel provides different AI creation experiences depending on whether you are building within an existing module or creating a broader interactive project.

### Funnel & Website AI

Funnel & Website AI creates and edits pages inside the standard builder using guided inputs, prompts, links, or image references. Users can refine pages through chat and review AI-assisted SEO suggestions before publishing. **Availability:** Labs.

[Learn more about Funnel & Website AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006713-funnel-website-ai)

### Email AI

Email AI is a guided, brand-aware experience inside Email Marketing. It can use Brand Board styling, generate an email from a prompt or reference, recommend layouts, support conversational edits, and preserve version history. **Availability:** Labs.

[Learn more about Email AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007382-email-ai-beta-2-0-create-on-brand-emails-faster)

![Build with AI button in Email Marketing templates](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065199293/original/uZ2rtDWlz88D37xMqkjNzT4nX5I2Jv-oHA.png?1771430121=)

### Content AI

Content AI generates and refines text and images across supported HighLevel content surfaces. Common uses include social posts, blogs, emails, website copy, headlines, and marketing assets. The available controls and placement depend on the builder where Content AI is used.

[See Content AI in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001234788-content-ai-with-social-planner)  |  [Create blog posts with AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007201-create-blog-posts-with-ai)

### AI Studio

AI Studio is a conversational workspace for building websites, landing pages, forms, booking experiences, and interactive web projects. It can generate layouts, copy, images, and code-level changes, then publish to a preview or custom domain. **Availability:** Labs.

[Learn more about AI Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007587-ai-studio-in-highlevel)

![AI Studio project preview and conversational editing workspace](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080913871/original/v2M_E0UOC3OLD7fupS3u2jE30e9jYoNFFw.png?1789424677)

**AI Studio and Agent Studio are separate products.** AI Studio creates web experiences. Agent Studio manages AI agent logic and tools.

## Knowledge Base and Reviews AI

The Knowledge Base gives supported AI products approved business context, while Reviews AI helps businesses manage and understand customer feedback.

### Knowledge Base

The Knowledge Base is the centralized area for managing AI-ready source content. Supported sources include websites, FAQs, tables, rich text, and uploaded files. AI products that use Knowledge Base retrieval can search these sources to provide more grounded, business-specific answers.

[Learn more about the Knowledge Base](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007313-knowledge-base-overview)

![Knowledge Base list inside AI Agents](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064136657/original/6ooslFQimk6WrEIkHqChnotL_589gmdrTA.png?1770184623=)

### Reviews AI

Reviews AI helps teams generate suggested responses or automate review replies. Drip Mode can process older unreplied reviews gradually instead of publishing a large backlog at once.

[Learn more about Reviews AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001074-maximizing-customer-engagement-with-reviews-ai-a-guide-to-suggestive-and-auto-pilot-modes)

## AI Plans, Pricing, and Availability

HighLevel AI is available through Pay-Per-Use, AI Employee Starter, AI Employee Growth, and AI Employee Unlimited. Some products are included on every plan, while others have monthly allowances, fair-use coverage, or token-based charges. For details on pricing for AI products and plans, see [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006652)

For agency access, rebilling, and reselling instructions, see [AI Employee: Access, Rebilling and Reselling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003906-ai-employee-access-rebilling-and-reselling).

## How To Get Started with HighLevel AI

A structured rollout helps ensure the AI product matches the business goal, has the right data and permissions, and performs safely before it reaches customers or runs automatically.

1. **Define the job.** Decide whether the goal is content creation, internal assistance, customer messaging, phone automation, workflow building, or autonomous task execution.
2. **Select the product.** Use the comparison table in this article to choose the tool designed for that job.
3. **Confirm access.** Check user permissions, plan coverage, Labs requirements, phone requirements, connected channels, and any required integrations.
4. **Prepare business context.** Configure Brand Voice, Knowledge Bases, prompts, approved content, calendars, workflows, and connected tools as needed.
5. **Review pricing.** Confirm current plan inclusions, limits, overages, token costs, and separate communication charges.
6. **Test with sample data.** Use available previews, Prompt Optimizers, testing panels, test contacts, and non-production resources.
7. **Monitor and improve.** Review logs, transcripts, recordings, execution history, generated assets, and customer outcomes after launch.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What AI tools does HighLevel currently offer?

The current pricing inventory includes Ask AI, Conversation AI, both Conversation and Voice Prompt Optimizers, Voice AI, Agent Studio, Managed Agents, Workflow AI, Funnel & Website AI, Email AI, Knowledge Base, Content AI, Reviews AI, and AI Studio.

Q: What is the difference between Ask AI, Conversation AI, and Managed Agents?

Ask AI is a user-initiated in-app copilot. Conversation AI handles live lead and customer conversations. Managed Agents run custom, event-driven business processes with a higher level of autonomy.

Q: What is the difference between AI Studio and Agent Studio?

AI Studio builds websites, pages, forms, and other web experiences. Agent Studio manages visual AI agent logic, tools, routing, variables, testing, and versions.

Q: Which tool can create a workflow from a prompt?

Workflow AI Builder can generate a complete workflow from a natural-language request and then refine it through conversational or targeted edits.

Q: Which AI tools can use a Knowledge Base?

Supported tools such as Conversation AI, Voice AI, Agent Studio, and Managed Agents can retrieve approved source content from a connected Knowledge Base. Availability depends on the product and configuration.

Q: Is every AI tool included with AI Employee Unlimited?

No. Unlimited includes expanded or unlimited coverage for selected products, but Agent Studio remains pay-per-use and other products have their own allowances, run limits, or usage windows.

Q: Are Workflow AI and external AI models the same thing?

No. Workflow AI Builder is HighLevel's native workflow-generation and editing experience. External models are selected through specific workflow actions or integrations and can have separate provider-based charges.

Q: Why might an AI feature not appear in my account?

The feature may require a specific user permission, plan, Labs toggle, sub-account setting, phone provider, connected channel, or staged rollout. Review the product-specific setup article for exact requirements.

Q: Should AI-generated content and actions be reviewed?

Yes. Review prompts, generated content, customer-facing answers, tool permissions, actions, links, pricing claims, and business information before publishing or enabling automated behavior.

Q: Where can I find the latest AI pricing?

Use the [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing) article and confirm the current in-app pricing before quoting costs or configuring client billing.

title_en: Restaurant Reservations: Manage Bookings, Tables, and Guests
source_md:
Reservations in HighLevel helps restaurants manage table bookings, seat walk-in guests, and track dining activity from a single place. Your team can monitor table availability, manage guest reservations, take dine-in orders, and collect payments without switching between multiple systems. Once your restaurant website is published, guests can also book tables online.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is Reservations?](#What-Is-Reservations?)
- [Key Benefits of Reservations](#Key-Benefits-of-Reservations)
- [Before You Start](#Before-You-Start)
- [Understanding Reservation Views](#Understanding-Reservation-Views)
- [How to Create and Manage Reservations](#How-to-Create-and-Manage-Reservations)
- [Understand Booking Statuses](#Understand-Booking-Statuses)
- [Take Dine-In Orders and Collect Payments](#Take-Dine-In-Orders-and-Collect-Payments)
- [Let Guests Book Online](#Let-Guests-Book-Online)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is Reservations?**

Reservations is the restaurant's front-of-house management system in HighLevel. It connects guest bookings to the tables in your restaurant's floor layout, making it easier to manage availability and seating throughout the day.

Each reservation also provides access to guest details, order history, payment information, and booking activity, helping your team manage the entire dining experience.

---

## **Key Benefits of Reservations**

Managing reservations and table activity in one place helps your team reduce scheduling conflicts, improve guest service, and keep restaurant operations organized.

- **See the whole room: The floor view shows every table with its status, the party at it and how long they have been seated.**
- **Book in seconds: Pick a party size, a day and an open time, and HighLevel finds a table that fits.**
- **Walk-ins welcome: Seat a guest who came in without a booking, with or without their details.**
- **Order at the table: Add rounds from your menu, send them to the kitchen and take payment, all from the booking.**
- **Every change on record: Each booking keeps its activity, from booked to seated to paid.**

---

## **Before You Start**

Reservations uses your restaurant's floor layout and reservation settings to determine table availability. Completing the initial restaurant setup ensures that bookings are assigned to the appropriate tables and that your team can begin managing guests.

Make sure you have:

- **Floor layout and reservation settings: Reservations are seated at your tables, so add your areas and tables and choose your reservation rules first. See [Restaurant Setup](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ddwMlOYygDii3i-qQIL2CJZKcnSgJ_UJSIl_lS7YVgw/edit#bookmark=id.zfqujibftyfr).**
- **Menu: To take dine-in orders, [add your menu](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ddwMlOYygDii3i-qQIL2CJZKcnSgJ_UJSIl_lS7YVgw/edit#bookmark=id.vxpuh5x5bxcn).**
- **Website (for online booking): Your team can book tables right away. Guests can book online once your [restaurant website](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ddwMlOYygDii3i-qQIL2CJZKcnSgJ_UJSIl_lS7YVgw/edit#bookmark=id.2vqtz6bfd4yc) is published.**

For detailed configuration instructions, refer to Restaurant Setup: Get Ready to Take Orders and Reservations and Restaurant Settings: Change Your Restaurant's Details and Rules.

---

## **Understanding Reservation Views**

HighLevel provides three views of your restaurant's reservations. Each view displays booking information differently, allowing your team to manage current guests, review upcoming reservations, and monitor table occupancy.

Navigate to Restaurants → Reservations from the left navigation. Reservations opens in Front of house by default. Use the tabs at the top to switch views.

**Until your website is published, a banner says You’re ready to take reservations. Your team can book tables now, and guests can book online once your website is live.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084896842/original/seR9Uuv0eYLj18m9xSGwqb6qACawtHnOMQ.png?1793772573)

### **Front of House**

Front of house displays an interactive map of your restaurant's tables and their current status. Select an area, such as Main dining, to view the tables within that area.

You can:

- **Tables: A free table shows its seats. A seated table shows the party size, how long they have been seated and how far along their meal is, for example 3 of 4 · 36m and Served or Bill waiting. A party past its table time shows Over by and how long.**
- **Free and need attention: The top of the map shows how many tables are free and how many need attention, such as a party past its table time or a bill waiting.**
- **Arriving and Seated: The list next to the map shows today’s guests in the order they arrive, with a Seat button for each, and the parties who are seated. To look ahead, click See all reservations (or See upcoming reservations when no one is arriving today).**
- **Table status: The key shows what each color means: Available, Reserved soon, Seated, Left open and Out of service.**
- **Find and zoom: Search by name or table, zoom in or out, or click Fit area to see the whole area.**
- **Area options: Choose Edit layout or Manage areas to change your tables.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084896945/original/ULMImh_Ohwiof-99tP-ACrNQZ-82qcPGGA.png?1793772772)

### **Timeline View**

Timeline view displays reservations across a time-based schedule, helping your team identify available time slots, booking overlaps, and table occupancy throughout the day.

Each table appears as a row, with reservations displayed as booking bars.

You can:

- **Choose Day, Week or Year, and move between dates with the arrows or Today.**
- **Filter by area, or fold an area to hide its tables.**
- **The key shows Confirmed, Seated, Late, Completed, Blocked and Past its end time.**
- **Turn on Whole day to see the full day.**
- **To stop bookings in an area, click the three-dot menu next to the area and choose Block this area.**

****![Timeline view shows each table’s bookings across the day.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084896966/original/Uc0A88lSfo9ms_re4Uv5BwkzihO2WH95gA.png?1793772825 "Timeline view shows each table’s bookings across the day.")****

### **List View**

List view organizes reservations into a searchable list, making it easier to review booking details and take quick actions.

Each reservation displays its Time, Guest, Party, Table, Status, Deposit, and Source.

You can filter reservations by date, seating area, or status, or search for specific guests.

- **Click a guest’s name to open their contact record.**
- **Click anywhere else in the row to open the booking.**
- **Use the button next to the status for the next step, such as Seat now or Mark completed.**

****![List view. The button next to each status moves the booking to its next step, such as Seat now or Mark completed.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897048/original/q8HqJ-nuMv5VmvRuTq2HoY-6cxeaHDVYnQ.png?1793772905 "List view. The button next to each status moves the booking to its next step, such as Seat now or Mark completed.")****

---

## **How to Create and Manage Reservations**

Reservations allows your team to book tables for future visits, seat walk-in guests, and manage existing bookings. HighLevel assigns eligible tables based on the booking information, while allowing staff to adjust assignments when needed.

### **Book a Table for a Guest**

Creating a reservation allows your team to select an available date and time, identify the guest, and assign a suitable table.

1. Click New reservation.
2. Choose the Party size (1 to 6), or click Custom for a bigger party.
3. Choose the Date: Today, Tomorrow, or pick a date.
4. Choose an open Time. If no table is free that day, you see a message such as No tables free for a party of 2 on this day. Choose another day, or click Book a custom time.
5. Optional: choose a Seating area, or leave it as Any area.
6. Under Guest, search by name, phone or email. If the guest is new, click the option to add them as a new guest, then enter their first name and a phone number or email so the guest can be saved.
7. Optional: add Special requests, such as allergies, occasions or seating preferences.
8. Click Book table.

HighLevel assigns a table that fits the reservation. You can change the table assignment afterward.

![Book a table: choose the party size, date and time, then find or add the guest.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897099/original/SlFocrjdjRepqQ50xSm5DX94Cb3z8c9Epw.png?1793772993 "Book a table: choose the party size, date and time, then find or add the guest.")

### 

### **Seat a Walk-In Guest**

Walk-in seating allows your team to accommodate guests who arrive without an advance reservation. Guest contact information is optional when seating a walk-in.

1. **Click Seat a walk-in.**
2. **Choose the Party size.**
3. **Check the Time. The party is seated now and keeps the table for its table time, for example Now until 10:20 am · 1 h 30 min. Click Change to adjust it.**
4. **Check the Table. HighLevel picks one that fits the party, and you can choose another.**
5. **Optional: search for the guest, or leave Guest empty to seat them as a walk-in.**
6. **Click Seat now.**

The table is marked as seated and appears in Front of house.  
  
![Seat a guest who came in without a booking.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897187/original/wYSwJOOwL1RpnRojIo82GZo8d-PYgvq-3A.png?1793773090 "Seat a guest who came in without a booking.")

### **View and Update a Booking**

Each booking has a details panel containing information about the reservation, guest, table, orders, and payments. This allows staff to manage a guest's visit without creating separate records for each action.

Click an existing reservation or an occupied table to open its booking.

| Tab | What You Can Manage |
| --- | --- |
| Overview | The booking (time, party size, how long the table is held, who booked it and when, and the deposit), the table, the guest and notes. Click Edit booking, Move table, Open contact or Edit notes. |
| Guest | The guest’s details and past visits. Click Open contact to see their contact record. |
| Notes | Notes for this visit, such as special requests. Click Edit notes to change them. |
| Payment | The bill, what has been paid, any deposit and what is still due. |
| Order | The table’s rounds and bill. See [Take a Dine-in Order](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ddwMlOYygDii3i-qQIL2CJZKcnSgJ_UJSIl_lS7YVgw/edit#bookmark=id.3g2ju4vtqe74). |
| Activity | Everything that happened, such as booked, seated, round sent to the kitchen and bill paid, with the time and who did it. |

To make changes:

- Edit a reservation: Under Overview, click Edit booking. Update the party size, date, time, seating area, guest, or special requests, then click Save changes.
- Move a reservation: Click Move table, choose another option under Tables that fit, and confirm with Move to.
- Cancel a reservation: Open the three-dot menu, select Cancel reservation, enter the cancellation reason, and confirm. The table becomes available again.
- Share a booking management link: Open the three-dot menu and select Copy manage link.

Cancellation notifications are sent when the corresponding customer notifications are enabled in Restaurant Settings.

![A booking’s details. Change the status at the top, and use the tabs on the side to move between sections.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897394/original/3bO1JsTNKfUObJkAPJHUQSWCirA8C-PTLw.png?1793773229 "A booking’s details. Change the status at the top, and use the tabs on the side to move between sections.")

---

## **Understand Booking Statuses**

Booking statuses help your team track where each reservation is in the guest journey. You can update the status using the selector at the top of the booking or the available action buttons.

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Pending payment | The reservation is awaiting payment. |
| Confirmed | The reservation is booked, but the guest has not been seated. |
| Seated | The guest is currently at the assigned table. Seating a guest early moves the reservation start time to the current time. |
| Completed | The dining visit has ended. Full payment completes the booking. |
| No-show | The guest did not arrive for the reservation. |

```
Note: Booking statuses are different from table-status indicators and kitchen order statuses. For example, a seated reservation can have an order that is still being prepared.
```

**![Booking statuses, from booked to closed.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897486/original/CkEQcOVmNminn_Bdc17M158fbEnJ8bv4dQ.png?1793773316 "Booking statuses, from booked to closed.")**

---

## **Take Dine-In Orders and Collect Payments**

After seating a guest, your team can take orders and process payments directly from the reservation. Each dining visit can include multiple rounds of orders, all associated with the same bill.

### **Take a Dine-In Order**

A round represents a group of items ordered together. Additional rounds allow guests to order more food or drinks without creating a separate bill.

1. Open the seated booking and go to Order.
2. Click Add round. Your menu opens, with a search box and your categories.
3. Tap each item the table orders. A count shows how many of each are in the round.
4. For items with choices, such as add-ons, pick the options, add an optional Kitchen note (like an allergy), set the Quantity and click Add to round.  
     
   ![An item with choices: pick the add-ons, add a kitchen note and set the quantity.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897648/original/U74VS3JtTaysoFwD5DLkh86tKG_R3zj1dw.png?1793773472 "An item with choices: pick the add-ons, add a kitchen note and set the quantity.")
5. Check the round on the right. Use One more, Remove or Edit on any line, or Clear to start over. The Round subtotal shows the total. Tax is added to the bill.
6. Click Send to kitchen.  
     
   ![A round ready to send: your menu on the left, the round on the right.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897671/original/Iy2Hs6TzKwL98Kd9JW5hA719zEydf7icDg.png?1793773501 "A round ready to send: your menu on the left, the round on the right.")

The round appears in the reservation's Order tab and in Restaurant Orders, where the kitchen can manage it.

Repeat the process using Add round whenever the guests order additional items. All rounds contribute to the same bill, with applicable taxes included in the final amount.

### **Take Payment and Close the Table**

Payments are managed directly from the booking. Staff can charge a card or record payments received through another method.

1. In the booking, click Take payment.
2. Check the Amount due, then choose a tip: No tip, one of your suggested amounts or Custom.
3. Search for the guest, or add them as a new guest with a phone number or email. A guest is needed to take payment.
4. Choose Charge a card, or Record manually for a payment taken another way (Cash, Card, Cheque, Bank transfer or Other).
5. Optional: to split the bill, choose Record manually and lower the Amount to what this guest pays. Take payment again for the rest. A card payment always pays the full amount due.
6. Click Charge or Record.

When the full bill has been paid, the booking is marked Completed, the table closes, and its order moves to the Completed tab in Restaurant Orders.

You can also use Mark completed to manually finish a booking.

**![Take payment: choose a tip, then charge a card or record a payment you took another way.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084897752/original/tUea-qX2eTN4kSgvqvum0SMk580TCBopfQ.png?1793773604 "Take payment: choose a tip, then charge a card or record a payment you took another way.")**

---

## **Let Guests Book Online**

Publishing your restaurant website allows customers to make reservations without contacting your staff. Available booking options are based on your restaurant's reservation settings, helping maintain consistency between online bookings and table availability.

Online reservations follow your configured:

- Reservation hours and available booking dates.
- Maximum online party size.
- Available seating areas.
- Table durations and availability.
- Deposit requirements, when configured.

Guests can receive reservation confirmations, reminders, and notifications about booking updates or cancellations based on your configured customer notification settings.

To configure these messages, navigate to Restaurant Settings → Customer.

To manually share a guest's reservation management link, open the booking's three-dot menu and select Copy manage link.

For website publishing instructions, refer to Restaurant Website: Set Up and Publish Your Website.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I take reservations before publishing my restaurant website?**

Yes. Your team can create reservations and seat walk-in guests directly in HighLevel before your restaurant website is published.

**Q: Why can't I find an available time for a reservation?**

A suitable table may not be available during your restaurant's configured reservation hours. Try a different date or party size, or select Book a custom time.

**Q: Why doesn't a particular table appear when moving a booking?**

The available table list includes tables that meet the party's seating requirements. Tables that are too small, inactive, or restricted by minimum party size may not appear.

**Q: What does "Held until" mean on a reservation?**

It indicates the end of the reservation's allocated table duration, based on the table-time settings configured for your restaurant.

**Q: Can I take a payment from a walk-in guest without contact details?**

You can seat a walk-in without contact details. However, you must select or create a guest contact before collecting payment through the booking.

**Q: Can guests split a bill?**

Yes. Use Record manually to record partial payments. Repeat until the full bill is paid. The Charge a card option processes the full outstanding balance.

**Q: How can I prevent reservations in a specific seating area?**

Open Timeline view, select the three-dot menu beside the area, and choose Block this area.

---
