title_en: How to Set Up a Payment Link for Multiple Products (One-Time & Recurring)
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/fb5ochlDsD4?&wmode=opaque)

This article walks you through how to set up a HighLevel Payment Link that includes both one-time and recurring products. It’s designed for users who want to simplify their checkout process, bundle multiple offerings, and manage payments efficiently. Whether you’re selling digital goods, subscriptions, or service packages—this guide helps you configure it all in one place.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Payment Links for Multiple Products?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-Are-Payment-Links-for-Multiple-Products?)
- [Key Benefits of Using Multiple Products in a Payment Link](#Key-Benefits-of-Using-Multiple-Products-in-a-Payment-Link)
- [How to Set Up a Payment Link for Multiple Products](#How-to-Set-Up-a-Payment-Link-for-Multiple-Products)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What Are Payment Links for Multiple Products?**

Payment Links in HighLevel allow you to combine several products—both one-time and recurring—into a single checkout experience. This is especially useful for businesses offering bundled packages, digital goods, and subscription services. Instead of creating separate links for each item, everything can be managed under one unified payment flow, improving the customer journey and backend tracking.

---

## **Key Benefits of Using Multiple Products in a Payment Link**

- **Unified Checkout**: Customers can view all one-time and recurring product options in a single, organized interface.
- **Improved Sales Strategy**: Present upsell and cross-sell options together to boost total order value.
- **Clean Customer Experience**: Recurring items are selectable one at a time, while one-time items allow multiple selections.
- **Fewer Links to Manage**: All product offerings are bundled into one shareable, trackable link.
- **Custom Branding & Behavior**: You can control the page design, URL, and post-purchase behavior to fit your brand.

---

## **How to Set Up a Payment Link for Multiple Products**

### **Access the Payment Links Section**

Start by navigating to the Payments tab in your left-hand menu. From there, click on Payment Links at the top of the screen. This is where you can create, manage, and monitor all your existing and new payment links.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600532/original/-4K_Wq7MBjQbV2qbIdygu9XOjxGBFrIVNg.png?1750410002)

### **Create a New Payment Link**

Click the + Create New Payment Link button in the top-right corner of the Payment Links dashboard. This begins the setup process where you can choose products, customize checkout, and configure additional options.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600598/original/cjUFrlzCpJYslgapPWF5y1O9W6M6oTCkqQ.png?1750410072)

### **Select a Product**

Begin by selecting the first product to include in your payment link. You can choose from both one-time and recurring products from your product library. This initial selection is required before you can add additional products or configure further checkout settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600644/original/wQxAwsPoZ_D3amZMFYn01DBl-SZBIHnv4w.png?1750410107)

### **Add Another Product**

Click the + Add Another Product button to include multiple offerings within the same payment link. You can combine several one-time products and one recurring product, allowing customers to make multiple selections in a single checkout session. Recurring products will be grouped separately on the checkout page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600727/original/_CiLXvT6B-RwQFRQD7b6Zn8td3jCrM1Mag.png?1750410157)

### **Enable Quantity Selection for Products**

Use the **Let customers adjust quantities** checkbox to allow buyers to choose how many units of a one-time product they want to purchase. You can set minimum and maximum limits to control bulk orders. This flexibility improves the checkout experience for customers who need multiple items.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600756/original/BfjtTmvOSX5WiuqZWT08CWZ3KNmsu1NVCQ.png?1750410195)

### **Collect Customer Phone Numbers**

Enable the Require customers to add a phone number option to make phone number collection mandatory during checkout. This is helpful for follow-ups, service coordination, or verification purposes. The phone field will appear alongside other contact details in the form.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600801/original/5vp0oMLXrfzSg1GoqGqnXS1U8V7i5ijLeg.png?1750410235)

### **Collect Customer Addresses**

Enable the Collect customer addresses option if you need detailed shipping or billing information. Once selected, address fields such as street, city, state, country, and postal code will be shown on the checkout page—ideal for physical product delivery or compliance requirements.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600876/original/LoixILuUX1P3pohukwL8jX1YycZG73oapA.png?1750410269)

### **Enable Coupon Codes at Checkout**

Select the Allow coupon codes option to display a coupon code field on the checkout page. This allows customers to apply discount codes to their purchases, helping drive promotional campaigns and incentivize higher conversions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600962/original/xyC73GpDSPrUvi4LbXP_qSKfZNHNjuwLHw.png?1750410324)

### **Add Post-Purchase Redirect URL**

Activate the Enable redirection to custom URL option to automatically guide customers to a specific page after completing their payment. You can define the redirect destination and choose whether it opens in a new tab or within the current one—ideal for thank-you pages or next-step instructions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048600983/original/v2m03c5md8G2K14FeQZNzCDVlvis1X2Gzw.png?1750410364)

### **Customize the Call-to-Action Button Text**

> Use the dropdown under Call to action for payment link button to personalize the button label based on your offering. You can select from options like “Pay,” “Book,” or “Donate” to align the CTA with your product type or user journey. This helps set the right expectations and improve conversion clarity.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601002/original/03PzJFoAfUkcIf36kBteTwAiMx_UsfqH3w.png?1750410394)

```
Note: Custom button text is available for all Payment Link types. Customers see the custom label on all devices. If a customer already has the checkout open when you make a change, they must refresh the page to see the updated label.
```

### **Add a Branding Message**

Enable the Branding option to include a custom “Powered by” label on the checkout page. You can edit the text to display your agency or business name, reinforcing brand visibility and trust during the checkout experience.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601034/original/eJWkFLuqr5KLotXLkAIVcIIdlk2mKxh-VA.png?1750410427)

### **Add Terms and Conditions**

Use the Add Terms and Conditions option to include important legal or policy-related information for your transaction. The message appears just below the Pay button on the checkout page, ensuring customers review key terms before completing the purchase. You can format the text for clarity and emphasis.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601053/original/9t7fgIL0owliEUJ56VyapoVfKby-bGMfIg.png?1750410448)

### **Set Automatic Deactivation Date**

Use the Automatic Deactivation setting to specify a date when the payment link should expire. This is helpful for time-bound offers, limited campaigns, or subscription windows. Once the selected date is reached, the link will no longer be accessible to customers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601113/original/Nk2MWmjph7o4kRkJ1QlQB08lXGSIHXcGhA.png?1750410487)

### **Choose Between Test and Live Payment Modes**

Use the Payment Mode toggle to switch between **Test** and **Live** environments. In Test mode, you can simulate payments using test card numbers without processing actual transactions. Switch to Live mode when you’re ready to accept real payments from customers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601161/original/jwui0qEAgW9MWF_4o-uafCRNZ3JGWJ_icQ.png?1750410517)

### **Name Your Payment Link**

Use the field at the top of the screen to enter a custom name for your payment link. This internal name helps you organize and identify links in your dashboard. It does not affect the customer-facing checkout page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601199/original/E1evz36kl3gPxes3NuHXlfUs4Yp_HP2VkA.png?1750410561)

### **Share the Payment Link**

Click the **Copy / Send** button to access options for distributing your payment link. You can copy a generic link to share with any customer or send a personalized version directly via email or SMS from within HighLevel.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601261/original/Yt1Vv9QawWQkYRxAo_fuql2M_V0q4EpAHA.png?1750410598)

### **Copy or Personalize the Payment Link**

Choose to copy a standard link for general use or generate a personalized payment link with prefilled customer data. Use the dropdown menu to select a contact and get the customized payment link for the selected contact.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601413/original/qsKn9wSPse8-AQ35QHVj1yTbitkygLbTiA.png?1750410664)

### **Send Links to Contacts**

Use the Send to Contacts option to deliver payment links via email, SMS, or both. Select the contact, choose your communication method, and customize the subject line and templates to match your campaign or offer.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601640/original/LajFAuBQcQO8NBhvq4kxoUhyzBI-JlF2pw.png?1750410851)

### **Preview the Payment Link Checkout Page**

Click the Preview button to see how your payment link will appear to customers. This allows you to verify product grouping, branding elements, form fields, and overall layout before sharing the link publicly.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601696/original/8uQYT_C-9jLmcX6bjWJ1lcRvHkegiU8tYQ.png?1750410918)

### **Save Your Payment Link**

Once your products and settings are finalized, click the **Save** button to publish your payment link. This action activates the link and allows you to begin sharing it with customers through your chosen channels.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048601773/original/WnE_sAbHgCi8kb_MkdZewSSM1fvD3If9XA.png?1750410955)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is there a limit to how many one-time products can be added?**

There’s no limit. You can include as many one-time products as your business needs.

**Q: Can coupon codes be applied across all products?**

Yes, coupon codes are accepted at checkout and apply to eligible products in the cart.

**Q: How are products organized in the checkout view?**

They are grouped under “One-time Products” and “Recurring Products” for clear separation.

**Q: Can I embed or share the payment link?**

Yes. The link can be shared via email, social media, or embedded on your website.

title_en: Getting Started - Connect Stripe
source_md:
Connecting Stripe to HighLevel allows you to process supported payments through your sub-account and use Stripe across eligible HighLevel payment experiences. Once connected, you can manage supported payment methods, configure how Stripe is used across payment channels, and begin collecting payments from customers. Use this guide to connect Stripe, verify the integration, and understand the most important settings to review before accepting payments.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Connecting Stripe to HighLevel?](#What-is-Connecting-Stripe-to-HighLevel?)
- [Key Benefits of Connecting Stripe to HighLevel](#Key-Benefits-of-Connecting-Stripe-to-HighLevel)
- [Before You Connect Stripe](#Before-You-Connect-Stripe)
- [Stripe Payment Methods](#Stripe-Payment-Methods)
- [Payment Provider and Channel Configuration](#Payment-Provider-and-Channel-Configuration)
- [How To Setup Stripe in HighLevel](#How-To-Setup-Stripe-in-HighLevel)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Connecting Stripe to HighLevel?**

Connecting Stripe makes your Stripe account available as a payment provider within a HighLevel sub-account. This connection allows supported HighLevel payment experiences to send eligible transactions to Stripe for processing while keeping the payment workflow connected to your HighLevel account. Each HighLevel sub-account can connect to one Stripe account at a time.

After the connection is complete, Stripe can be used across supported HighLevel product areas, including eligible invoices, payment links, order forms, forms, stores, calendars, courses, communities, and other payment experiences. The exact payment methods available depend on the product area, Stripe account eligibility, payment configuration, and other applicable requirements.

---

## **Key Benefits of Connecting Stripe to HighLevel**

Connecting Stripe gives you a direct way to use Stripe-supported payment processing within eligible HighLevel experiences. It also gives you greater control over how customers can pay and where Stripe is used across your payment workflows.

- **Centralized Payment Setup:** Connect Stripe from your HighLevel sub-account and manage supported Stripe payment settings without leaving your payment workflow.
- **Multiple Payment Experiences:** Use Stripe with supported HighLevel experiences such as invoices, payment links, order forms, stores, forms, calendars, and other eligible product areas.
- **Payment Method Control:** Manage supported cards, wallets, bank debit methods, and other eligible Stripe payment methods from HighLevel.
- **Separate Test and Live Configuration:** Configure supported payment methods independently for Test Mode and Live Mode.
- **Flexible Provider Routing:** When multiple providers are connected, configure preferred providers for supported payment channels.
- **Integrated Selling Workflows:** Connect Stripe before creating payment links, selling products, sending invoices, or using other supported checkout experiences.

---

## **Before You Connect Stripe**

Having the correct account access before beginning the connection helps prevent authorization issues and makes it easier to verify the integration when setup is complete.

Before connecting Stripe:

- Make sure you are working in the HighLevel sub-account where Stripe should be connected.
- Have access to the Stripe account you want to connect, or be prepared to create a Stripe account during the connection process.
- Make sure you have the appropriate Stripe permissions to authorize the integration.
- Confirm that Stripe is supported for the applicable country before beginning setup.

If you cannot authorize the connection, the Stripe account owner may need to adjust your permissions before you can continue.

---

## **Stripe Payment Methods**

Connecting Stripe establishes the payment-provider connection, while payment-method settings determine which eligible ways customers can pay. HighLevel allows supported Stripe payment methods to be managed for different product areas, helping you control the checkout options available to customers.

Depending on your account and payment experience, available methods may include cards, wallets, bank debit options, regional payment methods, or supported Buy Now, Pay Later options.

Payment-method availability can vary based on factors such as:

- Stripe account verification and eligibility
- Country or regional support
- The currency being used
- The HighLevel product area or checkout type
- Whether you are configuring Test Mode or Live Mode
- Additional requirements from Stripe for a specific payment method

Payment methods can be configured independently for Test and Live environments. Existing Stripe payment-method settings are preserved as the default unless they are updated through HighLevel.

For detailed configuration instructions, see [How to Manage Stripe Payment Methods inside HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005164-configure-stripe-payment-methods-inside-highlevel).

---

## **Payment Provider and Channel Configuration**

Connecting Stripe makes it available as a payment provider, but the connected provider is not necessarily used for every payment channel when multiple providers are configured. Channel-level settings allow you to control which connected provider is preferred for supported payment experiences.

HighLevel can apply payment-provider preferences to channels such as funnels, forms, stores, invoices, payment links, calendars, courses, communities, and other supported areas. When a channel has its own provider configuration, that setting can determine which provider is used instead of relying only on the account's global default.

Only providers already connected to the sub-account are available for channel configuration. If a preferred provider is disconnected, HighLevel can fall back to the default provider for that channel.

For detailed routing instructions, see [Configure Payment Providers by Channel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007346-configure-payment-providers-by-channel).

---

## **How To Setup Stripe in HighLevel**

A complete Stripe setup includes connecting the Stripe account, completing Stripe's authorization process, and confirming that the integration is enabled in HighLevel. Verifying the connection before building payment experiences helps prevent configuration issues later.

1. From your HighLevel sub-account, go to **Payments**.
2. Select **Integrations**.
3. Locate **Stripe** and click **Connect** or **Connect with Stripe**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078679826/original/nKeYRFVQq5n4riHpRC9ZIjJjC4i-7uRx5A.png?1787049112)
4. Follow the Stripe authorization instructions.
5. Log in to the Stripe account you want to connect. If you do not already have a Stripe account, follow the available Stripe prompts to create one.
6. Review the requested connection information and authorize HighLevel to connect to the Stripe account.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078680326/original/gqyLzVYRhxvWELpRK-M0_G5Ptt-2wkv1aA.png?1787049336)
7. After authorization is complete, return to **Payments > Integrations** in HighLevel.
8. Confirm that Stripe displays as connected or enabled.
9. When available, click **Manage** to access supported Stripe configuration options, including payment-method settings.

   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078679930/original/71soB3Bx3QBS0iPblOV41IhEucQh1L4UwA.png?1787049159)**

After Stripe is connected, review your payment-method and payment-provider settings before launching a customer-facing checkout. If you already use Stripe products, review the supported Stripe product-import behavior before attempting to import them into HighLevel.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I connect more than one Stripe account to the same HighLevel sub-account?**

No. A HighLevel sub-account supports one connected Stripe account at a time. If separate businesses or brands require different Stripe accounts, they can use separate HighLevel sub-accounts.

**Q: Why don't I see a specific Stripe payment method after connecting Stripe?**

Payment-method availability can depend on your Stripe account, country, currency, checkout type, account verification status, and whether the method is enabled in the correct Test or Live environment. Some payment methods also require additional eligibility or configuration before they can appear at checkout.

**Q: Does connecting Stripe automatically make it the payment provider for every HighLevel channel?**

Not necessarily. If payment-provider settings have been configured by channel, a supported channel can use its preferred connected provider rather than relying only on the global default provider. Review **Payments > Integrations** and your provider configuration if you use multiple payment providers.

**Q: Will payments that already exist in Stripe appear in HighLevel after I connect my account?**

No. Existing payments created directly in Stripe before the connection are not automatically imported into HighLevel. HighLevel tracks new applicable transactions created through HighLevel after the integration is connected.

**Q: Can I use Stripe Test Mode before accepting real payments?**

Yes. Stripe Test Mode can be used to simulate supported payments without charging real cards. Payment-method settings can also be configured separately for Test Mode and Live Mode, so confirm you are working in the correct environment before launching your checkout.

**Q: Can I import all of my existing Stripe products into HighLevel?**

No. HighLevel's current product documentation states that recurring or subscription products can be imported from Stripe, while one-time products should be created directly in HighLevel. Review the product-import documentation before migrating an existing Stripe catalog.

**Q: Can I use HighLevel invoices without processing the payment through Stripe?**

Some invoice workflows allow payments to be recorded manually instead of processing the transaction through Stripe. Connecting a supported payment provider is required when the payment needs to be processed through that provider and reflected through the corresponding payment-processing workflow.

**Q: What should I check if Stripe does not show as connected after authorization?**

Return to **Payments > Integrations** and verify the Stripe status. If the integration is not enabled, confirm that the Stripe authorization process was completed with an account that has sufficient permissions. If necessary, reconnect Stripe or ask the Stripe account owner to verify your access.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Connect Stripe to Your Sub-Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000981400)
- [How to Manage Stripe Payment Methods inside HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005164-configure-stripe-payment-methods-inside-highlevel)
- [Supported Payment Providers & Methods by Product Area (What Works Where)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006075)
- [Configure Payment Providers by Channel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007346-configure-payment-providers-by-channel)
- [Import Products / Price From Stripe](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001202184-import-products-price-from-stripe)
- [How to Set Up Products & Start Selling Online in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005071-getting-started-create-sell-products)

title_en: How to Build Branded Mobile Apps with AI App Studio
source_md:
AI App Studio lets you create a branded mobile app using a simple description of your business. Powered by AI and connected to your existing Client Portal, it generates mobile screens that reflect your branding and support your members, courses, and communities. You can customize the design, preview the generated experience, and refine it through conversation.

This guide walks you through building a branded mobile app and preparing an installable Android APK.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is AI App Studio?](#What-is-AI-App-Studio?)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [How To Setup AI App Studio](#How-To-Setup-AI-App-Studio)
- [Customize Your Branded Mobile App](#Customize-Your-Branded-Mobile-App)
- [Client Portal Features and Custom Objects](#Client-Portal-Features-and-Custom-Objects)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is AI App Studio?**

AI App Studio is an AI-powered app builder that creates branded mobile experiences using natural-language prompts. Instead of building each screen manually or relying on a fixed template, you describe the experience you want, select design preferences, and let AI generate the application's screens and code.

The builder connects to your existing Client Portal, allowing the generated experience to incorporate members, courses, communities, files, appointments, and other supported features.

You can review the application in a live phone-frame preview, request additional changes through conversation, and generate an installable Android APK.

**Examples of Branded Mobile App Designs**

AI App Studio's branding capabilities support different visual directions. The supplied examples illustrate how mobile interfaces can be tailored to different businesses.

- **Harbor Pilates:** A wellness-inspired sign-in screen with a studio image, green branding, and email/password fields.

- **STRIDE RUN CLUB:** A member dashboard design with weekly mileage, goals, data-entry fields, and bottom navigation.

- **Duende:** A dance school sign-in design with a large hero image, red accents, and Spanish interface text.

## 

**Key features include:**

- **Custom Branding:** Apply a design system and brand board to keep your logo, colors, fonts, and images consistent.

- **Member Access:** Built-in sign-in and sign-up, including code-based joining for new members.

- **Client Portal Integration:** Connect courses, communities, shared files, appointments, and account settings.

- **Mobile Features:** Support camera and photo access with automatically generated permission text.

- **Custom Objects:** Include up to three custom objects with fields, dropdowns, and links. Members can view and add records from the app's bottom navigation.

- **AI Customization:** Refine your app through follow-up prompts without rebuilding it from scratch.

---

## **Before You Begin**

You'll need access to the AI App Studio private beta and a HighLevel sub-account with AI Studio editing permissions.

Have your business description, branding assets, and any existing Client Portal resources you want to include ready.

---

## **How To Setup AI App Studio**

AI App Studio guides you from an initial prompt to a generated mobile application. You describe your business, choose the mobile experience, answer any necessary questions, and select design preferences before AI builds the app.

### 

### **Step 1: Open AI Studio and Describe Your App**

A detailed initial prompt helps AI understand the app's purpose, intended users, visual style, and key features.

- Log in to your HighLevel account.
- Open the relevant **Sub-Account**.
- Select **AI Studio** from the left navigation menu.
- Locate the prompt field on the AI Studio home screen.
- Enter a description of the application you want to create.

**For example:**Create a member app for my pilates studio. Members should be able to browse our courses, join community discussions, and access files we share with them. Use our brand colors and a clean, welcoming design.

- To provide supporting visual references, click **Add images** and attach the relevant images.
- Submit your prompt using the purple arrow button in the prompt field.

AI Studio uses your description to determine the experience you want to build.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083606327/original/PQpmag5wQvakGcaLqVB9XwtQDWSg9wdERQ.png?1792370291)

### 

### **Step 2: Choose Mobile and a Starting Point**

AI Studio supports Web and Mobile starting options. Select Mobile when creating a branded mobile application.

1. When **Choose a starting point** appears, locate the **Platform** selection.
2. Select **Mobile**.
3. Review the available starting-point options.
4. Select **Describe it instead** to build a mobile experience from your description.
5. Click **Continue**.

```
Important: you cannot change the platform or starting point after creating the project.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083606383/original/mJM-pZuy1UjuIyOjoVQsxqX3OTzTnfUQdg.png?1792370599)

### 

### **Step 3: Answer the Clarifying Questions**

AI Studio may ask follow-up questions when it needs more information about the app's design or functionality. Your answers help shape the generated experience.

1. Review the questions under **Some questions I need clarity on**.
2. Confirm the name of your application if prompted.
3. Review the available answers for each question.
4. Select the options that best match your requirements.
5. Click **Next** to continue.

For example, AI Studio may ask how members should progress through courses.

These questions help define the requested course experience before AI generates the application.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083606433/original/Qmxxhj7UdyPYbbKrAUx1Ku2XvKvEuxdEvQ.png?1792370906)

### **Step 4: Choose Your Color Palette and Fonts**

AI Studio lets you establish the application's visual direction before the build begins. Selected colors and fonts help maintain a consistent appearance across generated screens.

1. Review the **A few design choices** screen.
2. Find **Which colour palette fits best?**
3. Select your preferred color palette.
4. Review the available **Fonts** combinations.
5. Choose your preferred title and body fonts.
6. Click **Build my App**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083606450/original/APD0C7cpMViLpUVpnN-6pm893d7Gx4ubPA.png?1792370956)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083606458/original/oiDHbtJHuBTFqUfWsuF2BZJuBse-FD1-5Q.png?1792371030)

### 

### **Step 5: Generate Your Mobile App**

Once you submit your design choices, AI Studio begins generating the application based on your prompt and selected preferences.

1. Click **Build my App** after completing the design selections.
2. Review the progress information shown in the builder.
3. Monitor the AI agent's activity as it generates the application.
4. Review the phone-frame preview while the app is being built.
5. When the build completes, examine the generated screens.

The supplied build screen shows planning information, an AI build activity panel, and a mobile preview.

The agent generates application code while working with the Client Portal experience described in your prompt.

### 

### **Step 6: Review the Generated Experience**

Reviewing the initial app helps identify design or functional changes before publishing.

Check the generated experience against the requirements in your original prompt. Pay particular attention to:

- The business name and branding.

- The generated home screen.

- Navigation between the app's screens.

- Courses, communities, and other requested Client Portal resources.

- Member sign-in and account-related screens.

- Any forms, buttons, or other requested controls.

---

## **Customize Your Branded Mobile App**

AI Studio allows you to continue improving the generated application after its initial build. You can request changes through conversation or use supported customization tools to refine the app's source.

### 

### **Refine the App Through Conversation**

Conversational editing lets you describe the changes you want without restarting the entire design.

For example, you can request:

- A different arrangement of the home screen.
- A change to the visual style or colors.
- A different presentation of course progress.
- Additional navigation or content areas.

AI App Studio preserves the existing design during follow-up requests unless you explicitly ask for a redesign.

You can continue submitting refinement requests as you review the result.

### 

### **Edit the Application with the Customizer**

The customizer can update the application's underlying source code.

Unlike a temporary visual preview, the edits saved through the customizer are applied to the application's own source. This means the saved changes are included in the code used for publishing.

---

## **Client Portal Features and Custom Objects**

AI App Studio builds mobile applications around supported Client Portal functionality. This lets businesses create custom member experiences using the courses, communities, and resources associated with their existing portal.

### 

### **Connected Client Portal Features**

The release identifies several features that can be included in the generated mobile experience.

- **Courses:** Give members access to course content and learning experiences.

- **Communities:** Include community spaces and member interactions.

- **Files:** Make shared resources available to members.

- **Appointments:** Incorporate supported appointment-related experiences.

- **Account Settings:** Provide access to account-related functionality.

- **Authentication:** Include sign-in and sign-up experiences for members.

New members can join using a code.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I create a mobile app without selecting a prebuilt template?**

Yes. AI App Studio supports creating an app from a description of your requirements. Select **Describe it instead** when choosing a starting point.

**Q: Can I change from Web to Mobile after creating a project?**

The supplied starting-point screen states that the platform and starting point cannot be changed after the project is created. Choose the intended platform before continuing.

**Q: Can I publish my generated mobile app to the Apple App Store?**

The supplied interface references iOS and Android mobile experiences. However, the release only confirms Android APK publishing. iOS publishing availability and steps require confirmation.

**Q: How do new members join the mobile app?**

The release confirms built-in sign-up and a code-based joining option for new members. The exact process for generating and sharing the code requires verification.

**Q: What happens if my Android build fails?**

AI App Studio retains the build failure reason, allowing you to identify the problem that needs correction. The exact retry procedure requires confirmation.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [AI Studio in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007587-ai-studio-in-highlevel)

- [How to set up the Client Portal?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000193-how-to-set-up-the-client-portal-)

- [Unified Client Portal Experience](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008402-unified-client-portal-experience)

- [Creating and Editing Custom Objects](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003897-creating-and-editing-custom-objects)

title_en: How to Parse Emails Using AI Extract Data Action
source_md:
When inbound emails contain lead details, service requests, or other important information in unstructured text, teams often waste time manually copying that data into the CRM. AI Extract Data helps turn email content into structured values that workflows can use right away. This article shows how to parse email data in HighLevel workflows, store the extracted values using a follow-up action, and then use that data for automation.

```
Note: AI Extract Data is a premium workflow action and incurs additional charges per execution.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Email Parsing Using the AI Extract Data Action?](#What-is-Email-Parsing-Using-the-AI-Extract-Data-Action?)
- [Key Benefits of Email Parsing with AI Extract Data Action](#Key-Benefits-of-Email-Parsing-with-AI-Extract-Data-Action)
- [How To Parse Email Data Using AI Extract Data Action](#How-To-Parse-Email-Data-Using-AI-Extract-Data-Action)
- [Use Case](#Use-Case)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Email Parsing Using the AI Extract Data Action?**

Email parsing with AI Extract Data allows HighLevel to read inbound email content and pull out specific details such as a lead's name, email address, phone number, budget, service request, or other structured information. This makes it easier to convert unstructured email text into workflow-ready values without manual copying. Once the values are extracted, you can use later workflow actions to create or update records, trigger follow-ups, and notify your team.

AI Extract Data is especially useful when emails come from lead sources, marketplaces, referrals, or external systems that do not send information in a clean CRM format.

---

## **Key Benefits of Email Parsing with AI Extract Data Action**

- **Faster lead handling**: Capture important details from inbound emails automatically so your team can follow up sooner.
- **Less manual entry**: Reduce copy-and-paste work by extracting structured values directly from email content.
- **More consistent data capture**: Map extracted values into contact or opportunity fields for cleaner records.
- **Better workflow automation**: Use parsed values in later actions such as contact creation, opportunity creation, notifications, emails, calls, or SMS.
- **More flexible intake processes**: Support use cases where valuable information arrives by email instead of forms or direct CRM entry.

---

## **How To Parse Email Data Using AI Extract Data Action**

A complete email parsing workflow does more than extract values from an email. To make the extracted data useful, the workflow must also store or use those values in a later action such as Create Contact, Update Contact Field, or Create Opportunity.

```
Note: To learn more about how the AI Extract Data action works and understand the action in more detail, see Workflow Action - AI Extract Data.
```

**Before you begin:**

- Make sure you know which mailbox or email flow should trigger the workflow.
- Decide which values you want to extract from the email.
- Decide where those extracted values should be stored or used after extraction.
- Keep in mind that AI Extract Data is a premium workflow action and incurs additional charges per execution.

### **Step 1:**Create a new workflow

1. Go to **Automation** > **Workflows**.
2. Click **+ Create Workflow**.
3. Choose **Start from Scratch**.
4. Select **Standard Builder or Advanced Builder**as per your preference.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/d2BdXJDO3sLLJUZ0ip3P+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-03+at+18.01.03.gif)

### **Step 2:**Add the email trigger

```
Note: You can also use Customer Replied with the reply channel set to Email if your use case depends on replies instead of newly received inbound emails.
```

1. Click **+ Add New Trigger**.
2. Select **Inbound Email**.
3. Configure the trigger based on the mailbox or email pattern you want to monitor.
4. Use filters such as:

   - **Email Sent To Mailbox**
   - **Email Sent From**
   - **Subject**
   - **Body Plain Text**
   - **Has Attachments**
5. In **Advanced Settings**, choose whether the workflow should run only for a new email conversation.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/iNckpBfLhtAz9ZAIGauw+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-03+at+18.10.17.gif)

### **Step 3:**Add the AI Extract Data action

1. Click the **+** icon under the trigger.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/8IlHbwUlIP0TTgFXCL8x+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-03+at+18.15.37.png)
2. Search for and select **AI Extract Data**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/aB21vBl6HJ4oEiXeqKxy+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-03+at+18.18.19.png)
3. **Rename** the **action** if needed so the workflow is easy to understand.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/tO6ZKQBmL2EFF8klliig+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-03+at+19.40.27.png)

### **Step 4:**Choose the email content to extract from

1. In Extract From, open the **custom value picker**.
2. Go to **Inbound Email**.
3. Select the email content you want to parse. Common options include:

   - **Body Plain Text**
   - **Full Body Includes Reply Thread**
   - **Subject**
   - **Message ID**
   - **From Email**
   - **From Name**
   - **CC**
   - **Date**

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/iACr6EbxL0HvDgiw1HCf+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-03+at+18.26.17.gif)

### **Step 5:**Add Additional Context to improve extraction accuracy

1. Use **Additional Context** to explain what kind of email the action should expect.
2. Add details that help the AI identify the correct values.  
     
   **Example Additional Context:** "Inbound lead email from platforms like Zillow or Realtor.com. Extract the lead's name, email, phone number, budget, and property interest. Phone numbers may appear in plain text."  
     
   This is especially useful when the email format varies or when certain values may be labeled differently from one sender to another.
3. You can also add **custom values**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/3xdy5hc8PdGqWpG3i4tY+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-03+at+18.28.53.png)

### **Step 6:**Define the data you want to extract

1. Use a pre-built template if it helps you get started, such as:

   - **Contact Info**
   - **Opportunity Info**
   - **Order Info**
   - **Appointment Info**
2. After applying a template, edit the fields so they match your use case.
3. Add, remove, or rename fields as needed.
4. **Example fields for a lead notification email:**

   - Lead Name
   - Contact Email
   - Contact Phone
   - Budget
5. Choose field names that match the data you want to store later. This makes downstream mapping easier and more accurate.
6. Click **Save Action**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/FNflsiEp7iFzsPc5dqlz+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-03+at+19.43.41.gif)

### **Step 7:**Add a downstream action to store or use the extracted values

```
Important: AI Extract Data does not permanently store the extracted values by itself. The extracted values are only available inside the workflow through the custom value picker in later actions. If you do not add another action after AI Extract Data, the extracted data will not be saved to a contact, opportunity, or any other record.
```

1. Common next actions include:  
     
   - **Create Contact**
   - **Update Contact Field**
   - **Create Opportunity**
   - **Create/Update Opportunity**
   - **Internal Notification**
   - **Send Email/SMS**
2. In **Create Contact** or **Update Contact Field**, map each destination field to the corresponding value from **AI Extract Data** in the custom value picker.
3. If you want to create or update an opportunity, map relevant extracted values such as budget, service type, or job details into the correct opportunity fields.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/7musNYUnP6MkBRxNXExA+/GIF+Recording+2026-07-03+at+19.47.11.gif)

### **Step 8:**Add any follow-up actions you need

1. After the values are stored, you can continue the workflow with additional actions such as:  
     
   - Sending an internal notification to a teammate
   - Sending an email or SMS follow-up
   - Assigning the lead for follow-up
   - Creating or updating an opportunity
   - Triggering another workflow based on the updated contact or opportunity data

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/q6iyDxUZgLmo6UrO8Y8w+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-03+at+18.55.45.png)

---

## **Use Case**

### **Real Estate Lead Notifications**

Real estate teams often receive lead notifications from listing platforms and referral sources by email. Those emails usually contain valuable details such as the lead's name, phone number, email address, budget, and property interest, but the information may appear in unstructured text. Parsing those emails with AI Extract Data helps agents capture the details faster and start follow-up without waiting on manual entry.

**Example use case**

1. A real estate team receives lead notification emails from external platforms.
2. The workflow triggers when the email reaches the assigned mailbox.
3. AI Extract Data parses the lead details from the email body.
4. A downstream action creates the contact or opportunity.
5. The workflow then sends an internal notification so a team member can follow up quickly.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/52ozGEjWlmC1td2RIQ6D+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-03+at+19.00.33.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does AI Extract Data store the extracted values automatically?**  
No. The extracted values are only available in later workflow actions through the custom value picker. To save them permanently, add another action such as Create Contact, Update Contact Field, or Create Opportunity.

**Q: Which trigger should I use for email parsing?**  
Use **Inbound Email** when the workflow should run when a new email reaches a mailbox. Use **Customer Replied** with the reply channel set to **Email** when the workflow should run from an email reply event.

**Q: What should I choose in the Extract From field?**  
For most email parsing workflows, use an inbound email value such as **Body Plain Text** or **Full Body Includes Reply Thread**. The best option depends on whether you want to parse only the current message or a larger email thread.

**Q: Why should I add Additional Context?**  
Additional Context helps the AI understand what kind of email it is parsing and which values matter most. This can improve extraction accuracy, especially when the email format varies.

**Q: Can I use parsed email data to create an opportunity?**  
Yes. After extracting the data, you can create or update an opportunity using the relevant values. In many workflows, the cleanest setup is to create or update the contact first and then create the opportunity.

**Q: Do I need to use a template in AI Extract Data?**  
No. Templates can help you start faster, but you can edit the template fields or build the extraction fields manually to fit your use case.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Action - AI Extract Data](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007992-workflow-action-ai-extract-data)
- [Workflow Trigger - Inbound Email](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007650-workflow-trigger-inbound-email)
- [Workflow Trigger - Customer Replied](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002677-workflow-trigger-customer-replied)
- [Workflow Action - Create Contact](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002685-workflow-action-create-contact)
- [Workflow Action - Update Contact Field](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001214441-workflow-action-update-contact-field)
- [Workflow Action - Create Opportunity](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004752-workflow-action-create-opportunity)

- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Embedded Appointment Booking with HighLevel Calendar?**

Embedded Appointment Booking allows leads to schedule an appointment from the Facebook Lead Ads Instant Form Thank You page after submitting their information. Instead of sending the lead to a separate booking page, Meta can display the supported calendar booking experience directly inside the Facebook mobile app flow.

With HighLevel Calendar support, advertisers can use a HighLevel calendar scheduling link as the booking destination for the **Book time** CTA in Meta’s Instant Form editor. When the embedded experience is available, the lead can choose a time from the Thank You page, and available lead details such as name, email, and phone may be carried over from the submitted form into the booking flow.

---

## **Key Benefits of Embedded Appointment Booking with HighLevel Calendar**

- **Fewer steps for leads:** Leads can book from the Thank You page instead of being redirected to a separate scheduling page.
- **Improved appointment conversion:** Reducing redirects and repeated data entry can help increase the likelihood that a lead completes the booking process.
- **HighLevel calendar availability:** Appointment times shown in the booking experience are based on the HighLevel calendar link and its configured availability.
- **Simpler campaign setup:** Advertisers can paste a supported scheduling link into the Instant Form editor and use the **Book time** CTA.
- **Better lead follow-up:** Facebook Lead Ads can sync lead information into HighLevel, where teams can use CRM records, workflows, and nurture campaigns for follow-up.
- **Appointment-based automation:** Booked appointments can trigger HighLevel workflows for confirmations, reminders, internal notifications, and post-appointment follow-up.

---

## **Facebook Lead Ads Instant Forms and HighLevel Calendar Links**

Facebook Lead Ads Instant Forms collect lead information inside Meta’s ad experience. HighLevel can support the lead capture and follow-up side by syncing Facebook Lead Ads into the CRM, while the HighLevel calendar link supports appointment scheduling.

To use Embedded Appointment Booking, create or identify the HighLevel calendar you want leads to book into, then copy the public scheduling link for that calendar. The calendar link should point to the specific calendar, service, or booking experience you want the ad campaign to use.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074424875/original/aJgQRDOPxqUUGh178OGPK6BKZUN8Ilh3iw.gif?1782316110)

```
Important: Meta controls the Instant Form, CTA, Thank You page, provider detection, preview, and placement behavior. HighLevel controls the calendar link, appointment availability, booking rules, calendar notifications, and appointment records.
```

---

## **How To Setup Embedded Appointment Booking with HighLevel Calendar**

Proper setup ensures your Facebook Instant Form collects the lead, displays the **Book time** action, and sends the lead to the correct HighLevel calendar. Create or confirm the HighLevel calendar first, then use that scheduling link inside Meta’s Instant Form editor.

1. In your HighLevel sub-account, open the calendars page using either of these paths:  
   From the left navigation menu, go to **Calendars > Calendar Settings**.  
   From the left navigation menu, go to **Settings > Calendars**.  
     
   Use an existing booking calendar or create a new calendar booking for the campaign. Review **[How to Set Up a Personal Booking Calendar with HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005061-getting-started-setup-a-booking-calendar)** if you need help creating a calendar first.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074422420/original/D790ErYr-dS5-HdMsBTzYJVfc36qYrhXGg.png?1782315153)
2. Copy the HighLevel calendar scheduling link for the calendar you want Facebook leads to book into.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074422722/original/BNg7zrx5tZ3qf3YPA5Y3bhPPwreRuEJkww.gif?1782315248)
3. Log in to Facebook and go to **Ads Manager**, then click **+ Create**. Select **Leads** as your campaign objective and click **Continue**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074423120/original/joON6S5rBIZFbwWKt371DRTwjV5mdE5Apw.png?1782315420)
4. Complete the ad creation steps, and at the ad set level, select **Instant forms** as your conversion location.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074423428/original/CQbtsYOjoHb0XgDy2PUn1iCMS5Y7DBzwgg.png?1782315510)
5. Create an instant form and complete the required form setup steps. In the **Ending** section, select **Book time** under **Additional actions**.  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074423859/original/ZwTL8cCixJLcXzVn5YWYrxLcuwWkQNBj_Q.png?1782315697)**
6. Paste your HighLevel calendar URL under **Scheduling link**. Meta will automatically detect the calendar provider and display a live preview of the embedded calendar widget in Ads Manager when supported.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074424018/original/_M8ShhQJRl54Gn5xQC6BNue3z2nL2uhYrA.png?1782315758)
7. Complete the rest of your instant form and click **Publish** when your ad is ready.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074424082/original/8gPJcZwLuhedf8NbHgWYYDEpupcVpRboow.png?1782315830)
8. Consider creating follow-up workflows in HighLevel based on what happens after the form is submitted. For example, use **Facebook Lead Form Submitted** to follow up with leads who submit the Instant Form, use **Customer Booked Appointment** for contacts who complete the booking, and add appointment reminders or internal notifications to help reduce no-shows and keep your team informed.

```
Important: Embedded appointment booking is currently available for ads delivered on the Facebook mobile app. Ads shown in other placements, such as Instagram, may show the Book time CTA and open the booking page in a separate in-app browser instead of embedding the calendar on the Thank You page.

Note: Use the LeadConnector domain HighLevel calendar link for embedded booking. Branded-domain calendar links may not show the embedded preview in Ads Manager and may open the booking page in a browser in live ads instead of using the embedded experience.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does this work on Instagram placements?**  
The embedded booking experience is optimized for the Facebook mobile app. On unsupported placements, including Instagram, the booking link may open through the existing in-app browser behavior instead of embedding directly in the Thank You page.

**Q: Where can I review booked appointments?**Open the same sub-account used for the campaign and go to Calendars. Review the calendar or appointment view for the specific calendar tied to the scheduling link you added to the Instant Form. Use the date range, calendar, or team member filters to find appointments booked from that campaign.

**Q: Will the lead’s information be prefilled in the booking flow?**  
When supported, lead details such as name, email, and phone can be carried from the Instant Form into the booking experience to reduce duplicate entry.

**Q: Can I use different HighLevel calendars for different ads?**  
Yes. Use the scheduling link for the specific HighLevel calendar, service, or booking flow that matches each campaign.

**Q: What should I check if the embedded calendar loads but no time slots appear?**  
Check the HighLevel calendar’s availability, assigned team member, conflict calendars, buffers, date-specific hours, and booking rules. Also test the HighLevel calendar link outside Meta to confirm it works normally.

**Q: Are appointment confirmations sent by Meta or HighLevel?**  
Appointment confirmations and reminders should be managed by the HighLevel calendar and notification settings connected to the booking link.

**Q: Is coding required to use this feature?**  
No coding is required for the standard setup. Add the HighLevel calendar scheduling link to the **Book time** CTA in the Instant Form editor when the option is available.

**Q: What happens if a lead closes the booking widget before scheduling?**  
 If a lead closes the booking widget, they can reopen it by tapping the **Book time** button on the Thank You page. If messaging is enabled, the lead may also receive a Messenger reminder to complete the booking.

**Q: Can I see booked appointment counts in Ads Manager?**  
Appointment booking counts are not shown in Ads Manager for this embedded booking experience. Review confirmed appointments in the HighLevel calendar connected to the scheduling link used in your Instant Form.

**Q: Can I customize the embedded calendar shown in Facebook?**  
The calendar appearance is controlled by your HighLevel calendar settings. Meta does not provide additional customization options for the embedded calendar inside the Instant Form experience.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Step-by-Step Guide to Facebook Integration in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001157632-step-by-step-guide-to-facebook-integration-in-highlevel?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Getting Started - Setup Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005064-getting-started-setup-facebook-and-instagram-lead-ads?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Create a Facebook Form in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002439-how-to-create-a-facebook-form-in-ad-manager?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [How to Set Up a Booking Calendar in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005061-getting-started-setup-a-booking-calendar?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Facebook Lead Ad Integration & Troubleshooting Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000987779-facebook-lead-ad-integration-troubleshooting-guide?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Workflow Trigger - Customer Booked Appointment](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002675-workflow-trigger-customer-booked-appointment?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

title_en: Create and Manage Rental Add-ons
source_md:
# **How to Create and Manage Rental Add-ons in HighLevel**

Rental Add-ons let businesses offer optional extras, such as pet fees, equipment rentals, or insurance, alongside rental bookings. Admins can create reusable add-ons, configure pricing and taxes, and assign them to multiple listings. Customers can select extras during booking and see updated totals, while admins can manage add-ons on existing reservations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How to Create and Manage Rental Add-ons in HighLevel](#How-to-Create-and-Manage-Rental-Add-ons-in-HighLevel)
- [What Are Rental Add-ons?](#What-Are-Rental-Add-ons?)
- [Key Benefits of Rental Add-ons](#Key-Benefits-of-Rental-Add-ons)
- [Rental Add-on Pricing and Settings](#Rental-Add-on-Pricing-and-Settings)
- [How to Create and Manage Rental Add-ons](#How-to-Create-and-Manage-Rental-Add-ons)
- [Assigning Add-ons to Rental Listings](#Assigning-Add-ons-to-Rental-Listings)
- [Add-ons During the Booking Process](#Add-ons-During-the-Booking-Process)
- [Add-on Taxes](#Add-on-Taxes)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What Are Rental Add-ons?**

Rental Add-ons are optional products or services that customers can include with their rental reservations. They are managed through a global catalog and can be reused across multiple rental listings, eliminating the need for separate listings or manual charges.

For example, a vacation rental may offer a BBQ station or heated pool, while a vehicle rental may offer GPS navigation or equipment insurance.

**Note:** Add-ons are always optional. For mandatory charges, use Additional fees instead.

---

## **Key Benefits of Rental Add-ons**

Rental Add-ons simplify how businesses offer and manage optional services while giving customers more flexibility and transparency during booking.

- **Centralized Management:**Create reusable add-ons and assign them to multiple listings.
- **Flexible Pricing:**Configure fixed or percentage-based charges with quantity limits.
- **Additional Revenue:**Offer optional equipment and services alongside rentals.
- **Transparent Booking Experience:**Display available extras, update totals in real time, and include itemized charges on invoices.

---

## **Rental Add-on Pricing and Settings**

Add-ons support different pricing methods, quantities, and visibility configurations. Choosing the correct settings ensures customers are charged accurately and can select only the extras intended for their bookings.

### **Pricing Options**

| Pricing Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flat – Per booking | Fixed charge per selected add-on quantity, regardless of rental duration. | BBQ Station: $150/booking |
| Flat – Per booking unit | Charged for each hour, day, week, or month based on the listing's booking unit. | Heated Pool: $299/month |
| Percentage | Percentage of the base rental subtotal before taxes. | Insurance: 10% of $1,000 = $100 |

Important: Percentage charges do not compound with other add-ons or fees. Maximum quantity is a fixed cap per booking, regardless of the number of rental units.

### **Add-on Settings**

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Required name displayed to customers and on invoices. |
| Description / Image | Optional information displayed on the booking page. |
| Status | Set to Active or Inactive. |
| Price | Choose Flat amount or Percentage and enter the value. |
| Pricing unit | Choose Per booking or Per booking unit for flat pricing. |
| Maximum quantity | Maximum units selectable per booking; does not track inventory. |
| Hide from booking page | Keeps the add-on available to admins but hidden from customers. |
| Tax | Configure applicable taxes after saving the add-on. |

```
Note: Add-on status and visibility settings determine whether customers or admins can select an add-on for new bookings without affecting previously recorded selections.
  
• Active: Available for new bookings unless hidden from the customer-facing booking page.
• Hidden: Not visible to customers but available to admins when creating or editing bookings.
• Inactive: Unavailable for new bookings but remains assigned to existing listings. Previously selected add-ons remain on existing bookings.
```

---

## **How to Create and Manage Rental Add-ons**

The global catalog lets admins create, search, edit, and organize rental extras from one location. Add-ons can be assigned to multiple listings and updated centrally, reducing repetitive configuration.

### **Create a Global Add-on**

1. Navigate to Calendars → Calendar Settings → Rentals → Add-ons.
2. Click + New add-on.
3. Enter the Name, optional Description, and Image.
4. Select Active or Inactive.
5. Choose the Price type, enter the amount, and configure the Pricing unit if applicable.
6. Set the Maximum quantity and customer visibility.
7. Optionally select the listings to associate with the add-on.
8. Click Create add-on.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083908594/original/6LbFuueJHl4DYgkc8TxGdV9YnXi61xa6QQ.png?1792617709)

```
Tip: The image uploader supports SVG, PNG, JPG, and GIF formats and recommends an image size of 66 × 46 pixels.
```

### **Manage Existing Add-ons**

Created add-ons appear in the catalog with their names, prices, pricing units, assigned listings, statuses, and available actions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083908638/original/WRmJL5YvoBJY4G3M3Sz8IbB1ipSF3u16vw.png?1792617803)

Use the Search bar to find add-ons by name, Filters to narrow results by associated listings, or the Edit and Deleteactions to manage existing entries.

If a listing filter returns no results, clear or adjust it to check for other add-ons in the catalog.

```
Important: Editing a global add-on updates its configuration across all associated listings. Deleting it removes it from those listings, but previously created bookings retain their recorded add-on details.
```

---

## **Assigning Add-ons to Rental Listings**

Add-ons can be attached to listings from the global catalog or directly through an individual listing. Both methods use the same global add-on records, helping businesses maintain consistent settings.

| Method | Steps |
| --- | --- |
| Global Catalog | Open Rentals → Add-ons, create or edit an add-on, select one or more listings, and save. |
| Individual Listing | Open Rentals → Listings, edit a listing, select the Add-ons tab, click + Add-on, and choose an existing add-on or + New Add-on. |

Multiple add-ons can be attached to a listing.

- Edit: Change an add-on's configuration from the listing's Add-ons tab and save. Changes apply globally.
- Remove: Detach an add-on from the current listing without deleting it from the global catalog.

```
Important: If different listings require different add-on prices or settings, create separate entries in the global catalog.  
For more information, see Rentals – Create & Edit Listings.
```

---

## **Add-ons During the Booking Process**

Customers can select optional extras while booking a rental, and admins can add or modify them when managing reservations. Selected add-ons contribute to the booking total and appear as individual charges on the associated invoice.

### **Customer Booking Page**

After selecting rental dates and quantities, customers see an Add-ons area displaying active, non-hidden extras assigned to the listing.

Each card can display the add-on image, name, description, price, and Add/Remove controls.

- Selecting or removing an add-on updates the total in real time.
- Quantity selectors appear only when the maximum quantity exceeds one.
- Hidden or inactive add-ons do not appear on the customer booking page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083908713/original/jbgSJel-5FZj714_TeW-psIA8QG4YDPeOg.png?1792618022)

### **Add-ons in Manual Bookings**

Admins can attach optional extras when creating rental bookings, including add-ons hidden from customers.

1. Open the rental booking creation screen and click Add new listing.
2. Select the listing, rental dates, times, and quantities.
3. Expand Select add-ons.
4. Select the extras and adjust their quantities.
5. Review the charges and click Add listing.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083908722/original/MAMxL67V-0aIe4GXXjo_rRxNekWv-ISzew.png?1792618075)

### 

### **View and Edit Existing Booking Add-ons**

Admins can review selected extras in Booking details → Rental details, where add-ons appear beneath the corresponding rental listing.

To modify an existing booking:

1. Open the booking and select Edit Booking.
2. Add, remove, or adjust add-on quantities.
3. Review the updated total.
4. Click Save to apply changes or Discard to revert them.

```
Important: An Unsaved Changes banner appears until changes are saved or discarded. Updating add-ons affects the booking total and may require payment adjustments for paid bookings.  
For additional information, see Rentals – Editing a Booking.
```

---

## **Add-on Taxes**

Add-on taxes can be configured separately from the base rental, while status and visibility controls determine whether customers or admins can select an extra. These settings allow businesses to manage availability without changing previously recorded bookings.

Configure Add-on Taxes

1. Navigate to Rentals → Add-ons.
2. Edit an existing add-on and select Configure tax.
3. Assign the applicable tax rate and save.

Taxes are calculated on the add-on's applicable line total, considering the selected quantity and pricing unit. Tax amounts appear separately from add-on charges on the invoice and are included in the customer-facing total where applicable.

For additional guidance, see [Rentals – Taxes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007423-taxes-for-rentals).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can the same add-on have different prices across listings?**

Not when using one shared add-on. Create separate global add-on entries for different prices or configurations.

**Q: Is the maximum quantity based on the number of rental units?**

No. The limit applies to the entire booking. For example, a maximum of two allows up to two units of that add-on regardless of how many rental units are booked.

**Q: Can admins modify add-ons after a booking is paid?**

Yes, subject to existing booking payment restrictions. Changes may require payment adjustments, and the updated total cannot be lower than the amount already paid.

**Q: Are add-on charges included on invoices?**

Yes. Selected add-ons appear as separate invoice line items, with applicable taxes included in the tax breakdown. Invoices are not necessarily emailed automatically when bookings are created.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Rentals – Overview & How to Get Started](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006649-rentals-overview-how-to-get-started)
- [Rentals – Create & Edit Listings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006579-rentals-create-edit-listings)
- [Rentals – Configuring Pricing & Discounts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006611-configuring-pricing-discounts)
- [Rentals – Creating a Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006624-creating-a-booking)
- [Rentals – Taxes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007423-taxes-for-rentals)

title_en: Using Apple Pay and Google Pay in order forms
source_md:
Payments • Stripe • Order Forms

Using Apple Pay and Google Pay in HighLevel Order Forms

Apple Pay and Google Pay give eligible customers a faster way to complete purchases without manually entering card details during checkout. HighLevel supports these digital wallets on eligible One-Step and Two-Step Order Forms when Stripe is used as the payment provider. Wallet settings can be managed directly from the HighLevel sub-account. This guide explains how to configure Apple Pay and Google Pay, understand checkout eligibility, and troubleshoot wallet visibility.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to manage Apple Pay and Google Pay from the Stripe integration, configure the correct Order Form and payment environment, understand Apple Pay domain verification, and troubleshoot wallets that do not appear at checkout.

Important

Enabling a wallet does not guarantee that every customer will see it. Wallet visibility can depend on the product area, Test or Live configuration, Stripe account eligibility, customer location, browser or device, wallet setup, and additional requirements such as Apple Pay domain verification.

# What Are Apple Pay and Google Pay in HighLevel Order Forms?

Apple Pay and Google Pay are digital wallet payment methods customers can use during eligible HighLevel Order Form checkouts. They are available through Stripe and can appear alongside other enabled payment methods when the customer and checkout environment meet the applicable requirements.

HighLevel supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for eligible **Funnels - One-Step Order Form** and **Funnels - Two-Step Order Form** payment experiences.

## Key Benefits of Apple Pay and Google Pay

Digital wallets can reduce the amount of information eligible customers need to enter manually during checkout while giving businesses centralized control over where supported Stripe payment methods are available.

- **Faster Checkout:** Eligible customers can use a saved wallet instead of manually entering card information.
- **Centralized Management:** Manage supported Stripe payment methods directly from the HighLevel sub-account.
- **Order Form Support:** Configure wallet availability for eligible One-Step and Two-Step Order Forms.
- **Separate Environment Controls:** Configure supported payment methods independently for Test and Live environments.
- **Subscription Controls:** Review subscription-specific payment-method settings when the checkout includes recurring products.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Apple Pay and Google Pay only appear when the payment configuration and the customer's checkout environment meet the applicable requirements. Reviewing these conditions first helps prevent unnecessary Order Form troubleshooting.

- Stripe must be connected to the applicable HighLevel sub-account.
- The wallet must be enabled for the applicable Order Form product area.
- Confirm that you are configuring the correct **Test** or **Live** environment.
- The customer's country, device, browser, and payment account must support the selected wallet.
- The customer must have an eligible payment method configured in the applicable wallet.
- **Apple Pay** requires completed domain verification before it can appear during eligible checkout experiences.
- Subscription checkouts can have separate payment-method settings under **Subscriptions**.
- The **Subscriptions** configuration becomes available after a subscription product has been added in Live Mode for the applicable sub-account.

**Payment-provider scope:** Apple Pay and Google Pay for the Order Form use case covered here are provided through Stripe. Other payment providers have their own supported payment methods and product-area availability.

## How To Set Up Apple Pay and Google Pay for Order Forms

Stripe payment methods are managed from the Payments area of the HighLevel sub-account. Configure the wallets for the applicable Order Form product area and payment environment before testing the customer checkout.

### Step 1: Open the Stripe Integration

Start from the Stripe integration so you can access payment-method management and wallet-related configuration for the connected account.

1. From the **HighLevel sub-account view**, select **Payments**.
2. Select **Integrations**.
3. Locate **Stripe**.
4. Click **Manage**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081349015/original/WVJMR68TiXPoMzMU2WaZ7Ds6oERy4PCbjQ.png?1789796366)

### Step 2: Open Manage Payment Methods

The Stripe management page provides access to payment-method settings and the domain-registration control used for Apple Pay and Link.

1. On the **Manage Payment Integration** page, confirm the Stripe connection status.
2. Review **Register domains for Apple Pay and Link**.
3. Click **Manage Payment Methods**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081349023/original/nIMKflhmzf6zh0Gvq_HXTomMRZ_hLP48pA.png?1789796400)

**Apple Pay requirement:** Apple Pay requires completed domain verification. If Apple Pay is enabled but does not appear at checkout, domain verification should be one of the first settings you review.

### Step 3: Configure the Order Form Payment Methods

Payment methods are configured by product area, which lets you control whether a wallet is available for a One-Step Order Form, Two-Step Order Form, or another supported payment experience.

1. Review the available Stripe payment-method configurations.
2. Locate **Funnels - One-Step Order Form** or **Funnels - Two-Step Order Form**, depending on the checkout you use.
3. Enable **Apple Pay** where available.
4. Enable **Google Pay** where available.
5. Save the changes.

### Step 4: Verify Test or Live Mode

Test and Live payment-method configurations are independent. A wallet enabled only in one environment may not appear when the checkout is using the other environment.

1. Confirm whether you are configuring **Test** or **Live**.
2. Verify Apple Pay and Google Pay are enabled in the environment you plan to test or use.
3. Save any changes before testing the Order Form again.

### Step 5: Review Subscription Settings When Needed

Subscription products can use a separate payment-method configuration, so recurring checkouts should be reviewed independently from one-time Order Form settings.

1. Open the **Subscriptions** payment-method configuration when it is available.
2. Review the available wallet methods for subscription checkout.
3. Enable the applicable wallet settings and save your changes.

**Subscriptions not visible?** The Subscriptions configuration becomes available after at least one subscription product has been added in Live Mode for that sub-account.

## How Wallet Availability Works at Checkout

Enabling a wallet makes it available to eligible checkout experiences, but the final payment options displayed to a customer are determined at checkout based on several configuration and eligibility factors.

| Factor | Why It Matters |
| --- | --- |
| **Product Area** | The wallet must be enabled for the specific checkout type being used. |
| **Test or Live Mode** | The method must be enabled in the same environment as the checkout being tested or used. |
| **Stripe Account Eligibility** | Payment-method availability can depend on account activation, region, and Stripe eligibility requirements. |
| **Customer Location** | Some payment methods are only available in supported countries or regions. |
| **Device and Browser** | The customer's checkout environment must support the applicable wallet. |
| **Wallet Setup** | The customer needs an eligible wallet with a supported payment method configured. |
| **Apple Pay Domain Verification** | Apple Pay requires domain verification before it can appear on eligible web checkouts. |

If a wallet does not appear, verify the payment configuration and customer eligibility before treating the missing payment option as an Order Form issue.

## Troubleshoot Apple Pay and Google Pay

Wallet visibility is determined by several layers of configuration. Start with the Stripe integration and payment-method settings, then verify the checkout environment and customer eligibility.

### Troubleshoot Apple Pay

Apple Pay requires an eligible Stripe configuration, the correct Order Form settings, and completed domain verification before it can appear on a supported checkout.

1. Go to **Payments → Integrations**.
2. Click **Manage** for Stripe.
3. Open **Manage Payment Methods**.
4. Confirm **Apple Pay** is enabled for the applicable One-Step or Two-Step Order Form.
5. Verify the correct **Test** or **Live** environment.
6. If the checkout contains a subscription product, review the **Subscriptions** payment-method settings.
7. Confirm the Stripe account is activated and eligible for the payment method.
8. Confirm Apple Pay domain verification is complete.
9. Test from an eligible customer environment with Apple Pay configured.

### Troubleshoot Google Pay

Google Pay visibility depends on the Stripe payment-method configuration and whether the customer's checkout environment is eligible to display the wallet.

1. Go to **Payments → Integrations**.
2. Click **Manage** for Stripe.
3. Open **Manage Payment Methods**.
4. Confirm **Google Pay** is enabled for the applicable One-Step or Two-Step Order Form.
5. Verify the correct **Test** or **Live** environment.
6. If the checkout contains a subscription product, review the **Subscriptions** payment-method settings.
7. Confirm the Stripe account and payment method are eligible.
8. Test from a supported customer environment with Google Pay configured.

**Troubleshooting order:** Check product area, Test/Live mode, payment-method status, Stripe eligibility, and customer environment before changing the Order Form itself.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why does a wallet not appear even though I enabled it?

Wallet visibility also depends on the selected product area, Test or Live environment, Stripe account eligibility, customer location, browser or device, and wallet configuration. Apple Pay additionally requires domain verification.
