![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070783044/original/_dSgoaT2jtTMZ0TUuEIj5KyI3-rhBkXPxQ.gif?1778149258)

#### **Step 5: Verify the Custom Views in the Destination Sub-Account**

1. Open the destination sub-account.
2. Go to Contacts.
3. Open the Contact Detail Page customization area.
4. Confirm that the copied custom views are available.
5. Review the layout to make sure the correct fields, panels, modules, and view structure appear as expected.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I copy custom Contact Detail Page views from one sub-account to another?**Yes. Custom Contact Detail Page views can be included in snapshots and reused across sub-accounts.

**Q: Do I need to recreate custom views manually in every sub-account?**  
No. Once the view exists in the source sub-account, you can include it in a snapshot and push it to linked sub-accounts.

**Q: How many Contact Detail Views can a sub-account have?**  
Each sub-account has 1 default Contact Detail View and can have up to 4 additional custom views created manually or added by snapshot import, for a total of 5 views.

**Q: Will the imported view become the default Contact Detail View in the destination sub-account?**  
No. A view that is default in the source sub-account does not become default in the destination sub-account after import. It is imported as a custom view.

**Q: Are users copied with the custom view?**  
No. Users are not copied with imported Contact Detail Views. After deployment, assign the imported view to the users or groups who should use it inside the destination sub-account.

**Q: What happens if the destination sub-account does not have the custom fields used in the source view?**The import is not blocked. Fields that do not exist in the destination sub-account are skipped during mapping. Review the imported view afterward to confirm the correct fields appear.

**Q: What should I check if the copied view does not appear as expected?**  
Confirm the view was selected under Contact Detail Views, the snapshot update was pushed to the correct sub-account, users or groups were assigned to the imported view, and any required custom fields exist in the destination sub-account.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Creating Custom Objects using Snapshots](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004922)
- [Creating New Snapshots in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982512)
- [Refresh or Update Snapshots](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982583)
- [Load Snapshots Into Existing Sub-Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982582)
- [How to View Snapshot Assets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005917)
- [Snapshots - Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000982511)

title_en: Dashboards: Meta Ad Widgets and Insights
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/K57AnPi\_u6c?&wmode=opaque)

Quickly surface the numbers that matter—right where you work. Meta Ad Widgets let you display clicks, conversions, spend, and top-performing campaigns directly inside any HighLevel dashboard or custom report. Use built‑in filters and charts to compare results across campaigns without spreadsheets or switching tools.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Meta Ad Widgets?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-are-Meta-Ad-Widgets?)
- [Key Benefits of Meta Ad Widgets](#Key-Benefits-of-Meta-Ad-Widgets)
- [Prerequisites & Access](#Prerequisites-&-Access)
- [Meta Ad Performance Metrics](#Meta-Ad-Performance-Metrics)
- [Top Campaigns Widgets](#Top-Campaigns-Widgets)
- [Dashboard Widgets vs. Custom Report Widgets](#Dashboard-Widgets-vs.-Custom-Report-Widgets)
- [How To Setup Meta Ad Widgets](#How-To-Setup-Meta-Ad-Widgets)
  - [1) Add Widgets to a Dashboard](#1)-Add-Widgets-to-a-Dashboard)
  - [2) Add Widgets to a Custom Report](#2)-Add-Widgets-to-a-Custom-Report)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Meta Ad Widgets?**

Meta Ad Widgets are ready-made, visual reporting blocks that pull metrics from a connected Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad account into the Sub-Account Dashboard and Custom Reports. They eliminate manual exports so you can monitor paid‑traffic performance in the same workspace where you manage funnels, automations, and CRM data.

Understanding what Meta Ad Widgets are—and where they live—helps you centralize marketing and sales analytics. By viewing ad performance next to pipeline and revenue metrics, you can make faster, data‑driven decisions without bouncing between platforms.

---

## **Key Benefits of Meta Ad Widgets**

Meta Ad Widgets are designed to simplify daily monitoring and speed up optimization. Use the benefits below to align dashboards to your goals and spot issues before they impact spend or results.

- **Single‑pane visibility:** View ad spend, conversions, reach, CTR, and more alongside sales and CRM KPIs.
- **Faster optimization:** Identify rising CPCs or falling efficiency early so you can adjust budgets or creative.
- **Campaign drill‑downs:** Table widgets rank campaigns by spend, purchases, clicks, or impressions for quick winners/losers analysis.
- **Trend tracking:** Line and bar charts reveal movement in cost‑per‑conversion, reach, and other metrics across any date range.
- **Custom themes & filters:** Match your brand theme and slice data by campaign, ad set, or date to tailor insights to each audience or client.

---

## **Prerequisites & Access**

Before adding widgets, confirm your plan access and connection status so data appears as expected.

- A **Meta ad account must be connected** in **Settings → Integrations → Facebook** (LeadConnector).
- Ensure **LeadConnector permissions** are granted for the Business Manager, ad account, and pages you intend to report on.
- **Dashboards & Reports access**: verify users have permission to view or edit dashboards and to create/schedule reports.

---

## **Meta Ad Performance Metrics**

These widgets visualize the core numbers advertisers use to gauge success. Pair spend-based metrics with outcome metrics to keep efficiency front and center.

| Metric | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Website Purchases | Purchases completed on your website from users driven by social ads traffic. |
| Conversions | Actions attributed to your ads (e.g., purchases, sign-ups) as defined by your Meta setup. |
| Meta Ad Clicks | Total clicks on your Meta ads. |
| Amount Spent | Total ad spend in the selected date range. |
| Average CPC (Cost Per Click) | Average amount paid per click. |
| Cost Per Conversion | Average cost to generate one conversion. |
| Ad Impressions | Total number of times your ads were shown. |
| Reach | Unique users who saw your ads. |
| Average CPM (Cost Per Mille) | Average cost per 1,000 impressions. |
| CTR (Click-Through Rate) | Percentage of impressions that resulted in a click. |

---

## **Top Campaigns Widgets**

Table‑style widgets automatically rank campaigns so you can double‑down on what works.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Widget** | **Definition** |
| Top Campaigns by Ad Spend | Campaigns ranked by the highest advertising spend. |
| Top Campaigns by Conversions | Campaigns that drove the most conversions. |
| Top Campaigns by Website Purchases | Campaigns that resulted in the most website purchases. |
| Top Campaigns by Ad Clicks | Campaigns that generated the most clicks on ads. |
| Top Campaigns by Impressions | Campaigns with the highest number of ad impressions. |
| Top Campaigns by Reach | Campaigns that reached the most unique users. |

---

## **Dashboard Widgets vs. Custom Report Widgets**

Both environments use the same Meta metric library; choose based on how you need to consume and share insights.

- **Dashboard** — Best for at‑a‑glance monitoring throughout the day. Widgets live on a sub‑account dashboard and **update automatically**.
- **Custom Reports** — Best for scheduled email delivery and packaged insights. Build layouts with Meta Ad widgets, then schedule to stakeholders as needed. (Note: exported formats and email previews may differ based on content types.)

---

## **How To Setup Meta Ad Widgets**

Get connected and start visualizing performance in a few minutes. The exact steps to add widgets to a dashboard and build a custom report your team or clients can receive on a cadence.

### 

### **1) Add Widgets to a Dashboard**

1. In your **Sub-Account**, navigate to the Dashboard and click the blue button in the top-left corner to open the desired dashboard.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055690090/original/8OpOVwXH-d5Sa8EqYDjXoPqLnPXmNVchXg.png?1760089468)
2. Click **Edit Dashboard** → **Add Widget**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055690825/original/8sJbiHaBnc9zc67JBKcl8HPgiSmhOCfVcw.gif?1760089814)
3. Choose your preferred chart type (Numeric, Donut, Line, Bar, or Table), then scroll to the Meta Ads category and select your desired metric or Top Campaigns widget.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055691630/original/mf9eHbaYs1_CrkgWpPvck5Ik06GdS2xQNg.png?1760090134)
4. Apply filters (campaign, metric, date range) or switch theme/colors.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055692547/original/NgAI0g9YvagwqasoKZi-27mhEjMsfU2m7A.png?1760090539)
5. Click **Save**. The widget begins streaming ad data.

### 

### **2) Add Widgets to a Custom Report**

1. In your **Sub-Account**, go to **Reporting → Custom Reports →**open an existing report or click**New Report**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055693768/original/pjo9zJv8sLVQXrXoGt0Em9dofL_DwFculg.png?1760090986)
2. Choose to **start from a blank canvas**, **use a template**, or **import an existing dashboard layout**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055693789/original/qSGUI9CyAez2mnuhw6aTYAh6TagYwM2xGg.png?1760091013)
3. Click **Add Widget/Element** (top-left). In the widget list, find **Meta** widgets and **drag** the ones you want into the layout.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055693921/original/V2rtATaG6sqwGZ8l59ZNszTDc8PltLhV_g.png?1760091116)
4. Configure each widget: **chart type**, **filters**, and **theme** to suit your needs and Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055694027/original/PXaa35PBm69ylLC_AX1TRu91ClmJj8x0Sg.png?1760091185)
5. Click on Send or Schedule to set up an **email schedule** to receive the report automatically.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055694301/original/w2J4nHxYykP5wsyDPKnFTGFoRTeJqm_0HA.png?1760091375)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. Do I need a separate Meta connection for every sub‑account?**  
Yes. Each sub‑account dashboard pulls data only from the Meta ad account connected inside that sub‑account.

**Q. How often do Meta Ad Widgets refresh?**  
Widgets **update automatically**; no manual refresh is required.

**Q. Why is my widget blank after I add it?**  
Common causes include an overly narrow date range, restrictive campaign filters, no eligible ad account selected, or missing LeadConnector permissions. Remove filters, widen the range, and verify the connection.

**Q. Which roles can connect Meta and add widgets?**  
Users need permission to manage **Ad Manager** connections and to **Edit** dashboards or **Create** reports. View‑only users can see shared dashboards but can’t modify them.

**Q. Can I combine Google Ads and Meta Ads metrics on the same dashboard?**  
Yes. Add widgets from both libraries to compare channels side by side.

**Q. Can I schedule a Meta‑only report for clients?**  
Yes. Build a report using only Meta widgets, then schedule email delivery. Confirm export and layout options meet the client’s needs.

**Q. Will disabling the Meta integration break my existing widgets?**  
Widgets stop displaying data until you reconnect an eligible ad account, but your layout and widget settings remain in place.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Connect Facebook with Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003044-connect-facebook-with-ad-manager)
- [How to Create & Add Dashboard Widgets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001206-how-to-create-add-dashboard-widgets)
- [How to Create and Schedule Reports](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003965-how-to-create-and-schedule-reports)
- [How To Manage Dashboard Permissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001532-how-to-manage-dashboard-permissions)
- [How to Create and Use Custom Metrics For Dashboard Reports](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005903-how-to-create-and-use-custom-metrics-for-dashboard-reports)

title_en: How to Enable and Rebill Workflow Premium Features
source_md:
Workflow Premium Features allow sub-accounts to use supported premium triggers, actions, Marketplace Apps, and LC Apps inside workflows.

Agencies can enable these features for sub-accounts, rebill usage to clients, and optionally offer Workflow Pro plans that include bundled premium executions at discounted rates.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Workflow Premium Features?](#What-Are-Workflow-Premium-Features?)
- [What Counts as a Premium Execution?](#What-Counts-as-a-Premium-Execution?)
- [Free Premium Executions](#Free-Premium-Executions)
- [Standard Premium Execution Pricing](#Standard-Premium-Execution-Pricing)
- [Workflow Pro Plans](#Workflow-Pro-Plans)
- [Enable Workflow Premium Features](#Enable-Workflow-Premium-Features)
- [Enable Rebilling for a Sub-Account](#Enable-Rebilling-for-a-Sub-Account)
- [Configure Your Markup](#Configure-Your-Markup)
- [How Rebilling Works](#How-Rebilling-Works)
- [Agency Usage Cost](#Agency-Usage-Cost)
- [Client Rebilling](#Client-Rebilling)
- [Agency and Sub-Account Wallets](#Agency-and-Sub-Account-Wallets)
- [Resell Workflow Pro](#Resell-Workflow-Pro)
- [How Sub-Accounts Purchase Workflow Pro](#How-Sub-Accounts-Purchase-Workflow-Pro)
- [What Happens When the Execution Limit Is Reached?](#What-Happens-When-the-Execution-Limit-Is-Reached?)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Are Workflow Premium Features?**

Workflow Premium Features include supported workflow triggers and actions that incur premium execution charges.

Examples can include:

- Inbound Webhooks
- Custom Webhooks
- Google Sheets actions
- Slack actions
- Marketplace Apps
- LC Apps
- Other supported premium workflow triggers and actions

> **Important:** Some workflow features can use separate pricing models. Always refer to the individual feature documentation when pricing differs from standard premium execution pricing.

---

## **What Counts as a Premium Execution?**

A premium execution occurs when a supported premium workflow trigger or action runs.

Premium executions can include:

- Premium workflow triggers
- Premium workflow actions
- Marketplace App actions
- LC App actions

Standard workflow actions do not consume Workflow Pro premium execution allowances. Some AI-related workflow features may also use separate pricing and should be reviewed individually.

---

## **Free Premium Executions**

Each eligible sub-account receives:

**100 free lifetime premium executions**

After the free executions are used, standard premium execution charges apply unless the sub-account has an active Workflow Pro plan.

> **Note:** The 100 free executions are lifetime executions and do not reset monthly.

---

## **Standard Premium Execution Pricing**

Without a paid Workflow Pro plan, premium workflow executions are charged at the standard pay-per-execution rate.

Current standard pricing:

**$0.01 per premium execution**

For sub-accounts with a Workflow Pro plan, included executions and discounted overage rates apply based on the selected plan.

---

## **Workflow Pro Plans**

Workflow Pro provides monthly bundles of premium executions at discounted rates.

Current plans include:

| Plan | Monthly Price | Included Executions | Overage Rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0 | 100 lifetime | $0.01/execution |
| Starter | $10/month | 10,000/month | $0.008/execution |
| Growth | $25/month | 30,000/month | $0.006/execution |
| Scale | $50/month | 65,000/month | $0.004/execution |

Paid Workflow Pro execution allowances reset at the beginning of each billing cycle.

Unused monthly executions do not roll over to the next billing cycle.

If the included execution allowance is exceeded, workflows continue running and the applicable overage rate is charged.

---

## **Enable Workflow Premium Features**

To enable Workflow Premium Features for your agency:

1. From **Agency View**, go to **Settings**.
2. Open **Company** settings.
3. Locate **Workflow - Premium Features**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081999701/original/SfLU2Xpbor1bIyS8-iNVdqjF569sdPdOAw.png?1790597382)
4. Enable the feature.
5. Save your changes.

Once enabled, eligible sub-accounts can use supported premium workflow triggers and actions.

> **Note:** Feature availability and billing configuration are separate. Enabling Workflow Premium Features does not automatically mean that rebilling is configured for every sub-account.

---

## **Enable Rebilling for a Sub-Account**

Agencies can rebill premium workflow usage to individual sub-accounts.

To configure rebilling:

1. From **Agency View**, go to **Sub-Accounts**.
2. Locate the applicable sub-account.
3. Click the **More Options** menu.
4. Select **Manage Client**.
5. Open the **Rebilling** section.
6. Locate **Workflow - Premium Features**.
7. Enable rebilling.
8. Configure the markup.
9. Save your changes.

Once enabled, premium workflow usage can be charged to the client based on the configured rebilling settings.

---

## **Configure Your Markup**

You can apply a markup to premium workflow usage when rebilling clients.

For example:

If the underlying cost is:

**$0.01 per execution**

and you configure a **2x multiplier**, the client is charged:

**$0.02 per execution**

The difference between the underlying cost and the client-facing charge becomes your agency's gross profit.

> **Important:** A multiplier and a margin percentage are not the same. For example, charging 5x the underlying cost represents a 400% markup over cost, not a 500% margin.

---

## **How Rebilling Works**

When rebilling is enabled, premium execution usage creates two billing relationships.

### **Agency Usage Cost**

The agency is charged for the underlying premium workflow usage based on the applicable execution rate.

### **Client Rebilling**

The client is charged according to the price or markup configured by the agency. This allows agencies to recover the underlying usage cost and optionally add a markup.

---

## **Agency and Sub-Account Wallets**

Premium workflow charges can involve both agency-level and sub-account-level billing. Depending on the account configuration:

- The agency is responsible for the underlying workflow execution charges.
- Rebilling allows those charges to be passed to the client.
- Client-facing charges are based on the markup configured by the agency.

Review the sub-account's rebilling configuration to confirm how premium workflow charges are being passed through.

---

## **Resell Workflow Pro**

Agencies can also offer Workflow Pro plans to sub-accounts. To configure Workflow Pro reselling:

1. From **Agency View**, go to **Reselling**.
2. Locate **Workflow Pro**.
3. Enable reselling.
4. Configure the markup or client-facing price.
5. Save your changes.

The configured pricing determines what clients pay when purchasing a Workflow Pro plan.

---

## **How Sub-Accounts Purchase Workflow Pro**

Sub-account users can review and purchase Workflow Pro plans from their Workflow settings.

1. Open the applicable sub-account.
2. Go to **Automation → Workflows**.
3. Open **Global Workflow Settings**.
4. Locate **Workflow Pro Plans**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082000468/original/qlkSPV3oIhRJRT6zZGgg9_xfQPooqnx2ww.png?1790597724)
5. Click **View Plans**.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082000507/original/_Y6b4dtR_hMlA0AYoUKPosoo2M3bma_pCQ.png?1790597760)
6. Select the preferred plan.
7. Complete the purchase.

Once the plan is active, the included premium execution allowance applies to eligible premium workflow executions.

---

## **What Happens When the Execution Limit Is Reached?**

Workflow Pro plans do not stop workflows when the included execution allowance is exhausted.

Instead:

1. The included monthly executions are used first.
2. Additional premium executions are billed at the plan's applicable overage rate.
3. Workflows continue running normally.

This prevents workflows from stopping unexpectedly because the monthly included allowance was consumed.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### 

### **Do the 100 free executions reset every month?**

No. The 100 free executions are lifetime premium executions for the eligible sub-account.

### 

### **Do Workflow Pro executions reset monthly?**

Yes. Paid Workflow Pro plans include a monthly execution allowance that resets each billing cycle.

### 

### **Do unused Workflow Pro executions roll over?**

No. Unused included executions generally do not roll over to the next billing cycle.

### 

### **What happens if a sub-account exceeds its Workflow Pro allowance?**

The workflows continue running. Additional premium executions are charged at the applicable overage rate for the selected plan.

### 

### **Can agencies rebill premium workflow usage?**

Yes. Rebilling can be enabled for eligible sub-accounts from:

**Agency View → Sub-Accounts → Manage Client → Rebilling → Workflow - Premium Features**

### 

### **Can agencies resell Workflow Pro plans?**

Yes. Agencies can configure Workflow Pro reselling from:

**Agency View → Reselling → Workflow Pro**

### **Are all workflow actions billed as premium executions?**

No. Standard workflow actions do not count as premium executions. Supported Premium Triggers, Premium Actions, Marketplace Apps, and LC Apps are generally included in premium execution usage.

Some features can use separate pricing models.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Pro Plans and Premium Execution Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003971)
- [How to Use Inbound Webhooks in Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001237383)
- [How to Use Custom Webhooks in Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003299)
- [Workflow Marketplace Apps](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004025)
- [Workflow AI Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001156)
- [How Rebilling Works for Sub-Accounts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005083)

title_en: How to Set Up an E-Commerce Online Store (Websites)
source_md:
Ecommerce • Websites • Online Stores

How to Set Up an E-Commerce Online Store

HighLevel Ecommerce Stores let businesses display products, accept payments, manage orders, and customize the shopping experience directly from a website. You can use Ask AI for guided onboarding or configure the Store manually using products and Store elements. This guide covers the core setup process, Store pages, checkout behavior, order fulfillment, and Store management.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to create an Ecommerce Store, add products, use Ask AI for guided setup, customize the five Store pages, understand the current checkout experience, manage orders, and delete a Store when needed.

# What Is an Ecommerce Online Store?

An Ecommerce Online Store gives customers a storefront where they can browse products, review product details, manage a cart, complete checkout, and receive an order confirmation.

Store owners can configure products under **Payments → Products**, customize Store pages inside the Website Builder, connect a payment provider, manage orders and transactions, and fulfill purchases from the same sub-account.

## Key Benefits of an Ecommerce Store

Ecommerce Stores connect product management, checkout, payments, and order processing into one customer journey while giving businesses control over how their storefront looks and operates.

- **Centralized Product Management:** Create products, pricing, variants, descriptions, images, and videos under Payments.
- **Customizable Storefront:** Style Store pages and Store elements to match the website and brand.
- **Guided Setup:** Use Ask AI to work through supported Store onboarding tasks.
- **Flexible Checkout:** Collect required customer information, apply eligible coupons, offer available fulfillment options, and accept payment.
- **Order Management:** Review orders, transactions, refunds, and fulfillment details from Payments.
- **Automated Customer Journey:** Connect Store purchases to supported receipts, payment events, and order-related automation.

## How To Set Up an Ecommerce Store

A complete Store requires products, Store pages, a domain, and a connected payment provider. Ask AI can guide supported onboarding tasks, while some account-level setup must still be completed manually.

### Set Up Your First Store With Ask AI

Ask AI uses your Store setup progress to recommend the next supported task when the account does not already have a Store.

1. From the **Sub-Account view**, select **Sites**.
2. Select **Stores** in the top navigation.
3. Click **Complete Setup** in the Store setup banner.
4. Select the setup task you want to complete, or work through the full Store setup.
5. Answer the questions Ask AI presents.
6. Review confirmation requests before Ask AI creates or changes Store data.
7. Continue through the recommended tasks until the supported setup steps are complete.

![Stores page showing the Complete Setup option for guided Store onboarding](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081286257/original/9csqGwK7ltx4Au5UvX02Cw3c7Sp4a2Algw.png?1789731589)

**Continue later:** You do not need to complete Store onboarding in one session. Return to **Sites → Stores → Complete Setup** to continue from the remaining tasks.

### Complete Domain and Payment Setup

Domain and payment setup can require manual actions outside the Ask AI workflow, so confirm these items before publishing the Store.

- **Existing Domain:** Ask AI can assist with connecting an existing account domain to the Store.
- **New Domain:** Setting up a new domain remains a manual step.
- **Payment Provider:** Connecting a payment provider is completed manually. Ask AI does not collect or configure payment-provider credentials.

### Create and Configure Store Products

Product configuration controls what customers see in the Store and gives you the information needed for pricing, variants, media, and product presentation.

1. Go to **Payments → Products**.
2. Create or open a product.
3. Configure the product name, description, media, pricing, and variants as needed.
4. Enable **Include in Online Store** for products that should be available in the Store.
5. Save the product.

![Product settings showing the option to include a product in the Online Store](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930510/original/vXnsZPHSsO7tzFsg2DDhV2vGVXUlJROE7w.png?1790464708)

### Add the Store to a Website

Adding the first Store element or pre-built Store section to a website starts Store creation and generates the required Store pages.

1. Open the required website in the **Website Builder**.
2. Click **Add element**.
3. Drag a Store element, such as **Cart**, **Collections List**, or **Featured Products**, onto the page. You can also use a pre-built Store section.

![Website Builder showing Store elements that can be added to a page](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930613/original/A6-a8qm0gQwWDUjbYPrRmDto-AxzjSpnsQ.png?1790465344)

4. When the import modal appears, choose:
   - **Add Store:** Creates the Store and imports supported design settings from the current page.
   - **Skip:** Creates the Store without importing the current page's theme settings.
5. Continue customizing the generated Store pages and Store elements.

![Store creation modal showing Add Store and Skip options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930617/original/qoNOReSuP6t6bJaBgf18GXzVW5XXLbXnqA.png?1790465363)

## Store Pages and Checkout Experience

HighLevel creates five Store pages that work together to move customers from product discovery through checkout and order confirmation. These pages can be customized with additional website elements and Store-specific settings.

**Products List Page:** Displays the products or services available for customers to browse.

**Product Details Page:** Displays detailed product information, media, pricing, and available variants to help customers make a purchase decision.

**Cart Page:** Gives customers a summary of the items they intend to purchase and lets them adjust the cart before checkout.

**Checkout Page:** This allows customers to enter the required contact and address information, select available fulfillment options, apply eligible coupon codes, and complete payment. When **Pickup in Store** is available and selected, HighLevel hides the Shipping Details section and uses the selected pickup location as the shipping address.

**Thank You Page:** Displays an order confirmation after the purchase is completed successfully.

![Website Builder showing the Ecommerce Store pages used for the customer purchase journey](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009726192/original/GZwk9jvkFpikz-O_ZCXGIOxsZkxIz6IMIg.png?1696942645)

**Store page ordering:** Regular pages can be reordered from the Store's **Pages** grid and placed before or after the Store page group. The five Store pages remain together in this required sequence:

Products List → Product Details → Cart → Checkout → Thank You

The five Store pages cannot be reordered relative to one another, and regular pages cannot be placed between them. If an unsupported move is attempted, the page returns to its previously saved position and HighLevel displays a message explaining the restriction. Rejected moves do not change the saved page order.

Store elements can be customized using their available **General** and **Advanced** settings so the Store matches the rest of the website.

## Manage Orders and Fulfillment

Order and payment records provide the information needed to review purchases, process supported refunds, and track fulfillment after a customer completes checkout.

- Go to **Payments → Orders** to review Ecommerce Store orders.
- Go to **Payments → Transactions** to review payment activity.
- Orders initially requiring fulfillment can be managed from the Order Details page.
- When fulfilling applicable orders, add shipment details such as the tracking number, provider, and tracking URL.
- Fulfillment details remain available on the order after the order is marked fulfilled.

![Ecommerce order fulfillment settings showing shipment and tracking information](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930610/original/mWTUT32AzibJD-CsEEFnrwPi4cdMGO63rQ.png?1790465313)

## Delete a Store

Store deletion removes the pages belonging to that Store without deleting unrelated website pages, helping protect the rest of the website.

1. Go to **Sites → Stores**.
2. Open the Store's **three-dot menu**, or open **Store Settings**.
3. Select **Delete Store**.
4. Type **DELETE** in the confirmation modal.
5. Click **Delete**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930654/original/-M7m6pR8KdMrFg2SXJ9DsTJisJKs8RVHpA.png?1790465762)

**Important:** Store-related pages such as Products List, Product Details, Cart, Checkout, and Thank You are removed. Other website pages remain unchanged. Manually deleting a Store page can also remove the Store pages associated with that Store.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why isn't a product appearing in my Ecommerce Store?

Open the product under **Payments → Products** and confirm **Include in Online Store** is enabled for the product.

Q: Can Ask AI complete every Store setup task for me?

No. Ask AI can guide supported Store setup tasks, but creating a new domain and connecting a payment provider still require manual setup.

Q: What happens to Shipping Details when a customer selects Pickup in Store?

HighLevel hides the Shipping Details section and uses the customer's selected pickup location as the shipping address.

Q: Where can I review Store orders and payments?

Use **Payments → Orders** for order records and **Payments → Transactions** for payment activity.

Q: Can I have more than one Store in the same sub-account?

Yes. Multiple Stores can be created within the same sub-account.

Q: Does deleting a Store delete my entire website?

No. Store deletion removes the Store-related pages. Other website pages, such as Home or About, remain unchanged.

title_en: Getting Started - Setup Email, Phone, and SMS
source_md:
This guide walks you through setting up Email, Phone, and SMS inside HighLevel, so you can manage all communications from one platform. By completing these configurations, you’ll be able to send authenticated emails, make and forward calls, and send both individual and bulk SMS messages — including personalized, large-scale SMS campaigns directly from your Contacts tab.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Setup Email](#Setup-Email)
- [Setup Phone](#Setup-Phone)
- [Forward Phone Calls](#Forward-Phone-Calls)
- [Contact a Contact](#Contact-a-Contact)
- [Contact Bulk Contacts](#Contact-Bulk-Contacts)
- [What is Bulk SMS](#What-is-Bulk-SMS)
- [Key Benefits of Sending Bulk SMS](#Key-Benefits-of-Sending-Bulk-SMS)
- [How to Send Bulk SMS via Contacts](#How-to-Send-Bulk-SMS-via-Contacts)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Learn More](#Learn-More%E2%80%8B)

---

# **Setup Email**

Setting up a dedicated email domain ensures better inbox placement, higher deliverability, and a stronger sender reputation.

### **Steps**

1. Navigate to **Settings → Email Services**.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058341148/original/p1uuASqVD_gUorwClGdjJsDbkvOGbDv4Cg.png?1763065965)*
2. Click **Dedicated Domain and IP**.
3. Click **Add Domain**.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058341567/original/-4I43XNEJPeJp7W6ONjNQwHUrOWzOxkItA.png?1763066983)*
4. Enter your subdomain (for example, lc.mydomain.com) and click **Add & Verify**.
5. Follow the on-screen DNS record instructions from your registrar.
6. Click **Verify Records** once the updates are complete.
7. Click the **3-dot menu → Set Headers**.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058341607/original/EjWmtRa3meoFv9y5e5I1i0Gj2kasFgP_rA.png?1763067103)*
8. Enter your **From Name** and **From Email**, then click **Save**.

Your email setup is now complete and ready for verified sending.

---

## **Setup Phone**

Adding a phone number allows you to make and receive calls directly from within HighLevel.

### **Steps**

1. Go to **Settings → Phone System**andClick **Add Number → Add Phone Number**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067473684/original/zXamnRL6zAN3RZJqdA2I4K1RQlfUTxvrQQ.png?1774260664)
2. Filter numbers by **Country** or **Area Code**.
3. Choose your preferred number.
4. Click **Proceed to Buy**.

Your number will appear under **Manage Numbers** once added.

---

## **Forward Phone Calls**

Forwarding ensures incoming calls are automatically redirected to a number of your choice.

### **Steps**

1. Navigate to **Settings → Phone Numbers**.
2. Click the **3-dot menu → Edit Configuration**.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058341810/original/SOrLz4UVwEnUwJrWr5PyaRFZxaKiDyGktA.png?1763067317)*
3. Enter the number where calls should be forwarded.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058341921/original/DJSa9bnLPYzqTqIT6HAGJTMveo-XgaJhCQ.png?1763067474)*
4. Click **Save**.

Your call forwarding setup is now active.

---

## **Contact a Contact**

Easily reach individual contacts from their profile using SMS, Email, or Phone.

### **Steps**

1. Navigate to **Contacts**.
2. Select the contact you wish to reach.
3. Use the message composer tabs to select **SMS**, **Email**, or **Phone**.

   **Screenshot:** Contact record view showing **SMS**, **WhatsApp**, and **Email** tabs.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342064/original/Vhw3T5Acko0Pm489nCDQ-RswCPY9_TTxew.png?1763067867)*

---

## **Contact Bulk Contacts**

Send communications to multiple contacts simultaneously or apply bulk actions such as sending a message or performing list updates.

### **Steps**

1. Go to **Contacts → Smart Lists**.
2. Apply filters to target your audience.

   **Screenshot:** Filters panel showing filter options such as Business Name, Company Name, and Tag.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342133/original/FvGqWx-WJtxH6crdO0HJksIJOHxI5ubPSQ.png?1763068050)*
3. Select contacts using the checkboxes on the left.
4. Use the toolbar at the top to perform bulk actions like sending an **Email** or **SMS**.

   **Screenshot:** Bulk Actions toolbar displayed above the contacts list.

   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342260/original/oA3aLJaqmuX_mlhfJgxrX9GJpR4VS-G38g.png?1763068394)*

The **Bulk SMS** feature allows you to send personalized text messages to multiple contacts in just a few clicks. From promotions to reminders, you can compose, schedule, and track SMS campaigns at scale—all within the **Contacts** tab.

---

## **What is Bulk SMS**

Bulk SMS lets you send one SMS message to multiple contacts simultaneously. It’s ideal for marketing campaigns, service notifications, or time-sensitive updates. This feature ensures consistent communication with your audience without needing to message each contact individually.

---

## **Key Benefits of Sending Bulk SMS**

Using Bulk SMS helps streamline communication while maintaining personalization and delivery control.

- **Save time:** Message hundreds or thousands of contacts with one action.
- **Consistent communication:** Ensure all recipients receive the same information.
- **Personalized content:** Use custom fields and templates for tailored messages.
- **Flexible delivery options:** Choose to send instantly, schedule for later, or drip messages in batches.
- **Track results:** Monitor delivery and performance through the Bulk Actions dashboard.

---

## **How to Send Bulk SMS via Contacts**

Follow these steps to create and send an SMS campaign directly from your Contacts tab.

#### **Step 1:**Select Contacts

Go to **Contacts** and use the checkboxes on the left to select the recipients for your message.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342922/original/lDvptq2pRwRDPNvkV6yceTz8XMKCDqYabA.jpeg?1763069378)*

#### **Step 2:**Open the Bulk SMS Window

Click the **SMS icon** in the top menu bar to open the Bulk SMS setup window.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342921/original/1ZYiKri7cJEzz8qKVYHgcwPDeKhf1lptdA.jpeg?1763069378)*  
**Step 3:**Select the Sending Phone Number

From the **From Phone Number** dropdown, choose the number to send from.

If left blank, the system uses the last number used per contact or the account default.

#### **Step 4:** Compose or Select a Message Template

Type your custom message or select a saved template from **SMS Templates**.

You can personalize messages using custom fields and add emojis or attachments if needed.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342923/original/ihr8RdkQ8Dx_ieTlrQQlVtXcRcoi6SIPJg.jpeg?1763069378)*  
**Step 5:**Choose a Delivery Method

#### **Send All at Once**

Immediately sends your message to all selected contacts.

#### **Send at Scheduled Time**

Set a specific date and time for delivery.

#### **Send in Drip Mode**

Sends messages in smaller batches for improved pacing and deliverability.

**Drip Mode fields:**

- **Pick a Start Date & Time:** When sending begins.
- **Number of Messages per Batch:** Number of contacts per send batch.
- **Repeat After:** Time delay between each batch (in minutes, hours, or days).
- **Send On:** Select specific weekdays for sending.
- **Time Window:** Define allowed sending hours based on account timezone.
- **End At:** The latest time messages can be sent each day; messages outside this window resume the next day.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342920/original/W84znlfIZeBiArRa4ORKsRyyvb0e-ocM_Q.png?1763069378)*

#### **Step 6.**Send the SMS

Click **Send SMS** to submit your campaign. The action will be queued and processed automatically.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342918/original/dIqeYOGfnqOGWLpEVA2bzdzfJxIjm3NiFg.png?1763069378)*

#### **Step 7:**Track Results in Bulk Actions

Go to **Contacts → Bulk Actions** to view campaign status and performance metrics such as sent, delivered, failed, or skipped messages.

Click **Show Stats** for detailed delivery reports, including carrier responses and failure reasons.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058342919/original/DZOA0I8ec-_6dqwR-Exgzi9G7uJTvp6VoA.jpeg?1763069378)*

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What happens if I don’t select a “From” phone number?**

The system uses the last number used for that contact or defaults to the account’s primary number.

**Q: Can I cancel a scheduled bulk SMS?**

Sent messages cannot be canceled. Contact Support immediately for help with scheduled or drip sends.

**Q: How does Drip Mode handle time zones?**

Drip Mode uses your account’s local time zone.

**Q: Will unsubscribed contacts receive messages?**

No. HighLevel automatically excludes unsubscribed or DND contacts to maintain compliance.

**Q: Can I track failed messages?**

Yes. Go to **Bulk Actions → Show Stats** for detailed error reports.

**Q: Can I use the same number for calls and SMS?**

Yes, as long as the number is enabled for both.

**Q: Why verify my email domain?**

A verified domain ensures better inbox placement and prevents spam issues.

**Q: How can I increase messaging limits?**

Contact Support to request an increase after demonstrating consistent, compliant sending activity.

---

## **Learn More**

- [How to Increase Messaging Limits](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006385)
- [Best Practices for SMS Deliverability](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000079)
- [Email Sending Guide: Best Practices & Warm-Up](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001021)

title_en: Prerequisite for Bulk CSV - Basic and Advance CSV
source_md:
Scheduling social media posts in bulk with the help of a CSV file can be the optimal time-saving technique for scheduling the social journey in advance. CSV is a “comma-separated values” file that allows you to save your information in a structured way.  Social Planner supports both format .csv and .xlxs.  
  
Social Planner provides two different types of CSV Upload options for bulk scheduling  
  
1. Basic CSV - Basic CSV supports Date, Content, OG Meta URL, Image(s) Link, Video(s) Link, GIF

[BASIC Download Sample CSV](https://storage.googleapis.com/highlevel-staging.appspot.com/social-media-posting/CSV%20Import%20Sample%20-%20CSV%20Import%20Sample.csv)

2. Advance CSV - Say goodbye to limitations, and hello to the most comprehensive CSV importer in the market. Unlocks full capabilities, including: Platform-specific post types (Post, Story, Reel, Shorts), Watermark, tags, categories, follow-up comment , Google Business Profile (post types, call-to-action, events, offers), YouTube (title, privacy, video type), TikTok, LinkedIn PDFs, Pinterest board selection, and more

[Advance Download Sample CSV](https://storage.cloud.google.com/highlevel-staging.appspot.com/social-media-posting/advance-sample.csv)

#### 

#### (Note - if the title says Advance CSV means that field is only useful in Advance CSV, if it mentions both means that field is applicable for Advance and Basic CSV)

**Planner follows a set of prerequisites -**

---

1. Date and Time Column: [Both]  
 In this column, you can type in the date and time when you want to share your post. In this column, you must format the date exactly how you see it at the top of the column:

- Use the 24-hour format. Example: 2025-08-25 21:30
- If the date column is empty, it will be considered in the Draft.
- The Column Header of this column must be exactly as mentioned in the Sample CSV as shown in the video, it should be as follows: postAtSpecificTime YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm:ss, YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm, M/D/YYYY H:mm:ss, and M/D/YYYY H:mm
- It is highly recommended to have all the scheduled times be at least 10 minutes after the time when you are uploading the CSV.  For example, if the scheduled date/time for the post is  2023-10-14 15:00. This means that the CSV should be  uploaded no later than October 14th, 2023 at 2:50PM.

Please Note:

The schedule time formatting works in 24-hour format, not 12-hour. If you have difficulties with this, you can use[this tool](https://www.ontheclock.com/convert-military-24-hour-time.aspx) for assistance.

### 

### 2. Content Column [Both]

In this column, you can type in or paste what you want to appear as the caption of your post, you can add Hashtags too. The Column header of this column should be written as follows: content

The caption must abide by the social media post character limit rules you are scheduling it for.

**Note:** The caption is shared across all selected channels and limited to the smallest character limit among them (for example, 500 when Threads is selected, 300 with Bluesky). Text over the limit is cut off at import. Import channels with lower limits in a separate CSV to keep full captions elsewhere.

### 

### 3. Preview link:[Both]

In this column, you can type the URL or paste the URL that you want to appear as the link preview of your post. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: link (OGmetaUrl) 

Please Note:

If the other media rows like images, GIF or Video are filled in, they will override the link(OGmetaUrl). It will be appended to content column as a link.

### 

### 4. Image URL [Both]

In this column, you can paste what you want to appear as the image of your post. The column header should be written as follows: imageUrls . You can add multiple image URLs with commas separated. The image link must be in proper formats like png or jpeg/jpg and other aspects for image supported based on the social media platform. The maximum number of images supported is 10 image(s).

Please Note:

Learn more about image dimension and size for different social media platform[here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001210585-what-s-ideal-image-and-video-file-size-and-dimensions-in-social-plan).This same article applies for videos and gifs.

### 

### 5. GIF URL [Both]

In this column, you can paste what you want to appear as the GIF of your post. The Column header of this column should be written as follows: gifUrl

Please Note: 

You must not fill in any other media-related column if you added a link[here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001210585-what-s-ideal-image-and-video-file-size-and-dimensions-in-social-plan). (eg. link, imageUrls, videoUrls). 

### 

### 

### 6. Video URL [Both]

In this column, you can paste what you want to appear as the video of your post. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: videoUrls . You can add multiple Video URLs here comma separated. The maximum number of videos supported for one post is 10 videos at a time.  
  
Please Note: You must not fill in any other media-related column if you added a link [here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001210585-what-s-ideal-image-and-video-file-size-and-dimensions-in-social-plan). 

**Also: Thumbnail URL** **[Both]**

Use this column to set a custom thumbnail for video posts imported through CSV/XLSX.

Column header: thumbnailUrl

Behavior: The thumbnail is automatically applied to the first video in the post.

Limitations: Multiple video thumbnails are not supported, and behavior may vary across social platforms.

7. Media Optimization  [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add True or False to optimise your media means that the errors for dimensions or format will get resolved automatically. Example if the Instagram story requires .Mov file but you uploaded . Mp4 file than it will optimise and convert it to .mov file. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: **mediaOptimization (true/false)**  
  
8. Watermark  [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add True or False to add your watermark to your media assets. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: **applyWatermark (true/false)**  
  
9. Tags [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add multiple tags to your posts to organise them in order. These tags if not added earlier, will create new entry in the filters and dropdowns. Tags needs to be added with comma separated to be considered. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: **tags (comma-separated)**  
  
10. Category [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add a category to your posts to organise them in order. These category if not added earlier, will create new entry in the filters and dropdowns. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: **Category**  
  
11. Follow Up Comment [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add a followup comment which is first comment on your posts for engagement. Followup comments is support for Facebook Pages, Instagram Business Account, Linkedin Profiles and Pages, Youtube Video and Short, Threads and HighLevel Communities. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: followUpComment  
  
12. Facebook - type (post/story/reel) [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add Facebook option/ type of post, story or reel.  The Column header of this column must be written as follows: type (post/story/reel)  
  
13. Instagram - type (post/story/reel)   [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add option of Instagram option/ type of post, story or reel.  The Column header of this column must be written as follows: type (post/story/reel)  
  
14. Linkedin - pdfTitle and postAsPdf (true/false) [Advance]  
  
In this column, you can add Linkedin PDF title if you wish to post the PDF format in Linkedin and if you want to post as pdf and not images you add true or false. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: pdfTitle and postAsPdf (true/false)  
  
15. Google Business Profile [Advance]  
In these column, you can add Google Business Profile options like call\_to\_action/event/offer and according to what you select you can add the other columns. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: eventType (call\_to\_action/event/offer), actionType (none/order/book/shop/learn\_more/call/sign\_up), title, offerTitle, startDate (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss), endDate (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss), termsConditions, couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, actionUrl

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | Button-actionType | Action URL | Title | Offer title | Start Date | End Date | Terms - termsConditions | coupon code | Redeem online url |
| Call to Action | yes | yes | no | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Event | yes | yes | yes | no | yes | yes | no | no | no |
| Offer | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

.  
  
16. Youtube [Advance]  
In these column, you can add Youtube options as title, privacy labels like private, public, unlisted and type like video or shorts. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: title, privacyLevel (private/public/unlisted) and type (video/short)

17. Tiktok  [Advance]  
In these column, you can add tiktok options as privacy level, promote other brand, enable comment, duet, stitch, video disclosure, promote your brand options. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: privacyLevel(everyone/friends/only\_me), promoteOtherBrand(true/false), enableComment(true/false), enableDuet(true/false), enableStitch(true/false), videoDisclosure(true/false), promoteYourBrand (true/false)  
  
18. Community  [Advance]  
In these column, you can add Community option of adding title and notifyAllGroupMembers (true/false). The Column header of this column must be written as follows: title, notifyAllGroupMembers (true/false)  
  
19. Pinterest [Advance]  
In these column, you can add Pinterest option of adding title and link. The Column header of this column must be written as follows: title, link

```
Tip: You can set the Default Pinterest Board within the Social Planner Settings
```

title_en: How to Use Do Not Disturb (DND)
source_md:
This article provides an in-depth guide on the "Do Not Disturb" (DND) feature in HighLevel, explaining its purpose, key benefits, and how to configure it effectively. You'll also find step-by-step instructions for managing DND settings across various communication channels, practical use cases, and answers to common questions about this feature.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Do Not Disturb (DND)?](#What-is-Do-Not-Disturb-(DND)?)
- [Key Benefits of Do Not Disturb (DND)](#Key-Benefits-of-Do-Not-Disturb-(DND))
- [How to Configure Do Not Disturb (DND) Settings](#How-to-Configure-Do-Not-Disturb-(DND)-Settings)
- [Managing DND for Specific Channels](#Managing-DND-for-Specific-Channels)
  - [1. Email](#1.-Email)
  - [2. SMS](#2.-SMS)
  - [3. Calls](#3.-Calls)
  - [4. Facebook Messenger, GMB, and WhatsApp](#4.-Facebook-Messenger,-GMB,-and-WhatsApp)
- [Automating DND Settings with Workflows](#Automating-DND-Settings-with-Workflows)
- [DND Attribution in Conversations and Activity Logs](#DND-Attribution-in-Conversations-and-Activity-Logs)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Do Not Disturb (DND)?**

The Do Not Disturb (DND) feature in HighLevel allows businesses to manage communication preferences by enabling or disabling specific channels for individual contacts. This ensures that communications are aligned with each contact's preferences, enhancing customer satisfaction and compliance. DND settings can be applied globally or tailored to specific channels such as Email, SMS, Calls, Facebook Messenger, Google My Business (GMB), and WhatsApp.

---

## **Key Benefits of Do Not Disturb (DND)**

- **Respect Communication Preferences:** Automatically exclude contacts who have opted out of specific communication channels, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.
- **Enhanced Customer Satisfaction:** Reduces unwanted contact, leading to a better customer experience and higher trust.
- **Improved Automation Efficiency:** Simplifies workflows by enabling or disabling communication-based on DND status.
- **Customizable Channel Control:** Allows businesses to manage DND settings per channel or apply them globally across all channels.
- **Streamlined Compliance Management:** Helps businesses remain compliant with communication laws and guidelines by automating opt-outs for SMS and email.

---

## **How to Configure Do Not Disturb (DND) Settings**

Proper configuration of DND settings ensures that communications are sent according to each contact's preferences. Follow these steps to set up DND in HighLevel:

1. **Access the Contact Record:**

   - Navigate to the "Contacts" section in HighLevel.
   - Select the contact you wish to update.  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041821925/original/BDNEviSudESjixoY2L0JC722Ftn0_VCHVQ.jpeg?1739893461)
2. **Modify DND Settings:**

   - Within the contact's profile, locate the "**DND**" section, which is usually in the left column at the bottom.
   - Choose to **Enable or Disable DND** for all channels or select specific channels (**Email, SMS, Calls**, and **GBP**).  
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041822216/original/hFVAhkngw1RHKPYv9s_PNb_a_SSwGuPW2w.png?1739893694)

```
Please Note: We do have a separate checkbox for DND Inbound Calls and SMS in which Inbound calls from the contact's number will be directly blocked whereas Inbound SMS will be blocked at system level so charges will incur
```

---

## **Managing DND for Specific Channels**

HighLevel allows for granular control over communication channels. Here's how DND functions for key channels:

### **1. Email**

- **Automatic DND Activation:** The system enables DND if a contact unsubscribes, marks an email as spam, or if there are permanent failures like bounces.
- **Removing Email DND:** To remove DND, ensure the contact's email is valid and not on suppression lists. Then, manually update the DND status in the contact's profile.

```
Note: Email DND does not block every type of email. Certain transactional emails can bypass DND so contacts continue receiving critical operational information.
```

**The following email categories can bypass Email DND:**

- Payments (Invoices)
- Calendar notifications
- Notifications

Marketing and promotional emails continue to honor DND preferences. These exceptions apply only to the listed transactional email categories and do not create a general DND bypass.

### **2. SMS**

- **Automatic DND Activation:** DND is enabled if a contact replies with opt-out keywords (e.g., STOP, UNSUBSCRIBE) or if specific error codes (30003, 30004, 30005, 30006) are received from the service provider.
- **Removing SMS DND:**

  - *Temporary DND:* Can be updated directly within the contact's record.
  - *Permanent DND:* Requires the contact to send an opt-in message (e.g., START) or for the agency to provide proof of opt-in to support for manual removal.

### **3. Calls**

- **Inbound DND:** Enabling DND for calls ensures that no incoming calls from the contact are forwarded or displayed, providing uninterrupted workflow.
- **Managing Call DND:** Adjust the DND settings within the contact's profile to enable or disable call reception as needed.

### **4. Facebook Messenger, GMB, and WhatsApp**

- **Channel-Specific DND:** Once integrated, DND settings can be applied to these channels individually, allowing contacts to opt out of specific platforms while remaining active on others.
- **Configuration:** Access the contact's profile and adjust the DND settings for the desired channel accordingly.

---

## **Automating DND Settings with Workflows**

Automations help you apply, clear, and react to DND consistently at scale. This improves compliance, data hygiene, and team response times.

**Useful Triggers & Actions**

- **Contact DND**: Fires when DND is enabled/disabled; filter by channel (Email/SMS/Calls) or direction (Inbound/Outbound) to branch logic.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059903636/original/AMw9XadfwSHaZizO-k9sjVGyL915yh3EUg.png?1764855462)
- **Trigger Link Clicked**: Use unsubscribe trigger links for Email/SMS and route to a workflow that sets per‑channel DND.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054166344/original/TwsYnA3KNJ4j74OHiAmjnUv224upeYJxkA.png?1758296589)
- **Enable/Disable DND Action:**Automatically turn a contact's Do Not Disturb status on or off within workflows. Supports direction control—set to Inbound to block incoming calls/SMS from a contact, or Outbound to stop outgoing communications.  
    
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059903713/original/-4n9XLbPGX1osJ1JG1Oa4TdFzVClcPHS-w.png?1764855486)

**Key Actions**

- **DND Contact**: Enable/disable global or per-channel DND. Set direction to Inbound or Outbound.
- **Update Contact Field**: Set supporting fields (e.g., Consent Source, Opt‑in Timestamp).
- **Remove from Workflow / Stop Campaign**: Immediately halt scheduled sends when DND becomes true.
- **Internal Notification**: Alert the owner when high‑value contacts opt out.

---

## **DND Attribution in Conversations and Activity Logs**

HighLevel shows who triggered a DND status change in Conversations and activity logs:

- **DND Enabled by** Workflows/User/Contact for particular channel or all channels.
- **DND Disabled by** Workflows/User/Contact for particular channel or all channels.

Use the “**by**” value to understand the source of the change:

- **Workflows:** A workflow enabled or disabled DND.
- **User:** A team member enabled or disabled DND.
- **Contact:** The contacted person enabled or disabled DND.

This applies across all channels and requires no setup.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What happens if a contact is marked as DND?**

HighLevel stops communications through the channels where DND is enabled. For email, certain transactional messages can still be delivered, including Payments (Invoices), Calendar notifications, and Notifications. Marketing and promotional emails continue to honor Email DND.

**Q: Can DND settings be customized per channel?**

Yes, HighLevel allows you to enable or disable DND for individual channels if direction is outbound, providing flexibility based on each contact's preferences. Although, Inbound dnd can only be turned on or off for all channels, the channels supported are call and sms only as of now for inbound DND.

**Q: How do I know if a contact has enabled DND?**  
You can check a contact's DND status by opening their **contact profile** in HighLevel. If they have enabled DND for a specific channel, it will appear **grayed out** under the DND section on the left side of their profile.

**Q: Does enabling DND stop all communications?**  
DND blocks communications through the channels where it is enabled, but Email DND has targeted exceptions for certain transactional messages. Payments (Invoices), Calendar notifications, and Notifications can bypass Email DND so critical operational information can still be delivered. Marketing and promotional emails remain blocked when Email DND is enabled.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Trigger — Contact DND](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002673-workflow-trigger-contact-dnd)
- [Workflow Action — DND Contact](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003270-workflow-action-dnd-contact)
- [Configuring Sender ID & Opt‑Out Language (SMS Compliance)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004684-configuring-sender-id-and-opt-out-language-for-sms-compliance)
- [Understanding Common SMS Delivery Errors](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001208912-understanding-common-sms-delivery-errors)
- [How to Resubscribe After Unsubscribing from an Email List](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002948)

title_en: How to Test and Debug AI Conversations in Agent Studio
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/R46SSEd\_29M?&wmode=opaque)

Agent Studio’s Message Execution Timeline and Chat Emulator provide full visibility into every step of an AI conversation so you can debug faster, identify slowdowns, and deploy agents with confidence.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Message Execution Timeline & Chat Emulator?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-the-Message-Execution-Timeline-&-Chat-Emulator?)
- [Key Benefits of Testing and Debugging AI Conversations](#Key-Benefits-of-Testing-and-Debugging-AI-Conversations)
- [Message Execution Timeline](#Message-Execution-Timeline)
- [Transition Node Button](#Transition-Node-Button)
- [Performance Metrics Panel](#Performance-Metrics-Panel)
- [Chat Emulator](#Chat-Emulator)
- [How to Test and Debug AI Conversations in Agent Studio](#How-to-Test-and-Debug-AI-Conversations-in-Agent-Studio)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Message Execution Timeline & Chat Emulator?**

The Message Execution Timeline and Chat Emulator are built-in tools in Agent Studio that help you test and debug AI conversations with full visibility. The Timeline records every event, tool call, and decision your agent makes along with model metrics, while the Chat Emulator lets you simulate conversations, reset sessions, and jump directly to the node responsible for any response. Together, they provide a clear view of agent behavior so you can identify issues, validate logic, and improve performance with confidence.

These tools remove the “black box” effect often associated with AI workflows by showing exactly what happens at each step of execution, allowing you to trace the logic, inspect inputs and outputs, and make targeted improvements based on real data.

---

## **Key Benefits of Testing and Debugging AI Conversations**

Testing and debugging your AI conversations in Agent Studio gives you complete visibility into how your agent thinks, responds, and performs. By combining real-time execution logs with a production-like testing environment, you can validate logic, identify bottlenecks, and refine performance before going live.

- **Complete execution transparency:**Follow every node transition and tool invocation in the exact order they occur, eliminating guesswork.

- **Step-level performance insights:**Detect slow prompts, API calls, or tool steps instantly and optimize them for faster responses.

- **Model and cost awareness:**Review model details, token usage, temperature, and other execution settings directly alongside each message.

- **Instant issue resolution:**Jump from any log entry straight to the responsible node on the canvas to make targeted fixes quickly.

- **Realistic testing environment:**Validate conversations in a chat interface that mirrors the end-user experience, ensuring accurate QA.

---

## **Message Execution Timeline**

The Timeline appears beside the Chat Emulator and updates live as your agent runs.

- Event cards list the node name, model, input/output tokens, and execution time
- Colored latency badges (red = slow; green = fast) highlight bottlenecks
- Hover to view raw JSON inputs/outputs for detailed inspection

```
Task tracking with Todo Manager:

Agent Studio now tracks multi-step agent work using a Todo Manager. Tasks display with descriptive labels and dynamic statuses so you can follow progress more reliably during a test run.

- Tasks use label-based transitions instead of numeric indices.
- Status updates show which task is active and which tasks are completed.
- This makes multi-step plans easier to review in the Timeline and reduces ambiguity when steps change order or new tasks are added.

In addition to node transitions, multi-step task progress is tracked using labeled tasks. This helps you confirm which task the agent is working on as it moves through a longer sequence.
```

---

## **Transition Node Button**

In the **Execution Timeline**, each step displays a purple label. These clickable **Transition labels** indicate the exact node the conversation moved to during execution. Clicking the label automatically focuses and highlights that node on the canvas, allowing you to review or modify its logic immediately without manually searching through your flow.

This makes debugging faster by directly connecting execution logs to the visual builder.

---

## **Performance Metrics Panel**

Beneath each message, the metrics footer displays:

- Model & version (e.g., gpt-4-turbo)
- Input / output token counts
- Temperature, max tokens, top-p, frequency / presence penalties
- Total cost estimate (if billing is enabled)

This information helps evaluate both performance and efficiency during testing.

---

## **Chat Emulator**

A Chat Emulator is a simulated chat interface used to test AI conversations safely. It provides a streamlined testing environment that mirrors real-world deployment scenarios.

- Clean, mobile-responsive chat window with avatar support
- Reset button to clear context between runs
- Side-by-side layout with the Timeline for simultaneous review

---

## **How to Test and Debug AI Conversations in Agent Studio**

This section walks you through how to use the Timeline and Chat Emulator together to inspect execution steps, identify issues, and optimize performance before publishing your agent.

### **Open the Test Environment**

Navigate to **AI Agents → Agent Studio a**nd open the agent you want to test. Click the **Test** tab in the top-right corner to access the Chat Emulator and execution view.

When the Test panel opens, Agent Studio scans your agent for missing required fields.

```
If any required fields are missing, an orange warning appears at the top of the screen and lists the exact node and field you need to complete. The warning does not block testing, but completing the missing fields helps prevent confusing runtime errors.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074782477/original/yYKd-a9MbCgRK4NqMHbsZ-AezlgcL3RIfQ.png?1782768609)

### **Start a Test Session**

Click Start to launch the Chat Emulator. The Message Execution Timeline will appear alongside the chat window automatically.

Send a test message in the emulator or trigger the agent via API. As the agent processes the request, each node transition, tool call, and model execution step logs in real time in the Timeline panel.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074782489/original/L_5601X-jbju2IgEegXUQ_baqwICylST7g.png?1782768656)

### **Review Execution Logs**

Examine the event cards in the Timeline to understand how the agent handled the conversation. Look for node names, tool activity, token usage, execution time, and any latency badges that indicate slower steps.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074782508/original/cYU7k2d1qIT-MA1ZUDZvUQo1oZLpjg6Yhw.png?1782768718)

### **Inspect Performance Metrics**

Click into individual log entries to review detailed metrics such as model version, input/output tokens, temperature, and cost estimates (if enabled). Use this information to evaluate efficiency and fine-tune prompts or tool configurations.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074782517/original/Qkqm_Cyge11usX3Cly-9P66aAnASFBE22w.png?1782768747)

### **Jump to the Source Node**

Click the log card to automatically highlight the corresponding node in the builder. This allows you to quickly adjust logic, prompts, or variables without manually searching the canvas.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074782546/original/6M00qv_SOUXxe3XoNpo-YSVZ6ZcaGF_esA.png?1782768775)

### **Reset and Retest**

Use the Reset button in the Chat Emulator to clear the conversation and execution logs. Run the conversation again to verify that your updates resolved the issue.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074782574/original/qlx5CNgSjFQqPkrEnmX451I8RIYtkY-72w.png?1782768803)

### **Publish with Confidence**

Once testing confirms the conversation behaves as expected and performance is optimized, move your agent to Staging or Production as usual.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is the Timeline available for Voice AI agents?**

Yes. When you open the Test tab for a Voice AI agent, the same log view appears after a test call finishes.

**Q: Does the Timeline increase token usage or cost?**

No. The Timeline records metadata already returned by the model and tool nodes.

**Q: Can I export Timeline logs?**

Click the download icon in the upper-right of the Timeline to save a JSON file of the full execution.

**Q: Why don’t I see the Go to Node button?**

The button appears only after the agent has been saved at least once. Ensure you are not viewing an unsaved Draft.

**Q: Will resetting the Chat Emulator clear the Timeline?**

Yes. Reset clears both the chat context and its associated execution logs for a fresh session.

**Q: Is this feature gated by any plan?**

The Timeline and Chat Emulator are included with Unlimited AI Employee, the same plan required for Agent Studio.

**Q: Why do I see a “Missing Required Fields” warning when I click Test?**

Agent Studio detected one or more nodes with required fields that are not filled in. Open the listed node, complete the required fields, and save to clear the warning icon and avoid configuration errors during testing.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Use the AI Agent Studio in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006058-how-to-use-the-ai-agent-studio-in-highlevel)
- [Ask AI + Agent Studio Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006677-ask-ai-agent-studio-integration)
