title_en: How to Add a Two‑Step Order Form to a Funnel
source_md:
Learn how to add and configure a Two‑Step Order Form in a HighLevel funnel. This article goes through attaching products and prices, customizing the form and enabling options like Cart Mode, Order Bump, and Coupon Codes.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Two‑Step Order Form?](#What-is-a-Two%E2%80%91Step-Order-Form?)
- [Key Benefits of Two‑Step Order Forms](#Key-Benefits-of-Two%E2%80%91Step-Order-Forms)
- [Products Setup (Prerequisite)](#Products-Setup-(Prerequisite))
- [Adding the Two‑Step Order Form to a Funnel](#Adding-the-Two%E2%80%91Step-Order-Form-to-a-Funnel)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is a Two‑Step Order Form?**

Two‑Step Order Forms split checkout into two lightweight screens. Step 1 typically captures contact and shipping details while Step 2 collects payment and finalizes the order. Separating these steps can reduce friction, improve conversions. This form can be easily added to any funnel step making it simple to begin selling your products!

---

## **Key Benefits of Two‑Step Order Forms**

- **Conversion Optimization****:** Breaking checkout into two short steps can increase completion rates by reducing form fatigue.
- **Flexible Fields:** Customize the fields that are shown/hidden and required/optional to match your needs.
- **Cart Mode:** Cart mode and quantity limits let buyers select exactly what they need while keeping totals clear.
- **Revenue Boosters:** Order bump support makes it easy to offer complementary items on checkout.
- **Clear Configuration:** Step‑specific labels, headers, and buttons keep messaging on‑brand and easy to follow.

---

## **Products Setup (Prerequisite)**

Products must be attached to the funnel step before the Two‑Step Order Form can display and charge for them. Follow these steps to ensure your products and prices are available in the form.

```
Tip: Be sure to create your products before starting this process. To learn more about creating products, click here.
```

1. Go to **Sites** in the left navigation, open your **Funnel**, and select the **funnel step** you want to use.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061956299/original/JndMMDn8gEmdJKnU1k6pzIGGrFxqKMxzfQ.jpeg?1767653151)
2. Open the **Products** tab on the right. Click **+ Add Product**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061956301/original/dcb4G5PEHEBkfY7_eRiQpNO7tX0H_GYiNg.jpeg?1767653173)
3. Use the **Product** dropdown to select the item you want to sell or click the inline text link to **create a new product**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061956365/original/HCf7p1PkhPlU6GKU5nromrqd0WPwz8ZGrA.png?1767653443)
4. Under **Price**, choose an existing price or click the inline text link to **create a new price**.  
     
   You can optionally use **Product Name Override**to edit the name to control how it appears on the order form or **Price Display Override**to customize how the price is shown on the order form.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061956386/original/GqtqcHzgl3r6U9MRT3RcyacJ7Ygzl_ZbAg.png?1767653578)
5. Click **Additional options** to configure how the product can be purchased:  
     
   - Enable Allow multiple quantity to let customers purchase more than one unit of the product.  
   - Use Max per order to set the maximum quantity a customer can purchase in one order. You can set the limit from 1–999 units.  
   - Choose whether the item is a Main product or Bump product.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061956405/original/tMSy-2mZSUHmLv0lrgOwDdBF_1WeBiV-zA.png?1767653725)
6. Repeat to add one or many products as needed!

---

## **Adding the Two‑Step Order Form to a Funnel**

After products are attached to the step, follow these steps to add and configure the Two‑Step Order Form element in your funnel.

#### 

#### **S****tep 1:**Navigate to your Funnel Step

Go to **Sites → Funnels**, open your funnel, and select the specific step where you’ll place the checkout.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061955165/original/Xkqp6dN-PmkiG6wYRrvr8508N9kYFKo9qA.png?1767650735)

#### **Step 2:**Add the Two‑Step Order Form Element

Click **Add Elements** **(+)** in the top‑left and under **Order elements**, select the **Two‑Step Order**element. Drag this element into your design.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061955313/original/G22r2IveUsFhdBWOVPBo6j_m6T0csqkSoQ.png?1767650986)

#### **Step 3:**Configure Step 1

Step 1 captures contact information and shipping details. In the element settings, open **Form options** and select **Step 1**. Here you can configure:

- Headline and Sub‑headline
- Company name: Hidden, Optional, or Required.
- Placeholders/Display names for visible fields.
- Phone: required/optional/hidden.
- Shipping: toggle On/Off.
- Button text for progressing to Step 2.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061955499/original/oOvCg0nxSLXWq1pDkLjd0EOUBcpWPn3T5Q.png?1767651206)

#### **Step 4:** Configure Step 2

Step 2 takes payment information and finalizes the purchase. In the element settings, open **Form options** and select **Step 2**.

Here you can edit the labels, headers, and **button text** for payment and confirmation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061955501/original/Hyz22YJPXZekPnvvvzLLiAbioNqonoXcug.png?1767651232)

#### **Step 5:**OtherSettings (Optional)

Use the additional settings to control how products are presented, whether you offer add‑ons, and if buyers can apply discounts:

- Toggle **Enable cart mode** (when available for your funnel version).   
    
  **Enable Cart Mode:** Turn on **Cart Mode** to allow customers to purchase multiple products from the same order form. Customers can select the products they want and adjust quantities for products that have **Allow multiple quantity**enabled.  
    

  Without Cart Mode, the order form can be used for single-product selection. Cart Mode is available for supported V2 funnel order forms.
- **Product Description and Pricing:** Choose whether product descriptions and pricing information appear on the order form. For recurring products, the product description can display the price breakdown, including details such as the setup fee, trial period, number of trial days, and recurring payment information. Disable Product Description if you do not want these details displayed.
- Enable and configure an**Order Bump.**To learn more about Order Bumps in Forms, [click here!](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006914)
- Enable **Coupon Codes.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062046385/original/71Kv8sPvzyT3KvfMyMtuAZd3p5ierDZdrA.png?1767718761)

#### **Step 6:** Style the Form

In the element settings, adjust **Button, Text and Background****Colors** to match your brand.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061955516/original/7Zn-5E6sEfMORcYuatz8k6cHBC4JOQ1yJg.png?1767651331)

#### **Step 7:**Preview and Publish

Before publishing your funnel, click the **Preview** button in the upper-right corner to test your order form. Once verified, click the blue **Publish**button.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155061955522/original/DQgK4xQ1pN2ncMim5kA8hjg-FTZZ8dQYSw.png?1767651358)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why don’t my products appear in the Two‑Step Order Form?**

Make sure products and at least one price are added in the Products tab for the same funnel step.

**Q: How do I let customers buy multiple quantities?** 

In Products → Additional options, enable Allow multiple quantity and set Max per order.

**Q: Can I use a two‑step order form in V1 funnels?**

Two‑step order forms can be added in funnels. Consider migrating the step to V2 to access the latest settings such as cart mode.

**Q: Does the order form support subscriptions and one‑time products?**

Yes. The order form reflects the Pricing you attach to the product (one‑time or recurring).

**Q: Can I add a platform/processing fee to all orders?**

Yes! Processing or platform fees can be added under payments settings. [Click here to learn more!](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005519)

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Shopping Cart Mode in One and Two-step Order forms (V2 Funnels only)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001221440)
- [Workflow Trigger - Order Submitted vs Order Form Submission](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004303)
- [Getting Started - Create & Sell Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005071)
- [Adding Processing Charges or Additional Fees to Customer Payments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005519)
- [How to Use Order Upsell in Forms](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006914)

title_en: Services - Overview & How to Get Started
source_md:
Enable Services to unlock HighLevel’s multi‑service booking with add‑ons, resources, and built‑in payments. This article shows you how to turn Services on for one (or multiple) sub-accounts!

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview of Services](#Overview-of-Services)
- [Key Benefits of Services](#Key-Benefits-of-Services)
- [How to Enable Services for a Single Sub-Account?](#How-to-Enable-Services-for-a-Single-Sub-Account?)
- [How to Enable Services for Multiple Sub-Accounts?](#How-to-Enable-Services-for-Multiple-Sub-Accounts?)
- [Upcoming Features](#Upcoming-Features)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Overview of Services**

Services is the enhanced booking and scheduling tool designed specifically for service-based businesses. Services provide you with many feature upgrades including:

#### **Better Booking Experience**

- Quickly create and manage new services.
- Cleaner, more intuitive booking pages.
- Book multiple services at once directly from the in-app appointment modal.

#### **More Payment Options**

- Accept payments via **Stripe, Square, Razorpay, Authorize.net, and NMI**.
- Save cards on file for future bookings.
- Collect payments directly in the appointment modal.

#### **Flexible Services Management**

- Control **public or private service visibility**.
- Create service variations (different durations, prices).
- Add **add-ons** and processing times to bookings.
- Manage **resources** like rooms and equipment.

[Click here for more information on Services Management](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005330)

#### **Advanced Staff Configurations**

- Offer staff-specific pricing.
- Configure granular staff availability.
- Auto-assign appointments based on **availability** or **price**.

[Click here for more information on Staff Configurations](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005331)

#### **Easy Customization**

- Share booking links for services, staff, or categories.
- Brand your booking page with advanced customization options.
- Use **global settings** for quick updates.
- Keep customers informed with customizable notifications.

[Click here for more information on Services Customization](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003546)

---

## **Key Benefits of Services**

Services help you speed through setup, reduce booking errors, and boost conversions while keeping you in control.

- **Boost Revenue:**Encourage customers to book multiple services in a single checkout and add paid add‑ons
- **Enhance Customer Experience:** Provide flexible booking options and optimized booking pages that reduce friction
- **Streamline Scheduling:**Use advanced booking management tools tailored to your business exact needs
- **Save Time and Effort:**Simplify setup and operations with unified booking flows, easy payment collection, and built‑in automations

---

## **How to Enable Services for a Single Sub-Account****?**

You can enable Services for sub-accounts directly from **Agency Settings**. Follow these steps to activate Services in a single sub-account!

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to Sub-Accounts

- From the Agency dashboard, select the **Sub-Accounts**tab on the left-side navigation bar

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053136709/original/8Deyq7N-GGl-_LaL_hHcBar6zA2tCA9MRQ.png?1757010283)

#### 

#### **Step 2:**Go to Manage Client

- Use the search bar or scroll to locate the sub-account where you would like to active Services
- Click the **Three Dots (⋮)**icon in the bottom right of the sub-account panel
- Select the **Manage Client**Option

#### 

#### **Step 3:**Turn on Services (Single Sub-Account)

- Select **Calendar Settings**from the top navigation bar
- Use the toggle to Turn On **Services**
- Click the blue **Save** button to save your changes

#### 

---

## **How to Enable Services for Multiple Sub-Accounts****?**

You can enable Services for sub-accounts directly from **Agency Settings**. Follow these steps to activate Services for multiple sub-accounts at once!

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to Sub-Accounts

- From the Agency dashboard, select the **Sub-Accounts**tab on the left-side navigation bar

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053136709/original/8Deyq7N-GGl-_LaL_hHcBar6zA2tCA9MRQ.png?1757010283)

#### **Step 2:**OpenSetup Calendars

- Select the sub-accounts where you would like to active Services using the checkboxes
- Once sub-accounts are selected, click **Bulk Actions** in the upper-right corner
- From the drop down menu, pick **Setup Calendars**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053137266/original/OOfr8fgbIy8Iuw6m4opkgagljgICS7Xf5Q.png?1757011135)

#### **Step 3:**Turn on Services (Multiple Sub-Accounts)

- Use the toggle to Turn On **Services**
- Type **CONFIRM** then click the blue **Save** button to save your changes

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155053137350/original/1U9ZUdC05Ti7ElOumM1t5XLNwkEf__jeaA.png?1757011263)**

---

## **Upcoming Features for Services**

We’re always working to make Services better for you. Here’s an early look at what’s coming soon:

- **Group Bookings** – Book multiple appointments for the same time slot.
- **Reporting & Insights** – Get detailed reports on bookings, services, and revenue.
- **Opportunities Integration** – Book and manage service appointments via the Opportunities tab.
- **Conversation AI & Voice AI** – Allow AI bots to book appointments on your behalf.
- ****Custom Values in Email Builder** –** Select Service and Rental custom values directly from the Email Builder to personalize communications with relevant booking information.

- **[Now Live] Snapshots** – Create snapshots and import your setup into different sub-accounts.
- **[Now Live] Mobile App Support** – Create and view service bookings directly from the mobile app.
- **[Now Live] Custom Forms at Service Level** – Add custom forms to individual services for more flexibility.
- **[Now Live] Edit Unpaid Appointments** – Make edits to unpaid appointments (paid appointments editing will be added in a future update).
- **[Now Live] Processing Fees** – Apply processing fees to each transaction.
- **[Now Live] Gift Cards for Services** – Enable customers to purchase and redeem gift cards.
- **[Now Live] Taxes for Services** – Configure and apply tax settings for services.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will enabling Services disrupt my existing calendars or workflows?**  
No. When you enable Services, HighLevel automatically copies your existing service calendars and creates equivalent Services. Your current calendars and any workflows tied to them continue to work exactly as they do today. You can run Meetings (Existing Calendars) and Services side by side or enable only the one that fits best. This ensures that the transition is smooth and without disruptions.

**Q: Do I have to connect payments before enabling Services?**  
No, but you must connect a provider before collecting payments on the booking page.

**Q: Can I enable Services for only some sub-accounts?**

Yes. Since the activation of services is done on a per sub-account basis, you can roll it out selectively. Enabling Services in specific sub-accounts will not affect the other (non-selected) sub-accounts.

**Q: Are Services supported in snapshots?**

Yes! You can include the following assets when creating or loading a Snapshot: Calendar Services, Calendar Service Add-Ons, Calendar Service Categories and Calendar Service Resources. These assets are selectable independently while creating or restoring Snapshots, giving agencies full flexibility.

**Q: Can I edit a Service Appointment after it is booked?**

Yes but what you can edit depends on whether the appointment is unpaid or paid.

- Unpaid Service Appointments: You can edit most details directly from the appointment edit screen, including adding/removing services and add-ons, changing duration, service variants, staff, location, appointment title, date/time, timezone, and coupon codes.
- Paid Service Appointments: Structural changes (for example, changing the service or staff) remain restricted after payment is collected. The edit screen shows a message explaining what is editable. To make broader changes, click Duplicate Appointment to clone the appointment, update the duplicated appointment, and rebook.

---

## **Related Articles**

- **[Global Settings in Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003546)**
- **[How to Create Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005330)**
- **[Configuring Staff in Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005331)**
- **[Categories in Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003547)**
- **[Resources in Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003505)**

title_en: How to Set Custom Affiliate Commissions
source_md:
Custom affiliate commissions let you override campaign-level commission settings for an individual affiliate. You can configure a general commission, create product-specific rates, and adjust supported tier commission rates without changing the campaign defaults for other affiliates.

The campaign continues to control the overall tier structure. This guide explains how to open an affiliate’s campaign settings, configure available commission overrides, save the changes, and understand the supported precedence rules.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Custom Commissions for an Affiliate?](#What-are-Custom-Commissions-for-an-Affiliate?)
- [Key Benefits of Custom Affiliate Commissions](#Key-Benefits-of-Custom-Affiliate-Commissions)
- [How To Set a Custom Commission for an Affiliate](#How-To-Set-a-Custom-Commission-for-an-Affiliate)
- [How Commission Overrides Work](#How-Commission-Overrides-Work)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/2bc2bcbd2e574e49ba74c4be2251bc6f?sid=910cb825-4ea9-4477-bda0-fd42c238f73e)

---

# **What are Custom Commissions for an Affiliate?**

Custom commissions let you configure commission settings for one affiliate within a specific affiliate campaign.

Affiliate-level settings can override the campaign-level commission settings for that affiliate. Other affiliates can continue using the campaign’s configured commission rates.

In multi-tier campaigns, affiliate-level settings can adjust supported commission rates for existing tiers. The campaign continues to control the number of tiers.

---

## **Key Benefits of Custom Affiliate Commissions**

Affiliate-level commission settings let you customize one affiliate’s rates without changing the broader campaign structure.

- **Individual Overrides:** Set a custom commission for one affiliate without changing the campaign default for other affiliates.

- **Product-Specific Rates:** Configure different commission rates for selected products where supported.

- **Tier-Level Customization:** Adjust supported commission rates for an affiliate in a multi-tier campaign.

- **Campaign Structure Preserved:** Change affiliate-specific rates without changing the campaign’s tier count.

---

## **How To Set a Custom Commission for an Affiliate**

Open the affiliate profile, choose the relevant campaign, then use the campaign-specific **Commissions** tab to configure the available override.

### 

### **Open Affiliate Manager**

Start from the Sub-Account where the affiliate campaign is configured.

1. From the HighLevel **Sub-Account** view, select **Marketing**.
2. Select **Affiliate Manager**.
3. Open **Affiliate**.

### 

### **Select the Affiliate**

Open the profile for the affiliate whose campaign commission you want to customize.

1. Locate the affiliate.
2. Open the affiliate profile.

The profile displays affiliate statistics, campaign-specific referral links, commission information, and other affiliate-management options.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082655933/original/j6D02xbG7BOgja8nBdtq8suGDKRmM41HBA.png?1791297838)

### **Choose the Campaign**

Commission overrides are configured separately for each applicable campaign.

1. Scroll to **Active referral links**.
2. Locate the campaign you want to customize.
3. Click **Customize** beside that campaign.

The campaign-specific Advanced settings modal opens.

### **Open the Commissions Tab**

The Advanced settings modal includes separate campaign-specific controls, so open the commission settings before changing a rate.

1. Confirm that the correct campaign is selected.
2. Select **Commissions**.

### **Set the Default Commission**

The default commission acts as the affiliate’s general commission setting where no more specific product commission applies.

1. Locate **Default commission for all products**.
2. Select the available commission type.
3. Enter the affiliate-specific commission value.

The supplied current UI confirms percentage-based commission entry.

### 

## 

### **Customize Commission by Product**

Use product-specific commission settings when selected products need a different affiliate commission from the general default.

1. Select **Customize commission by products**.
2. Select the products available for customization.
3. Configure the supported commission rate for each selected product.
4. Review the product-specific overrides before saving.

Product-based commission settings are more specific than broader default commission settings and take priority where they apply.

### **Configure Multi-Tier Commission Rates**

In a multi-tier campaign, affiliate-level settings can customize supported commission rates for the campaign’s existing tiers.

1. Open **Advance commission settings**.
2. Review the tiers already configured for the campaign.
3. Adjust the supported affiliate-level commission rates where needed.
4. Leave the campaign’s tier structure unchanged.

```
Note: Affiliate-level settings can adjust supported rates for existing tiers, but the number of tiers must be changed from the campaign configuration.
```

The current campaign-level commission system supports up to seven tiers.

### 

### **Save the Custom Commission**

Save the settings after reviewing the affiliate’s default, product-specific, and tier-level commission values.

1. Review the commission settings.
2. Click **Save**.

---

## **How Commission Overrides Work**

Commission calculations can involve affiliate-level settings, product-specific settings, and campaign defaults. The supported precedence rules should be applied only where current HighLevel documentation defines them.

### **Affiliate-Level vs. Campaign-Level Commissions**

Affiliate-level custom commission settings can override campaign-level commission settings for that affiliate.

For example, if a campaign has a 40% default commission and one affiliate has a 50% affiliate-level override, the custom affiliate rate applies where that override is eligible.

Other affiliates can continue using the campaign-level commission.

### **Product-Specific vs. Default Commissions**

Product-based commission settings take priority over broader default commission settings for the applicable product.

Use **Default commission for all products** for the affiliate’s general rate. Use **Customize commission by products** when a selected product needs a different rate.

### **Multi-Tier Commission Structure**

The campaign controls the number of commission tiers.

Affiliate-level settings can adjust supported commission rates for the campaign’s existing tiers, but they cannot add, remove, or restructure those tiers.

### **Complete Commission Priority**

HighLevel documentation supports the individual precedence rules above, but it does not currently publish one complete hierarchy covering every affiliate-level and campaign-level commission type.

### **Restore Default**

The current Advanced settings modal includes a **Restore Default** action.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I set a different commission for one affiliate?**  
Yes. Affiliate-level commission settings can override campaign-level commission rates for that affiliate.

**Q: Will changing one affiliate’s commission affect other affiliates?**  
No. Affiliate-level commission settings apply to the selected affiliate and campaign. Other affiliates can continue using the campaign-level settings.

**Q: Can I set a different commission for a specific product?**  
Yes. Use **Customize commission by products** to configure supported product-specific commission overrides.

**Q: Can I change the number of tiers from the affiliate profile?**  
No. The campaign controls the tier structure. Affiliate-level settings can adjust supported rates for existing tiers.

**Q: How many tiers can an affiliate campaign have?**  
Current HighLevel documentation supports up to seven tiers at the campaign level.

**Q: What takes priority, a product-specific commission or a default commission?**  
Product-based commission settings take priority over broader default commission settings for the applicable product.

---

### **Related Articles**

title_en: Sub-Account Transfer Guide
source_md:
A sub-account transfer moves an entire sub-account from one HighLevel agency, known as the releasing agency, to another HighLevel agency, known as the receiving agency. A transfer does not merge two sub-accounts or move only selected data. Contacts, conversations, supported assets, and account history remain together within the transferred sub-account.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Who Can Request or Complete Sub-Account Transfers?](#Who-Can-Request-or-Complete-Sub-Account-Transfers?)
- [Steps to Transfer a Sub-Account to Another Agency (Send)](#Steps-to-Transfer-a-Sub-Account-to-Another-Agency-(Send))
- [Steps to Receive a Sub-Account from Another Agency](#Steps-to-Receive-a-Sub-Account-from-Another-Agency)
- [What Information and Assets are Transferred Over?](#What-Information-and-Assets-are-Transferred-Over?)
- [What Information and Assets are Not Transferred Over?](#What-Information-and-Assets-are-Not-Transferred-Over?)
- [Phone Number Transfers](#Phone-Number-Transfers)
- [Email Services Transfer](#Email-Services-Transfer)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/3Q5zlUmFHVI?&wmode=opaque)

---

## **Who Can Request or Complete Sub-Account Transfers?**

Transfer permissions protect client data by limiting who can move a sub-account between agencies.

By default, only the **Agency Owner**can request or complete a sub-account transfer.

The **Agency Owner**can grant sub-account transfer permission to specific **Agency Admins**. Agency Admins without this permission cannot submit or approve transfer requests.

The receiving agency must be active and eligible to accept the additional sub-account. Before starting the transfer, confirm that the receiving agency has the required account capacity, compliance add-ons, and active account status.

```
Note: You must be the Agency Owner or an Agency Admin with sub-account transfer permission to perform this action.
```

---

## **Steps to Transfer a Sub-Account to Another Agency (Send)**

If you are unable to access the Sub-Account Requestor Form or encounter any issues during the transfer process, [please reach out to HighLevel Support](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000969-24-7-customer-support-options)for assistance.

1. Go to ***Agency Level > Sub-Accounts***. Go to ***Manage Client*** for the sub-account that needs to be transferred.   
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021022085/original/h62UiXTRThy13emRPyMm5wFv9kDMSk6f2Q.png?1708435032)
2. Select ***Actions > Transfer Sub-account***  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021022540/original/UQiBBJEsJq-MXRzDROSbMCDc0wg1G9MLuA.png?1708435159)
3. Enter the Relationship Number of the agency that you need to transfer the sub-account to. For more information, read this article: [How do I find my Agency's Relationship Number?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001204536)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021023338/original/udPZYD3k_ABQJDI8D6uoY0Tm0HhhF8RTFA.png?1708435357)
4. A request will be sent to the receiving agency upon confirming the action. The sub-account will be transferred as soon as the request is approved.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021023798/original/Ap-Uua4aLjKOCuqwDWDnN0QA8U6LnF2ECw.png?1708435488)
5. **Tracking:**   
     
   In order to track your sub-account transfer requests, go to ***Agency Level > Sub-Accounts***. Select the ***Sub-account Transfers*** option. Navigate to the ***Send*** tab.  
     
   Transfer requests can also be canceled by selecting ***3-Dot Menu > Cancel Request***.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021024941/original/_Uq3FccUs_a4lOES2dKIZtnJdkKgYM33Kg.png?1708435928)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021025106/original/OXPtaS6fBlsjJ-L8rKjFvOv2uS_CmmModA.png?1708435993)

```
We do support Bulk Location Transfer in-app .To learn how to transfer sub-accounts in bulk, please refer Bulk Sub-account Transfers.
```

---

## **Steps to Receive a Sub-Account from Another Agency**

1. The releasing agency needs to follow the above steps to raise a transfer request.
2. Once the request has been raised, you will get an email regarding the same. Click on the ***Review Request*** button.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021027078/original/LSmN0GmsRyztGS2xv07GU_iq2TLRYFC_0A.png?1708436743)  
     
   Alternatively, go to ***Agency Level > Sub-Accounts*** and select the ***Sub-account Transfers*** option.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021027273/original/6CW9-WgnhRaIJpTL1u8CV0Rgn7Mrx8_-HQ.png?1708436829)
3. On the ***Transfer Requests*** page, ***Approve*** the request. Sub-account will be transferred to your agency as soon as the request is approved.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155021027731/original/5UP9ORYilrbfYM0F8zs2kfPOwiO1LoE2Gg.png?1708436974)

---

## **What Information and Assets are Transferred Over?**

Supported information remains attached to the sub-account so the receiving agency can continue working with its existing records and assets.

The following information generally transfers:

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077896614/original/_G7N3vpBSxUKO8lOmIkTghp-J9fsCHSyRg.png?1786108839)

---

## **What Information and Assets are Not Transferred Over?**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077896857/original/-_2qBm98hEy89HZ96FWJ8tXNTGFN3dg8HQ.png?1786108978)

---

## **Phone Number Transfers**

```
NOTE: Phone numbers may transfer automatically depending on the phone provider used by both agencies.
```

### 

### If Both Agencies Use LC Phone

- Phone numbers transfer with the sub-account.
- Eligible A2P registration stays with the numbers.
- Future phone usage is billed to the receiving agency.

### If Either Agency Uses Twilio

Phone numbers do not transfer automatically. The agencies and Twilio account owner must coordinate the move separately.

For detailed requirements, see the **Moving Phone Numbers: Migration Guide**.

---

## **Email Services Transfer**

## Email Service Transfers

Email settings may change depending on whether the sub-account and receiving agency use LC Email or another email provider.

### If the Sub-Account Uses LC Email

- **Agency-assigned dedicated domain:** The domain is removed during the transfer.
- **Sub-account-owned dedicated domain:** The domain transfers with the sub-account.
- **Dedicated IP:** The IP is unassigned and the related subscription is removed.
- **Email verification:** The existing On or Off setting is preserved.
- **After transfer:** If the receiving agency uses LC Email, the sub-account stays on LC Email. If the receiving agency uses another provider, the sub-account switches to that provider.

### If the Sub-Account Uses Mailgun or SMTP

Existing Mailgun or SMTP configurations are removed.

The sub-account adopts the receiving agency’s default email provider.

For additional assistance, contact HighLevel Support.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I merge one sub-account with another?**

No. A transfer moves the entire sub-account from one agency to another. It does not combine the transferred account’s data with another sub-account.

**Q: Can I transfer only part of a sub-account?**

No. Partial sub-account transfers are not supported. The complete sub-account and its supported data move together.

**Q: Can I transfer a HIPAA-enabled sub-account?**

Yes. The receiving agency must have the required HIPAA Compliance add-on before the transfer can be completed.

**Q: How long does a sub-account transfer take, and how can I check its status?**

The sub-account transfers after the receiving agency approves the request. Timing may vary if eligibility requirements or account dependencies need to be resolved.

You can monitor the request from **Agency Level > Sub-Accounts > Sub-Account Transfers** to see its current status.

**Q: How will I know when the transfer is complete?**

The receiving agency receives an email when the transfer request is submitted. Both agencies can monitor the request from the **Sub-Account Transfers** page.

Review the transfer record to determine whether the request is pending, completed, rejected, canceled, or blocked.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Sub-Accounts Transfers: Bulk Transfer Sub-accounts to an Existing Agency](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004570-bulk-sub-accounts-transfers-transfer-sub-accounts-in-bulk-to-an-existing-agency)
- [Sub-Account Transfer FAQs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001207259)
- [Sub Account Transfers: Eject Sub-Account to a New Agency](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003465)

title_en: Where Can I Find My Dedicated Domain SMTP Credentials?
source_md:
Email Infrastructure

SMTP Credentials for Email Domains

Create, manage, reset, and delete SMTP credentials for your dedicated email domain — plus ports, limits, pricing, and IMAP notes.

What You'll Learn

To use the SMTP server, you need credentials tied specifically to your dedicated sending domain. Each domain has its own set of SMTP credentials — they are not shared across domains or at the agency level.

This article covers how to create, reset, and delete SMTP credentials; which ports are supported; email and credential limits; pricing; and where to find IMAP settings for receiving email.

## How to Create SMTP Credentials

SMTP credentials are created at the **sub-account level** under a dedicated domain — not at the agency level, and not for agency-assigned domains.

Step 1

Navigate to Sub-account Settings

Go to **Email Service → SMTP Service → Dedicated Domain and IP → SMTP Settings** under your dedicated domain.

![SMTP Settings location under Dedicated Domain and IP in Email Services](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023337421/original/nMyZojgr2ZYUAZSkyYnJ6GXwk_Eyr_1HGw.png?1711087651)

Step 2

Create New SMTP User

Click **Create New SMTP User** and enter a username and password for the credential.

Note — Approval Required

The platform uses an automated approval system for SMTP access. Eligible sub-accounts can create credentials immediately. If your account is not approved, the **Create New SMTP User** button may be disabled or you may see a warning message.

![Create New SMTP User button and form](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023337477/original/3gfn3HeigPBnj1KhpAJrkIlpaoOzAJ0ONw.png?1711087786)
![SMTP user created successfully](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023337530/original/utUNsl_XodI8FsMRFgE8TrwwQdmfgvu_uA.png?1711087862)

Your SMTP Settings

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SMTP Server Address | smtp.mailgun.org |
| Secure Connection | TLS/SSL (based on your mail client or SMTP plugin) |
| SMTP Username | YourGivenName@DomainName.com |
| SMTP Password | YourGivenPassword |
| SMTP Ports | 25, 465 (SSL/TLS), 587 (STARTTLS), 2525 |

## What Ports Does Mailgun Support?

The SMTP server (smtp.mailgun.org) listens on the following ports:

| Port | Protocol | Use When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 25 | Standard SMTP | Server-to-server relaying (often blocked by ISPs for client use) |
| 465 | SSL/TLS | Clients requiring implicit TLS from the start of the connection |
| 587 | STARTTLS | Recommended for most email clients and SMTP plugins |
| 2525 | Alternative SMTP | Fallback when ports 25, 465, and 587 are blocked |

## How to Reset SMTP Password

To reset the password for an existing SMTP credential, locate the credential in your domain's SMTP Settings and click the reset option. In the confirmation modal, click **Reset Password** to finalize the change.

![Reset Password button in SMTP credential modal](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023337656/original/22ZqznlGSww3OYVk2ULdCYph_uhwvbBG9A.png?1711088188)

Initiate the password reset from the SMTP credential row

![Confirm Reset Password in the confirmation modal](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023337668/original/NsTvuvM2YMJRI2xkQypolDdneD_Yn8-tJw.png?1711088202)

Confirm the reset in the pop-up modal

## How to Delete SMTP Credential

To remove an SMTP credential, locate it in your domain's SMTP Settings and click **Delete**. Confirm the deletion in the pop-up modal.

![Delete SMTP credential button](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023337727/original/f7oeVWxByu7aA60MK7YoTBAA7c-citPWbg.png?1711088371)

Click Delete on the SMTP credential row

![Confirm deletion of SMTP credential](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155023337732/original/-c2VpTSwanpwk3Nc_sLI3fi87590WKS2TA.png?1711088383)

Confirm deletion in the modal

## Limits for SMTP and Emails

SMTP Credential Limit

5 credentials per dedicated domain

A maximum of **five SMTP credentials** can be created for each dedicated domain.

Daily Email Limit

1,500 emails per day per account

Each account is limited to **1,500 emails per day**.

Important

If the daily email limit is exceeded, **all SMTP credentials will be automatically deleted** from all dedicated domains on the account.

## LC Email Pricing

LeadConnector email is priced at **$0.675 per 1,000 emails** — lower than most major SMTP providers (Mailgun charges $0.80/1,000). All plans use the same per-email rate.

Email charges are deducted from your account credits and can be reviewed at **Agency View → Billing → Credits**.

Note

[All incoming and outgoing emails — including To, CC, and BCC recipients — are each charged separately.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001220605-what-is-lc-email-i-want-to-know-more#LC---Email-Pricing)

## Where to Find IMAP Settings

Not Supported

Since mailboxes are not hosted here, POP and IMAP protocols are not supported. **SMTP credentials cannot be used in IMAP settings.**

IMAP is used to *retrieve* messages from your mailbox, while SMTP is for *sending*. If you need IMAP to read email in a client, you must get those settings from your email hosting provider — not from this platform.

**Example — Google Workspace:** Generate an app password in Google, then use:

Google IMAP Settings

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Username | Your full email address |
| Password | Your Google app password |
| IMAP Host | imap.gmail.com |
| IMAP Port | 993 |

For other providers, find IMAP settings in their own support documentation. Quick links:

[Amazon AWS WorkMail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/workmail/latest/userguide/using_IMAP.html)

[Hostgator](https://www.hostgator.com/help/article/email-connection-settings)

[Ionos](https://www.ionos.com/help/email/general-topics/settings-for-your-email-programs-imap-pop3/)

[Kinghost](https://king.host/wiki/artigo/como-configurar-seu-e-mail-no-pipedrive/)

[Rackspace](https://docs.rackspace.com/support/how-to/rackspace-email-and-hosted-exchange-settings/)

[TransIP](https://www.transip.eu/knowledgebase/entry/309-the-email-settings-at-transip/)

[Bluehost](https://www.bluehost.com/help/article/email-application-setup)

[Titan](https://support.titan.email/hc/en-us/articles/900000215446-Configure-Titan-on-other-apps-using-IMAP-POP)

[Dreamhost](https://help.dreamhost.com/hc/en-us/articles/215612887-Email-client-protocols-and-port-numbers)

[InMotion](https://www.inmotionhosting.com/support/email/getting-started-guide-email/)

If your provider isn't listed, contact them directly for IMAP hostname and port information.

Common IMAP Reference

| Provider | IMAP Host | IMAP Port |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Google / Gmail | imap.gmail.com | 993 |
| Verizon | imap.verizon.net | 995 |
| AOL | imap.aol.com | 993 |

## Troubleshooting

Issue

"Unable to Create SMTP User" — button is disabled or a warning banner appears

This means SMTP credentials cannot be created for that domain at this time. This is controlled by an automated approval system. Eligible accounts get access immediately; others require manual review.

**What to do:**

- Contact Support to request SMTP access for your sub-account.
- Include your sub-account ID, the sending domain or subdomain, and a screenshot of the warning message.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why am I seeing "SMTP Credential creation is blocked. Please contact support"?

This appears when your account has hit usage thresholds or has been flagged by internal controls to prevent abuse — commonly triggered by exceeding the 1,500 emails/day limit. Contact support with your sub-account ID to have the block reviewed and resolved.

Q: Can I create SMTP credentials at the agency level?

No. SMTP credentials are created at the sub-account level only, and only under a dedicated domain — not agency-assigned domains.

Q: What happens to my SMTP credentials if I exceed the daily email limit?

All SMTP credentials will be automatically deleted from all dedicated domains on the account. You will need to re-create them once your account is back within limits.

Q: Which port should I use for my email client or WordPress SMTP plugin?

Port **587 with STARTTLS** is the recommended choice for most email clients and SMTP plugins. Use port **465** if your client requires implicit TLS. Port **2525** is a reliable fallback if the others are blocked by your host or ISP.

Q: Can I use SMTP credentials to receive email (IMAP/POP)?

No. SMTP credentials are for *sending* only. Mailboxes are not hosted here, so POP and IMAP are not supported. For receiving email, use the IMAP settings provided by your email hosting provider (e.g., Google Workspace, Outlook, etc.).

Q: How many SMTP credentials can I create per domain?

Up to **five SMTP credentials** can be created per dedicated domain.

Q: Are BCC recipients counted toward the daily email limit?

Yes. All recipients — To, CC, and BCC — are each counted and charged individually. A single email sent to 3 recipients (1 To, 1 CC, 1 BCC) counts as 3 emails toward both the daily limit and billing.

title_en: Rich Link & Event Previews in Communities
source_md:
Communities

# Rich Link & Event Previews in Communities

Share content and events with automatic rich previews that keep members engaged without leaving the conversation

What You'll Learn

Rich link and event previews transform how members interact with shared content in HighLevel Communities. Instead of clicking away to view videos or event details, members can watch videos, see event information, and register for events directly within posts and comments.

This article explains how rich previews work, which content types are supported, and how to use event preview cards to boost engagement and streamline community interactions.

## What Are Rich Link & Event Previews?

Rich link and event previews are automatically generated visual cards that appear when you share supported links or mention events in community posts and comments. These previews display relevant information directly in the feed, allowing members to interact with content without navigating away from the conversation.

For links, this means embedded video players and contextual information about the shared content. For events, members see event details and registration options right in the post. Both preview types work seamlessly in posts and comments throughout your HighLevel Community.

## Key Benefits

Rich previews create a more engaging and seamless experience for community members by reducing friction and keeping conversations flowing.

**Inline Video Playback** — Watch YouTube, Loom, and other supported videos directly in the feed without opening new tabs or windows.

**One-Click Event Registration** — Register for events directly from posts without navigating to the Events page.

**Contextual Information** — See event details, video thumbnails, and link descriptions before deciding to engage.

**Enhanced Engagement** — Create richer, more interactive discussions that keep members actively participating in the community.

**Reduced Navigation** — Keep members in the conversation flow by minimizing the need to click away from posts.

## Rich Link & Video Previews

When you paste a supported link into a post or comment, HighLevel automatically generates a rich preview card that displays relevant information about the shared content. For video platforms like YouTube and Loom, the preview includes an embedded player that allows members to watch videos without leaving the feed.

Feature 1

Automatic Preview Generation

Simply paste a supported link into any post or comment. The rich preview generates automatically without requiring any additional setup or formatting.

Feature 2

Inline Video Playback

Supported videos from platforms like YouTube and Loom can be played directly within the feed. Members click the play button on the preview card to watch without leaving the conversation.

Feature 3

Works in Posts and Comments

Rich link previews function consistently across both community posts and comments, ensuring a uniform experience regardless of where content is shared.

Feature 4

Contextual Link Information

Preview cards display titles, descriptions, and thumbnails from the linked content, giving members helpful context before they decide to click through or watch.

Supported Platforms

Rich link previews currently support YouTube and Loom video platforms. When you paste links from these platforms, an embedded video player appears in the preview card.

## Interactive Event Previews

Event preview cards make it easy to promote and share community events directly within posts. When you mention an event in a post, an interactive preview card displays the event's key details and allows members to register without leaving the conversation.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080274294/original/cvw8-czHMaJkwXrDwVVzrHIY8cbdhkVkyA.png?1788784512)

Feature 1

Automatic Event Card Generation

Mention an event in your post and an event preview card is automatically generated, displaying the event's essential information in a clean, organized format.

Feature 2

Event Details at a Glance

The preview card displays important event information including the event name, scheduled date and time, and current registration status. Members can quickly assess whether the event fits their schedule.

Feature 3

Direct Registration from Posts

Members can register for events directly from the preview card in the post. This eliminates the need to navigate to the Events page just to sign up.  
  
 ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080272281/original/RzCs8MwORJpY0NQFo1wpRxPIRPuoUfM6Mw.png?1788783531)

Feature 4

Events in Conversations

Event previews make events a natural part of community discussions. You can reference upcoming events in posts about related topics, making it easier for members to discover relevant events organically.

Simplified Event Promotion

Event preview cards reduce the friction between discovering an event and registering for it. By embedding registration directly in posts, you can increase event attendance and engagement within your community.

## How to Use Rich Previews in Your Community

Rich link and event previews require no special setup or configuration. Follow these simple steps to start using them in your community posts and comments.

Step 1

Create a Post or Comment

Navigate to your HighLevel Community and create a new post or add a comment to an existing post.

Step 2

Paste a Supported Link or Mention an Event

For link previews: Paste a URL from a supported platform like YouTube or Loom directly into your post or comment.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080272240/original/D_tifx5ql0CEGWFaLPKWGtZ7x0AqvdP1zw.png?1788783516)

Step 3

Preview Generates Automatically

HighLevel automatically generates the rich preview card as you type. You'll see the preview appear below your text, showing the video player, link information, or event details.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080272360/original/UOkyPAsmB20TGAV-Pj12Ocqbk-vIEhPIBw.png?1788783587)

Step 4

Publish Your Post or Comment

Publish your post or comment as usual. The rich preview will display in the feed, allowing members to interact with videos or event registration directly from the preview card.

Best Practices

Add context around your shared links and events to give members a reason to watch or register. A brief explanation of what the video covers or why the event matters can significantly increase engagement.

Use event previews when announcing webinars, workshops, or training sessions in discussion posts related to those topics. This helps members discover events naturally as they browse community content.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Which video platforms support rich link previews?

Rich link previews currently support YouTube and Loom video platforms. When you paste a link from these platforms, an embedded video player appears in the preview card, allowing members to watch videos directly in the feed.

Q: Do rich previews work in both posts and comments?

Yes, rich link previews and event preview cards work consistently in both community posts and comments. You can share supported links or mention events anywhere in the conversation and the appropriate preview will generate automatically.

Q: Do I need to configure anything to enable rich previews?

No configuration is required. Rich link and event previews are automatically enabled in HighLevel Communities. Simply paste a supported link or mention an event in your post or comment, and the preview generates automatically.

Q: Can members register for events directly from the preview card?

Yes, event preview cards include a registration button that allows members to register directly from the post. They don't need to navigate to the Events page to sign up, which reduces friction and can increase event attendance.

Q: What information displays in an event preview card?

Event preview cards display the event name, scheduled date and time, current registration status, and a registration button. This gives members all the essential information they need to decide whether to attend without clicking through to the full event page.

Q: Can members watch videos without leaving the community feed?

Yes, supported videos from YouTube and Loom can be played directly within the feed using the embedded video player in the rich preview card. Members click the play button to watch the video without opening a new tab or leaving the conversation.

Q: Will more video platforms be supported in the future?

YouTube and Loom are currently the supported video platforms for rich link previews. HighLevel continues to expand platform integrations based on user feedback and demand. Check the HighLevel release notes for announcements about additional platform support.

Q: Can I remove or disable a rich preview after it's generated?

Rich previews are generated automatically when you paste a supported link or mention an event. To remove a preview, you would need to edit your post or comment and remove the link or event mention that triggered the preview generation.

title_en: Progress Analytics in Courses
source_md:
Course Management

# Course Progress Analytics

Track completion trends, identify drop-offs, and analyze member-level progress with a comprehensive dashboard built for speed and actionable insights.

What You'll Learn

Course Progress Analytics provides a single dashboard to understand how learners engage with courses across your location. Track completion rates, analyze engagement patterns, and drill into member-level progress using consistent filters and reliable data.

This article explains the dashboard components, key metrics, performance improvements, and how to access Course Progress Analytics in your HighLevel account.

## What is Course Progress Analytics?

Course Progress Analytics is a comprehensive dashboard that provides creators and administrators with a centralized view of learner engagement across all courses in their location. The dashboard consolidates key performance metrics, learner journey data, and member-level progress information into a single interface.

Unlike one-off reports, Course Progress Analytics uses consistent filters across all dashboard components, ensuring that every metric updates instantly when you change your view. Whether you're managing a handful of learners or thousands, the dashboard is designed to deliver reliable data for day-to-day decisions.

The analytics dashboard includes filtering options by course and enrollment date, key performance metrics with period-over-period comparisons, a learner journey funnel, a detailed member progress table, and CSV export capabilities.

## Key Benefits of Course Progress Analytics

**Unified engagement view** — Understand engagement across all courses from one dashboard, eliminating the need to navigate between multiple reports or export separate data sets.

**Proactive learner support** — Quickly identify learners who need attention before they disengage by reviewing last accessed dates, session counts, and progress percentages.

**Actionable performance metrics** — Measure course performance with clear insights including completion rates, average progress, and time to complete with period-over-period comparisons.

**Flexible reporting** — Export reports to share with teammates or keep for record-keeping. Smaller exports download instantly, while larger exports are delivered by email with a secure 24-hour download link.

**Built for scale** — The dashboard is designed to stay fast as locations and course catalogs grow, with approximately 43% faster page loads and nearly 90% less data downloaded compared to previous implementations.

## Dashboard Components

The Course Progress Analytics dashboard includes five primary components that work together to provide comprehensive learner engagement insights. Each component updates instantly when filters are applied, ensuring consistent data across the entire dashboard.

Component 1

Filters

Apply filters by course and enrollment date to focus on specific segments. The entire dashboard updates instantly using the same filters, ensuring all metrics, charts, and tables reflect your selected criteria.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/SXgZ2n8egA2H0wExlpvo+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-30+at+19.41.30.png)

Component 2

Key Performance Metrics

View three essential metrics at a glance, each with a comparison to the previous equivalent time period:

- **Overall Completion Rate** — The percentage of enrolled learners who have completed the course.
- **Average Course Progress** — The mean progress percentage across all enrolled learners.
- **Average Time to Complete** — The average duration from enrollment to course completion.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/PGqwckNR2i3WLUvWUVCb+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-30+at+19.43.08.png)

Component 3

User Conversion Funnel

Visualize how learners progress through your course with three funnel stages:

- **New Users** — Total number of learners who have enrolled in the course.
- **Started Learning** — Number of enrolled learners who have begun course content.
- **Completed a Course** — Number of learners who have finished all course requirements.

The funnel helps identify drop-off points and understand where learners may need additional support or where course content may require optimization.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/XzaQ9Ovc4VGKgKJqnaLS+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-30+at+19.47.40.png)

Component 4

Member Progress Table

View detailed progress information for each learner in a sortable, filterable table. The table includes:

- **Member name** — The learner's full name.
- **Courses completed** — Total number of courses the learner has finished.
- **Enrollment date** — When the learner enrolled in the course.
- **Course start date** — When the learner first accessed course content.
- **Last accessed date** — The most recent date the learner interacted with the course.
- **Session count** — Total number of sessions the learner has logged.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/rFzIVKO6XlPiPgPNJRNq+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-30+at+19.54.17.png)

Component 5

CSV Export

Export exactly what you're viewing on the dashboard to CSV format. Smaller exports download instantly to your browser. Larger exports with 500 or more rows are processed and delivered by email with a secure download link that remains available for 24 hours.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/awVclw2mXEeKkcPJ1y9u+/Screen+Shot+2026-07-30+at+19.55.46.png)

## Performance Improvements

Course Progress Analytics is built with performance and scale in mind. The dashboard uses optimized data loading strategies to ensure fast page loads and responsive interactions, even as your course catalog and learner base grow.

Key performance improvements include approximately 43% faster page loads compared to previous analytics implementations and nearly 90% less data downloaded, reducing bandwidth usage and improving load times on slower connections. The dashboard maintains consistent speed regardless of location size or course count, and filter changes and table interactions update instantly without full page reloads.

These improvements ensure that Course Progress Analytics remains a reliable tool for monitoring learner engagement, whether you're tracking a single course or managing a comprehensive course catalog.

## How to Access Course Progress Analytics

Course Progress Analytics is accessible directly from your HighLevel account. Follow these steps to access the dashboard and begin analyzing learner engagement.

Step 1

Navigate to Course Progress Analytics

From your HighLevel dashboard, navigate to **Memberships → Courses → Analytics → Course progress**.

Step 2

Apply Filters and Analyze Data

Use the course and enrollment date filters to focus on specific segments. All dashboard components update instantly to reflect your selected criteria. Review key metrics, examine the learner journey funnel, and drill into member-level progress in the table.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/JuGedEBicLz2VumpI3zY+/Screenshot+2026-07-30+at+20.00.26.png)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What metrics are included in the dashboard?

The dashboard includes Overall Completion Rate, Average Course Progress, and Average Time to Complete. Each metric includes a comparison with the previous equivalent time period. The dashboard also displays a learner journey funnel showing enrolled, started learning, and completed counts, plus a detailed member progress table.

Q: How do filters work in Course Progress Analytics?

Apply filters by course and enrollment date at the top of the dashboard. All components — including key metrics, the learner journey funnel, and the member progress table — update instantly using the same filters, ensuring consistent data across the entire dashboard.

Q: How does CSV export work for large data sets?

Smaller exports download instantly to your browser. Larger exports with 500 or more rows are processed on the server and delivered by email with a secure download link. The download link remains valid for 24 hours after the email is sent.

Q: Can I view progress for individual learners?

Yes. The Member Progress Table displays detailed information for each learner including courses completed, enrollment date, course start date, last accessed date, and session count. The table is sortable and searchable for easy analysis.

Q: What does the "Average Time to Complete" metric measure?

Average Time to Complete measures the mean duration from enrollment to course completion across all learners who have finished the course. This metric helps you understand typical completion timelines and identify courses that may require more or less time investment.

Q: How does the period-over-period comparison work?

Each key performance metric includes a comparison with the previous equivalent time period. For example, if you filter data for the last 30 days, the comparison shows the change from the previous 30-day period. This helps you identify trends and measure improvement over time.

Q: Will Course Progress Analytics work with my existing courses?

Yes. Course Progress Analytics works with all existing courses in your location. The dashboard immediately begins tracking engagement data for all current and future courses without requiring any additional configuration.

title_en: SaaS Wallet Credit Management - Sub Account Level
source_md:
#### [동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/UIv2QuQkZtM?&wmode=opaque)

#### **Covered in this article:**

#### [**What is SaaS Wallet?**](#What-is-SaaS-Wallet?)

#### **[Where can the wallet be accessed from?](#Where-can-the-wallet-be-accessed-from?)**

#### **[How to view the wallet transaction history?](#How-to-view-the-wallet-transaction-history?)**

#### [**How to Recharge Wallet?**](#How-to-Recharge-Wallet?)

#### [1. Auto Recharge Settings](#1.-Auto-Recharge-Settings)

#### [2. Charge Client's Card Manually (Add Balance)](#2.-Charge-Client's-Card-Manually-(Add-Balance))

#### [3. Monthly Complimentary Credits](#3.-Monthly-Complimentary-Credits)

#### [4. Add Complimentary Credits from Agency View](#4.-Add-Complimentary-Credits-from-Agency-View)

#### [**How to Remove Credits from the wallet?**](#How-to-Remove-Credits-from-the-wallet?)

#### [1. Complimentary Credits](#1.-Complimentary-Credits)

#### [2. Non-Complimentary Credits](#2.-Non-Complimentary-Credits)

#### [**How to Issue Refunds for Non-Complimentary Credits**](#How-to-Issue-Refunds-for-Non-Complimentary-Credits)

#### [**Wallet Recharge Retries**](#Wallet-Recharge-Retries)

#### [1. SaaS Wallets (for telephone & email rebilling)](#1.%C2%A0SaaS-Wallets-(for-telephone-&-email-rebilling))

#### [2. Agency Wallets (for ISV)](#2.%C2%A0Agency-Wallets-(for-ISV))

---

# **What is SaaS Wallet?**

To charge the client for Twilio and Email rebilling, the system uses their wallet. The agency owner/ client recharges their wallet using the client's credit card which adds messaging credits to the location wallet. Each time a message/ email is sent, call is made, or a phone number is purchased, the wallet credits are debited.

**Please Note:** 

```
Some charges in the wallet may appear after 6 - 24 hours.
```

The wallet is recharged when it reaches the minimum balance set in the Company Billing settings. The client's card is attached to the wallet for all charges. The wallet can also be recharged with complimentary (free) monthly/ one-time credits.

Now, each time a message is sent, Twilio / Mailgun will charge the agency, and the system will charge the client's wallet based on rebilling settings. So for example the client sent 100 messages worth $10 and rebilling was set to 5x, the agency will be charged $10 by Twilio, and the client's wallet will be charged $50.

**Please Note:** 

```
When the wallet is recharged, the client's card is charged and these charges are sent into the Agency's Stripe account. So the client is paying the agency for these wallet credits.
```

---

## **Where Can the Wallet Be Accessed From?**

The wallet is found in the Sub Account Settings > Company Billing

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179220627/original/r-cGcDfoBT7XnC_abUKNm_Ow2VnD_kVv6A.png?1642188595)

### **Refunding Wallet Credits** Wallet credits and Stripe payments are related but not automatically synchronized after credits are spent.

If a client has:

- Added $100 to their Wallet
- Used $40 in Wallet credits
- Remaining Wallet balance = $60

You **cannot refund $100 in Stripe** unless you first adjust the Wallet balance.

```
Only refund the amount that matches the remaining wallet balance. If you refund more than the wallet balance, you create a financial mismatch between Stripe and Wallet credits.
```

---

## **How to View the Wallet Transaction History?**

You can view the wallet transaction history from Settings > Company Billing > Credits > See Details:

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179221231/original/TXqt8wBkRBOchmACU_YMdAKrYG2f-B_pfA.png?1642188770)

---

## **How to Recharge Wallet?**

The wallet can be recharged in several ways.

### **1. Auto Recharge Settings**

In the Company Billing > Credits section, you can find the auto recharge settings with 2 options. The amount entered in the 'Auto Recharge with' field will be added to the wallet each time the balance is lower than the amount set in the 'when balance lower than' field.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179222076/original/LB4LFuJAKL9AnoirgKBlbEBMeNce505fQA.png?1642189100)

### **2. Charge Client's Card Manually (Add Balance)**

Using the 'Add Balance' button in Company Billing, you can recharge the client's wallet. This method will charge the client's primary card added in the Company Billing settings

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179223494/original/PsQIq28kR5TZ_O13q4a634VUEcjUhPQJhg.png?1642189572)

### **3. Monthly Complimentary Credits**

If the subaccount is on a SaaS Plan, you can set an amount of credits to be granted to the subaccount on monthly basis. These credits will be added to the client's wallet each month. These credits can be modified for each SaaS Plan from the SaaS Configurator.

#### **Trial behavior (Complimentary Credits)**

If your SaaS plan has a trial, the agency can choose to issue complimentary credits:

- Immediately upon sign-up, or
- Only after the trial ends using the “Add credits after trial period ends” toggle.

When enabled, no credits are issued until the trial converts. Recurring credits start at trial conversion and follow the billing cycle from that point forward. If rollover is enabled, it applies only after the first credit issuance.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179224350/original/WiV2HJcC_3jecI3DCoeQGb3DyuocqdGEog.png?1642189881)

The amount for these credits can also be changed for each subaccount (which is on a SaaS Plan) individually. The individual settings can be accessed from Agency View > Accounts > View Details:

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179224816/original/0s24US3LCvhVYQt3E9XEctFypBiJu_OYag.png?1642190032)

### **4. Add Complimentary Credits from Agency View**

In the Agency View > Accounts > View Details > Manage Credits, you can also add complimentary credits to the client's wallet directly. These credits are not charged to anyone. Once the client uses these credits to send out messages/ calls, then the agency owner is charged for those messages/ calls, but the client is not charged since these credits were given for free.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179225579/original/3Dc5PvZJROUW2mKJirq29F9YIpO-M57XIA.png?1642190302)

```
If you refund the full original Stripe transaction after part of the wallet credits were already used:

The wallet usage history remains.

You may create negative balance or reconciliation issues.

The platform does not automatically recalculate previously used wallet credits.
```

---

## **How to Remove Credits from the Wallet?**

### **1. Complimentary Credits**

These credits can be removed by using the 'Debit' option in the Agency View > Accounts > View Details > Manage Credits. The Debit option only removes the balance from the wallet, it does not refund the amount in Stripe, so if you want to remove original (non-complimentary) credits, you will need to follow an additional step mentioned in the next paragraph.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179226525/original/_esPD3ycS5qkglxxcQPc2q681OVesOgh2A.png?1642190596)

### **2. Non-Complimentary Credits**

To remove these credits:

1. Use the same 'Debit' option mentioned above.

2. You will ***also*** need to issue a refund for these credits from your Stripe account by following the steps mentioned below.

---

## **How to Issue Refunds for Non-Complimentary Credits**

**1.** Go to the Stripe account connected in your Agency Settings > Stripe

[**2.** Find the client's Stripe customer associated with their subaccount](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001207110-how-to-upgrade-downgrade-saas-plan-for-a-location#Finding-the-Stripe-Customer%3A)

**3.** In the 'Payments' section for this customer, find the payment for the addition of credits and click the 'Refund payment' button against that payment

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48179228361/original/qJlF0g2BYgjbz12TNQikaXPZ7h3Za8ashg.png?1642191183)

That's it, you're all set! :)

---

## **Wallet Recharge Retries** **1.****SaaS Wallets (for telephone & email rebilling)**

We will try to automatically charge the wallet a maximum of **7 times (7 attempts x 1 attempt/day).**

If all 7 attempts fail we will stop automatic retries.

- We will notify the agency admins
- We will notify the location admins

## **2.****Agency Wallets (for ISV)**

We will try to automatically charge the wallet a maximum of **12 times (3 days x 4 attempts/day).**

If all 12 attempts fail we will stop automatic retries

- We will notify the agency admins

**Please Note:** 

```
We are making this change because repeated retries were causing the suspension of Stripe accounts. Once we give up manual retries, users will be able to recharge manually and that will reset our counter and automatic retries will start again.
```
