# **Setup Personal Booking Calendar**

Your personal booking calendar is your best friend when it comes to managing appointments. Once it's up, you'll wonder how you ever managed without it. 

To use Google Calendar for scheduling appointments, it's essential to first create a HighLevel Personal Booking Calendar. This booking calendar serves as the foundation for your scheduling rules—allowing you to configure availability, buffer times, meeting durations, and reminders. Even if you use Google Calendar daily, this calendar is required to manage how bookings are accepted and displayed within HighLevel.

1. Navigate to **Calendar > C****alendar Settings**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066592799/original/z9nVrbIH5ziNObPoQJWmABjrzbrlyxe0RA.png?1773144800)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066221388/original/i0KgyPsA8ygTbGvKczimClmFQQgzZSvr_w.png?1772653939)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066221401/original/iIRSFaAMr2iQg1XPih0fKwe6weLO4QDa6Q.png?1772653976)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046581684/original/w_jfRs4qEjTzZY8tjdID9d54ZYKM1U83vw.png?1747182590)  
   Calendar Settings are now grouped into sections to help you move faster: **Basic details**, **Staff & location**, **Availability**, **Booking rules**, and **Advanced settings**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066592686/original/d1Y3-9gB28e1z4WOabePsJ4H3epFc9g_lg.png?1773144729)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066221479/original/xzDvgh3Mo4DKQoLy_zldlRZSBw2ebsCwAw.png?1772654105)

**Next**, you can customize your calendar appearance to match your branding, making it even more inviting.

```
When using a custom form in your booking flow, you can manage the post-submission experience under Advanced settings → Form & confirmation → Confirmation page. Select Use custom form rules to follow the form’s redirect or custom message behavior after submission.
```

---

## **Add Yourself As A Team Member**

Even if you're working solo, adding yourself as a team member ensures everything runs smoothly. Think of it as giving yourself VIP access to your own scheduling system.

1. Navigate to **Settings > My Staff**.
2. Click **Add User**.
3. Add yourself and save the details.

**Next**, you can set specific permissions for yourself or additional team members, streamlining your workflow.

---

## **Setup Automated Reminders**

Automated reminders mean fewer missed appointments and happier clients. They’re like your calendar gently tapping clients on the shoulder to remind them you're meeting soon.

1. Navigate to **Automation**.
2. Click **Create Workflow** and select **Recipe**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046582042/original/X0KXph5Qggv6ls_gtEKqdD6gJd_GTgIOrg.png?1747184480)
3. Choose the recipe **Appointment Confirmation + Reminder**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046582055/original/Y6Y4q8Sd5uM3TAT6Pr2Ohu-XfrZJhRt7tQ.png?1747184652)
4. Edit the **Confirmation Email** action.
5. Update your meeting link (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.) and click **Save Action**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046582067/original/zwK15IKOBl0WlNnqnTP_tlBBcjUYKdk8Yg.png?1747184728)
6. Review all actions.
7. Click **Publish**.
8. Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046582073/original/oqAx0Yzr78U2Z1i-kUPeDx5B1v1HCCWp4Q.png?1747184767)

**Next**, consider customizing your reminders with personalized messages to build stronger client relationships.

**Fix missing required fields while saving**

If required fields are missing when you click **Save changes**, HighLevel helps you find the issue automatically.

- If the missing field is in the current tab, the editor scrolls to that field and highlights it.
- If the missing field is in another tab, HighLevel opens the correct tab and highlights the field there.

This helps you fix missing details faster before saving the calendar.

---

## **Integrate Personal Calendar**

Connecting your booking system with your personal calendar keeps everything in sync. No more double-booking or missed meetings, just effortless organization.

1. Navigate to **Calendars > Calendar Settings**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046582081/original/DosSWHTt2THvSPzLG8neIvdu_7_Y1QY67A.png?1747184874)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046582097/original/OL5bIDvosxda9GtMpgvjvYhP-rNFQZT6ww.png?1747184942)
3. Then select the **Video Conferencing** tab and click **Add New** to link your preferred conferencing tool.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046582104/original/KE9SnwYzFVB8Eb0-C2mJqKhvd8hvPHwiEw.png?1747185004)

**Next**, double-check that your integrations are syncing properly to enjoy seamless scheduling!

---

## **Share from the Calendar Header**

Sharing directly from the calendar you’re editing saves time and prevents copy-paste errors.

**Use the Share button**

Open **Settings → Calendars → [Your Calendar]** and click **Share** in the **top-right header** to:

- **Copy** your booking link
- Create a **One-Time Link**
- Get the **Embed****code**
- **Preview** the calendar as visitors see it

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064116937/original/VW3GXgSdWHyuZ2vVZsSVXQKadZ6ZV-u-Fg.png?1770138871)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Where do I find my booking link now?**  
Open **Settings → Calendars → [Your Calendar]** and click **Share** in the top-right header. Click **Copy Link**.

**Q: How do I generate a one-time link?**  
Click **Share** in the header and select **One-Time Link**, then follow the prompt to create and copy it.

**Q: Where’s the embed code for my website?**  
Click **Share** in the header and choose **Embed Code** to copy the HTML snippet.

**Q: Can I preview the calendar as a visitor?**  
Yes. Click **Share** and select **Preview** (or open the copied link in a private window).

**Q: What does “Troubleshoot Calendar” do?**  
It launches diagnostics to check configuration and availability issues and guides you to fixes.

**Q: Do these buttons change any existing links?**  
No. They surface quick actions; your booking link remains the same unless you create a new one-time link.

---

title_en: Build a Dental Practice That Runs Smoothly—Even When You’re Not There : Operations Playbook
source_md:
Behind every high-performing dental clinic is an operations system that works quietly and efficiently in the background. Most practices lose time, patients, and revenue not because of bad service—but because of avoidable bottlenecks: manual reminders, missed calls, overbooked providers, underutilized assistants, and miscommunication between front desk and providers.

This playbook shows you how to use GoHighLevel (GHL) to systematize your practice from the ground up—so your front desk team can handle more, your patients stay informed and on time, and your calendar stays full without chaos.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Why Operational Efficiency Matters in Dentistry](#Why-Operational-Efficiency-Matters-in-Dentistry)
- [Core Operational Systems Every Clinic Needs (All Handled Inside GHL)](#Core-Operational-Systems-Every-Clinic-Needs-(All-Handled-Inside-GHL))
  - [1. Smart Calendar Configuration](#1.-Smart-Calendar-Configuration)
  - [2. Online Booking & Embedded Calendar](#2.-Online-Booking-&-Embedded-Calendar)
  - [3. Intake Forms That Pre-Qualify Patients](#3.-Intake-Forms-That-Pre-Qualify-Patients)
  - [4. Automated Confirmations & Reminders](#4.-Automated-Confirmations-&-Reminders)
  - [5. Missed Call Text-Back](#5.-Missed-Call-Text-Back)
  - [6. Internal Alerts & Task Assignment](#6.-Internal-Alerts-&-Task-Assignment)
- [Optimize for Team Communication and Accountability](#Optimize-for-Team-Communication-and-Accountability)
- [AI Assistants and Workflows That Scale](#AI-Assistants-and-Workflows-That-Scale)
- [Reporting and Admin Control](#Reporting-and-Admin-Control)
- [Monthly Operations Checklist (Build Inside GHL)](#Monthly-Operations-Checklist-(Build-Inside-GHL))
- [Final Word](#Final-Word)

---

### **Why Operational Efficiency Matters in Dentistry**

A dental clinic has dozens of moving parts every day:

- New patient inquiries
- Insurance and treatment plan follow-ups
- Recalls and hygiene checkups
- Provider scheduling
- No-show management
- Review collection
- Billing and reactivation

If you’re managing these across 4–5 different tools, your staff is constantly switching tabs, missing messages, and working reactively. GHL solves this by centralizing all communication, scheduling, workflows, and internal coordination in one place.

Let’s break down what that looks like in practice.

---

### **Core Operational Systems Every Clinic Needs (All Handled Inside GHL)**

#### 

#### **1. Smart Calendar Configuration**

Stop juggling multiple calendars. Use GHL to set up:

- Separate calendars by appointment type (e.g., Hygiene, New Patient Exam, Emergencies)
- Provider-specific availability synced with real-time bookings
- Rules for buffer time, same-day cutoff, and automatic rescheduling

**Pro Tip:** Set “Lead Source” rules so appointments from ads, Google, or referrals go into different pipelines automatically.

**[How To Create Service Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001159-how-to-create-service-calendars)**

#### **2. Online Booking & Embedded Calendar**

Let patients schedule without needing to call your front desk.

- Embed your GHL calendar on your website, landing pages, and Google Business profile
- Include calendar links in SMS, email, and social posts
- Set provider priority and team rotation logic

**GHL Workflow:** Booking → Confirmation → Pre-Visit Reminders → Post-Visit Review Request

**[Embedding HighLevel Calendars using HTML Code](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000982201-embedding-highlevel-calendars-using-html-code)**

#### **3. Intake Forms That Pre-Qualify Patients**

No more paper forms. GHL allows you to build custom digital forms that:

- Collect insurance info, concerns, and medical history
- Trigger workflows based on answers (e.g., flagged anxiety or previous trauma)

title_en: How to Integrate TikTok Lead Ads
source_md:
The TikTok Lead Ads integration allows you to capture leads from TikTok lead generation campaigns directly in HighLevel. By connecting your TikTok account, you can map lead form fields to your CRM and automate follow-up actions using workflows.

TikTok Lead Ads now supports a Marketplace-based integration with enhanced authentication and account management. The new architecture improves security and reliability while maintaining compatibility with existing TikTok Lead Ads connections and workflows.

This article explains how to connect TikTok Lead Ads, configure lead form field mappings, manage your integration, and troubleshoot common issues.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How TikTok Lead Ads Integration Works](#How-TikTok-Lead-Ads-Integration-Works)
- [What's New With the Marketplace Integration?](#What's-New-With-the-Marketplace-Integration?)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [Connect TikTok Lead Ads Through Marketplace](#Connect-TikTok-Lead-Ads-Through-Marketplace)
  - [Step 1: Connect TikTok Lead Ads](#Step-1%3A-Connect-TikTok-Lead-Ads)
  - [Step 2: Review Your Connected Account](#Step-2%3A-Review-Your-Connected-Account)
  - [Step 3: Select Your Advertising Account](#Step-3%3A-Select-Your-Advertising-Account)
  - [Step 4: View Your Lead Forms](#Step-4%3A-View-Your-Lead-Forms)
  - [Step 5: Map Form Fields](#Step-5%3A-Map-Form-Fields)
  - [What Happens to Existing Connections?](#What-Happens-to-Existing-Connections?)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Resources](#Related-Resources)

---

## **How TikTok Lead Ads Integration Works**

The TikTok Lead Ads integration connects your TikTok lead generation forms to HighLevel, allowing you to capture leads in your CRM.

Once your TikTok account is connected and your lead forms are configured, leads submitted through TikTok Lead Ads can sync to HighLevel.

You can also use the **TikTok Form Submitted** workflow trigger to automate follow-up actions when new leads submit a form.

---

## **What's New With the Marketplace Integration?**

TikTok Lead Ads has moved to the Marketplace architecture, introducing several improvements:

- **Enhanced Authentication:** New connections use Marketplace authentication flows for improved credential handling and account security.
- **Improved Reliability:** The Marketplace architecture provides a more maintainable foundation for the integration.
- **Updated Account Management:** The integration includes dedicated sections for viewing connections, selecting advertising accounts, and mapping lead forms.
- **Backward Compatibility:** Existing connections and workflows continue functioning without requiring users to reconfigure their setup.
- **Future Enhancements:** The new architecture provides a foundation for upcoming capabilities, including multi-account support.

**Important:** Multi-account support within a single location is a planned enhancement. It is not confirmed as available in this release.

---

## **Before You Begin**

Before connecting TikTok Lead Ads, make sure you have:

- Access to the TikTok Business account you want to connect.
- A TikTok advertising account.
- A TikTok instant form created for your lead generation campaign.
- Access to the HighLevel sub-account where you want to receive leads.

For assistance creating TikTok lead generation campaigns, refer to [TikTok's official documentation](https://ads.tiktok.com/).

---

---

## **Connect TikTok Lead Ads Through Marketplace**

TikTok Lead Ads now supports Marketplace-based connections with enhanced security, authentication, and account management. The new architecture maintains compatibility with existing connections and workflows while supporting future enhancements.

Users can enable the Marketplace integration through **Labs** during early access.

### **Step 1: Connect TikTok Lead Ads**

1. Go to **Settings → Integrations** in your HighLevel sub-account.
2. Find **TikTok Lead Ads** and click **Connect** to begin the connection process.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084539119/original/sGWzy2pSdU0kcGcQqGa-hoag0cLxDGoeJQ.png?1793296404)

### **Step 2: Review Your Connected Account**

Once connected, open **External Connection** to view your TikTok account's name, email address, and connection status.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084539138/original/GkmkKXG9QLrETfni5dgQYWidffZ7BqyoUQ.png?1793296448)

### **Step 3: Select Your Advertising Account**

1. Open **Manage Tiktok Accounts → Ad Account**.
2. Select your advertising account and click **Save**.

The page displays the selected account's synchronization status.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084539180/original/hKTZwlY1MvYuKW-1qtwlkaAEKtZlIBsNXQ.png?1793296471)

### **Step 4: View Your Lead Forms**

1. Open **Manage Tiktok Accounts → Form Field Mapping**.
2. Review the available forms, including their **Page ID**, **Form Name**, **Mapping**, and **Sync Status**.
3. Use **Refresh Forms** to refresh the form list when needed.

The **Actions** column provides options to manage each form's mappings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084539195/original/pLrEP1PP-Y9bhKNnTO6PtgR99DsHwTv7eQ.png?1793296494)

### **Step 5: Map Form Fields**

1. Click the **edit icon** under Actions for the desired form.
2. In the **Map Fields** window, match each TikTok form field to the appropriate CRM field using the dropdowns.
3. Review the field statuses and click **Confirm** to save.

Successfully mapped fields display a **Mapped** status.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084539207/original/He2sWasiCRqs9gCgqMrhAu8BsDtIxQ9z9g.png?1793296525)

### **What Happens to Existing Connections?**

Existing TikTok Lead Ads connections and workflows continue working without reconfiguration.

During early access, older connections remain on the existing architecture. HighLevel plans to migrate them automatically after the Marketplace integration leaves Labs, without requiring user action.

```
Note: The Marketplace architecture supports future enhancements, including planned multi-account support within a single location. This capability is not yet confirmed as available.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q. Do I need to reconnect my TikTok account after the Marketplace migration?**

No. Existing TikTok Lead Ads connections are designed to continue working without requiring users to reconnect or reconfigure their setup solely because of this migration.

**Q. Will existing TikTok Lead Ads workflows continue working?**

Yes. Existing TikTok Lead Ads workflows remain compatible with the Marketplace migration.

**Q. How do I access the Marketplace-based TikTok Lead Ads integration?**

The Marketplace integration is available through Labs during early access.

**Q. What happens to my existing integration while the Marketplace feature is in Labs?**

Existing connections remain on the previous integration architecture during early access.

HighLevel plans to migrate these connections automatically after the Marketplace feature leaves Labs.

**Q. Can I manage multiple TikTok accounts within the same HighLevel location?**

The Marketplace architecture provides a foundation for future multi-account support.

The current release does not confirm that this capability is available.

**Q. Does the Marketplace migration change how TikTok leads are captured?**

The migration does not introduce changes to existing lead capture workflows. It focuses on improving integration architecture, authentication, and account management.

**Q. How can I check whether my TikTok account is connected?**

For Marketplace connections, open Settings → Integrations → TikTok Lead Ads → External Connection and review the account's connection status.

**Q. Where can I configure TikTok lead form field mappings?**

For Marketplace connections, open Settings → Integrations → TikTok Lead Ads → Manage Tiktok Accounts → Form Field Mapping.

---

## **Related Resources**

- [TikTok Lead Ads Migration to Marketplace Architecture — Release Note](https://highlevel.canny.io/changelog/tiktok-lead-ads-migration-to-marketplace-architecture)
- [Workflow Trigger — TikTok Form Submit](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003262)
- [TikTok Ads — Launch Lead-Gen Campaigns in Ad Manager](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009244-tiktok-ads-launch-lead-gen-campaigns-in-ad-manager)
- [TikTok Ads Manager](https://ads.tiktok.com/)

title_en: Send Bulk Email to Associated Contacts
source_md:
Bulk Email • Companies • Custom Objects

Send Bulk Email to Associated Contacts

Send bulk emails directly from selected Company or Custom Object records without rebuilding the same audience under Contacts. HighLevel uses the records' associations to determine which Contacts should receive the message. You can also personalize emails with Company or Custom Object data and use the existing bulk email creation, delivery, and reporting experience.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to build a bulk email audience from Company or Custom Object associations, choose the right recipients, personalize the message, select a delivery method, and review results.

# What Is Bulk Email to Associated Contacts?

Bulk Email to Associated Contacts lets you select Company or Custom Object records and email the Contacts associated with those records.

For Custom Objects, you can choose one or more association labels and send to the most recently associated Contact, earliest associated Contact, or all associated Contacts. For Companies, HighLevel automatically uses the Contact association.

Supported Company and Custom Object fields can also be used as merge fields so each email can include information from the source record.

## Key Benefits of Bulk Email to Associated Contacts

Association-based bulk email turns existing CRM relationships into ready-to-use audiences without requiring the same segment to be recreated under Contacts.

- **Email From Existing Records:** Start from selected Companies or supported Custom Object records.
- **Target Specific Relationships:** Use Custom Object association labels to control which Contacts qualify.
- **Control Recipient Selection:** Send to the earliest, most recent, or all associated Contacts.
- **Personalize With Source Data:** Insert supported Company or Custom Object fields into the message.
- **Prevent Duplicate Sends:** Contacts qualifying through multiple selected association labels are de-duplicated.
- **Use Existing Bulk Email Tools:** Compose, test, schedule, batch-send, and track the email through the standard bulk email experience.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Bulk email relies on existing Contact associations and normal email eligibility rules, so the required records and relationships should already be in place before sending.

- Selected Company or Custom Object records must have associated Contacts.
- A Custom Object must have an association with Contacts before **Send email** is available.
- For Companies, HighLevel automatically selects the Contact association.
- For Custom Objects, one or more applicable association labels can be selected.
- The final recipient list is resolved when the bulk action runs.
- Contacts qualifying through multiple selected association labels receive only one email.
- Contacts without an eligible email address or restricted by applicable email settings may be skipped.
- Existing permissions, consent requirements, deliverability protections, rate limits, and other bulk-email restrictions still apply.

## How To Set Up Bulk Email to Associated Contacts

Start from the Company or Custom Object records that define the audience, then use their associations to resolve recipients before composing and sending the email.

### Step 1: Select the Source Records

Select only the records that should contribute Contacts to the recipient audience.

1. For Companies, go to **Contacts → Companies**. For a Custom Object, open the applicable object from the sub-account navigation.
2. Use filters or a Smart List when needed to narrow the records.
3. Select the records whose associated Contacts should receive the email.

![Custom Object list with multiple records selected and the Send email bulk action visible](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081929953/original/NNAoibr9W-TjpcuYVp9u3XuUlY-NtPN4AQ.png?1790460391)

### Step 2: Start the Bulk Email

The confirmation step verifies the selected source records before HighLevel resolves their associated Contacts.

1. Click **Send email** from the bulk action bar.
2. Review the number of selected records.
3. Click **Confirm and proceed**.

**Recipient count:** The exact recipient list is resolved when the bulk action runs. Final numbers appear in the bulk action's statistics.

### Step 3: Choose the Association and Recipients

Association labels control which Custom Object relationships qualify, while the recipient setting determines how many associated Contacts are selected from each source record.

1. Enter an **Action name**.
2. For a Custom Object, select one or more **Association label** values. For Companies, the Contact association is selected automatically.
3. Select **Most recently associated contact**, **Earliest associated contact**, or **All associated contacts** under **Email recipients**.

![Bulk email settings showing an association label and associated Contact recipient options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081929994/original/dcU4ht-UHMNsrfsPuIQkfh9sDpmNPXrw5w.png?1790460669)

### Step 4: Compose and Send the Email

Use the standard Bulk Email Builder to create the message, personalize it with supported source-record fields, test it, and choose when it should be delivered.

1. Enter the required sender information, subject, and optional pre-header.
2. Choose **Quick Compose**, **From Smart Builder**, or **Select existing template**.
3. Create the email and insert Contact, Company, or Custom Object merge fields when needed.
4. Add attachments and send a test email when needed.
5. Open **Additional settings** if you need options such as click tracking or UTM tracking.
6. Choose **Send all at once**, **Send all at scheduled time**, or **Send in batch mode**.
7. Review the configuration, complete any required consent acknowledgment, and click **Send email**.

![Bulk email composer showing email creation options, message content, delivery modes, and test email controls](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930014/original/kdLaPVB6rb5UBI1-cA-fv73rnmAmJ-hjcA.png?1790460820)

### Step 5: Track Results

Bulk email statistics show which recipients were processed successfully and where delivery or engagement issues occurred.

Open the applicable send under **Contacts → Bulk Actions** to review metrics such as Accepted, Delivered, Opened, Clicked, Replied, Unsubscribed, Complained, Bounced, Failed, and Skipped.

![Bulk Email Stats showing delivery and engagement results for associated Contacts](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930018/original/OmpjYKICiuSsLo0S39kK-owzjyjVgsZGtA.png?1790460844)

For broader reporting, use **Load More Stats** from the bulk action or go to **Marketing → Emails → Statistics** and select **Bulk Action Campaigns** from the source filter.

## Common Use Cases

This feature is most useful when your audience is naturally organized around Companies or business-specific Custom Object records.

- **Real Estate:** Select Property records and email Contacts associated as Potential Buyers.
- **Insurance:** Select Policies approaching renewal and email associated Policy Holders.
- **B2B:** Filter Companies by relevant criteria and email their associated Contacts.
- **Pets or Veterinary:** Select Pet records and email associated owners with reminders or updates.
- **Smart List Segments:** Build a Company or Custom Object Smart List, select its records, and email the associated Contacts directly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why is Send email missing from a Custom Object?

The Custom Object must have an existing association with Contacts before the Send email bulk action becomes available.

Q: Will a Contact receive duplicate emails if they qualify through multiple association labels?

No. Contacts qualifying through multiple selected association labels are de-duplicated before sending.

Q: Why might a Contact be skipped?

Contacts may be skipped when they do not have an eligible email address or when existing email permissions, consent settings, or other sending protections prevent delivery.

Q: Can I use an existing email template?

Yes. Select **Select existing template** in the Bulk Email Builder to use a saved template.

Q: Can I add click or UTM tracking?

Yes. Open **Additional settings** in the Bulk Email Builder to use supported tracking options such as Track Clicks and UTM Tracking.

Q: Where can I review full bulk-email performance?

Review the send under **Contacts → Bulk Actions**, or open **Marketing → Emails → Statistics** and filter the dashboard to **Bulk Action Campaigns**.

✅ **76% of homeowners call the same plumber again—if they follow up.**  
✅ **Referral customers convert 5X faster & spend 16% more** than cold leads.

```
You need a HighLevel account before we can get started - Sign Up Here!
```

✅ How to **automate follow-ups & keep customers coming back.**

### **Step 1: Automate Follow-Ups & Rebooking**

#### **Why It Matters?**

Most plumbing businesses **lose thousands** because they **don’t follow up** with past customers.

**Fact:** **65% of customers forget their plumber’s name** after just 6 months.

#### **1.1 Post-Service Follow-Up Messages**

✔ **Send an automated thank-you SMS or email** after every plumbing job.  
✔ **Ask if everything is running smoothly** & remind them about future service.  
✔ **Offer a discount for their next service** to boost retention.

**Example Message:**  
*"Hey Mike, thanks for trusting [Your Business Name] for your plumbing needs! Everything running smoothly? Schedule a pipe checkup in 6 months & get $50 off!"*

#### [How to Automate Customer Follow-Ups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001165881-how-to-build-automated-appointment-follow-up-surveys-in-workflow-builder)

### **1.2 Automated Check-In Reminders**

✔ **Set up maintenance reminders for key services** (e.g., drain cleaning, water heater inspections).  
✔ **Offer a quick way to book their next appointment online.**

**Example Message:**  
*"Mike, it’s been 6 months since your last water heater check. Need us to stop by? Reply YES, and we’ll take care of it!"*

#### [How to Set Up Maintenance Reminders](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001167806-how-to-send-users-appointment-reminders)

---

## **Step 2: Get More 5-Star Reviews Automatically**

⭐ **85% of customers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations.**  
⭐ **Plumbing businesses with 50+ Google reviews rank 2X higher** than those with fewer.

### **2.1 Automate Review Requests**

✔ **Trigger SMS & email review requests right after job completion.**  
✔ **Personalize the request with the customer’s name & job details.**  
✔ **Direct them to Google, Facebook, and Yelp for maximum exposure.**

**Example Message:**  
*"Hey Mike, thanks for choosing us! If we did a great job, could you leave us a quick review? It helps us a ton! Click here: [Google Review Link]"*

#### [How to Automate Review Requests](#)

### **2.2 Handle Negative Reviews Proactively**

✔ **AI flags negative reviews before they go public.**  
✔ **Customers with complaints get a follow-up call first.**  
✔ **Turn unhappy customers into loyal clients by resolving issues quickly.**

**Example:**  
*A customer had a complaint about a late service. Instead of leaving a bad review, they receive a follow-up message:*

*"Hey Mike, we noticed you weren’t fully satisfied. We’d love to make things right! Let’s schedule a free touch-up. Reply YES to book."*

---

## **Step 3: Create a Referral Machine**

**Referral customers convert 5X faster and spend 16% more** than leads from ads.

**Fact:** **Plumbing businesses with referral programs grow 30% faster** than those relying only on ads.

#### [How to Set Up an Automated Referral Program](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001213448-affiliate-refferal-page-leads-customers-cancelled-statuses)

### 

### **3.2 Automate Referral Follow-Ups**

*"Know someone who needs a plumber? Refer them now & get $50 off your next repair!"*

---

## **Step 4: Lock in Recurring Revenue with Plumbing Maintenance Plans**

## **Why It Matters?**

Plumbers who offer maintenance plans **generate 30% more repeat business** and **higher customer retention rates.**

### 

### **4.1 Offer Service Plans for Recurring Work**

✔ **Create annual or semi-annual plumbing maintenance plans.**  
✔ **Automate invoicing & renewal reminders so customers never miss a service.**

### **Step 5: Use AI & Smart Lists to Boost Customer Engagement**

Your past customers are **10X more likely** to book again than a cold lead. **HighLevel automates personalized outreach based on customer history.**

### **5.1 Smart Lists for Re-Engagement**

✔ **Create lists of past customers by service type, location, or last booking date.**

### **5.2 AI-Powered Follow-Ups & Surveys**

✔ **Use AI to check in with past customers via SMS.**

**Example Message:**  
*"Hey [First Name], it’s been 6 months since your last plumbing check. Need an inspection? Reply YES to book!"*

#### [How to Sell & Automate Maintenance Plans](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003450-recurring-appointments)

#### [How to Use Smart Lists for Customer Retention](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001062094-getting-started-with-smart-lists)

# **Final Thoughts: Retention = Long-Term Profit**

By **automating follow-ups, increasing reviews, encouraging referrals, and offering maintenance plans**, you **create a system where every satisfied customer leads to more jobs & revenue—without extra effort.**

**HighLevel makes this effortless—so you can focus on delivering top-notch plumbing services while your business grows on autopilot.**

title_en: How to Customize the SaaS Subscription Cancellation Flow
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/gXxe2ALWFCU?&wmode=opaque)

This guide walks you through the new SaaS Sub-Account Cancellation Flow customization options, available to agencies using the SaaS Configurator. It explains how you can personalize the cancellation experience for your clients, offer discounts to reduce churn, track cancellation activity, and redirect users if needed. If you're looking to gain better control over subscriber cancellations and improve retention, this documentation is for you.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Custom SaaS Cancellation Flow?](#What-is-the-Custom-SaaS-Cancellation-Flow?)
- [Key Benefits of the Custom Cancellation Flow](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Custom-Cancellation-Flow)
- [Global Toggle — Allow Clients to Cancel Subscription](#Global-Toggle-%E2%80%94-Allow-Clients-to-Cancel-Subscription)
- [Manage Cancellation Reasons](#Manage-Cancellation-Reasons)
- [Offer Discount to Retain Clients](#Offer-Discount-to-Retain-Clients)
- [Redirect Users to an External Page](#Redirect-Users-to-an-External-Page)
- [Track Cancellation Activity with Activity Logs](#Track-Cancellation-Activity-with-Activity-Logs)
- [Preview the Cancellation Flow](#Preview-the-Cancellation-Flow)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Custom SaaS Cancellation Flow?**

Custom Cancellation Flow replaces the default “one-click cancel” with a branded, multi-step journey. At each stage—reason collection, discount offer, external redirect—you decide the wording, incentives, and next actions, ensuring clients encounter an intentional retention experience instead of an abrupt exit.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Custom Cancellation Flow**

- **Capture Exit Insights**: Gather structured and open-ended cancellation reasons to inform product, pricing, and onboarding improvements.
- **Reduce Churn**: Present time-bound percentage discounts during the exit flow to persuade wavering clients to remain subscribed.
- **Drive High-Touch Saves**: Redirect cancel-clickers to external concierge pages, surveys, or booking links for personalized retention efforts.
- **Maintain Full Visibility**: Track every cancellation attempt or deflection in real-time Activity Logs for transparent reporting and coaching.
- **Iterate Without Code**: Update reasons, offers, and copy on demand, enabling rapid A/B testing of retention tactics, without the need for coding

---

## **Global Toggle — Allow Clients to Cancel Subscription**

Turning this master switch **ON** reveals the “Modify / Cancel” button inside every sub‑account’s Billing Dashboard. Turning it **OFF** hides all cancellation options, deferring control entirely to the agency.

- Location: **Agency View****→ SaaS Configurator → Cancellation Settings**
- Default state for new SaaS businesses: **OFF**
- Changes take effect immediately after **Save**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049729631/original/c4U9EzbLVlpHLypPREqGmcFODpPs7OG9jg.png?1752242877)**

---

## **Manage Cancellation Reasons**

Collecting specific exit feedback helps you identify pricing objections, feature gaps, or onboarding challenges. Here you can configure a list of reasons that your clients will see when they attempt to cancel their SaaS subscription.  
  
To customize reasons:

1. Go to **SaaS Configurator → Cancellation Settings**
2. Under **Manage Cancellation Reason**, choose from existing defaults or add new ones
3. Click the ✏️ icon to edit any listed reason or ➕ to add a new one
4. The **"Other"** option is always included and allows your customers to type a free-text response

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049081667/original/MsrKuMGjwHgpVQ80DEG8labRPshCYJaXRQ.png?1751285152)

---

## **Offer Discount to Retain Clients**

You can try to save the customer by offering a **discount** before they confirm cancellation.

A well‑timed price break can nudge users to stay and explore more value before deciding. HighLevel automatically applies the coupon on the next billing cycle.  
  
To enable this:

1. Toggle on **Enable Discount Offer**
2. Set:

   - **Discount %** (e.g., 25%)
   - **Discount Duration** (e.g., 3 months for monthly plans)
3. Optionally allow users to **receive the offer more than once**
4. When a customer accepts the offer, it’s **automatically applied** to their next billing cycle
5. Customers who accept will be **deflected** from cancellation

```
⚠️ This feature is currently available for V1 sub-accounts only
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049081716/original/Y_1JJrodYvghRCvhvGPA942kM9SokSBePA.png?1751285182)

---

## **Redirect Users to an External Page**

If you want to handle cancellation logic outside the platform (e.g., on your own site), you can redirect users. This can be used for more advanced off-boarding flows, surveys, or saving attempts.

Steps:

1. Under **Redirect to External Page**, enter a valid URL
2. When enabled, users will be taken to this page immediately after selecting a cancellation reason
3. The cancellation will **not** complete within HighLevel

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049081726/original/-5esIHLnV47gNyPYzxPDy7xvKMNIN-H_mA.png?1751285207)

---

## **Track Cancellation Activity with Activity Logs**

All cancellation attempts are logged for visibility and analysis. This gives you actionable insights into **churn patterns** and **retention performance**.

To view logs:

1. Scroll to the **Activity Logs** section
2. View:

   - **Sub-account name & user**
   - **Timestamp**
   - **Plan details**
   - **Cancellation reason**
   - **Outcome (Cancelled / Deflected)**
   - **Detection type** (e.g., coupon, redirect)
3. Use the **Download** button for exporting the log

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155049081746/original/I-GIi7zy9SRof0upqSDhtKr5zKGvDSSQmQ.png?1751285223)

---

## **Preview the Cancellation Flow**

Before enabling the flow for your clients, you can simulate it using **Preview Mode**. Preview Mode reproduces the full client‑side journey in a safe sandbox, letting you double‑check copy, coupon math, and redirect destinations. No coupons are issued and no log entries are created while in Preview. This ensures a smooth and polished cancellation experience before going live.

How to preview:

1. Click **Preview** (top right of Cancellation Settings)
2. Navigate through each step as your customer would see it
3. Use this to validate text, offers, and logic flow

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can a client accept the discount more than once?**  
Yes. Check Allow Sub‑Accounts to receive discount offer more than once in Discount settings.

**Q: What happens if I enable an external redirect and the user closes the browser?**  
The subscription remains active because the in‑app cancellation step was bypassed. The Activity Log will list Deflected – External Link.

**Q: Where can I see which team member tried to cancel?**  
Check the User column in Activity Logs for the exact sub‑account admin.

**Q: Can I export the Cancellation Activity Log for auditing or reporting?**  
Yes. Click Download in Activity Logs to export a CSV that includes every cancellation and deflection event, along with reasons and user data.

**Q: Does Preview Mode create real coupons or log entries?**  
No. Preview runs in a sandbox environment. It displays the full flow for review but does not issue coupons, change subscription status, or write to Activity Logs.

**Q: Are deflection events recorded even when the client ultimately keeps the subscription?**  
Yes. Activity Logs list every attempt, including deflections caused by discount acceptance or external redirect, so you always see total churn‑pressure volume.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Cancel SaaS Sub‑Account for Your Client](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001216453)
- [Upgrading and Cancelling SaaS Plans for Clients](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001979)
- [Subscription Management in Client Portal](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003204)
- [Coupon Application on Subscription Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004886)
- [Coupon Application on Subscription Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004886)

These improvements help community owners, coaches, educators, and event hosts manage sessions more efficiently while delivering clearer, more engaging experiences for attendees. Whether you're hosting recurring calls, training sessions, or live community events, these enhancements make it easier to host, share, and scale your content inside HighLevel.

# **What are Communities Live Session Enhancements?**

Communities Live Session Enhancements introduce new tools designed to simplify how you host, manage, and reuse live content inside HighLevel Communities. With a reusable Personal Meeting Link, centralized access to recordings, and improved audio clarity, hosts can create a more polished and consistent experience for their audience while reducing manual setup and meeting management tasks.

These enhancements are especially useful for recurring coaching calls, onboarding sessions, workshops, office hours, and community-led discussions where consistency and ease of access are important.

---

## **Key Benefits of Communities Live Session Enhancements**

These updates improve both the hosting experience and attendee experience by reducing friction before, during, and after live sessions.

- **Personal Meeting Links:**Create one reusable meeting room link that can be shared across recurring meetings, events, and 1:1 sessions.
- **Professional Branding:** Deliver a more consistent and polished experience with a dedicated meeting URL.
- **Centralized Recordings Hub:** Access, manage, replay, download, or delete recordings from one location.
- **Content Repurposing:**Turn live sessions into reusable training, onboarding, or educational content.
- **Enhanced Noise Cancellation:** Reduce background distractions and improve voice clarity during sessions.
- **Faster Workflows:**Spend less time creating new links and searching for recordings.
- **Improved Attendee Experience:**Help participants join sessions quickly and enjoy clearer conversations.

---

## **Personal Meeting Links**

Personal Meeting Links provide hosts with a dedicated, reusable meeting room that stays consistent across sessions. Instead of generating a new link every time you host a session, you can share one permanent link for recurring meetings, office hours, coaching calls, workshops, or community discussions.

---

## **Recordings Hub**

The Recordings Hub centralizes all session recordings into one accessible location. Hosts can quickly review past sessions, replay important discussions, download recordings for external use, or remove recordings when they are no longer needed.

---

## **Enhanced Noise Cancellation**

Enhanced Noise Cancellation improves audio quality during live sessions by reducing unwanted background sounds and interruptions. This helps hosts and attendees communicate more clearly, even in less controlled environments.

Clearer audio creates a more professional experience and helps maintain participant engagement during meetings and events.

---

## **How To Setup Your Personal Meeting Link**

Properly configuring your Personal Meeting Link helps create a seamless experience for attendees while reducing the need to generate new links for every session.

#### **Step 1: Navigate to Communities Live Session Settings**

1. Log in to HighLevel.
2. Open your Communities dashboard.
3. Navigate to the Live Sessions or Meeting Settings area.
4. Locate the Personal Meeting Link section.

#### **Step 2: Configure Your Personal Meeting Link**

1. Create or customize your meeting URL.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072839593/original/BYUumf4Snt9r1j49dMdxlVnHP0XxtoIndQ.png?1780502190)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072838611/original/Mw4oOTUgLPUisRLKR1isKISeQG5cLSNddw.png?1780501652)
2. Save your changes.
3. Copy the meeting link for sharing.

#### **Step 3: Share Your Meeting Link**

You can share your Personal Meeting Link through:

- Community posts
- Event pages
- Email campaigns
- Calendar invitations
- Direct messages

This allows attendees to consistently join sessions using the same meeting URL.

---

## **How To Access and Manage Recordings**

Managing recordings centrally makes it easier to organize content and provide ongoing value to your community members.  
  
  
**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072838794/original/w2ntRiHvO8ZqydfqrDAsZhpNw3kldwHQEQ.png?1780501767)**

#### **Step 1: Open the Recordings Hub**

1. Navigate to Communities.
2. Open the Live Sessions or Recordings area.
3. Select the Recordings Hub.

#### **Step 2: View Available Recordings**

Inside the Recordings Hub, you can:

- Browse previous recordings
- Search for specific sessions
- Open recordings for playback

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155072838822/original/LZn9y_nM42vPaGsN11bHIaRDQM-SScF0kw.png?1780501790)

#### **Step 3: Download or Delete Recordings**

Select a recording to:

- Download the file
- Replay the recording
- Delete recordings no longer needed

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use the same Personal Meeting Link for recurring sessions?**

Yes. Personal Meeting Links are designed to be reusable across recurring meetings, events, coaching calls, and live sessions.

**Q: Where can I find my session recordings?**

All available recordings can be accessed inside the Recordings Hub.

**Q: Can I download recordings from the Recordings Hub?**

Yes. Hosts can download recordings for external storage, sharing, or repurposing.

**Q: Can recordings be deleted?**

Yes. You can remove recordings directly from the Recordings Hub when they are no longer needed.

**Q: Does Enhanced Noise Cancellation work automatically?**

Noise cancellation enhancements are designed to improve audio clarity during live sessions and may be enabled automatically depending on the meeting environment and configuration.

**Q: Can attendees join using the same Personal Meeting Link every time?**

Yes. The same reusable meeting link can be shared with attendees for ongoing sessions.

**Q: Are Personal Meeting Links useful for 1:1 meetings?**

Yes. Personal Meeting Links work well for recurring client meetings, office hours, consultations, and coaching sessions.

**Q: Can recordings be used for onboarding or training?**

Yes. Many hosts use session recordings to create educational libraries, onboarding resources, and member training content.

---

title_en: How to Use the Color Picker for Funnels & Websites
source_md:
The Color Picker lets you define brand, default, and custom colors and apply them anywhere in your pages; even down to individual words or characters. This article explains what the Color Picker is, why it matters, and how to make the most of its features.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Color Picker?](#What-is-the-Color-Picker?)
- [Key Benefits of the Color Picker](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Color-Picker)
- [Per-Character and Per-Word Level Styling](#Per-Character-and-Per-Word-Level-Styling)
- [Custom Color Labels & Tooltip](#Custom-Color-Labels-&-Tooltip)
- [Supported Color Formats](#Supported-Color-Formats)
- [Validation and Duplicate-Color Prevention](#Validation-and-Duplicate-Color-Prevention)
- [How to Use the Color Picker](#How-to-Use-the-Color-Picker)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Color Picker?**

The Color Picker is the design component inside HighLevel’s Funnels & Websites Builder that controls every color you use, from section backgrounds to hyper-specific text highlights. It displays brand, default, and custom colors together, supports HEX, RGB, and custom values, and offers precise, per-character styling directly from the inline text toolbar.

```
Default colors in the picker may change over time as the Page Builder’s out-of-the-box styling is refreshed. For example, new default palette options can appear (such as Cobalt and Smoke) to support modern starter designs. If you need strict brand consistency, set your Brand Board colors or Global Custom Colors and select those instead.
```

---

## **Key Benefits of the Color Picker**

A unified interface and smart controls help you style pages faster and more consistently.

- **Unified Palette**: View brand, default, and custom colors in a single panel, so there is no need to switch tabs
- **Per-Character Control**: Color a single word or letter for precise emphasis
- **Custom Labels**: Name colors (for example, “CTA Blue”) for quick reuse
- **Format Flexibility**: Enter and display colors in HEX, RGB, or custom values
- **Duplicate Protection**: Validation prevents accidental shade duplicates
- **Compact Layout**: Modern, space-efficient design loads quickly and stays out of your way

---

## **Per-Character and Per-Word Level Styling**

With the updated inline text editor, you can now apply color to individual words or even individual characters in your text. This means you can highlight specific words or change the color of just a part of the text, giving you full control over your design's look and feel.

---

## **Custom Color Labels & Tooltip**

Keep palettes organized, even when shades are similar, by giving your custom colors names!

#### **Naming Colors**

After picking a color, users can name and edit labels for custom colors (for example, “Warning Red”). Labels can be edited or removed at any time.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051160535/original/1Vggg2ZFsC6uWnIZYxzSucJ7DpyCCAUIhw.png?1754599413)*

#### **Custom Label Tooltips**

Hovering over a custom color displays its label as a tooltip. This makes it easier to distinguish similar shades, so your team can pick the right tint without memorizing HEX codes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051160803/original/fRw8Wx4PUYBPpxQ4i8gol0BXRSZIoNwGRg.png?1754599942)

---

## **Supported Color Formats**

The Color Picker allows you to choose and save colors in multiple formats so you can work with the values that best suit your needs. Use the dropdown to switch between color formats.

- **HEX**: A six-character code that defines color (for example, #1E90FF). This is the most common format for web design.
- **RGB**: A set of three numbers that define color based on red, green, and blue values (for example, rgb(30,144,255)). This is useful for precise control over color blending and opacity.
- **Custom Values**: Accepts dynamic tokens such as *{{ custom\_values.primary\_color }}.* These allow the color to be pulled from your custom values, making it easy to change in one place and have it update everywhere it is used.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051160736/original/WzlihryVhW-9lXTRM_CKo_iIC1a4kUwgcA.png?1754599810)

---

## **Validation and Duplicate-Color Prevention**

#### **Custom Color Validation**

Custom token values must exist in the current location’s configuration before they can be stored, which prevents broken references.

#### **Duplicate Color Prevention**

Stay consistent and error-free! If you try to save a shade already in the palette, the picker flags it instantly and prompts you to adjust the value. 

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051160685/original/xG5j-x_n8H9f4klkAp4FOKi_C0nPCvmvow.png?1754599744)*

---

## **How to Use the Color Picker**

Follow the steps below to use the color picker:

#### **Step 1:**Open Color Picker

- Open an an existing funnel or website page
- Select a section, element, or text block
- Click the **Color** square in the style panel, or click the **A-icon** in the inline toolbar for text

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051160970/original/GRQNsgty6uvfl4_pBv7uhZO0J1LRERwEzg.png?1754600328)

#### **Step 2:**Choose a Color

- Pick a shade from the default colors, brand colors or already created custom colors
- To create a new custom color, press **+ Add**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051161016/original/DpGToqSkGDyadKxEm7yczG3RTXhsyWyzLg.png?1754600498)**

#### **Step 3:**Create Custom Color

- Once the custom color panel is open, select the desired color
- Use the dropdown to select between RBG, HEX and Custom color formats
- Type a descriptive name for the color
- Click **Save**. The new color tile will appear in your palette

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155051161075/original/cb6br_kB7TZXbbv4j8kOc0I8lFbjy5mkFQ.png?1754600645)

## 

### **Button Icon Color (Page Builder)**

Button icons can now be colored independently, giving you precise control over icon visibility and brand alignment without affecting button text or subtext.

**How it works**

Independent control: Icon Color is separate from Text and Subtext colors.  

Color sources: Uses the new Color Picker,  including  Brand Board colors and Custom colors.  

Design flexibility: Adjust the icon to match brand accents while keeping text highly readable.

\_Add a screenshot of the Button element’s \*\*Colors\*\* panel with the \*\*Icon Color\*\* swatch highlighted. Alt text: “Button element Colors panel showing the new Icon Color control.”\_

## 

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will existing pages change if I edit a Brand Color?**  
No. Brand Color updates apply going forward. Colors already saved on existing elements or text stay the same.

**Q: Why do I see a “duplicate color” message when I try to save?**  
The value you entered already exists in the palette, or a saved custom value resolves to the same value. Change the value or edit the existing swatch instead.

**Q: Can I rename or delete a custom color without breaking pages?**  
A: Yes. Renaming or deleting a swatch does not change colors that are already applied on existing pages.

**Q: Can I bulk-import brand colors?**  
A: Add them in the Brand Board; they automatically appear at the top of the palette.

**Q: Why won’t my custom value color save?**  
The token must exist in your current location’s Custom Values and the final value cannot duplicate an existing swatch. Check that the custom value exists in your account.

**Q: Why do new pages look different from older pages?**Page Builder defaults (fonts, placeholders, and default palette colors) can be updated for newer designs. Your Brand Board or saved templates ensure consistent styling across pages.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Use Brand Boards in Funnels & Websites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003231)
- [Sites Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001633)
- [Getting Started - Launch A Funnel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005057)
- [How to Create a Brand Board](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003136)

Meta Campaign Budget Optimizer gives you more flexibility in deciding **where and how you want to manage your Meta campaign budget**.

You can choose to:

- Set one budget for the entire campaign, or
- Manage budgets separately for each ad set.

If you choose to manage budgets at the ad set level, you can also allow Meta to shift up to 20% of the budget between eligible ad sets based on performance.

---

## **TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Meta Campaign Budget Optimiser?](#What-is-Meta-Campaign-Budget-Optimiser?)
  - [Campaign budget](#Campaign-budget)
  - [Ad set budget](#Ad-set-budget)
- [How to choose your budget setup](#How-to-choose-your-budget-setup)

  - [Daily budget](#Daily-budget)
  - [Lifetime budget](#Lifetime-budget)
- [Using Ad set budget](#Using-Ad-set-budget)
- [Sharing budget between ad sets](#Sharing-budget-between-ad-sets)
