title_en: Workflow Triggers- Abandoned Checkout Trigger for E-commerce Stores
source_md:
Boost your revenue recovery with HighLevel’s new Abandoned Checkout workflow trigger a single, unified trigger that detects carts abandoned in your HighLevel store or an external platform like Shopify and lets you automate perfectly-timed follow-ups.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Abandoned Checkout Trigger?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-the-Abandoned-Checkout-Trigger?)
- [Key Benefits of the Abandoned Checkout Trigger](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Abandoned-Checkout-Trigger)
- [Shopify Abandoned Cart Trigger (Deprecating Soon)](#Shopify-Abandoned-Cart-Trigger-(Deprecating-Soon))
- [How To Set Up the Abandoned Checkout Trigger](#How-To-Set-Up-the-Abandoned-Checkout-Trigger)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Abandoned Checkout Trigger?**

The Abandoned Checkout trigger fires when a shopper adds items to the cart, enters a valid email address, but doesn’t finish paying within the “abandonment window” you define. It works for both native HighLevel Ecommerce Stores and connected external stores (e.g., Shopify), giving you one consistent automation entry-point for all recovery campaigns.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Abandoned Checkout Trigger**

Automate recovery while focusing on sales:

- **Unified across platforms:**No need to juggle separate Shopify-only or HighLevel-only triggers.

- **Smarter segmentation:**Filter by cart value, country, products, and order source for laser-focused messaging.

- **Flexible timing:**Decide exactly how many minutes must pass before a cart is considered abandoned, preventing premature or late reminders.

- **Scalable:**Future-proofed to support additional external platforms as they’re added.

- **Higher conversions:**Timely, personalized nudges routinely reclaim 10-30 % of would-be lost orders.

---

## **Shopify Abandoned Cart Trigger (Deprecating Soon)**

The legacy “Shopify Abandoned Cart” trigger has been renamed “Shopify Abandoned Cart (Deprecating Soon).” Existing workflows keep working, but all new recovery automations should use the Ecommerce Stores → Abandoned Checkout trigger for maximum flexibility and future support.

---

## **How To Set Up the Abandoned Checkout Trigger**

Follow these steps to start recovering lost sales right away.

### **Create Workflow**

Navigate to **Automation → Workflows** from the left sidebar to open the Workflow List page. Click the **+ Create Workflow** button in the top-right corner and select **Start from Scratch** to begin building a new automation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065195915/original/tdy3e4NbCZ584LIN6NJmIG7cHvtPmWsVsw.png?1771428330)

### **Add Trigger**

Inside the workflow builder, click **Add Trigger** to define the event that will start the automation. This opens the trigger selection panel where you can choose the workflow entry condition.

### 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065196031/original/3BJIFYPNjfB9Ll1Itz9c751h4lwdI87gjw.png?1771428393)

### 

### **Select Abandoned Checkout**

In the trigger list, scroll to the **Ecommerce Stores** section and select **Abandoned Checkout**. This ensures the workflow activates when a customer leaves the checkout process without completing their purchase.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065196084/original/JRvULGxCjpWkqOFEeQ-NFc70AjjryXfhkA.png?1771428419)

### **Name Trigger**

Confirm that **Abandoned Checkout** is selected under *Choose a Workflow Trigger* and review the **Workflow Trigger Name** field. You can keep the default name or customize it for easier identification if managing multiple triggers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065196145/original/tkKYgeW0SCNxjIJeoGsJIoS6Wkqoya19dQ.png?1771428463)

### 

### **Configure Filters**

Set the **Duration (in mins)** to define how long the system should wait before marking the checkout as abandoned. Use the **Select** dropdown under Filters to refine the trigger further with conditions such as Cart Value, Country, Global Products, Order Source, Store Name, or Sub Source.

- **Duration (minutes):** Choose the exact wait time before a cart counts as abandoned.

- **Cart Value:** Set minimum, maximum, or range-based amounts to trigger only high-value (or low-value) carts.

- **Country:** Limit automation to shoppers in specific locations, ideal for localized shipping or tax rules.

- **Global Products:** Select the product you want to use for the trigger. To filter by inventory, select a single **Price**, then select **Available Quantity** and configure the required condition and numeric value.

- **Order Source:**Pick Store (HighLevel) or External.

- **Sub-Source:** Appears when Order Source = External; choose Shopify today, with more platforms coming soon.

**Price and Available Quantity as custom values:** When the trigger provides the required product context, you can use **Price** and **Available Quantity** as custom values in supported workflow actions.

```
Note:  Price and Available Quantity are not currently supported in If/Else conditions.
```

  

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065196234/original/H9TWKcHW3B-407c7U7fQAxmJTS5iemjhZA.png?1771428503)

### **Using Conditional Branch (Optiona**

This example demonstrates how a **Condition** action can be added after the Abandoned Checkout trigger to further segment contacts before sending recovery messages. In this sample setup, filters such as **Cart Value**, **Order Source**, and **Sub Source** are used to control which abandoned checkouts move down a specific branch, helping you tailor follow-ups based on cart details or store origin rather than sending the same message to every contact.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065197722/original/ymqt67As61I__Riv0FhuaWDf2q8qdPSKmA.png?1771429298)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does the trigger work if the shopper never enters an email?**

No. An email address is required to mark the checkout as abandoned and start the workflow.

**Q: What’s the best abandonment window to use?**

Fast-moving, low-ticket stores usually choose 15-30 minutes; high-ticket or build-to-order products often extend to several hours. Test different windows to see what converts best.

**Q: Can I vary the follow-up message by cart value?**

Yes. Use the Cart Value filter or an If/Else step after the trigger to send different incentives to high- vs. low-value carts.

**Q: Will my existing Shopify Abandoned Cart workflows break?**

No. They continue to function, but we recommend migrating to the new trigger for future-proofing.

**Q: Can I trigger based on specific products only?**

Absolutely use the Global Products filter to select one or more SKUs.

**Q: How do I include dynamic cart items in my reminder email?**

Use the Shopping Cart element in the Email Builder to automatically list the abandoned products.

**Q: Is SMS supported for external (Shopify) stores?**

Yes. Once the trigger fires, you can add any workflow action email, SMS, call, task, etc. regardless of store type.

**Q: What analytics are available for abandoned-cart recovery?**

Check the Workflow “Analytics” tab for sent/open/click stats and saved revenue, and the Payments → Orders screen for recovered orders.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Recover Lost Sales with Automatic Abandoned Checkout Emails](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000001718?portalId=48000045315)
- [Workflow Trigger – Abandoned Checkout (Shopify legacy)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000002618?portalId=48000045315)
- [Shopping Cart Element in Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000006831?portalId=48000045315)
- [Workflow Action – Wait](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000002470?portalId=48000045315)
- [Workflow Action – Go To](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/48001196760?portalId=48000045315)

title_en: Workflow Trigger - Order Submitted
source_md:
The Order Submitted trigger is a powerful new workflow trigger that allows businesses to upsell customers after they have submitted an order. This trigger works with both 1 Step and 2-Step order forms, giving businesses the flexibility to customize their upsells based on the type of order form used or types of products purchased.

#### **Covered in this Article:**

#### [When does the Order Submitted trigger fire?](#When-does-the-Order-Submitted-trigger-fire?)

#### [How is it different from the Order Form Submitted Workflow Trigger?](#How-is-it-different-from-the-Order-Form-Submitted-Workflow-Trigger?)

#### [Using an Email Template to send an Order Confirmation via this Workflow](#Using-an-Email-Template-to-send-an-Order-Confirmation-via-this-Workflow)

#### [How do submission types filters work?](#How-do-submission-types-filters-work?%C2%A0)

#### [Will this trigger impact existing Order form submission triggers?](#Will-this-trigger-impact-existing-Order-form-submission-triggers?)

#### [What are the filter types, if/else conditions, and custom values I can use?](#What-are-the-filter-types,-if/else-conditions,-and-custom-values-I-can-use?)

---

## **When does the Order Submitted trigger fire?**

**Please Note**

```
Make sure that the Allow Multiple Setting is toggled on in the Workflow Settings if you want it to fire off for the same contact for an Upsell, right after it fires off for them for a Primary Product's purchase.

If you put in a wait step which holds the first instance (which came from the purchase of the primary product) of the customer in the workflow, and they go ahead and purchase the upsell, since they would still be held inside the workflow, the Upsell purchase will not let them enter the workflow a second time. Try to avoid using wait steps in this workflow, feel free to use them if you do not plan on selling Upsells or Bumps for the same product.
```

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/03105bba5cc64a4b8aec9e9e4ac9a88a)

---

The trigger runs upon a 1-Step or 2-Step order form submission and upsells. This trigger runs both when an order form is submitted, and again when an upsell purchase occurs; on either of these occasions it holds the product information. This means that if the end customer purchases products A and B on an order form and product C on an upsell, it will run two times (first for A and B purchase, and then for the upsell purchase)

**Please note:**

```
This only works with version 2 funnels. (Check out this article for more details on V2 Funnels) If you are using a version 1 funnel, please upgrade to version 2 using the button shown below:
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48271898507/original/Jt_bZs48_YpDTe855zfIKEv09u7ptooXnA.png?1672223754)
```

---

## **How is it different from the Order Form Submitted Workflow Trigger?**

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/ce4e9483f7c7496cb8765613254bd689)

---

The following are the most significant differences between the Order Submitted and the Order Form Submitted Workflow Triggers:

- The trigger does not run multiple times on multiple product purchases. The trigger contains a single checkout object sending info only a single time upon an order form submission, Even if that one order session consists of buying multiple products.
- Ability to filter the trigger directly on the basis of the global product/price. The existing trigger does not provide this functionality

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48271902305/original/HkW1R_dgtia5VEH8lw5XtAJoMKdamm2xog.png?1672224456)

- Ability to use order-related custom values inside the workflow. This contains custom values related to customers, order details, coupon information, and payment gateway

**Please Note:**

```
These Custom values will not show up in the custom values drop down unless the Order Submitted Trigger is one of the workflow trigger steps.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48271903161/original/GfNiNTpIzmqHoleW7RVRvGJKHUBrcM8vow.png?1672224689)

- Use conditions related to order details or product details in the If branches to direct the workflow based on the cart value/products purchased/funnel

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48271903365/original/Fy-l-g5na5xvLpx26kk97KGSVej6hjghwA.png?1672224749)

---

## **Using an Email Template to send an Order Confirmation via this Workflow**

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/d63c77963e294cffbaa4258c3501924e)

---

The products purchased by a client can be populated using the Shopping Cart element on an email builder template and using that specific template to send out a confirmation email to the end customer. The Shopping Cart element will auto-populate the product line items along with the purchased quantities, product images, and line item prices.

**Please Note:**

```
The Shopping Cart element will also populate the product images added in the Payments ➝ Products page. In case no image is added for the product, the element will populate the default image on its own. It is highly recommended to use custom product images while making use of the shopping cart element to avoid any default system-generated images.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48271904923/original/uMFRmaT5jF11XlibbTZhrwlAA9Slk44k0w.png?1672225164)

All you would need to make sure is that the **Shopping cart** element is added to Template, and the same template is added to the workflow in the **Send Email** action for the values to populate properly.

---

## **How do submission types filters work?**

**Primary** - Filters if any primary product is purchased at the checkout on the order form.

**Bump**- Filters only if a bump product has been purchased on the order form. The trigger would not work if no bump product has been purchased

**Upsell**- Filters only in case of upsell purchases. If the filter is set to upsell, the trigger would not run on an order form submission (purchase of a primary/bump product)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48271933980/original/qbQT79u8jkDAXIjo053ldP95IVhs9kG4kw.png?1672231859)

---

## **Will this trigger impact existing Order form submission triggers?**

No, this should not make any changes to an existing order form submission trigger. However, we recommend using the Order submitted trigger to make use of the order-related custom values along with coupon information and product line items.

---

## **What are the filter types, if/else conditions, and custom values I can use?**

title_en: AI Preflight Checks for HighLevel Marketplace App Listings
source_md:
AI-powered preflight checks in the HighLevel Developer Marketplace help developers identify policy violations, resolve white-label compliance issues, and improve app listing content before submission. Automated checks provide real-time feedback on listing details, while built-in AI tools help generate or improve taglines and descriptions. This helps reduce preventable rejections and streamline the Marketplace review process.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are AI-Powered Preflight Checks in the Developer Marketplace?](#What-Are-AI-Powered-Preflight-Checks-in-the-Developer-Marketplace?)
- [Key Benefits of AI-Powered Preflight Checks](#Key-Benefits-of-AI-Powered-Preflight-Checks)
- [AI Preflight Validation](#AI-Preflight-Validation)
- [White-Label Compliance Detection](#White-Label-Compliance-Detection)
- [AI Content Enhancements](#AI-Content-Enhancements)
- [How to Use AI-Powered Preflight Checks](#How-to-Use-AI-Powered-Preflight-Checks)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Are AI-Powered Preflight Checks in the Developer Marketplace?**

AI-powered preflight checks automatically review Marketplace app listings for potential policy and branding violations during listing creation. They help developers identify issues early and make corrections before submitting their apps for review.

The feature checks app names, taglines, descriptions, logos, and preview images. When a potential issue is found, 

developers receive a notification with guidance on how to resolve it.

---

## **Key Benefits of AI-Powered Preflight Checks**

AI-powered preflight checks make it easier to prepare compliant, high-quality Marketplace listings while reducing the need for repeated corrections.

- **Early Issue Detection:** Identify potential compliance violations before submitting an app.
- **White-Label Compliance:** Detect restricted branding references and receive correction guidance.
- **AI Content Assistance:** Generate or improve app taglines and descriptions.
- **Real-Time Feedback:** Receive notifications when potential issues are detected.
- **Fewer Rejections:** Reduce preventable submission errors.
- **Faster Review Preparation:** Prepare more complete, review-ready listings.

---

## **AI Preflight Validation**

AI Preflight Validation automatically scans supported listing content to identify potential policy violations before submission.

The validation covers:

| Listing Element | Validation |
| --- | --- |
| App Name | Checks for potential policy and branding issues. |
| Tagline | Reviews short app descriptions for compliance. |
| Description | Identifies potentially noncompliant content. |
| Logo | Checks for potential visual policy violations. |
| Preview Images | Reviews uploaded images for compliance concerns. |

Validation runs in the background during listing creation. When an issue is detected, the system displays a notification with suggested corrections.

---

## **White-Label Compliance Detection**

White-label Marketplace listings must follow specific branding requirements. AI-powered checks help developers identify restricted references that could cause compliance issues.

The system can detect references such as:

- HighLevel
- GoHighLevel
- GHL

If a restricted reference is detected, developers receive feedback explaining the issue and how to correct it. For example, a flagged tagline can be revised to use brand-neutral wording while accurately describing the app.

For more information, see [Configure Marketplace App Listing Type](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001559-configure-marketplace-app-listing-type).

---

## **AI Content Enhancements**

AI Content Enhancements help developers create clear, informative Marketplace listings without manually drafting every detail. The built-in AI tools support:

- **Tagline Generation:** Create short descriptions that highlight an app's purpose.
- **Tagline Improvement:** Refine existing wording for clarity.
- **Description Generation:** Generate informative app descriptions.
- **Description Improvement:** Improve existing descriptions to communicate features and benefits more effectively.

Developers should review AI-generated content for accuracy and compliance before submission.

---

## **How to Use AI-Powered Preflight Checks**

Preflight checks work during Marketplace listing creation, helping developers identify issues, make corrections, and improve content before submitting their apps.

**Step 1: Open Your Marketplace App**

1. Visit the [HighLevel Developer Marketplace](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/).
2. Sign in and navigate to **My Apps**.
3. Select an existing app or click **Create App**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084961276/original/HwN79637nmsJ9pVmT2JzpFzcjBTkew-5Nw.png?1793806034)

**Step 2: Complete Your App Listing**

1. Open the app listing configuration.
2. Enter the app name, tagline, and description.
3. Upload the app logo and preview images.
4. Review the applicable listing and branding requirements.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084961955/original/5VJLZmK7akNRIJgzgrypo9yk4HmameJfug.png?1793806351)

AI-powered checks run in the background as you create the listing.

**Step 3: Review and Resolve Compliance Warnings|**

1. Review any AI preflight notifications that appear.
2. Identify the flagged text or image.
3. Follow the suggested guidance to correct the issue.
4. Review your updated listing for additional compliance concerns.

**Step 4: Improve Listing Content with AI**

1. Locate the AI enhancement option for the tagline or description.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084961677/original/OYwflGOPe0XOKE83YsfjNgTun0tZXGLcHw.png?1793806214)

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084962044/original/-yYGqrmdUpFBNMd-QEr__1qnYTIAQcFiDA.png?1793806409)
2. Generate new content or improve existing text.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084961852/original/qUaO_Svw0kSRuXPZsa-F0jDnG6apQZW60g.png?1793806297)
3. Review the AI-generated suggestion.
4. Apply the content using the available editor controls.

**Step 5: Review and Submit Your App**

Before submission, verify that:

- All listing details are accurate and complete.
- Branding and compliance issues have been addressed.
- Logos and preview images are appropriate.
- AI-generated content has been reviewed.

Once ready, proceed with the Marketplace submission process.

```
Note: Passing AI preflight checks does not guarantee Marketplace approval. Apps remain subject to the applicable review process.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do AI preflight checks guarantee Marketplace approval?**

No. They help identify potential issues before submission but do not replace Marketplace review.

**Q: Are preflight checks automatic?**

Yes. Validation runs in the background during listing creation.

**Q: Does preflight validation check images?**

Yes. App logos and preview images are included in the validation process.

**Q: Can AI improve an existing tagline or description?**

Yes. AI Content Enhancements can generate new content or improve existing listing text.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Get Started with the Developer's Marketplace](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000136-how-to-get-started-with-the-developer-s-marketplace)
- [Configure Marketplace App Listing Type](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001559-configure-marketplace-app-listing-type)
- [Selling Snapshots on the App Marketplace](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003709-selling-snapshots-on-the-app-marketplace)
- [How to Manage Developer Users and Permissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002458-how-to-manage-developer-users-and-permissions)

title_en: Expanded Contact Field Support in Conversation AI
source_md:
The Add Contact Info action in HighLevel's Conversation AI now supports additional custom field types, including Radio Select, Checkbox, single-select and multi-select Dropdowns, and Phone, along with standard fields such as Contact Source and Contact Type. Conversation AI can recognize natural-language responses and match them to predefined field options, including multiple selections. This expanded support helps businesses automatically capture customer preferences, lead qualification details, and other important information directly in contact records.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Expanded Contact Field Support in Conversation AI?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-the-Expanded-Contact-Field-Support-in-Conversation-AI?)
- [Supported Contact Field Types](#Supported-Contact-Field-Types)
  - [Supported Custom Field Types](#Supported-Custom-Field-Types)
  - [Supported Standard Contact Fields](#Supported-Standard-Contact-Fields)
- [How Conversation AI Matches Customer Responses to Field Options](#How-Conversation-AI-Matches-Customer-Responses-to-Field-Options)
- [How to Set Up the Add Contact Info Action](#How-to-Set-Up-the-Add-Contact-Info-Action)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Expanded Contact Field Support in Conversation AI?**

Expanded contact field support allows prompt-based Conversation AI agents in Auto-Pilot mode to collect customer information using additional field types through the existing Add Contact Info action. For fields with predefined options, the agent interprets customer responses and saves the matching values, allowing customers to answer naturally without using the exact option names.

---

## **Supported Contact Field Types**

Different contact field types allow businesses to collect and organize customer information in different ways. Single-selection fields store one choice, while multiple-selection fields can store several choices. Conversation AI also supports fields for text, numbers, dates, times, and phone information.

### **Supported Custom Field Types**

| Field Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Radio Select | Saves one matching option from a predefined list. | Travel Class: Business |
| Checkbox | Saves one or multiple matching selections. | Dietary Preferences: Vegetarian, Gluten-free |
| Dropdown (single) | Saves one matching option from the dropdown list. | Preferred Color: Blue |
| Dropdown (multiple) | Saves multiple matching options from the dropdown list. | Interested Services: Consulting, Training |
| Phone | Captures phone information in a supported custom Phone field. | Alternate Contact Number |

### **Supported Standard Contact Fields**

Conversation AI can also update the following standard contact fields through the Add Contact Info action:

- Contact Source: Records where the contact came from.
- Contact Type: Records the contact's type or classification.

---

## **How Conversation AI Matches Customer Responses to Field Options**

Conversation AI can recognize customer responses and match them to the available options in a contact field. Customers do not need to use the exact wording of an option. Depending on the field type, the agent can save one or multiple matching values.

| Field Type | How It Works | Example Customer Response | Saved Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Radio Select | Matches the response to one available option. | "Business class please" | Business |
| Checkbox | Recognizes and saves multiple matching options. | "I'm vegetarian and gluten free" | Vegetarian, Gluten-free |
| Dropdown (single) | Matches the response to one option from the dropdown list. | "I'd like blue" | Blue |
| Dropdown (multiple) | Recognizes and saves multiple matching dropdown options. | "I'm interested in consulting and training" | Consulting, Training |
| Phone | Captures the customer's phone number in a custom Phone field. | "My alternate number is 415-555-0123" | 415-555-0123 |

```
Note: Conversation AI only saves matching values for fields with predefined options. Fields configured to allow custom values can accept additional entries. If you update the available options under Settings > Custom Fields, Conversation AI uses the updated list starting with the next customer message.
```

---

## **How to Set Up the Add Contact Info Action**

Configuring the Add Contact Info action allows Conversation AI to collect customer information and save it to the appropriate contact fields. Selecting the correct fields and providing clear prompt instructions helps the agent capture customer responses accurately.

1. Go to AI Agents > Conversation AI > Agents List and open your prompt-based agent.
2. Under Bot Goals > Setup your Actions, select Contact Info.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083907279/original/1TTLGzsa60XJDKT3G5dieMp0hN1GLm5ctw.png?1792614552)
3. Enter an Action name and choose Which contact field to be updated.
4. For fields with predefined options, review Values the Conversation AI can update to confirm the available choices.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083907200/original/bPViVCkrow2uXnunniFZYNLzf9SfL7YBUQ.png?1792614361)
5. To collect additional information, select Add new field and configure the additional fields. Click Save.
6. Update the agent's prompt with instructions to ask customers for the information you want to collect.
7. Test the agent and confirm that customer responses are saved to the correct fields in the contact record.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083907220/original/BUNHfEqBL0rHUtAYLg-wQl2bJSccgQ6CXg.png?1792614417)

```
Important: Adding a Contact Info action does not automatically tell the agent to ask the corresponding questions. Include clear instructions in the agent's prompt to collect the required information.  
For additional guidance, see How to Configure Bot Goals in Conversation AI.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can Conversation AI save multiple values from a single customer response?**

Yes. Checkbox and multi-select Dropdown fields support multiple selections. For example, if a customer says, "I'm vegetarian and gluten free," Conversation AI can save both Vegetarian and Gluten-free when these options are available.

**Q: What happens if a customer's response doesn't match an available option?**

If a field only allows predefined options, Conversation AI will not save a value that doesn't match any of them. If the field allows custom options, the agent can save additional values.

**Q: Can Conversation AI change information already saved in a contact field?**

No. The Add Contact Info action only updates empty fields. It will not replace existing contact information.

**Q: Why wasn't a customer's response saved to the contact record?**

A response may not be saved if the field already contains a value, the answer doesn't match an available option, or the wrong field is selected in the action. Also, check that the agent's prompt includes instructions to collect the information and that you're using a prompt-based agent in Auto-Pilot mode.

---

title_en: Conversations AI Bots can now Respond to Audio
source_md:
Give customers the option to speak instead of type. HighLevel’s Conversations AI understands voice notes and audio files across WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and SMS/MMS. The bot transcribes speech to text and replies intelligently using your existing training and settings, keeping conversations fast and natural. This article covers supported audio types, channel compatibility, setup, and troubleshooting.

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/9z1oFO5o4gA?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Audio Response in Conversations AI?](#What-is-Audio-Response-in-Conversations-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Audio Response](#Key-Benefits-of-Audio-Response)
- [Supported Audio Types](#Supported-Audio-Types)
- [Channel Compatibility](#Channel-Compatibility)
- [How To Set Up Audio Response](#How-To-Set-Up-Audio-Response)
- [Behavior & Limitations](#Behavior-&-Limitations%C2%A0)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Audio Response in Conversations AI?**

Audio Response lets your HighLevel Conversations AI bot “hear” customers. When a contact sends a voice note or audio file, HighLevel transcribes the audio to text, passes it to your bot, and returns an intelligent, context-aware reply so customers can speak naturally without typing.

Conversations AI now supports inbound audio across popular messaging channels. Transcription happens behind the scenes, and the bot follows your existing bot settings (training, prompts, response mode, and timing) for consistent results.

**What Audio Response Can Do**

With Audio Response enabled, your Conversation AI can:

- Receive voice notes and audio attachments
- Automatically transcribe speech into text
- Process audio content using your existing AI training
- Generate intelligent, context-aware responses
- Handle multiple audio files within a single interaction
- Work across supported messaging channels

**Prerequisites**

Before using Audio Response, ensure:

- Conversation AI is enabled for your Sub-Account
- At least one AI Agent is configured
- Supported messaging channels are connected
- The AI Agent is assigned to the desired communication channels

---

## **Key Benefits of Audio Response**

These advantages focus on customer experience and operator efficiency, tying audio inputs directly into how your bot already works.

- **Natural conversations:** Contacts can speak naturally instead of typing long messages.
- **Faster Customer Responses:** Audio messages are automatically converted into text and processed immediately.
- **Multi-audio intake:** Customers can send one or multiple audio files; your bot processes them as a single interaction.
- **Omnichannel reach:** Works with WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and SMS/MMS for one consistent workflow.
- **Consistent governance:** Audio replies respect your Wait Time and message-limit settings, just like text.

---

## **Supported Audio Types**

Acceptable formats determine which files the bot can transcribe reliably.

| Category | Supported items | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Voice notes (platform-native)** | WhatsApp Voice Notes, Facebook Voice Notes, Instagram Voice Notes | Recorded using each app’s mic button; delivered to HighLevel as audio objects the bot can transcribe. |
| **File formats (uploads/attachments)** | OGG, MP3, **MP4 (audio-only)**, AAC, M4A, MPEG | Ensure the file is audio-only. Video MP4s aren’t supported as audio inputs. |
| **Multi-audio in one interaction** | **Supported** (multiple files) | Multiple audio files sent close together are handled in a single interaction. |

---

## **Channel Compatibility**

Audio Response plugs into channels where Conversations AI already operates. Ensure each channel is properly connected in HighLevel before expecting audio replies.

- **Facebook Messenger**
- **Instagram Direct Messages**
- **WhatsApp**
- **SMS (MMS)**

---

## **How To Set Up Audio Response**

Proper setup ensures audio messages are transcribed and handled by the right bot on the right channels.

1. **From your Sub-Account, go to AI Agents → Conversation AI → Agent List, then click the three dots (⋮) next to the bot you want to configure and select Edit to open the bot’s settings.**  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055792623/original/GeVER88sjur3v_MG4l6pf89rG8t4ppbmJg.png?1760261682)**
2. **Enable Audio Responses**  
   Toggle **“Also allow this bot to respond to: Voice Notes.”**and Save Your Changes  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055792681/original/zbYz6Ja-1saNdWYH81ulILXZAEYeeNanhA.png?1760261903)**
3. **T****est on a Connected Channel**  
   Send a Voice note from WhatsApp or a social channel to confirm the reply references the image.  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055792764/original/sDRqxAQ5Z0H9_YXyMl0InCMNe_bIzTAEKg.png?1760262151)**  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055792792/original/mx4b4af8F44RlmUvmGvVCE0wP2TaJ_KAUw.png?1760262250)**

---

## **Behavior & Limitations**

Understanding timing and message handling helps you design the right experience for audio-first customers.

- **Wait Time aggregation:** Your bot waits the configured **Wait Time Before Responding** so it can collect multiple inbound messages (including audio + text) and send **one** unified reply.
- **Message limit:** The bot follows your **Maximum Message Limit**; if reached, the bot sleeps until reset per your standard flow.
- **Transcripts & transparency:** You can review AI details—including prompts, sources, and response info—from the **AI Response Info** sidebar in Conversations.
- **Channel policies:** Delivery on Meta channels must comply with policy windows (e.g., 24-hour window for Messenger/Instagram). Plan flows accordingly.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does Audio Response cost extra?**  
Usage is billed under standard **Conversations AI** usage and your channel’s messaging fees (e.g., SMS/MMS, WhatsApp). Agencies can configure rebilling for Conversation AI usage. See **Pricing & Rebilling** and **SMS/MMS costs**; WhatsApp has separate pricing.

**Q: Will the bot reply with audio or text?**  
Bots send standard channel messages for maximum compatibility. Most replies are text; design flows accordingly.

**Q: Can I restrict audio handling to specific channels?**  
Assign only the channels you want the bot to use in **Bot Settings**. The bot will listen/respond only on assigned channels.

**Q: How are multiple audio files handled?**  
Multiple audios in a short window are transcribed and handled during your **Wait Time** window so the bot can craft a single, context-aware reply.

**Q: Where do I review what the bot “saw” and why it responded that way?**  
Open the **AI Response Info** sidebar in the conversation to review the response, prompt, and training sources.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Setting Up Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004401-setting-up-conversation-ai)
- [Advanced Settings Overview – Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004415-advanced-settings-overview-conversation-ai)
- [View & Edit AI Response Info in Conversations](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004183-view-edit-ai-response-info-in-conversations)
- [Getting Started – Setup Facebook & Instagram Messenger](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005068-getting-started-setup-facebook-and-instagram-messenger)
- [How to Set Up WhatsApp for a Sub-Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001980-how-to-set-up-whatsapp-for-a-sub-account)
- [Pricing & Rebilling – Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001357-pricing-and-rebilling-conversation-ai)

title_en: Voice AI: Edit Prompts with AI
source_md:
Edit Prompts with AI helps you quickly refine Voice AI Agent prompts in HighLevel without rewriting large sections manually. Use this feature to improve selected prompt text, make instructions clearer, adjust tone, or expand guidance for specific call scenarios. AI-generated edits are suggestions, so you can review each change before accepting it.

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/h28awpjwfGY?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Edit Prompts with AI for Voice AI?](#What-is-Edit-Prompts-with-AI-for-Voice-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Edit Prompts with AI for Voice AI](#Key-Benefits-of-Edit-Prompts-with-AI-for-Voice-AI)
- [When To Use Edit Prompts with AI](#When-To-Use-Edit-Prompts-with-AI)
- [Permissions & Availability](#Permissions-&-Availability)
- [How to Edit and Refine Voice AI Prompts Using AI](#How-to-Edit-and-Refine-Voice-AI-Prompts-Using-AI)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Edit Prompts with AI for Voice AI?**

Edit Prompts with AI is a Voice AI prompt editor feature that allows you to highlight selected text inside a Voice AI Agent prompt and ask AI to improve it. The AI can rewrite, simplify, expand, or adjust the selected text based on your instruction.

This feature is best for focused prompt improvements inside an existing Voice AI Agent. It does not replace full agent setup, prompt evaluation, call testing, or reviewing agent logs after real interactions.

---

## **Key Benefits of Edit Prompts with AI for Voice AI**

AI-assisted prompt editing helps teams improve agent instructions faster while still keeping control over what changes are saved. This makes it easier to refine call behavior, improve clarity, and update prompts without starting from scratch.

- **Edit specific prompt sections:** Highlight only the text you want to improve instead of rewriting the full prompt.
- **Refine prompts with AI instructions:** Tell AI exactly what to improve, such as clarity, tone, or tool-trigger behavior.
- **Iterate before finalizing:** Run additional refinements until the updated version matches your goal.
- **Review changes clearly:** Compare what was added, removed, or kept before applying the new text.
- **Use voice input for instructions:** Speak your improvement request with the microphone option instead of typing. Chrome browser support is currently required for microphone input.

---

## **When To Use Edit Prompts with AI**

Edit Prompts with AI works best when you already know which part of the prompt needs improvement. Selecting a focused section gives AI clearer context and helps prevent broad changes that could affect unrelated agent behavior.

Use Edit Prompts with AI when you need to:

- Make prompt instructions clearer or easier to follow.
- Simplify long or repetitive prompt sections.
- Expand short instructions into more complete guidance.
- Adjust the agent’s tone, personality, or conversational style.
- Improve how the agent handles objections, booking, transfers, fallback responses, or qualification questions.
- Refine prompt text after using Prompt Evaluator or Prompt Optimizer.
- Improve prompt wording after reviewing test calls or call logs.

Edit Prompts with AI is different from other Voice AI prompt tools:

- **Prompt Evaluator:** Reviews the overall prompt and identifies improvement opportunities.
- **Edit Prompts with AI:** Rewrites or refines selected prompt text based on your instruction.
- **Prompt Optimizer:** Uses scenario-based testing and results to suggest prompt improvements.

---

## **Permissions & Availability**

Access to prompt editing depends on the user’s Voice AI permissions and the account’s feature availability. Confirming access before editing helps prevent missing editor options or changes that cannot be saved.

To use Edit Prompts with AI:

- The user must have access to Voice AI Agent settings.
- The user must be able to edit the selected Voice AI Agent or prompt.
- The feature must be available in the Voice AI prompt editor.
- Microphone input may require Chrome and browser microphone permissions.
- Use typed instructions if microphone input is unavailable.

---

## **How to Edit and Refine Voice AI Prompts Using AI**

Edit with AI helps you improve selected prompt text faster while keeping you in control of the final result. You can highlight a section, describe what you want to improve, review the suggested changes, and then choose whether to accept, discard, or refine the update again.

```
Tip: Review custom variables, logic rules, and tool instructions carefully before accepting any changes.
```

1. Go to **AI Agents > Voice AI** and open your Voice AI agent.  
  
![](https://jumpshare.com/share/BPxRAAjro9uu51ZVuzR1+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-19+at+14.15.29.png)

2, [Create a Voice AI Agent](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004107) or **edit** an **existing** one.  
  
![](https://jumpshare.com/share/gxIHH6NTLTBltNoz8hkC+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-19+at+14.18.27.png)

3. In **Agent Goals**, navigate to the **Prompt** editor.  
  
![](https://jumpshare.com/share/XDQzy0eCLqJNb5J1a1Iw+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-19+at+14.20.34.png)

4. Highlight the part of the prompt you want to improve.

5. Click **Edit with AI**.

6. Enter a short instruction such as **Make this clearer**, **Simplify this section**, or **Improve tool-trigger instructions**.

7. To **speak** your **instruction** instead of typing it, click the **microphone** icon. (Microphone input is currently supported on **Chrome** **browsers**.)

8. Click the **send** **icon** to generate the update.

9. Review the generated changes, including highlighted additions and removals.

10. Click **Accept changes** to apply the update, **Discard** to keep the original text, or add another refinement to generate a new version.

11. Repeat as needed until the prompt section matches the behavior you want.  
  
![](https://jumpshare.com/share/U45Gw9zk9cfQrG7rmddt+/GIF+Recording+2026-03-19+at+14.25.38.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to rewrite the full prompt to use this feature?**

No. Edit with AI is designed to improve only the selected portion of the prompt.

**Q: Can I run multiple refinements on the same text?**  
Yes. You can continue refining the generated result until it matches the outcome you want.

**Q: Are changes applied automatically after AI generates them?**  
No. Review the generated changes first, then choose whether to accept or discard them.

**Q: Can I discard the AI suggestion and keep my original text?**  
Yes. Select **Discard** to reject the generated revision and keep the original prompt content.

**Q: What kinds of instructions work best?**  
Short, specific requests such as improving clarity, simplifying wording, strengthening rules, or optimizing tool-trigger behavior usually work best.

**Q: Can I use my voice instead of typing the instruction?**  
Yes. You can use the microphone option to speak your improvement request.

**Q: Does microphone input work in every browser?**  
Microphone input for this feature is currently supported on Chrome browsers.

**Q: Should I review custom variables before accepting changes?**  
Yes. If your selected prompt text contains custom variables, custom values, or important logic, review the revision carefully before applying it.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004107)
- [How to Use the Prompt Evaluator in Voice AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006074)
- [Exposed System Prompts for Voice AI Agents in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007215)
- [Voice AI Custom Variable Support in Prompt](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004690)
- [How to Upgrade Your Voice AI Agent for a Better Call Experience](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005556)

title_en: Pause Account Feature – Everything You Need to Know
source_md:
Temporarily stepping away from HighLevel does not have to mean rebuilding your account later. The Pause Account Plan lets you retain core account data and configurations for $27/month while access to the platform is paused.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Pause Account Feature](#What-is-the-Pause-Account-Feature)
  - [What Happens When You Pause Your Account](#What-Happens-When-You-Pause-Your-Account)
  - [What Is Preserved When Your Account Is Paused](#What-Is-Preserved-When-Your-Account-Is-Paused)
  - [What Is Not Included in the Pause Account Plan](#What-Is-Not-Included-in-the-Pause-Account-Plan)
  - [How to Pause Your Account](#How-to-Pause-Your-Account)
  - [How to Reactivate Your Paused Account](#How-to-Reactivate-Your-Paused-Account)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#%E2%80%8BFrequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Pause Account Feature**

The Pause Account Feature is designed for Agency users who temporarily do not need an active HighLevel subscription but want to preserve their core account setup and data. While the account is paused, Agency users and sub-accounts cannot actively access the platform, but supported data, settings, and configurations remain preserved for future reactivation. The Pause Account Plan costs $27 per month, and you can reactivate, change, or cancel the plan when needed.

Pausing is different from canceling your HighLevel subscription. A canceled account enters a 90-day data-retention period, after which the Agency account, sub-accounts, and associated data are permanently deleted if the account is not reactivated. The Pause Account Plan is intended for users who want to step away temporarily while retaining supported account data.

---

## **What Happens When You Pause Your Account**

During the pause period:

- You and your sub-accounts will not have active access to the platform.
- Your data, settings, and configurations will be securely preserved.
- You can reactivate, change, or cancel your plan anytime.

When you reactivate, all your progress will be restored so you can continue right where you left off.

---

## **What Is Preserved When Your Account Is Paused**

We retain your core business assets so your work remains intact.

#### 

| Category | What Is Preserved | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **CRM Assets** | Contacts, Conversations, Custom Objects, Tasks, Opportunities, Companies, Users | Core CRM data remains stored for reactivation |
| **Funnels** | Funnel configurations and settings | Published funnel pages are moved to Draft |
| **Automations** | Workflows and automation configurations | Published workflows are moved to Draft |
| **Calendars** | Calendar settings and configurations | Booking links are moved to Draft |
| **Client Portal** | Portal configuration settings | Client access is disabled during pause |
| **Email Builder** | Email templates and assets | Scheduled campaigns are moved to Draft |
| **Media Storage** | Images, videos, PDFs, documents, audio, and other uploads | All uploaded media remains stored |
| **Snapshots** | Saved snapshots and templates | Fully preserved for reuse |
| **Subscriptions (Records)** | Subscription records created via HighLevel checkouts | Does not include external subscription behavior |
| **Transactions** | Payment history and receipts | Includes imported and native transactions |
| **Products** | Product catalog, pricing, and variants | Fully preserved |
| **Orders** | Order records and related transaction data | Retained for reporting and history |
| **Coupons** | Active and expired coupon configurations | All coupon data remains stored |
| **Gift Cards** | Gift card products and order history | Fully preserved |
| **Payment Settings** | Taxes, receipts, notifications, and related settings | Configuration data remains intact |

---

## **What Is Not Included in the Pause Account Plan**

Some HighLevel services depend on active subscriptions, registrations, renewals, or external infrastructure and are not preserved in the same way as core account data. Reviewing these items before pausing can help you avoid unexpected service loss or additional setup after reactivation.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Category | What Happens During the Pause | What to Know |
| **Phone Numbers** | Phone numbers are deleted 14 days after the account enters Paused status | Deleted phone numbers may need to be obtained or configured again after reactivation |
| **A2P Registration** | A2P registrations are deleted 14 days after the account enters Paused status | Messaging registration may require additional setup after reactivation |
| **Reselling Subscriptions** | Reselling subscriptions are automatically canceled | You must resubscribe to affected services after reactivating the Agency account |
| **Marketplace Subscriptions** | Marketplace subscriptions are automatically canceled | Canceled subscriptions do not automatically resume after reactivation |
| **SaaS Subscriptions** | SaaS subscriptions are automatically canceled | Pausing the Agency account is different from pausing individual SaaS sub-accounts |
| **Domains** | Upcoming internal domain renewals fail while the account is paused | A domain that is not renewed can expire and may require recovery after reactivation |

---

## **How to Pause Your Account**

1. From **Agency View**, go to**Settings**> **Billing**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078171921/original/Hb4F-5zqfj1ihyJ936S8ESGHkm4x3ULVzg.png?1786476516)
2. Click **Want to Modify/Cancel Your Subscription?**  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078171912/original/iWahRdOsB_fFFyI0YZ0lqPSXTXk7LZ0soA.png?1786476488)**
3. Select the **Pause Account** option when presented.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078171946/original/6U1lvMCX19DBZwCrmjpItSxMOT_eFWNPKQ.png?1786476560)

---

## **How to Reactivate Your Paused Account**

Reactivating your account is simple and takes just a few minutes.

1. Go to the login page and sign in to your account.
2. You’ll be presented with a **Reactivate** **Account** screen.
3. Complete the payment process.
4. Your account will immediately move from Paused to Active status.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can my team or clients access HighLevel while the Agency account is paused?**

No. The Agency and its sub-accounts do not have active platform access while the account is paused. Client Portal access is also unavailable during this period.

**Q: Do my workflows continue running while my Agency account is paused?**

No. Published workflows and automations are moved to Draft when the account is paused. Their configurations remain preserved so they can be reviewed and republished after reactivation.

**Q: Do canceled Marketplace, reselling, or SaaS subscriptions restart automatically after reactivation?**

No. These subscriptions are automatically canceled when the Agency account is paused. You must resubscribe to any affected services you want to use after reactivation.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [What happens to your data when you cancel your HighLevel Subscription?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004281-what-happen-s-to-your-data-when-you-cancel-your-highlevel-subscription-)
- [Billing Related Questions for Agencies](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001208376-billing-related-questions-for-agencies)
- [How to Bulk Manage SaaS Sub-accounts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005270-how-to-bulk-manage-saas-sub-accounts)

Our analytics give you a clear, no‑fluff view of how forms and surveys perform over time. Track views, responses, completion rate, average time, and (for surveys) slide‑level views and drop‑off so you can spot friction and improve conversions fast.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview](#Overview)
- [Key Benefits](#Key-Benefits)
- [Available Filters and Metrics](#Available-Filters-and-Metrics)
- [How to Use the Analytics Dashboard](#How-to-Use-the-Analytics-Dashboard)
- [Survey Slide‑Level Metrics (Views & Drop‑Off)](#Survey-Slide%E2%80%91Level-Metrics-(Views-&-Drop%E2%80%91Off))
  - [How Drop‑Off is calculated](#How-Drop%E2%80%91Off-is-calculated)
  - [Why Drop‑Off can be negative](#Why-Drop%E2%80%91Off-can-be-negative)
  - [Troubleshooting Checklist for Negative Drop‑Off](#Troubleshooting-Checklist-for-Negative-Drop%E2%80%91Off)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Overview**

Analytics for Forms and Surveys provides both at‑a‑glance and deeper insights. From high‑level trends (views, responses, completion) to slide‑level drop‑off in surveys, you’ll see where people fall off and where they jump ahead—so you can fix issues and ship improvements with confidence.

---

## Key Benefits

- **See performance clearly:** Total views, responses, completion rate, and average completion time.
- **Compare over time:** Previous‑period comparison to confirm trends and spot anomalies.
- **Pinpoint friction:** Slide‑level drop‑off highlights where respondents abandon (or jump ahead).
- **Flexible filters:** Focus on a specific form/survey or review all assets over any date range.

---

## **Available Filters and Metrics**

Use filters to focus on the exact asset and timeframe you care about, then read the on-screen metrics to understand engagement, completions, and where users drop off. Pairing the right filters with the right metrics helps you pinpoint issues and validate improvements quickly.

**Filters**

- **Type:** Forms or Surveys (top‑left)
- **Asset:** All or a specific Form/Survey
- **Date Range:** Presets (Last 7/14/30/60/90 days) or Custom

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052527416/original/bl8empe2yMQZsemDRsJFJYQ2BLfCQKK1AA.png?1756316584)

**Metrics**

- **Total Views:** How many times the selected asset(s) were viewed in the chosen date range
- **Responses:** Completed submissions
- **Average Time:** Average completion time
- **Completion Rate:** % of responses vs views, with an automatic previous‑period comparison
- **Total Views chart:** Line chart to spot increases or declines
- **Per‑Asset Breakdown:** Table of Total Views per Form/Survey (shown when viewing **All** assets)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052527746/original/di80EXtVFGF-XYICuhUZt4VfgpcsecnxXA.png?1756317018)

- **Survey Views:**Only available for Surveys and only when a single survey is selected in the filter  
    
  - **Slide View:** The step within the survey metrics refer to
  - **Views:** How many respondents reached that slide
  - **Drop-Off:** How many exited on that slide (Count followed by the percentage). Use this to identify slides that should be improved and tested

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052527772/original/xclq74UfEKdj6YXZsfdpCfXzj6CTts8vQQ.png?1756317079)

---

## **How to Use the Analytics Dashboard**

1. **Navigate:** From the left menu, go to **Sites** → top navigation **Analytics**.
2. **Select Filters:** Choose **Type** (Forms/Surveys), pick an **Asset** (All or a specific one), and set a **Date Range**.
3. **Read the Data:** Review metric cards, charts, and (for a single survey) the slide‑level table.

> Tip: Switch the **Asset** to a single survey to see per‑slide **Views** and **Drop‑Off**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052528076/original/bWZbDSqaCacUQu47Cslrkv0LQhXOcYQ1Ag.png?1756317308)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052528442/original/HKkQCB5Dj44dYQPF5omH-COPaCmSs4USCg.png?1756317747)

#### 

## **Survey Slide‑Level Metrics (Views & Drop‑Off)**

When a **single survey** is selected, you’ll see a per‑slide table.

**Columns**

- **Slide** — step number/title
- **Views** — sessions that reached the slide
- **Drop‑Off** — change vs the previous slide (shown as a **count** and a **%**)

### **How Drop‑Off is calculated**

For slide **n** (where n > 1):

- **Drop‑Off (count)** = Views(n‑1) − Views(n)
- **Drop‑Off (%)** = Drop‑Off(count) ÷ Views(n‑1) × 100

Notes:

- Slide 1 has no prior slide → **Drop‑Off = N/A**
- **Positive** Drop‑Off = fewer people reached the current slide (a drop)
- **Negative** Drop‑Off = more people reached the current slide (a gain)

### **Why Drop‑Off can be negative**

Negative values mean the current slide had **more views** than the previous slide. Common causes:

- **Jump/skip logic** routes respondents past the previous slide
- **Legacy “move to slide based on option”** (radio/checkbox) skips slides
- **Slide re‑ordering** after data collection changes which slide counts as “previous”

**Quick example**

- Slide 1: 100 views
- Slide 2: 93 views → Drop‑Off = 100 − 93 = **7 (7%)**
- Slide 3: 98 views (5 jumped from 1 → 3) → Drop‑Off = 93 − 98 = **‑5 (‑5.4%)**

### **Troubleshooting Checklist for Negative Drop‑Off**

- **Check conditional logic:** Did you use jump/skip rules that route to this slide?
- **Check for legacy routing:** Using the older “move to slide based on radio/checkbox option” can skip slides.
- **Check slide order changes:** Did you reorder slides during the selected date range?
- **Align dates:** If you changed logic or slide order recently, ensure your date filter matches the timeframe you want to analyze.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How is the “previous period” comparison determined?**  
It compares your selected date range to the immediately preceding, equal-length period (e.g., Last 14 days vs the prior 14 days).

**Q: Why is the per-form/survey breakdown missing?**  
The per-form/survey breakdown appears only when viewing All forms/surveys. Selecting a single asset hides the aggregate breakdown.

**Q: I selected a survey but don’t see the per-slide analysis table. Why?**  
The slide analysis appears only when a single, specific survey is selected. If you’re on All surveys, switch the asset selector to the exact survey to view Slide, Views, Drop-off, and Drop-off rate.

**Q: What analytics types can I choose in the top-left dropdown?**  
You can select Forms or Surveys. The dropdown also includes other types (funnels, websites, QR codes, blogs)

**Q: The table says “Drop‑Off,” but I see negative numbers. What does that mean?**  
Negative Drop‑Off means the current slide had **more views** than the previous slide (a net gain). This often happens with jump/skip logic, legacy “move to slide based on option,” or after reordering slides.

**Q: Why don’t I see the slide table?**  
The slide table appears only when a **single survey** is selected. Switch the Asset filter from **All surveys** to a specific survey.

---
