title_en: In-App Banner Management
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/0D1kIGh3AQc?&wmode=opaque)

Quickly control which in‑app banners your clients see—and keep your interface on‑brand—using HighLevel’s Banner Management in Agency Settings. Use it to review, prioritize, and enable/disable banners across the agency and connected sub‑accounts so only the most relevant messages are shown.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Banner Management?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Banner-Management?)
- [Key Benefits of Banner Management](#Key-Benefits-of-Banner-Management)
- [Access & Permissions](#Access-&-Permissions)
- [Banner Status (Enable vs Disable)](#Banner-Status-(Enable-vs-Disable))
- [Dismissal & Reappearance](#Dismissal-&-Reappearance)
- [How To Setup Banner Management](#How-To-Setup-Banner-Management)
- [Best Practices](#Best-Practices)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is In-App Banner Management?**

Banner Management is a centralized control panel in Agency Settings for reviewing, ordering, and controlling the visibility of informational or promotional in‑app banners across your agency account and connected sub‑accounts.

Banner Management gives agency administrators a single place to decide which banners appear, where they appear, and how often they reappear. Centralizing this control helps reduce noise, preserve white‑label consistency, and surface time‑sensitive announcements in the right order.

---

## **Key Benefits of In-App Banner Management**

Understanding the benefits clarifies when to use banners versus other channels like emails or push notifications. These advantages focus on controlling visibility, brand consistency, and the user experience for agency staff and clients.

- **Client‑facing control:** Turn eligible HighLevel‑provided banners on or off at any time.
- **White‑label consistency:** Keep in‑app announcements aligned with your agency’s branding and tone.
- **Reduced support noise:** Hide upsells or system prompts that aren’t relevant to your clients.
- **Prioritized communication:** Ensure critical alerts appear ahead of general promotions.
- **Flexible recurrence:** Use frequency to prevent over‑messaging and banner fatigue.

---

## **Access & Permissions**

Knowing who can manage banners prevents permission errors and ensures only authorized team members make platform‑wide changes.

- Banner Management is available from **Agency Settings → Banner**.
- Typically restricted to **Agency Admins**. If your account uses custom roles, ensure the user has permission to manage agency‑level settings (or a specific **Banner Management** permission, if available in your account).
- Changes to banners affect the agency and may propagate to connected sub‑accounts, depending on the banner’s scope.
- For roles/permissions setup, see **[Agency | Managing user roles & permissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002543-agency-managing-user-roles-permissions)**.

---

## **Banner Status (Enable vs Disable)**

Status is the fastest way to control visibility platform‑wide. Enable/Disable is helpful for seasonality, temporary campaigns, and minimizing distractions.

- **Enabled** banners are eligible to appear wherever their scope allows (agency and/or sub‑accounts).
- **Disabled** banners are hidden platform‑wide.
- Some **system banners** may be locked or have limited controls based on product requirements; these will indicate restricted state (e.g., non‑interactive toggle or lock icon).

---

## **How To Setup Banner Management**

Proper setup ensures the right messages display to the intended audience at the right cadence. Follow these steps to review current banners and adjust order, frequency, and visibility.

1. Log in as an **Agency Admin** and go to **Agency Settings →****Banners Management**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055216910/original/-XQdxigJ9HrAPJspKFEi2YyYYcaG1zlUEQ.png?1759511542)
2. Review the banner list. Key columns typically include **Banners, Priority, Frequency, and Status.**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055217167/original/4iyCCVF4bItQBDZRN1LAmx05tjsbsj-uog.png?1759511860)
3. Adjust **Priority** (drag to reorder or edit the priority value), then **save** the order if required.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055216940/original/tjGCd-TIYRcYuOqUo9kd6TWilLG2OCwF2A.png?1759511625)
4. Toggle **Enable/Disable** to control visibility. System‑locked banners will indicate restricted controls.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055217120/original/63kbuF5qM97V_psedbibMtpebEt3aII5hA.png?1759511778)
5. Switch to a **sub‑account** to validate that banners appear as expected based on scope.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will disabling a banner hide it for all users?**  
Yes. Disabling a banner removes it platform‑wide according to its scope.

**Q: Can I show a banner only in the agency dashboard and not to clients?**  
Scope determines where a banner appears. If a banner supports **Agency only**, it will not show in sub‑accounts when enabled.

**Q: Can I control upsell or plan‑related banners?**  
Some upsell/system prompts appear in Banner Management. Editability depends on your plan and banner type.

**Q: Does changing priority affect analytics?**  
Priority only affects display order. If analytics are available for your banners, the data tracks views/clicks independently of priority.

**Q: Can I target specific sub‑accounts or user roles?**  
Targeting options vary by banner type. Review the banner’s details to confirm available scope controls.

**Q: Do dismissals persist across browsers/devices?**  
Dismissal is typically user‑based but may vary by device/session. Frequency settings determine when a banner can reappear.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Agency Company Settings in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000982604-agency-company-settings-in-highlevel)
- [Agency | Managing user roles & permissions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002543-agency-managing-user-roles-permissions)
- [Social Planner: In-App Notification Banner for Disconnected Accounts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005535-social-planner-in-app-notification-banner-for-disconnected-accounts)
- [Admin Vs. User Roles and Permission Scopes](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001078296-admin-vs-user-roles-and-permission-scopes)

title_en: Voice Dictation in AI Builder & Assistant
source_md:
Speak your ideas and let HighLevel do the typing. Voice Dictation in AI Builder and AI Assistant allows you to create and modify workflows using natural speech instead of manual text entry. This feature helps you build automations faster, improve accessibility, and streamline workflow creation across languages.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Voice Dictation in AI Builder & Assistant?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Voice-Dictation-in-AI-Builder-&-Assistant?)
- [Key Benefits of Voice Dictation](#Key-Benefits-of-Voice-Dictation)
- [Voice-to-Workflow Creation (AI Builder)](#Voice-to-Workflow-Creation-(AI-Builder))
- [Using Voice with AI Assistant](#Using-Voice-with-AI-Assistant)
- [Multi-Language Support](#Multi-Language-Support)
- [How To Use Voice Dictation](#How-To-Use-Voice-Dictation)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%C2%A0)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Voice Dictation in AI Builder & Assistant?**

Voice Dictation adds speech-to-text functionality to both the Workflow AI Builder and the in-builder AI Assistant. Instead of typing prompts, you can click the microphone icon and describe what you want to build or modify. HighLevel transcribes your speech and processes it the same way as a typed AI prompt, generating workflows or applying edits accordingly.

---

## **Key Benefits of Voice Dictation**

Voice input removes friction from workflow creation, making automation faster and more inclusive for teams of all sizes.

- **Hands-Free Ideation:** Capture automation ideas while multitasking without needing to type.
- **Faster Workflow Creation:** Move from concept to structured workflow in seconds.
- **Improved Accessibility:** Enables users with limited mobility or typing challenges to build workflows more easily.
- **Multi-Language Support:** Dictate in any language supported by HighLevel AI tools.
- **Seamless Editing:** Generated workflows appear in the standard builder for review and refinement.

---

## **Voice-to-Workflow Creation (AI Builder)**

AI Builder allows you to generate complete workflows using natural language. With Voice Dictation enabled, you can describe triggers, conditions, and actions verbally, and HighLevel will structure them into an automation draft inside the workflow canvas.

This is ideal when creating new workflows from scratch or rapidly prototyping automation logic.

(Screenshot: AI Builder prompt box with microphone icon highlighted above the “Add Trigger” button.)

After transcription:

- The workflow appears in the builder.
- You can edit triggers, actions, delays, and conditions as needed.
- You can continue refining using either voice or typed prompts

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065980623/original/T_w9Dk1EFvQ6WJBJFey7JNkvXWaJDYbW3A.gif?1772445217)

Learn more about AI workflow generation: **[Workflow AI Builder: Generate and Edit Workflows with AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006100-workflow-ai-builder)**

---

## **Using Voice with AI Assistant**

The AI Assistant inside the workflow canvas supports conversational edits and guidance. Voice Dictation allows you to speak your requests directly into the Assistant chat instead of typing.

This is best for:

- Modifying an existing workflow
- Asking configuration questions
- Adding or adjusting steps incrementally

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065988647/original/hs4424Mk3odAYxbvNL-IEKqdUzBcRxNGaQ.gif?1772449079)

Examples:

- “Add a 2-hour delay after the form submission trigger.”
- “Insert an SMS reminder before the appointment.”
- “How do I apply a tag when a contact replies?”

---

## **Multi-Language Support**

Voice Dictation works in any language supported by HighLevel AI prompts. This enables global teams to create workflows using their preferred language without needing to translate instructions manually.

The AI will:

- Transcribe your spoken language
- Interpret intent
- Generate the workflow in the builder interface

---

## **How To Use Voice Dictation**

Proper setup ensures your browser can capture audio and that AI Builder processes your voice instructions correctly.

1. Navigate to **Automation → Workflows**. Create a new workflow or open an existing one.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065985657/original/Kh9XNuH8mLXpRIKOC0XecGkMaFqXXTmD3A.png?1772447500)
2. Locate the **AI Builder prompt box** above the “Add Trigger” button.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065985744/original/9dyIYvaLvdP_SZHlAV_Pten4AevXY3IgcA.gif?1772447542)
3. Click the **microphone icon**. (Grant browser microphone permissions if prompted). Speak your workflow idea naturally, including triggers and actions. Click Stop (or wait for auto-stop).  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065987110/original/A5KmVwSOEy1qC-L4wCUlf6ZBX4MdnQbkzg.gif?1772448201)
4. Review the generated workflow and make edits as needed. You can use the Voice Dictation to further edit the workflow.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065987429/original/zuOHZfQ51TrZ5B6Bf8TlSK6fmoRLwJDe2w.gif?1772448460)
5. Click **Save** and **Publish**.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does Voice Dictation require a separate subscription?**  
Voice Dictation is available wherever Workflow AI Builder or AI Assistant is enabled within your plan.

**Q: Which languages are supported?**  
Any language supported by HighLevel AI prompts can be used with Voice Dictation.

**Q: Can I use Voice Dictation in existing workflows?**  
Yes. You can use voice input to modify existing workflows via AI Assistant or generate new logic within AI Builder.

**Q: My microphone isn’t working. What should I check?**  
Confirm microphone permissions are enabled in your browser and operating system settings. Refresh the page after granting access.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Workflow AI Builder: Generate and Edit Workflows with AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006100-workflow-ai-builder)

title_en: Live Streaming and Video Calling
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/4UYuVgIcDkY?&wmode=opaque)

Bring real-time human connection directly into HighLevel with Media Core’s Interactive Video Rooms and Live Streaming Engine. These fully integrated suites let you host collaborative meetings, broadcast events, and build custom live video experiences—without relying on outside tools.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Live Streaming & Video Calling?](#What-is-Live-Streaming-&-Video-Calling?)
  - [Key Benefits of Live Streaming & Video Calling](#Key-Benefits-of-Live-Streaming-&-Video-Calling)
  - [Interactive Video Rooms](#Interactive-Video-Rooms)
  - [Live Streaming Engine](#Live-Streaming-Engine)
  - [Build Your Own Experience (Composable Components)](#Build-Your-Own-Experience-(Composable-Components))
  - [Integrated Analytics & Resource Protection](#%C2%A0Integrated-Analytics-&-Resource-Protection)
  - [Courses & Communities — Battle‑Tested in Beta](#Courses-&-Communities-%E2%80%94-Battle%E2%80%91Tested-in-Beta)
  - [Embedding & Sharing Replays](#Embedding-&-Sharing-Replays)

---

# **What is Live Streaming & Video Calling?**

Media Core Live Streaming & Video Calling is HighLevel’s end-to-end solution for real-time video. It adds Interactive Video Rooms for multi-participant collaboration and a Live Streaming Engine for one-to-many broadcasts—on the same infrastructure that already stores your on‑demand images and videos.

---

## **Key Benefits of Live Streaming & Video Calling**

These benefits focus on enabling efficient, high‑quality live video while reducing tool sprawl, simplifying setup, and giving you control over performance, costs, and brand presentation.

- **One unified platform**: Store assets, run video calls, and live stream from a single media hub inside HighLevel.
- **Zero external licenses**: Eliminate separate Zoom/StreamYard/OBS hosting fees by using native experiences.
- **Built for engagement**: Raise hands, share reactions, chat in real time, and switch layouts to spotlight speakers.
- **Recording & replay**: Turn every call or stream into on‑demand content for members who couldn’t attend live.
- **Resource protection**: Automatic session shutdown prevents runaway costs when connection‑minute thresholds are exceeded.
- **Integrated analytics**: Track connection minutes, bandwidth usage, participant counts, and join/leave times.
- **Simple developer experience**: Drop in Vue components—state, connections, and real‑time events are handled for you.

---

## **Interactive Video Rooms**

Use Interactive Video Rooms for collaborative work—client meetings, coaching, classrooms, and team huddles. Controls help hosts moderate access, maintain order, and keep engagement high without juggling multiple tools.

- **Preview Mode**: Let attendees test camera and mic before joining for smoother starts.
- **Dynamic Layouts**: Automatically switch between **Grid View** (everyone visible) and **Speaker View** (active speaker spotlight).
- **Granular Host Controls**: Mute/unmute participants; grant or revoke **mic**, **video**, or **screen share** access; **remove** attendees if needed.
- **Participant Limits**: Configure the maximum number of participants per session.
- **Raise Hand**: Attendees can request to speak without interrupting.
- **Emoji Reactions**: Floating reactions boost energy without breaking flow.
- **Recording & Replay**: Record the call and optionally share a replay link for those who missed it.

---

## **Live Streaming Engine**

Use the Live Streaming Engine for one‑to‑many broadcasts—webinars, launches, town halls, and live announcements. Choose your production style—from quick webcam sessions to external encoder setups—while keeping the experience native to HighLevel.

- **Stream Software Mode**: Generate a **Stream Key & URL** (RTMP) and broadcast from tools like OBS, Zoom, or StreamYard.
- **WebCam Mode**: Go live directly in your browser—no external software required.
- **Professional Ingest**: Bring your studio or encoder feed directly into HighLevel for a polished broadcast.
- **Role‑Based Access**: Separate **Host** (broadcaster) and **Attendee** (viewer) roles for security and clarity.
- **Live Interaction**: Viewers can watch, **chat**, and **react** in real time—with a **live participant count** visible to hosts.
- **Recording**: Capture broadcasts to create on‑demand videos from your live event.

---

## **Build Your Own Experience (Composable Components)**

Media Core’s component‑based architecture gives you granular building blocks—so you can match your brand, rearrange UI, and create specialized layouts for collaboration or broadcasting.

- **Composable by design**: Use "<Player>, <ControlBar>, <Chat>" and other granular pieces to craft any layout.
- **Fully customizable**: Style and arrange components for minimalist tiles or complex multi‑column stages.
- **DX advantage**: Connection logic, state management, and real‑time events are handled for you.

---

## **Integrated Analytics & Resource Protection**

Built‑in analytics help you understand engagement and capacity planning across calls and streams, while safeguards control spend automatically when usage exceeds your limits.

- **Analytics captured**: Connection minutes, bandwidth usage, participant counts, and join/leave timestamps.
- **Usage protection**: Sessions that exceed connection‑minute thresholds automatically enter a grace period and then end, preventing overages.
- **Operational insight**: Use metrics to right‑size participant caps, optimize encoder bitrates, and schedule replays.

---

## **Courses & Communities — Battle‑Tested in Beta**

Real‑world testing ensures reliability. Media Core’s live video has already powered coaching sessions, classroom meetings, and community events at scale during beta.

- **Proven at scale**: Successfully rolled out to select beta users in **Courses** and **Communities**.
- **Seamless publishing**: Share replays in communities or course lessons to extend value beyond the live moment.

---

## **Embedding & Sharing Replays**

Make live content discoverable after the event. Share watch links, embed replays on sites/dashboards, or attach links in Conversations to keep engagement going.

- **Watch Page link**: Share the auto‑generated watch link with your audience.
- **Website embed**: Use an iframe snippet on funnels, websites, or dashboards. See **Embed External Content on a Dashboard** (blue) and **Embed Media from Third‑Party Platforms in Posts** (blue).
- **Library management**: Recordings appear in your Media Library with your other videos. See **Media Storage & File Upload Limits** (blue) for file specs.

title_en: Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag HighLevel Dialer
source_md:
HighLevel’s updated dialer makes it easier to stay on a call while continuing to work inside the platform. With auto-minimize, pin, and drag, you can keep the dialer accessible without letting it block important contact or pipeline information. These improvements help create a cleaner workspace and a smoother calling experience in the HighLevel web app.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Dialer Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag?](#What-is-Dialer-Auto-minimize,-Pin-&-Drag?)
- [Key Benefits of Dialer Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag](#Key-Benefits-of-Dialer-Auto-minimize,-Pin-&-Drag)
- [Auto-minimize](#Auto-minimize)
- [Pinning the Dialer](#Pinning-the-Dialer)
- [Dragging and Position Memory](#Dragging-and-Position-Memory)
- [How To Setup Dialer Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag](#How-To-Setup-Dialer-Auto-minimize,-Pin-&-Drag)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#%C2%A0Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Dialer Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag?**

Dialer Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag is a usability enhancement for the HighLevel web dialer that gives you more control over how the dialer behaves and where it appears on your screen. It introduces three core behaviors: the dialer can minimize automatically when you click outside it, stay visible when pinned, and be moved to a preferred location on your screen. This makes it easier to manage calls while reviewing records, updating details, or navigating to other areas of HighLevel.

---

## **Key Benefits of Dialer Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag**

- **Less screen clutter:** Auto-minimize helps free up space when you click into other areas of HighLevel during a call.
- **More control:** Pinning keeps the dialer visible when you want call controls available at all times.
- **Flexible placement:** Dragging lets you move the dialer to a part of the screen that works best for your workflow.
- **Consistent layout:** When the dialer is pinned, it can reopen in the same location where you last placed it.
- **Smoother multitasking:** You can review contact details or pipeline information without manually closing or repositioning the dialer each time.

---

## **Auto-minimize**

Auto-minimize helps keep the dialer out of the way while you work in other parts of HighLevel during an active call. This makes it easier to review records and update information without the dialer staying fully expanded on top of the page.

- When the dialer is open and not pinned, clicking outside the dialer minimizes it.
- Minimizing the dialer changes how it appears on screen, but it does not end the call.
- You can reopen the dialer from its minimized state whenever you need to access call controls again.
- To restore the minimized dialer, click the **phone icon** in the top navigation.

---

## **Pinning the Dialer**

Pinning allows you to keep the dialer visible while moving through other areas of the platform. This is useful when you want call controls to remain on screen while reviewing records, following a script, or updating notes during a conversation.

- Click the pin icon to keep the dialer open.
- When pinned, the dialer stays visible instead of minimizing when you click elsewhere.
- To return to the standard behavior, unpin the dialer or minimize it manually.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068054310/original/bLCRbyPuXlm1GMr8Qw6d5KXGzbel7kf4QA.png?1774879213)

---

## **Dragging and Position Memory**

Dragging allows you to place the dialer where it fits best on your screen. This makes it easier to keep it accessible without covering the information you need most. You can drag the dialer to a preferred location on the screen while it is open.

- Click and hold the dialer header or drag area.
- Move the dialer to your preferred on-screen location.
- Release it to place the dialer there.
- If the dialer is pinned, it can reopen in that saved position.

---

## **How To Setup Dialer Auto-minimize, Pin & Drag**

These controls are built into the HighLevel Web Dialer and do not require additional setup.

1. From the top navigation bar in HighLevel, click the green phone icon to open the Web Dialer.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068054537/original/ZaaO_UlmUxyvTdJL21B3EJq3qX3uOwVc-Q.png?1774879317)
2. Leave the dialer unpinned and click anywhere outside it to see the auto-minimize behavior in action.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068056176/original/9Dlc7uNQRMaJUTYBePZeAr8eTVeWH7WWCg.gif?1774879773)
3. Click the pin icon when you want the dialer to stay open while you work elsewhere in the platform.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068058469/original/RkoRJmGDxf7xliCkXlGJYM7hP_TDCVh-0Q.gif?1774880830)
4. Drag the dialer to a preferred location on the screen. If it is pinned, reopen it to confirm that it appears in the same saved position.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155068059210/original/QOFndHZNLPSNcgpUttDYhB8_D9sWnHHYTg.gif?1774881152)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does auto-minimize end my call?**  
No. Auto-minimize only changes how the dialer appears on screen. Your call remains active.

**Q: Does the dialer remember where I placed it?**  
Yes, when the dialer is pinned, it can reopen in the same location where you left it.

**Q: How do I keep the dialer open while I work in other areas of HighLevel?**  
Click the pin icon. When pinned, the dialer stays open until you unpin it or minimize it manually.

**Q: Can I move the dialer to another part of my screen?**  
Yes. You can drag the dialer to a different location on your screen.

**Q: Where do I open the dialer in HighLevel?**  
You can open the dialer from the phone icon in the top navigation bar of the web app.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Outbound Calls with Dialer in HighLevel Web App (Softphone)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000981431-outbound-calls-with-dialer-in-web-app-softphone-)
- [The Phone Dialer Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005807-the-phone-dialer-overview)
- [How to Create and Use Call Scripts in Web & App Dialers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004935-how-to-create-and-use-call-scripts-in-web-app-dialers)
- [Overview of Phone Number Configuration Options](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001229976-overview-of-phone-number-configuration-options)

title_en: How to Select Country Server Location for WordPress Hosting
source_md:
This guide explains how to pick the best-fit data-center region while you’re creating a site using WordPress Hosting in HighLevel. Selecting a nearby server cuts page-load times and boosts user experience with zero extra plugins or CDN setup.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Country Server Selection For WordPress Hosting?](#What-is-Country-Server-Selection-For-WordPress-Hosting?)
- [Key Benefits of Country Server Selection For WordPress Hosting](#Key-Benefits-of-Country-Server-Selection-For-WordPress-Hosting)
- [List of Available Locations](#List-of-Available-Locations)
- [How To Select Country Server Location for a Site](#How-To-Select-Country-Server-Location-for-a-Site%C2%A0)
  - [Step 1: Start Creating a Site](#Step-1%3A-Start-Creating-a-Site)
  - [Step 2: Choose a Setup Method](#Step-2%3A-Choose-a-Setup-Method)
  - [Step 3: Select Your Server Location](#Step-3%3A-Select-Your-Server-Location)
- [Understanding Immutable Locations](#Understanding-Immutable-Locations%C2%A0)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Country Server Selection For WordPress Hosting?**

Country Server Selection is a WordPress hosting feature in HighLevel that integrates right into your dashboard, letting you choose exactly which data center (Ashburn, Phoenix, London, etc.) will host your site’s files before the server spins up. This ensures visitors always load pages from the closest server for optimal performance, and once you pick a region during setup, it’s permanently embedded in your site’s metadata and visible on your site card.

---

## **Key Benefits of Country Server Selection For WordPress Hosting**

This enhancement offers a range of advantages that directly impact your site's performance and user experience. The feature provides:

- **Faster loading for local visitors:** Having servers nearby makes pages open more quickly.
- **Better site speed:** Your website feels snappier, keeping visitors happy.
- **Follow data rules easily:** Keep EU traffic on EU servers or APAC traffic in Sydney/Singapore.
- **One‑click setup:** Pick your region once and skip any complex moves later.
- **Locked region:** Prevents accidental changes that could break things like caching or SSL.
- **Clear hosting info:** You’ll always see your site’s server location and setup time in the dashboard.

---

## **List of Available Locations**

```
Note: Your selected location is captured as part of your site’s metadata and is clearly displayed on your site card. The configuration remains immutable post-setup, ensuring consistency for ongoing performance.
```

- **US** – Ashburn
- **US** – Phoenix
- **US** – Dallas
- **GB** – London
- **DE** – Frankfurt
- **NL** – Amsterdam
- **AU** – Sydney
- **SG** – Singapore

---

## **How To Select Country Server Location for a Site**

Setting up the Country Server Selection feature is integrated within your regular WordPress site creation process. Follow these steps to select your ideal server location:

### **Step 1:** Start Creating a Site

1. Login to your sub-account and click **Sites** in the left menu.
2. Click on the  **WordPress**tab.
3. Click the **+ Create Site** button.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/uQmYN1NqNjuhRC6jYUzw+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-29+at+9.25.33+PM.png)
4. **Subscribe** to the WordPress plan.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/QFtdSbjKW33eJMu0e9Gw+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-29+at+9.28.54+PM.png)
5. Or click on **Complete Setup** button of any previously subscribed site if you want to.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/nF8KXRuQArGGGzGAMAF8+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-29+at+9.30.44+PM.png)

### **Step 2:** Choose a Setup Method

1. **Choose** your preferred creation method:  
     
   1. **Blank** (start from scratch)
   2. **Existing Site** (clone another WordPress site)
   3. **Template** (use a prebuilt layout)
2. Click **Create** after selecting your option.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/YXydGhKJ6PWFvdcVw2jg+/Screen+Shot+2025-07-29+at+9.35.48+PM.png)

### **Step 3:** Select Your Server Location

1. Click the **Server Location dropdown**.
2. Select the **data center closest to your target audience**.
3. Click **Create WordPress Site/****Create** to create the site with your chosen server location.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/GPFKpmHHuhF7Xf8V9fZi+/GIF+Recording+2025-07-29+at+9.41.00+PM.gif)

---

## **Understanding Immutable Locations**

Because your files and database reside on physical hardware, the chosen region is locked the moment the server spins up.

- If you need a different region later, clone the site to a new location and repoint your DNS.
- Deleting and recreating the site also works but results in data loss.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I modify the server location after my site has been created?**

No, the server location selection is permanent once the site setup is complete.

**Q: Does the Country Server Selection feature work with all WordPress site setup methods?**

Yes, it is available for blank setups, cloning from an existing site, and template-based setups.

**Q: How do I determine the best server location for my site?**

Consider the geographic location of your target audience and select the nearest data center to minimize latency.

**Q: Will selecting a specific server location guarantee better site performance?**

While selecting a nearby data center can reduce latency and enhance performance, overall speed may also be influenced by other factors.

**Q. Does the region I pick affect my hosting bill?**

No. Pricing is identical across all data centers.

**Q. What happens if I choose the wrong location by mistake?**

Delete and recreate the site, or clone it to the correct region and migrate content.

**Q. Do I still need a CDN?**

A CDN is optional but recommended for global audiences. Regional hosting delivers fast origin responses; a CDN adds edge caching worldwide.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Migrate a Wordpress Site](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005070)
- [Cloning Wordpress Websites in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004189)
- [How to Install Popular WordPress Plugins During Site Creation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005126)
- [LC (LeadConnector) WordPress Plugin](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005560)
- [WordPress Access & Activity Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004141)

title_en: Workflow Trigger - Product Access Removed
source_md:
This article explains the **"Product Access Removed"** workflow trigger, a tool designed to automate actions when a customer’s access to a product is revoked. You’ll learn what this trigger does, its key benefits, how to configure it step-by-step, and examples of real-world applications. Finally, we address common questions to help you maximize its potential.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Product Access Removed Workflow Trigger](#What-is-Product-Access-Removed-Workflow-Trigger)
- [Key Benefits of Product Access Removed Trigger](#Key-Benefits-of-Product-Access-Removed-Trigger)
- [Configuring the Trigger: A Step-by-Step Process](#Configuring-the-Trigger%3A-A-Step-by-Step-Process)
  - [Name Your Trigger](#Name-Your-Trigger)
  - [Select Product](#Select-Product)
- [Use Cases](#Use-Cases)
  - [Customer Notification for Expired Subscriptions](#Customer-Notification-for-Expired-Subscriptions)
  - [Internal Team Alerts for Membership Revocations](#Internal-Team-Alerts-for-Membership-Revocations)
  - [CRM Updates for Accurate Tracking](#CRM-Updates-for-Accurate-Tracking)
  - [Upsell Opportunities After Access Removal](#Upsell-Opportunities-After-Access-Removal)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Product Access Removed Workflow Trigger**

The Product Access Removed workflow trigger activates when a customer’s access to a product is revoked or removed. This trigger enables businesses to automate follow-up actions such as sending notifications, updating CRM records, and notifying internal teams. It can be tailored to specific products, making it a versatile solution for managing customer relationships and maintaining operational control.

---

## **Key Benefits of Product Access Removed Trigger**

- **Automated Customer Notifications:**Inform customers about access changes in real time, ensuring transparency and professionalism.
- **Streamlined Operations:**Automate administrative tasks like updating CRM records or managing access permissions to save time and reduce errors.
- **Improved Customer Retention:**Provide clear next steps to customers, such as subscription renewal or contacting support, to regain access.
- **Enhanced Team Coordination:**Notify internal teams, such as support or sales, to enable timely follow-ups and retention efforts.
- **Customizable Responses:** Use filters to target specific products, ensuring workflows are tailored to meet different business needs.

---

## **Configuring the Trigger: A Step-by-Step Process**

### **Access Workflow Settings**

Navigate to the automation or workflow settings in your CRM platform. Create a new workflow from scratch or select the existing workflow where you want to implement the "Product Access Removed" trigger.

### **Add a New Trigger**

Click **“Add New Trigger”** and select **"Product Access Removed"** from the dropdown menu.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039182977/original/9MZXXaCFvBnllrHN4DBMhXUOXCqEiZtzfw.png?1735830609)

### **Name Your Trigger**

Provide a descriptive name, such as “Subscription Access Revoked.”

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039183043/original/j2LYzecF4uCIeKoL5lXGyRh97RDsV_aDiw.png?1735830660)

### **Set Filters:**

Refine workflow activation criteria by configuring filters:

### **Select Product**

Choose the specific product to trigger the workflow when access is removed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039183057/original/Ge-bmqeG1uOauaQF64Y2NfJjrqQn2JNuDA.png?1735830680)

---

### **Save the Configuration**

Click the **"Save"** button to ensure the trigger is properly configured.

### **Test and Publish**

Test the workflow using sample data to confirm its functionality. Once validated, enable the Publish toggle to activate the workflow.

---

## **Use Cases**

### **Customer Notification for Expired Subscriptions**

**Scenario:**A customer’s subscription to an online course expires, and they need to be informed.

**Trigger Setup:**

- **Trigger:** Product Access Removed.
- **Filter:** Select Product: “Advanced Marketing Course.”

**Outcome:**The workflow sends an email notifying the customer about the expiration and providing steps to renew their subscription.

---

### **Internal Team Alerts for Membership Revocations**

**Scenario:**A customer’s access to a premium membership is revoked, and the support team needs to follow up.

**Trigger Setup:**

- **Trigger:**Product Access Removed.
- **Filter:**Select Product: “Premium Membership.”

**Outcome:**The workflow notifies the support team, updates the CRM, and creates a follow-up task for the sales team to retain the customer.

---

### **CRM Updates for Accurate Tracking**

**Scenario:**Access to a digital product is removed, and the customer’s profile needs to be updated for tracking purposes.

**Trigger Setup:**

- **Trigger:**Product Access Removed.
- **Filter:** Select Product: “E-Book Access.”

**Outcome:** The workflow updates the CRM record to reflect the removal and tags the customer for potential re-engagement campaigns.

---

### **Upsell Opportunities After Access Removal**

**Scenario:** A customer’s access to a basic product is revoked, and they are encouraged to upgrade to a premium offering.

**Trigger Setup:**

- **Trigger:**Product Access Removed.
- **Filter:**Select Product: “Basic Plan.”

**Outcome:** The workflow sends an email highlighting the benefits of upgrading to a premium plan and includes a discount code as an incentive.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**What happens if access to the same product is removed multiple times for a customer?**

The trigger will activate each time access is removed. To avoid redundant actions, use conditions or cooldown periods in your workflows.

**How do filters improve workflow precision?**

Filters allow you to target specific products or scenarios, ensuring workflows activate only under relevant conditions. This customization improves accuracy and reduces unnecessary automation.

**Can I combine this trigger with other triggers in a workflow?**

Yes, the Product Access Removed trigger can be combined with others, such as**“Tag Added”** or **“Subscription Expired,”** to create advanced workflows.

**Is it possible to notify different teams based on the product removed?**

Absolutely. You can configure conditional actions to send notifications to specific teams or individuals depending on the product being removed.

title_en: Mobile Editor for Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/Jo3l6PlwVS0?&wmode=opaque)

This article will walk you through using the powerful Mobile Editor in HighLevel’s Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes builder. Customize visuals and text for mobile devices without affecting your desktop layout — for a perfectly responsive and engaging experience.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Mobile Editor?](#What-is-the-Mobile-Editor?)
- [Key Benefits of the Mobile Editor](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Mobile-Editor)
- [How To Use the Mobile Editor](#How-To-Use-the-Mobile-Editor)
- [Mobile Header & Background Images](#Mobile-Header-&-Background-Images)
- [Mobile Font Styling](#Mobile-Font-Styling)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is the Mobile Editor?**

The Mobile Editor is a new feature in HighLevel that gives you dedicated tools to customize how your forms, surveys, and quizzes look on mobile devices. Instead of compromising between mobile and desktop, you can now style each experience independently — ensuring your content always looks polished and performs well across every screen size.

## 

## **Key Benefits of the Mobile Editor**

Delivering a smooth, mobile-first experience is key to keeping users engaged. This feature allows you to fine-tune visual elements on mobile without affecting your desktop design.

- Upload custom **header** and **background images** just for mobile
- Independently adjust **font family**, **font size**, and **font weight**
- Style specific text elements: **Labels**, **Short Labels**, **Placeholders**
- Preview and test mobile design before publishing
- Ensure forms remain user-friendly and on-brand across devices
- Increase completion rates by enhancing the mobile user experience

## 

## **How To Use the Mobile Editor**

Follow these steps to activate and configure your form, survey, or quiz using the Mobile Editor.

1. **Open** any form, survey, or quiz from your builder dashboard.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047765746/original/WLW2pIjU1oURMGynOfMxSUyYBiGyWTG7lQ.png?1749068777)
2. **Click the Device Toggle** at the top of the screen to switch to **Mobile View**.  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047765949/original/OqX7HBaCddbhDXWsaMDIy4hpofLBWXfKZw.png?1749069210)

3. In **Mobile View**, the right-hand panel will now offer mobile-specific settings:

   - **Layout Style**: Choose your preferred mobile layout.
   - **Mobile Header Image**: Upload an image specifically for mobile headers.
   - **Mobile Background Image**: Upload a mobile-specific background image.
   - **Font Settings**:

     - Adjust **Font Family**
     - Change **Font Size**
     - Modify **Font Weight**
4. These font settings apply individually to:

   - **Labels** (e.g., “First Name”)
   - **Short Labels** (e.g., field headers in condensed formats)
   - **Placeholder Text** (e.g., “Enter your email”)  
     Once complete, **click Save**, then **Preview** to test your mobile design.

5. When satisfied, **publish** your form — now fully mobile-optimized!

---

**Separate Style Panels for Desktop and Mobile**

Independent style controls keep each device crisp without CSS overrides. Match layout to screen size while preserving brand consistency.

**Per-device style properties**

- Background color, padding, border, font weight (add alignment, line-height, letter spacing if present – Needs Confirmation)
- Styles set on **Mobile** do **not** overwrite **Desktop**, and vice versa.
- True 0 px padding on Mobile: In Mobile View, you can set Top and Bottom padding to 0 px for true zero spacing. Mobile styles are device-scoped, so this does not change Desktop padding.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064146055/original/siER8o4XuLfkF-Ub9l_XoXO6AVO2pzP5RA.gif?1770193571)

---

## **Content vs. Style on Mobile**

Content and presentation are configured separately. Edit mobile-specific text for clarity, and fine-tune mobile-only styles for legibility.

**Behavior**

- Content: You may use different copy on Mobile.
- Style: Spacing, borders, and typography are device-scoped.
- Reset/Copy: If available, use Reset or Copy from Desktop to speed setup (Needs Confirmation).

---

## **Mobile Header & Background Images**

Images scale differently on mobile screens. With this feature, you can upload images specifically optimized for small devices, ensuring your design looks clean and purposeful.

Why this matters:

- Mobile users interact vertically — use tighter, portrait-style images.
- Prevent image cropping or distortion that often happens when desktop images scale down.

## 

## **Mobile Font Styling**

Text that reads well on desktop can feel cramped or oversized on a mobile screen. Use the Mobile Editor to adjust font elements individually for a smoother mobile reading experience.

Available Controls:

- **Font Family**: Choose from available system or custom fonts
- **Font Size**: Set exact px size for clarity on small screens
- **Font Weight**: Use bold, light, or normal to enhance visibility

Elements Affected:

- **Labels** — These guide users to fill fields properly
- **Short Labels** — Ideal for condensed layouts or multi-column sections
- **Placeholders** — Useful for subtle input cues

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will changes in Mobile View affect my desktop layout?**

No — all edits made in Mobile View apply **only to mobile**. Your desktop design remains untouched.

**Q: Can I use different header and background images for mobile?**

Yes! Upload mobile-specific images that better fit smaller screen ratios without affecting your desktop version.

**Q: Can I preview only the mobile version before publishing?**

Absolutely. Use the **Preview** button while in Mobile View to test what your users will see on mobile.

**Q: Are font changes global or element-specific?**

Font settings can be configured individually for **Labels**, **Short Labels**, and **Placeholders** — giving you complete control.

**Q: Do all HighLevel plans include the Mobile Editor?**

Yes, this feature is included in all plans that offer Forms, Surveys, or Quizzes.

### 

---

### **Next Steps**

- Test your top forms with mobile customization to improve engagement.
- Split test mobile-optimized vs. shared designs.
- Explore more ways to enhance UX with styling options and smart fields.
- Analyze mobile-specific conversion data using analytics tools.

title_en: How to Find Unread Messages in Mobile Conversations
source_md:
Finding unread messages in HighLevel's mobile Conversations is easier with the new **New** divider. When you open a conversation with unread messages, the app automatically takes you to the first unread message instead of the bottom of the chat. Scrolling is also smoother, especially in long conversations. This article explains how to find unread messages, use the divider, and navigate conversations more efficiently.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Unread Message Divider in Mobile Conversations?](#What-is-the-Unread-Message-Divider-in-Mobile-Conversations?)
- [Key Benefits of the Unread Message Divider](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Unread-Message-Divider)
- [How the New Divider Works](#How-the-New-Divider-Works)
- [When the New Divider Disappears](#When-the-New-Divider-Disappears)
- [Improved Scrolling in Long Conversations](#Improved-Scrolling-in-Long-Conversations)
- [Supported Mobile Applications](#Supported-Mobile-Applications)
- [How to Find Unread Messages in Mobile Conversations](#How-to-Find-Unread-Messages-in-Mobile-Conversations)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Unread Message Divider in Mobile Conversations?**

The **New** divider shows where unread messages begin in a conversation. It appears directly above the first unread incoming message, helping you pick up where you left off.

When you open an unread conversation, the app automatically scrolls to this divider, even if the unread messages are far back in the conversation history.

The feature works automatically and does not require additional setup.

---

## **How the New Divider Works**

When you open a conversation with unread activity, HighLevel places the **New** divider above the first unread incoming message.

You can scroll upward to view older messages or downward to reach the latest activity.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083796254/original/qqcJu1LypSSU4sTI8sGLPmCYWUzF0hAhGA.png?1792516662)**

```
Note: Opening a conversation does not automatically mark it as read. The divider remains until the conversation's unread status is cleared.
```

---

## **When the New Divider Disappears**

The divider automatically disappears when the conversation becomes read.

This can happen when you:

- Send a reply from the message composer.
- Send an AI-suggested reply.
- Manually mark the conversation as read.
- Reply through the web application or another device.

You do not need to remove the divider manually.

For more information, see [How to Mark a Conversation as Read](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000980858-unread-vs-read-must-manually-mark-as-read).

---

## **Improved Scrolling in Long Conversations**

Mobile Conversations now scroll more smoothly, even when a chat contains a long message history.

On supported devices with 120 Hz displays, scrolling performance can reach approximately **120 FPS**, compared with approximately 90 FPS previously.

Actual performance may vary depending on the device.

---

## **Supported Mobile Applications**

The release is intended for these mobile applications:

- HighLevel
- LeadConnector
- White-label mobile apps

```
Availability: The supplied release note lists the feature as In QA. The official release date and supported app versions are not yet confirmed.
```

---

## **How to Find Unread Messages in Mobile Conversations**

The New divider appears automatically in supported mobile app versions. No special settings or filters are required.

1. **Open the mobile app.** Sign in to HighLevel, LeadConnector, or your supported white-label app.
2. **Go to Conversations.** Open your conversation list.
3. **Select an unread conversation.** Tap the conversation you want to review.
4. **Find the New divider.** The chat opens at the first unread incoming message, with the divider directly above it.
5. **Read and reply.** Review the new messages, then respond or mark the conversation as read when appropriate.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083796287/original/KpNpz7mZruof0uWA7ERTQHxH2AqlQLNgmw.png?1792516719)**

```
Tip: Scroll upward for earlier messages or downward for the latest activity.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to enable the New divider?**

A: No. It appears automatically in supported app versions when a conversation contains unread messages.

**Q: Why does a conversation open in the middle of the chat?**

A: The app opens at the first unread message so you can review what you missed.

**Q: Does opening a conversation mark it as read?**

A: No. Simply opening the conversation does not necessarily clear its unread status.

**Q: When does the New divider disappear?**

A: It disappears when the conversation becomes read, such as after sending a reply or marking it as read.

**Q: Does replying from another device remove the divider?**

A: Yes. The release supports clearing unread status through replies from the web or another device.

**Q: Can I still see older messages?**

A: Yes. Scroll upward to view earlier messages.

**Q: Does the divider work in long conversations?**

A: Yes. The app can open at the unread position even when it is far back in the history.

**Q: Will scrolling reach 120 FPS on every phone?**

A: No. Actual scrolling performance depends on the device and its display capabilities.

**Q: When will this feature be available?**

A: The release date and supported app versions have not yet been confirmed.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started with the Conversations Tab](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006610-getting-started-with-the-conversations-tab)
- [How to Mark a Conversation as Read](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000980858-unread-vs-read-must-manually-mark-as-read)
- [The Revamped Mobile App Experience](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006707-the-revamped-mobile-app-experience-mobile-v4-0-0)
- [HighLevel Mobile App Experience](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008398-highlevel-mobile-app-experience)
- [How to Use Conversation AI in the Mobile App](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002669)
- [Overview of Conversation Filters](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001222121-overview-of-conversation-filters)

title_en: How to Track Gift Card Performance (Analytics & Metric Tracking)
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/3rtMS9gGlFE?&wmode=opaque)

Use the Gift Cards analytics dashboard to understand how many gift cards you’ve issued, total value, average order value, and which denominations perform best. This article explains each metric, how filters work, and how to drill into Gift Card Orders so you can make smarter merchandising and promotion decisions.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Gift Card Dashboard?](#What-is-the-Gift-Card-Dashboard?)
  - [Key Benefits of Gift Card Analytics](#Key-Benefits-of-Gift-Card-Analytics)
  - [Filters and Date Ranges](#Filters-and-Date-Ranges)
  - [Gift Card Dashboard Metrics](#Gift-Card-Dashboard-Metrics)
    - [Total Gift Cards Issued](#Total-Gift-Cards-Issued)
    - [Total Value of Gift Cards Issued](#Total-Value-of-Gift-Cards-Issued)
    - [Average Order Value (AOV)](#Average-Order-Value-(AOV))
    - [Number of Unique Customers](#Number-of-Unique-Customers)
    - [Top Denominations & Popularity Chart](#Top-Denominations-&-Popularity-Chart)
  - [Gift Card Orders Page](#Gift-Card-Orders-Page)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Gift Card Dashboard?**

The Gift Card Dashboard (under **Payments → Gift Cards**) provides a consolidated view of how your gift card program is performing over time. This includes issuance counts, revenue impact, buyer trends, and denomination preferences.

The dashboard also gives you information on specific Gift Card Orders to verify the customer, status, remaining balance and other gift card details.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126280/original/VBfDyrU0khfv574THijmSBng_3yuPsncMg.jpeg?1764021217)

---

## **Key Benefits of Gift Card Analytics**

- **Fast Performance Insights:** See cards issued, total value, average order value, and top denomination at a glance.
- **Better Merchandising:** Identify which denominations convert best and adjust your product mix or promos.
- **Faster Auditing:** Jump from KPIs to Gift Card Orders to confirm code, balance, delivery, and status.
- **Filter Results:**Compare metrics from predefined (Today, Yesterday, Last 7/30 days, This/Last Month) or custom date ranges

---

## **Filters and Date Ranges**

The dashboard view changes based on the filters available on the top left corner of the Gift Cards landing page, with 'This Month' as the default. This remains as a consistent section irrespective of whether user is viewing the Gift Card Products page or All Orders page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126454/original/oNA28_DyA1fMGYtdKrPh-g0adsJm3cshXw.png?1764021589)

---

## **Gift Card Dashboard Metrics**

### **Total Gift Cards Issued**

Shows the total number of gift cards created within the selected time period, combining both:

- Cards sold through any checkout, and
- Cards sent directly through the Send flow

Use this metric to understand overall adoption and utilization.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126349/original/HGCf-abRC3zQyvUcF_3hFwp2FQCy27Rk6w.png?1764021409)

### **Total Value of Gift Cards Issued**

Displays the total monetary value of all issued gift cards. A trend chart shows value changes over time, helpful for spotting seasonal peaks or campaign-driven spikes.

Example: If five $500 cards and two $2,000 cards were issued in a week, the total value reflects $6,500.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126371/original/4nglZ0EzYDUzFu20Ni2uTWcD--b5AFmZkg.png?1764021439)

### **Average Order Value (AOV)**

Shows the average value of gift card orders. This helps identify whether customers gravitate toward smaller or larger denominations.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126377/original/I-0zyiO1fk7XxDk3Dw-N52Gl006No8SVJg.png?1764021475)

### **Number of Unique Customers**

Represents how many unique individuals purchased or received a gift card during the selected time period. This helps measure program reach, repeat engagement, and customer acquisition via gifting.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126390/original/tUDYpDiqu5BaUSuwERjAM3WKfinCyawXzg.png?1764021501)

### **Top Denominations & Popularity Chart**

This metric highlights:

- The most frequently issued denomination
- The Top 5 denominations chart

These insights help you optimize future inventory and denomination options.

Example: Top 5: $1,000 → $500 → $2,000 → $250 → $5,000

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126407/original/o85PWY2k1vBDQ8o8UDbRR6LB82KHvHktWg.png?1764021544)

---

## **Gift Card Orders Page**

The gift card orders page lists all the sold or sent gift cards along with their statuses, balances and customer details. All cards on this page are clickable and open up a detailed page for that order. The gift card order details page acts as the single source of truth for all Gift Cards in the account. You can use the filters to slice metrics by contacts, status or denomination.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155059126474/original/-Z20oQpNQXeAkmaxsYEiXoYOxYBSO399gA.png?1764021682)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How are Scheduled gift cards counted in the dashboard?**  
Scheduled issues are included in issuance totals for the selected date range. Use the Status filter to analyze Scheduled or Active gift cards specifically.

**Q: What’s the difference between Gift Card Orders and the regular Orders page?**  
Gift Card Orders (inside Payments → Gift Cards) track every card issued or purchased. The generic Orders page only records paid transactions.

**Q****: How do gift card transitions done in Test mode affect analytics?**

Gift cards created in **Test** mode do not have any affect on analytics in the Gift Card Dashboard.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started with Gift Cards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006980)
- [How to Sell Gift Cards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006986)
- [How to Send Gift Cards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006987)

title_en: Workflow Trigger - Instagram Comment(s) On A Post
source_md:
This trigger fires when there is a comment on your Instagram post(s).

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is The Trigger - Instagram Comment(s) On A Post?](#What-Is-The-Trigger---Instagram-Comment(s)-On-A-Post?)
  - [Where To Find This Trigger](#Where-To-Find-This-Trigger)
  - [Components](#Components)
  - [Filters](#Filters)
    - [Page Is + Post Type + Post Is](#Page-Is-+-Post-Type-+-Post-Is)
    - [Contains Phrase OR Exact Match](#Contains-Phrase-OR-Exact-Match)
    - [Track First Level Comment Only](#Track-First-Level-Comment-Only)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What Is The Trigger - Instagram Comment(s) On A Post?**

This trigger is fired when a comment on your Instagram post(s) matches the filters you set.

---

## **Where To Find This Trigger**

## 

Navigate to Automations > Workflows > Workflow Builder > Triggers > Facebook/Instagram Events.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041830962/original/L9pXyb2ALo5ULdcFeYUy0T6VYpOyoO-wRw.jpeg?1739902001)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041831350/original/46MFAXXN7ivLHEZi5jJITh3R3RFPEcN9zw.png?1739902649)

---

## **Components**

There are four (4) primary components of the Workflow Trigger - Instagram Comment(s) On A Post:

1. **Choose A Workflow Trigger:** By default this option is set to this trigger. You can change it to a different trigger if you want.
2. **Workflow Trigger Name:** By default this is just the name of the trigger. You can edit this to give it a clearer name that is visible in the Workflow.
3. **Filters:**This is where you select the criteria for firing the trigger in the right situation. More details in the next section.
4. **Track First Level Comments Only:**This toggle, when off, will allow the trigger to fire for all nested comments. When it is toggled on, then the trigger will only fire for the top (first) comment, not for comments under that comment.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041831384/original/6Ce-Rwd62Mg6NBY35w_eh41WpIfq_p66-w.png?1739902707)

---

## **Filters**

Detailed description of the filters:

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Filter Level 1 | Options |
| Page Is | List of your account's pages |
| Post Type | Published Post (all posts on your business page) |
| Custom Post (enter a URL) |
| Post is | List of the posts that match your Page Is + Post Type settings |
| Contains Phrase | Phrase = "I bought from you" Comment = "I bought from you yesterday" --> Pass Comment = "I bought one from you" --> Fail Comment = "how much" --> Fail |
| Exact Match | Phrase = "I bought from you" Comment = "I bought from you" --> Pass Comment = "I bought from you yesterday" --> Fail Comment = "I bought one from you" --> Fail |

### **Page Is + Post Type + Post Is**

First select the page from Page Is, then select the type of post from Post Type, then you can select the post itself from Post Is.

**Step 1: Select the Page**

Select Standard Fields > Page Is and then the page from the list.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041831411/original/8CdKJJyt-KHiyQ9u9FFZEPG_LDKCS1Nl3A.png?1739902781)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041831479/original/tvHzg5VvNtl1or3g4RyJUsQETiIrz9dEAA.png?1739902917)

**Step 2: Select the post type**

Select Published Post to pick from a list or Custom Post to enter a URL.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041830957/original/5smhFAlN2W3h3Ufg9WrD7zVrqb_7LWtvAw.jpeg?1739902001)

**Step 3: Identify the exact post**

If you used Published Post, then pick from the list, and if you used Custom Post, enter the direct URL.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041830959/original/QgLcGzSJlU_yu4JQsPGv92RDNLxdUPAEtQ.jpeg?1739902002)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041830961/original/tOlAMbpzythpz_CBJFtWIpYNC06JaKsy9A.jpeg?1739902002)

---

### **Contains Phrase OR Exact Match**

### 

After you have identified the exact post,  you can use either the Contains Phrase filter or the Exact Match filter.

- **Contains Phrase:**the trigger will fire if the body of the comment contains one of the exact text strings you provide.
- **Exact Match:** the trigger will fire if the entire body of the comment exactly matches one of the text strings you provide.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041830958/original/VXaZqRiMQLv0vjxMBVhtcP7sqHT5lYfwkQ.jpeg?1739902002)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041830964/original/oudpvop2MK-VyOCAWk55cgPMouFiDOjYhg.jpeg?1739902002)

---

### **Track First Level Comment Only**

You can use the toggle to turn on/off 1st level comment only.

- **Toggle On:** the trigger will only fire for the first comment in a chain, not for comments under a comment.
- **Toggle Off:** the trigger will fire for any comment, even if it's nested under other comments.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155041830963/original/JM8x0HqYuN35fNB2rYm4BspMSf4USIjDAQ.jpeg?1739902002)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can the trigger Instagram Comment(s) on post work for Facebook?**

No, this trigger only works for Instagram. You can use the identical [Facebook Comment(s) on post](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004645) trigger for Facebook.

**Q: What actions should I use with the trigger Instagram Comment(s) on post?**

Use the Recipe Instagram Comment Automation to see an example of how to use this trigger in a workflow. Review the article [Facebook & Instagram Comment Automation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002055) and the actions [Reply In Comment](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003302) and [Instagram Interactive Messenger](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003301).

**Q: Can the Comment On Post trigger create an infinite loop?**

No, automatic comments will not create an infinite loop. The workflow triggers automatically ignore any comments posted by workflow actions.

title_en: How to Enable and Customize Live Chat Notifications
source_md:
Live Chat notifications alert you when a new message comes in so you can respond quickly and keep conversations moving. Live Chat uses your existing Conversation notification preferences, allowing you to control which events trigger alerts and how those alerts are delivered.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Live Chat Notifications?](#what-are-live-chat-notifications)
- [Key Benefits](#key-benefits)
- [Set Up and Customize Live Chat Notifications](#manage-live-chat-notifications)
- [Conversation Notification Options](#conversation-notification-options)
- [Notification Channels](#notification-channels)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Are Live Chat Notifications?**

Live Chat notifications alert you when supported Live Chat activity occurs. These alerts use the same Conversation notification settings as other conversation types, so there is no separate Live Chat notification setup.

Depending on your preferences, supported notifications can be delivered through channels such as In-App, Email, or SMS.

---

## **Key Benefits**

- **Stay informed:** Receive alerts for supported Live Chat activity.
- **No separate setup:** Live Chat uses your existing Conversation notification preferences.
- **Centralized management:** Manage Live Chat and other Conversation alerts from My Profile.
- **Flexible delivery:** Choose the supported notification channels that work best for you.

---

## **Set Up and Customize Live Chat Notifications**

Live Chat notifications are managed through your Conversation notification settings.

### **Step 1:**Open Notifications

From the applicable Sub-Account, go to **Settings → My Profile → Notifications**.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082698321/original/3mNETVvp1dlvUdgaXuC306jyaA01vBHKjQ.png?1791352259)

In **My Profile**, select **Notifications** from the left-side menu.

### **Step 2:**Configure Conversation Notifications

Review the Conversation notification options and enable the alerts that match the activity you want to follow.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082698214/original/Utdzt_7Ijve1I4s8R0WkJxRSBeiHblSfjg.png?1791352161)

### **Step 3:**Choose Notification Channels

Select the available delivery channels for each notification type based on how you want to receive alerts.

### **Step 4:**Apply Your Changes

After configuring your notification options and channels, use the available save action to apply your changes.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082698301/original/7odiXSUaLaOg4mHExBr7H1jQGfcbToOttg.png?1791352231)

---

## **Conversation Notification Options**

Available Conversation notification settings can include:

- **Notify for all new conversations & messages initiated with the account:** Receive alerts when a new conversation or message is initiated with the account.
- **Notify when a conversation gets assigned to me:** Receive an alert when a conversation is assigned to you.
- **Notify for new messages on a conversation I am assigned to:** Receive alerts for new messages in conversations assigned to you.
- **Notify when I am added to an internal chat:** Receive an In-App notification when you are added to a supported internal chat.
- **Notify for all new messages in internal chats I am part of:** Receive In-App alerts for supported new messages in internal chats you have joined.
- **Notify when I am mentioned in any conversation:** Receive an alert when another user mentions you in a conversation.
- **Notify for all new messages in conversations where I am mentioned:** Continue receiving supported alerts for new messages after being mentioned in a conversation.

Live Chat activity follows the applicable Conversation notification settings, so you do not need to configure a separate set of Live Chat preferences.

---

## **Notification Channels**

Available channels depend on the notification type and can include:

- **In-App:** Displays supported alerts while you are working in the platform.
- **Email:** Sends supported notifications to your registered email address.
- **SMS:** Sends supported notification alerts to your configured phone number.

You can enable the supported combination of channels that best fits your workflow.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: If I disable "Notify for all new conversations & messages initiated with the account," will I still receive Live Chat notifications for conversations assigned to me?**

Yes. If **Notify when a conversation gets assigned to me** or **Notify for new messages on a conversation I am assigned to** remains enabled, you can still receive supported alerts for conversations assigned to you.

**Q: Can I choose individual notification channels for Live Chat alerts?**

Yes. Supported notification channels can be enabled or disabled independently for the applicable Conversation notification type.

**Q: How do mention notifications work together?**

**Notify when I am mentioned in any conversation** alerts you when you are mentioned. **Notify for all new messages in conversations where I am mentioned** continues sending supported alerts for later messages in that conversation.

**Q: Will changing my notification preferences affect other users?**

No. Notification preferences are specific to each user's profile. Other users can configure their own Conversation notification options and channels.

**Q: Do I need to configure Live Chat notifications separately?**

No. Live Chat uses the applicable Conversation notification settings configured under **My Profile → Notifications**.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Set Up Custom Notifications as a User in a Sub-Account](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001224427-how-to-set-up-custom-notifications-as-a-user-in-a-sub-account)
- [Live Chat: How to Use and Manage Website Chat](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001320-live-chat)
- [Getting Started: Set Up a Live Chat Widget](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005067-getting-started-setup-live-chat-widget)
- [Notification Sound Option in Chat Widgets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007165-notification-sound-option-in-chat-widgets)

---

title_en: Assign tasks, set priority, and set dates
source_md:
Three properties turn a list of tasks into something a team can actually work from - who owns it, how urgent it is, and when it is due. This article covers all three, including how assignment works when several people are involved in the same piece of work.

```
Note: Project Management is now available to agencies on the $497 plan. To enable it, navigate to Agency or Sub-account settings → Labs and toggle on Project Management to access the new experience.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Why These Three Properties Matter](#Why-These-Three-Properties-Matter)
- [Assigning a Task](#Assigning-a-Task)
- [Steps for Assigning a Task](#Steps-for-Assigning-a-Task)
  - [Option 1 - While creating the task](#Option-1---While-creating-the-task)
  - [Option 2 - On an existing task](#Option-2---On-an-existing-task)
- [Splitting Work Across Several People](#Splitting-Work-Across-Several-People)
- [Setting Priority](#Setting-Priority)
- [Setting Dates](#Setting-Dates)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## Why these three properties matter

A task with a name and nothing else tells you that something needs doing, but not who is doing it, whether it matters, or when it is needed. Assignee, priority, and dates are what make a board reviewable at a glance. All three can be set the moment you create a task, or added later.

---

## Assigning a task

The Assignee property records the person responsible for a task. It is a single selection - a task has one assignee. The picker also has an option to clear the assignee and leave the task unowned.

```
In the first iteration, a task can have only one assignee. Support for multiple assignees will be introduced in later releases.
```

Assignee picker open on a task, showing the list of members

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078498291/original/tSv35k6RBDpKD1V9TOOrG3QN1cFkv3PAqQ.png?1786779167)

The people available in the picker are those with access to the Space. If someone you expect is missing, check that they have been shared into the Space.

---

## Steps for assigning a task

### Option 1 - While creating the task

The inline task composer includes an "Add assignee" control. Setting the owner at creation is the best habit, because an unassigned task has nobody watching it.

### Option 2 - On an existing task

Click the task card to open its detail panel.

Find the "Assignee" property.

Click it and choose a person from the list.

Save your change.

---

## Splitting work across several people

Because a task takes one assignee, subtasks are how you divide a piece of work between people. Keep the parent task as the overall outcome, then add a subtask per person for their part of it.

For example, a task called Launch September newsletter might have subtasks for drafting copy, designing the header, and scheduling the send, each assigned to a different person. The parent stays as the single thing you are tracking, while ownership of each step is clear.

A task with several subtasks, each showing a different assignee

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078498292/original/ED43ZUqrtYb6tmlxJ5gIEwVr5UQ9UXXd7Q.png?1786779167)

---

## Setting priority

Priority records how urgent a task is. Four levels are available:

1. Urgent: Needs attention now, ahead of other work.
2. High: Important and should be picked up soon.
3. Normal: Standard work in the usual order.
4. Low: Can wait, or is worth doing only when there is space.

Priority can also be left unset, which is fine for routine work.

```
Priority only helps if it is used sparingly. If most tasks on a board are marked Urgent, the field has stopped telling anyone anything.
```

Priority picker

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078498290/original/PLkzpzWnNIy0O47yyEhfA2RxfcoTC6FFmQ.png?1786779167)

To set it while creating a task, use the "Priority" control in the inline composer. To set it later, open the task, find the "Priority" property, choose a level, and save.

---

## Setting dates

The Dates property accepts either a single date or a date range, so you can record just a due date or a full start-to-finish window. The timezone the dates are being displayed in is shown alongside them, which matters when your team works across regions.

Use a single date for work that happens on or by a particular day. Use a range for work that occupies a period, such as a two-week build. On the board, a card displays whichever you have set.

Dates control open on a task, showing a range selected and the timezone label

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078498293/original/ErHsmrWAzFgQunXzZi0mmuOjLoSlK7_LTg.png?1786779167)

To set dates while creating a task, use the "Select date" control in the inline composer. To set them later:

Open the task.

Click the "Dates" property.

Pick a single date, or pick a start and an end date for a range.

Check the timezone shown beside the dates.

Save your change.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Can I assign a task to more than one person?**

Not in this release. A task has a single assignee. Use subtasks to split work between people.

**Q: Can I leave a task unassigned?**

Yes. The picker includes an option to clear the assignee. It is worth doing this only temporarily, since an unassigned task has no owner.

**Q: Why can I not find a colleague in the assignee list?**

The picker shows people with access to the Space. Check the Space has been shared with them.

**Q: Does assigning a task notify the person?**

Yes, assigning a task notifies the person

****Q: What are the priority levels?****

Low, Normal, High, and Urgent. Priority can also be left unset.

**Q: Can I create my own priority levels?**

No. The four levels are fixed. If you need another dimension of urgency, a custom field on the Space is the better route.

**Q: Can I set a start date and a due date on the same task?**

Yes. The Dates control accepts a range.

**Q: Which timezone are the dates shown in?**

The timezone displayed beside the dates on the task follows sub-account’s timezones.

---
