- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is LinkedIn Integration**

LinkedIn integration in HighLevel allows users to connect their personal profiles or business pages to the Social Planner. Once connected, you can seamlessly schedule, publish, and manage your LinkedIn posts right from the HighLevel dashboard. It streamlines social engagement, saving time and improving content visibility.

---

## **Key Benefits of Connecting LinkedIn to HighLevel**

Connecting your LinkedIn account offers powerful capabilities to boost your social media strategy:

- Schedule and publish posts to LinkedIn profiles or pages directly.
- Manage multiple accounts across social platforms in one place.
- View the connection status and token validity to maintain uptime.
- Easily reconnect or refresh access if permissions expire.
- Control user access and permissions for collaborative teams.

---

## **Configuring the LinkedIn Integration**

Before you begin setting up LinkedIn, make sure you have **admin access to the LinkedIn Page** you want to connect. The integration token is valid for approximately **60 days**, after which you’ll see a **“Reconnect” prompt** to renew access. If the connection fails due to missing permissions, the account will display a **“Permissions Missing”** status—simply follow the setup steps again to reauthorize the connection successfully.

### **Navigate to the Social Planner**

From the left sidebar, go to Marketing > Social Planner. This is where you manage all your scheduled content across connected social platforms.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044689220/original/JcKxSMZlSM3nu1Wlohn6E_ZyMReFF-Cqqg.jpeg?1744082143)

### 

### **Look for Connect Social Option**

You can access the social account connection options in three ways:

- Click **+ Socials** to open the **Connect socials** window directly.
- Click the **gear icon** to open **Social planner settings**.
- Click the **Settings** tab to open **Social planner settings**, then go to **Social accounts** and click **+ Connect Social**.

Click Connect Social for Next step to appear

### 

### **Select LinkedIn**

A popup will display all available platforms. Click Connect LinkedIn.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044689243/original/MVpazPWTR3yleUsi1sTjq5amujqJY7uRmA.jpeg?1744082216)

### **Log In to LinkedIn**

You’ll be redirected to the LinkedIn login screen. Enter your LinkedIn credentials and click Sign In.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044689247/original/ZHo-WvrJX2QHLcVjURRhw1giIbiwcpX2Cg.jpeg?1744082235)

### **Grant Permissions**

LinkedIn will ask you to authorize access to your account through LeadConnector. Click Allow to proceed.

```
Note: If you’re connecting for advertising purposes, ensure your LinkedIn login has Super Admin or Campaign Manager access to the ad account. Otherwise, the account may not appear later in Social Planner.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044689252/original/07f1i2myV_dWoA2rNnNPG8PlDAKqexH2lw.jpeg?1744082254)

### **Choose LinkedIn Profile or Page**

After granting access, select the LinkedIn profile or business page you want to connect and click Add.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044689253/original/AzyGVZdk_CfL6RK0hYpUbhq5Yo26FtKflg.png?1744082278)

### **Connection Confirmation**

Once added, the account will show as Connected in the Social Accounts section, along with type and token validity.

```
Suggestion: If you don’t see your ad account after a successful connection, check that the account is active (not archived or suspended) and that you’ve accepted LinkedIn’s Marketing Developer Terms in Campaign Manager
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044689255/original/Rg3V8lQ_c4LiJDAKmITWyV87ux_eE3GkOw.jpeg?1744082291)

---

<https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008432-why-you-should-grant-access-to-all-pages-when-connecting-a-social-account>

## 

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I connect both a LinkedIn profile and a business page at the same time?**

Yes, HighLevel allows you to connect multiple LinkedIn accounts—both personal profiles and business pages—based on available access and permissions.

**Q: What happens if my LinkedIn connection expires?**

If the token expires, you will see a “Reconnect” prompt in the Social Accounts tab. Simply click it and reauthorize via LinkedIn.

**Q: Why does it say “Permissions Missing” for my page?**

This usually means your LinkedIn account does not have admin rights on the page or certain permissions were not granted during authorization. Reconnect and ensure full access is provided. For ad accounts specifically, missing permissions often mean your user role in LinkedIn Campaign Manager isn’t sufficient. Try reconnecting after updating your role, clearing your cache, or using an incognito window.

**Q: Can I schedule LinkedIn posts for both personal and company pages?**

Yes, once both are connected, you can select where to publish each post during the content creation process.

**Q: Is there a limit to how many LinkedIn accounts I can connect?**

While there’s no fixed limit in HighLevel, the number of accounts you manage should align with your subscription tier and admin permissions.

title_en: How to Reschedule an Email Campaign (Email Builder)
source_md:
Rescheduling an email campaign lets you change the planned delivery date or time without creating a new campaign. HighLevel supports rescheduling for Simple Schedule, Batch Schedule, and RSS Schedule campaigns.

```
TLDR: If a campaign is scheduled but has not been sent, go to Marketing > Emails > Campaigns > Email Campaigns, open the campaign's action menu, and select Reschedule. Update the schedule, click Save, then click Schedule to create the bulk actions. Do this at least 60 minutes before the scheduled send time.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Email Campaign Rescheduling?](#What-is-Email-Campaign-Rescheduling?)
- [Key Benefits of Email Campaign Rescheduling](#Key-Benefits-of-Email-Campaign-Rescheduling)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#Prerequisites-and-Limitations)
- [How To Reschedule an Email Campaign](#How-To-Reschedule-an-Email-Campaign)
- [Reschedule From the Campaign Editor](#Reschedule-From-the-Campaign-Editor)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Email Campaign Rescheduling?**

Email campaign rescheduling lets you change the scheduled delivery date or time for a campaign that has not yet been sent. You can access the rescheduling option directly from the Email Campaigns page or return to the scheduling step while editing the campaign.

Rescheduling is available for:

- Simple Schedule campaigns
- Batch Schedule campaigns
- RSS Schedule campaigns

---

## **Key Benefits of Email Campaign Rescheduling**

Rescheduling gives you control over an upcoming campaign when its original delivery time no longer works.

- **Change an upcoming send:** Move a scheduled campaign to a different future date or time.
- **Keep the existing campaign:** Adjust the delivery schedule without creating a replacement campaign.
- **Access the schedule quickly:** Use the campaign action menu to open the scheduling step directly.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Before rescheduling a campaign, confirm that it is still scheduled and that enough time remains before its execution time.

- The campaign must already be scheduled for **Reschedule** to appear in its action menu.
- Complete the reschedule at least **60 minutes before the campaign's execution time**.
- Allow enough time for the system to process the updated schedule. Avoid relying on last-minute schedule changes.

> **Important:** Saving changes does not complete the reschedule. You must also click **Schedule** so HighLevel can create the new bulk actions for the revised schedule.

---

## **How To Reschedule an Email Campaign**

Use the Email Campaigns page when you need to change the delivery schedule of a campaign that has already been scheduled.

1. From the **Sub-Account view**, select **Marketing** in the left navigation.
2. Select **Emails**.
3. Select **Campaigns**.
4. Open **Email Campaigns**.
5. Locate the scheduled campaign you want to change.
6. Open the campaign's action menu.
7. Select **Reschedule**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082416312/original/j-Z0FCXafkVC8ux8J50u38-xMm6BIJ22iQ.png?1790962842)

8. HighLevel opens the campaign editor directly at the scheduling step.
9. Update the campaign's schedule as needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082416725/original/99lyKcxm_2UEs56P3O9Km-ZGRhwmaUC1fw.png?1790963240)

10. Click **Save** to save your changes.
11. Click **Schedule** to complete the reschedule and create the new bulk actions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082416807/original/6WtDEKBKXTky_n39l9pCqGb2-B8oOKXNCw.png?1790963298)

> **Important:** Do not stop after clicking **Save**. Your changes may be saved, but the new bulk actions are not created until you also click **Schedule**.

---

## **Reschedule From the Campaign Editor**

If you are already editing the campaign, you can return to its scheduling controls without going back to the Email Campaigns list.

1. From the campaign editor, click **Send or Schedule**.
2. Update the campaign's scheduling details.
3. Click **Save**.
4. Click **Schedule** to complete the reschedule and create the new bulk actions.

Remember to complete the change at least 60 minutes before the campaign's execution time and allow enough time for the system to process the updated schedule.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How close to the send time can I reschedule an email campaign?**  
A: Complete the reschedule at least 60 minutes before the campaign's execution time. Avoid waiting until the last minute so the system has enough time to process the updated schedule.

**Q: Why didn't my new schedule take effect after I clicked Save?**  
A: Saving keeps your changes, but it does not complete the reschedule. Click **Schedule** after saving so HighLevel can create the new bulk actions for the revised schedule.

**Q: Can I reschedule a campaign while I am already editing it?**  
A: Yes. Click **Send or Schedule** from the campaign editor, update the scheduling details, click **Save**, and then click **Schedule**.

**Q: Which scheduled campaign types can be rescheduled?**  
A: Rescheduling is supported for Simple Schedule, Batch Schedule, and RSS Schedule campaigns.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Send or Schedule an Email Campaign in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215263)
- [How to Pause, Resume, or Cancel a Scheduled Email Campaign](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003462)
- [How to Batch Schedule Email Campaign(s) in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215379-how-to-batch-schedule-email-campaigns)
- [Email Sending & Scheduling Options in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215384-different-email-sending-delivery-method-s-send-now-schedule-batch-rss-schedule)
- [How-to Send RSS Email Campaign(s)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001215372-how-to-send-rss-email-campaign-s-)

title_en: Webinar Video Analytics
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/Pu\_RMwTRg\_8?&wmode=opaque)

Webinar Video Analytics brings data-rich dashboards to your live, on-demand, and recurring webinars, so you can see exactly where viewers drop off, which sessions outperform, and how to fine-tune timing for maximum conversions.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Webinar Video Analytics?](#What-is-Webinar-Video-Analytics?)
- [Key Benefits of Webinar Video Analytics](#Key-Benefits-of-Webinar-Video-Analytics)
- [On-Demand Webinar Analytics](#On-Demand-Webinar-Analytics)
- [Live Webinar Analytics](#Live-Webinar-Analytics)
- [Recurring Webinar Analytics](#Recurring-Webinar-Analytics)
- [How To Set Up Webinar Video Analytics](#How-To-Set-Up-Webinar-Video-Analytics)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## **What is Webinar Video Analytics?**

Webinar Video Analytics is a new reporting area inside HighLevel’s Site Analytics suite that visualizes attendee behavior across every webinar format—live, on-demand, and recurring. By layering time-based graphs, engagement counters, and per-session breakdowns, it turns raw viewer activity into actionable insight you can use to grow registrations and revenue.

---

## **Key Benefits of Webinar Video Analytics**

- Pinpoint engagement peaks and drop-off moments to improve content flow.
- Compare registrations vs. actual attendance to gauge promotional effectiveness.
- Track repeat attendees in a series to spot loyal fans and high-value topics.
- Optimize scheduling with trend lines that reveal the best-performing days and times.
- Share visual reports with clients or teammates for quick, data-backed decisions.

---

## **On-Demand Webinar Analytics**

On-demand dashboards focus on pre-recorded sessions that prospects can watch at any time. They include:

- **Total Views:** cumulative play count.
- **Average Watch Time:** mean minutes watched per viewer.
- **Engagement Events:** Plays, Pauses, Completion %.
- **Drop-off Analysis:** the timestamp where most viewers exit, plus the % who leave there.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055529185/original/U67jkNdctcDF8wMaCRn3kY1lb6UuHU3D8g.png?1759931253)

These metrics reveal whether your evergreen content still resonates and where to inject stronger calls-to-action.

---

## **Live Webinar Analytics**

Live analytics zero in on scheduled broadcasts and real-time attendance:

- **Total Registrations vs. Total Attendees**: instantly spot no-show gaps.
- **Peak Live Viewers:** highest concurrent audience (displayed on the timeline graph).
- **Engagement Spikes:** plays, pauses, and chat bursts mapped to the broadcast clock.

Use this data to refine reminder workflows and interaction moments.

---

## **Recurring Webinar Analytics**

Recurring analytics aggregate data across every session in a series:

- **Series Overview:** Registrations, Attendees, Repeat Attendees, Avg Attendance %, Avg Conversion %, Session Count.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055525004/original/C7w0i7T-iBh97y2c3U-T1ZJqKCfLueC_-g.png?1759929536)
- **Trend Graphs**: per-session registration and attendance lines to highlight momentum or fatigue.

This bird’s-eye view helps you choose the best cadence and topics for always-on webinar programs.

---

## **How To Set Up Webinar Video Analytics**

Harnessing the new dashboards takes only a few clicks, but proper setup ensures complete, accurate data.

1. Create or import your webinar (Live, On-Demand, or Recurring) under Sites → Webinars.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055524224/original/vEZ1WGMnNmzQLv7-w8y34e2W-c68TwvXAw.png?1759929193)

```
Need help - See the Complete Guide to Creating Webinars!
```

```
IMPORTANT: Publish the registration pages and confirm that your form feeds into Contacts; this ties viewer activity to CRM records. Run or release your session. HighLevel automatically records every play, pause, and exit event.
```

2. Access your analytics: Sites → Analytics → Webinars. Choose the On-Demand, Live, or Recurring tab, then pick a date range in the upper-right filter.

3. You can also hover over any graph point to view exact counts and percentages.

4. Use Quick Filters (e.g., device, location) to drill down without altering the underlying widget.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055524545/original/LCbvI7hPdzQlIGAqdyAExsd40NbT8jAAdQ.png?1759929375)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to add any tracking code to use Webinar Video Analytics?**

No. Tracking is native to HighLevel webinars and is enabled automatically once the webinar is published.

**Q: How soon after a webinar ends are the metrics available?**

Live webinar data populates in near-real time; final counts and completion percentages are fully processed within 10–15 minutes after the session ends.

**Q: Can I segment analytics by device type or traffic source?**

Yes. Use the Quick Filter button at the top of the dashboard to filter widgets by device, UTM source, or any custom field.

**Q: What qualifies as a “Repeat Attendee” in a series?**

Any contact that attends two or more sessions within the same recurring webinar series during the selected date range.

**Q: Will analytics track a viewer who watches the same on-demand webinar twice?**

Yes. Each playback increments Total Views, while unique contacts contribute only once to Unique Viewers.

**Q: Do you know if I can export webinar analytics?**

Click the three-dot menu in the top-right corner of a widget or table and choose CSV or PDF export to share with stakeholders.

**Q: How can I trigger automations when someone reaches a certain watch percentage?**

Use the Video Tracking workflow trigger and set the percentage threshold (e.g., 50 % watched).

**Q: Do recurring webinar graphs adjust automatically when I add new sessions?**

Yes. The Series Overview and Trend Graphs update as soon as a new session’s data is collected.

title_en: How to Automate Review Posts in Social Planner
source_md:
Social Planner's **Review Post Automation** lets you automatically share customer reviews from Google Business Profile or Facebook on your connected social media accounts.

You can choose which reviews to share, customize their appearance, and schedule when they should be published—without manually creating posts for every review.

This helps you showcase customer feedback and maintain an active social media presence.

**Who is this for?** Business owners, agencies, and marketers who want to automatically share customer reviews on social media.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/Zet1BPssExM?&wmode=opaque)

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [How to Set Up Review Post Automation](#How-to-Set-Up-Review-Post-Automation)
- [How Does Review Posting Frequency Work?](#How-Does-Review-Posting-Frequency-Work?)
- [How to Manage Review Post Automations](#How-to-Manage-Review-Post-Automations)
- [Important Things to Know](#Important-Things-to-Know)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Before You Begin**

Make sure you have:

1. Connected your **Google Business Profile or Facebook Page** to HighLevel.
2. Connected the social media accounts where you want to publish reviews.
3. Confirmed that customer reviews are available under **Reputation > Reviews**.

```
Note: Review sources are managed through Reputation integrations, while social publishing accounts are connected through Social Planner.
```

---

## **How to Set Up Review Post Automation**

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner**.
2. Click **New Post > Post Reviews**.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084946972/original/b9oOKliLGbMAxvaUHZxm9C2Tb8VCmlKtbA.png?1793799206)**Select review sources:** Choose Google Business Profile or Facebook and set the star rating range for reviews you want to share.
3. **Choose social accounts:** Select the connected social media accounts where the reviews should be published.
4. **Set the posting schedule:**

   - Choose how many reviews to publish per scheduled execution.
   - Under **When should we send?**, select **Every day**, **Every week**, or **Every month**.
   - Select your preferred publishing time.  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084947066/original/rP5WOTo59gPUrYhPTrRH6zykLA6Tw1RP8w.png?1793799262)
5. **Customize your review posts:**

   - Choose or upload background images (JPEG/PNG, 1:1 ratio, maximum 5 MB).
   - Add a custom caption or use the review content.
   - Display the customer's full name, first name, or initials.
   - Customize fonts, colors, and opacity.
   - Complete the setup using the available confirmation option.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084947440/original/zhU2Dwe0rwRMuSDUIzWVzuur9fsnSXD_Sw.png?1793799453)

Your automation is now configured to publish eligible reviews according to your selected schedule.

---

## **How Does Review Posting Frequency Work?**

Posting frequency determines **when the automation runs**, while the maximum post count determines **how many eligible reviews can be published each time**.

**Example:**

Suppose you configure:

- **Frequency:** Every week
- **Time:** Tuesday at 11:00 AM
- **Maximum posts:** 3

Every Tuesday at 11:00 AM, the automation can publish up to three eligible reviews.

This means **three reviews during one scheduled execution**, not three separate posting days.

The same logic applies to daily and monthly schedules.

```
Note: If fewer eligible reviews are available, fewer posts may be published. If no eligible reviews are available, that scheduled execution is skipped.
```

---

## **How to Manage Review Post Automations**

1. Navigate to **Marketing > Social Planner > Content > Review**.
2. Find the automation you want to manage.
3. Use the available actions:

   - **Pause:** Pause the automation.
   - **Edit:** Update its settings.
   - **Delete:** Remove the automation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084947349/original/t9zZM6cLJYLYvRJBiA_eabS6_dt09uY0Wg.png?1793799409)

---

## **Important Things to Know**

- **New Google reviews only:** Google reviews published before the automation was created are not considered.
- **Written reviews required:** Reviews containing only star ratings without written feedback are skipped.
- **Rating filters apply:** Only reviews matching your selected star rating range are eligible.
- **No eligible reviews:** If none are available when the automation runs, that execution is skipped. A repeating automation can check again at a later scheduled execution.
- **Timezone:** Publishing follows your configured local timezone.
- **Connections matter:** Review sources and social publishing accounts must remain connected for the automation to work.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Why aren't my reviews being posted?**

Check whether new eligible reviews are available under **Reputation > Reviews**, verify your rating filters, and ensure that the review source and publishing accounts remain connected.

**Can I publish reviews received before creating the automation?**

Google reviews published before the automation creation date are not eligible under the documented Review Post workflow.

**Can I change the review post design?**

Yes. You can customize backgrounds, captions, customer name formats, fonts, colors, and opacity.

**Can I pause or edit my automation?**

Yes. Navigate to **Social Planner > Content > Review** and use the available management options.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started – Setup Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005063)
- [Integrating Multiple Review Platforms](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004584)
- [How to Integrate Google Business Profile](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001222899)

title_en: Audit Logs in Funnels, Websites, Webinars & Stores
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/\_L2IIkLCLr0?&wmode=opaque)

Track every change with confidence. This article explains how to use the new Audit Logs feature available in Funnels, Websites, Webinars, and Stores. It provides visibility into user activity for greater transparency and accountability.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Audit Logging?](#What-is-Audit-Logging?)
- [Key Benefits of Audit Logging](#Key-Benefits-of-Audit-Logging)
- [How to Access Audit Logs](#How-to-Access-Audit-Logs)
- [Audit Log Coverage by Module](#Audit-Log-Coverage-by-Module)
- [Tracked Actions and Event Types](#Tracked-Actions-and-Event-Types)
- [Filtering and Navigation Tips](#Filtering-and-Navigation-Tips)
- [Data Retention Policy](#Data-Retention-Policy)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Audit Logging?**

Audit Logging captures a history of user actions within your HighLevel assets. This gives you a full trail of changes—who did what, when, and where—making it easier to troubleshoot, improve workflows, and maintain compliance.

---

## **Key Benefits of Audit Logging**

Audit logs help teams stay accountable, resolve issues faster, and manage digital assets more effectively by offering a clear historical record of changes.

- Get full transparency into edits and deletions
- Improve team accountability by tracking who made changes
- Troubleshoot errors by reviewing specific action history
- Ensure compliance for regulated industries
- Isolate issues using filters by module or action type
- Retain logs securely for 60 days

---

## **How to Access Audit Logs**

Audit Logs are located in the Settings area of your account and are organized by module. Each module has its own audit trail and filtering system, allowing you to track actions independently across Funnels, Websites, Webinars, and Stores.

To access Audit Logs:

1. Navigate to **Settings > Audit Logs** from your left-hand menu.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066487592/original/l8AlLAodg9UCk_NDWaSgOqp0Hqx4ZrJfRQ.png?1773051824)
2. Use the tabbed navigation or icons to switch between modules:

   - Funnels
   - Websites
   - Webinars
   - Stores (eCommerce)
3. Review the logs listed for the selected module.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066487837/original/rMwwraT4OXQat9Myi-I-95_-D2fWPS75Lw.png?1773051956)

---

## **Audit Log Coverage by Module**

Each module maintains its own set of logs and filters, so you can focus on the specific type of asset you’re working with.

- **Funnels:** Logs funnel settings changes, step edits, split tests, and deletions.
- **Websites:** Tracks updates to pages, structures, and content.
- **Webinars:** Captures scheduling, edits, and webinar configuration updates.
- **Stores:** Records eCommerce changes like store configuration and product management.

This modular approach ensures the audit data remains relevant and easy to interpret for each asset type.

---

## **Tracked Actions and Event Types**

HighLevel currently tracks the following types of actions across supported modules:

- Folder Delete
- Move to Folder
- Funnel Delete
- Funnel Settings Change
- Funnel Settings Change (with domain removed)
- Step Edit
- Step Reorder
- Step Delete
- Step Restore Variation
- Step Delete Variation
- Step Choose Split Test Winner
- Stats Reset
- Page Edit

These logs include timestamps, user IDs, and action types to help you reconstruct exactly what happened and when.

---

## **Investigate deleted Page Builder assets**

Audit Logs now records a **Deleted** entry when key saved Page Builder assets are removed in Funnels, Websites, Stores, or Webinars.

**Assets covered**

- Section Templates
- Global Sections
- Universal Sections
- Element Templates
- Universal Element Templates

**What the log includes**

- Asset name
- Asset ID

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066487214/original/iyLuRdD_Saxb9J5lzzvCxxiwn1_R8C_DFw.png?1773051639)

---

## **Filtering and Navigation Tips**

Audit Logs include filters that make it easy to locate specific events or actions. Each module has independent filtering options.

You can filter logs by:

- **Module** – Funnels, Websites, Webinars, or Stores
- **Action Type** – e.g., Deleted, Updated, Created
- **Date/Time Range** – View actions within a specific period (limited to the last 60 days)

Tips for navigation:

- Use action filters to locate deletions, edits, or structural changes
- Use date ranges to isolate events related to a campaign launch
- Quickly switch between modules using the tabs/icons at the top of the interface

---

## **Data Retention Policy**

Audit Logs are retained for a **rolling 60-day period**. After that, records are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

Important:

- Logs older than 60 days are **not retrievable**
- Consider exporting or recording key actions for long-term compliance needs
- Set internal review processes to capture logs before they expire

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I export audit logs?**

Yes. You can export Audit Logs to CSV using the **Export** option on the Audit Logs page. See [Export Audit Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007611-exporting-audit-logs)

**Q: How long are logs stored?**

Logs are retained for 60 days and then automatically purged from the system.

**Q: Can I search logs by user?**

Username-based filtering is available. Click on **Select Users**from the filters banner on top.

**Q: Do deleted funnels or steps show up in the audit logs?**

Yes, deletion events are recorded, including funnel and step deletions.

---

### **Next Steps**

- Check your logs regularly to monitor changes across digital assets
- Implement an internal workflow to review logs after key updates
- Share this feature with your team to improve accountability
- Stay informed about upcoming expansions to audit tracking

title_en: Email Tracking for LC Email
source_md:
Email Analytics

LC Email Open & Click Tracking

Learn how to enable or disable open and click tracking for your dedicated sending domain — and understand what engagement data you'll gain access to.

Important

Email tracking is **ONLY** available if you are using LC Email. This feature is not available for any other email provider, such as Mailgun, Gmail, or others.

## What is Email Tracking?

Email tracking refers to the ability to monitor and record specific actions recipients take when they interact with your emails. This includes tracking when an email is opened (**open tracking**) and when links within the email are clicked (**click tracking**).

By enabling these features, you gain valuable insights into the effectiveness of your email campaigns — understanding recipient engagement and optimizing your marketing strategies based on real-time data.

![Email tracking overview animation](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031768039/original/_LJPe1CEkFO09bZyqB0APRn_6V_fjs2PRw.gif?1724785224)

## Why You Should Use Email Tracking

Email tracking provides valuable insights into how your audience engages with your emails, allowing you to refine your marketing strategies and improve overall campaign performance. By tracking opens and clicks, you can identify which content resonates most, optimize your messaging, and increase conversions.

Real-World Example

Imagine you're running an email campaign to promote a new product launch:

With email tracking enabled, you can see which recipients opened your email and clicked on the product link. If a significant number of people clicked the link but didn't complete the purchase, that data prompts you to follow up with a targeted email — perhaps offering a limited-time discount or additional information — ultimately driving more sales.

Without email tracking, you'd be left guessing about your audience's behavior, missing opportunities to optimize your campaign.

## Where To Find Email Tracking

A

Log in to your Sub-Account

Open the platform and navigate to your sub-account dashboard.

B

Click on Settings

![Settings navigation in sub-account](https://jumpshare.com/share/Qkoo3Kve68ZSWEuN1Fe6+/Screen+Shot+2025-09-17+at+6.50.26+PM.png)

C

Click on the Email Services tab

![Email Services tab in Settings](https://jumpshare.com/share/tICDA3zJEutya9XRVaYS+/Screen+Shot+2025-09-17+at+6.51.07+PM.png)

## How To Setup Email Tracking

Setting up email tracking is just a few clicks. Follow the steps below to enable or disable open and click tracking for your LC Email dedicated sending domain.

Prerequisite

To set up email tracking, you'll need to have already configured a dedicated LC Email sending domain.

[Learn how to set up a dedicated LC Email sending domain →](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001226115)

Go To Email Settings

Navigation

Settings → Email Services → LC Email selected → Dedicated Domain and IP

Navigate to the **Email Services** tab in your sub-account settings. Make sure you have LC Email selected, then click the **Dedicated Domain and IP** button.

![Dedicated Domain and IP button in Email Services settings](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155031768466/original/aKaW4hSM6jlbYQ8YsuFx7f13KLU99ns07g.jpg?1724785936)

Open Domain Settings

Click the **three-dot menu** (⋯) in the top corner of your LC Email dedicated sending domain card. From the dropdown, select **Domain Settings**.

![Three-dot menu on domain card with Domain Settings option](https://jumpshare.com/share/D5ThPjATnIaBXxUOZXPQ+/Screen+Shot+2025-09-17+at+6.57.31+PM.png)

Enable or Disable Email Tracking

From the Domain Settings pop-up, toggle **Click Tracking** and **Open Tracking** on or off according to your preference. Changes apply immediately to emails sent through that domain.

![Domain Settings pop-up showing Click Tracking and Open Tracking toggles](https://jumpshare.com/share/NGK1EfwbzY1gcNWdgcCq+/Screen+Shot+2025-09-17+at+7.02.07+PM.png)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What type of data is collected when tracking email activity?

Engagement data is collected and attributed to contacts in your sub-account records. Within email tracking analytics, you'll see the following event types per contact:

Email Sent, Email Delivered, Email Opened, Email Clicked (link inside the email), Email Bounced, Complained (marked as spam), Unsubscribed, and Email Failed to Send.

Q: Can I track email activity if I am using Mailgun to send emails?

No. Email tracking analytics is only available when LC Email is your SMTP provider. If your sub-account is configured to send through Mailgun, Gmail, or any other external provider, tracking data will not be available.

Q: Can I track emails sent from my Gmail email address?

No. You need to send emails from an LC Email dedicated sending domain to track email activity and engagement. You can still use your Gmail address as a "From Name" when sending emails, but tracking is not supported when Google is your SMTP provider.

Q: What happens if I turn off email tracking?

If you turn off email tracking you will no longer have visibility into engagement data such as opens, clicks, bounces, and more. We recommend keeping email tracking enabled so you maintain full visibility into which contacts are engaging with your email campaigns.

Q: Can I configure tracking settings differently for each sending domain?

Yes. Tracking settings are configured at the individual domain level via Domain Settings. If you have multiple dedicated sending domains, you can enable or disable open and click tracking independently for each one.

Q: Does enabling click tracking change the links in my emails?

Yes — when click tracking is enabled, links in your emails are wrapped through a tracking redirect so clicks can be recorded. This is standard practice for email marketing analytics and does not affect the final destination your recipients are sent to when they click a link.

title_en: How Product Deletion Works
source_md:
This help document walks you through how to delete products in your account. You’ll learn the different ways you can delete a product, how bulk deletion works, and which types of products are protected from deletion to ensure ongoing processes aren’t disrupted.

## What does this feature do?

- [What does this feature do?](#What-does-this-feature-do?)
- [What do I need to use this feature?](#What-do-I-need-to-use-this-feature?)
- [How to delete a product](#How-to-delete-a-product)
  - [Option 1: From the Products List](#Option-1%3A-From-the-Products-List)
  - [Option 2: From the Product Details page](#Option-2%3A-From-the-Product-Details-page)
- [How to bulk delete products](#How-to-bulk-delete-products)
- [Restrictions: what you cannot delete (and why)](#Restrictions%3A-what-you-cannot-delete-(and-why))
  - [SaaS products (SaaS Plans & Agency Plans)](#SaaS-products-(SaaS-Plans-&-Agency-Plans))
  - [Calendars products](#Calendars-products)
  - [Memberships/Communities products](#Memberships/Communities-products)
  - [Prices & variants (SaaS, Calendars, Memberships/Communities)](#Prices-&-variants-(SaaS,-Calendars,-Memberships/Communities))
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

## What does this feature do?

Product deletion lets you permanently remove products you no longer need. To protect billing and customer access, the system blocks deletion for certain product types or when active/past\_due subscriptions exist. In bulk actions, only eligible products are removed; protected items are skipped with clear messaging.

Please note that deleting products doesn't necessarily delete the products that are already sold i.e. transactions, orders, invoices, subscriptions, etc. that already have this product, will continue to do so. It would only block future purchases of or actions on the product.

## 

## What do I need to use this feature?

- **Permissions:** Role with **Products → Delete** (and **Products → View**).
- **Navigation:** **Payments → Products** (list and details pages).
- **Awareness:** Deletion is **permanent** and cannot be undone. Ensure the product isn’t required in active checkouts or by Calendars/Memberships or active SaaS subscription.

## 

## How to delete a product

### Option 1: From the Products List

1. Go to **Payments → Products**.
2. Locate the product.
3. Click the **Delete (trash)** icon.
4. Confirm in the dialog.

### Option 2: From the Product Details page (Price / Variant deletion)

1. Go to **Payments → Products → Edit**
2. Click **Delete Price**. Note - This would only work if there is more than 1 price / variant available of the product, the last price / variant cannot be deleted.

> **Note:** If the delete control is disabled or you see a message about eligibility, review the “Restrictions” section below.

## 

## How to bulk delete products

1. Go to **Payments → Products**.
2. Select multiple products with the checkboxes (or **Select All**).
3. Click **Delete**under **Bulk Actions**.
4. Review the confirmation message and confirm.

**Confirmation messages (what you’ll see):**

- *“Are you sure you want to delete these products? This action cannot be undone. Only products eligible for deletion will be deleted.”*
- If a fixed count is shown (e.g., 10 selected):  
  *“Are you sure you want to delete these 10 products? This action cannot be undone. Only products eligible for deletion will be deleted.”*

Only eligible products are deleted; protected products remain.

## 

## Restrictions: what you cannot delete (and why)

To safeguard billing and feature integrity, the following rules apply:

### SaaS products (SaaS Plans & Agency Plans)

- **Blocked if any active or past\_due subscriptions exist** on the product.
- **Allowed** only when **no** active/past\_due subscriptions exist.
- If blocked, the delete control is disabled and the product remains.

### Calendars products

- Products created by **Calendars** cannot be deleted.
- The **Delete** CTA is hidden.

### Memberships/Communities products

- Products created by **Memberships/Communities** cannot be deleted.
- The **Delete** CTA is hidden.

### Prices & variants (SaaS, Calendars, Memberships/Communities)

- **Saved** prices/variants: **cannot** be deleted; the delete icon is disabled.
- **Unsaved** (just added, not saved yet) prices/variants: **can** be removed.

## 

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Why is the delete button not visible against my product?**  
A: It’s either a Calendars or Memberships/Communities product (never deletable), or it’s a SaaS product with active/past\_due subscriptions.

**Q: How do I delete a SaaS product that’s blocked?**  
A: First resolve or cancel all **active/past\_due** subscriptions tied to that product. Once none remain, the product can be deleted.

**Q: What happens in bulk delete if my selection includes protected products?**  
A: Only eligible products are deleted. Protected items are skipped, and the confirmation dialog clarifies this behavior.

**Q: Can I delete a price/variant on a protected product?**  
A: You can remove it only if it has **not** been saved yet. Saved prices/variants on SaaS, Calendars, or Memberships/Communities products cannot be deleted.

**Q: Is deletion reversible?**  
A: No. Deletion is permanent. Confirm dependencies before proceeding.

**Q: I deleted a product from the CRM's Payments tab, but why is it still appearing in my account?**

A: Products linked to an external payment gateway (like Stripe) require dual deletion. When you delete the product in the platform, it removes the local record but often fails to remove the corresponding product or plan stored in your payment gateway.

To completely and permanently remove the product:

1. Delete from the Platform: Delete the item from Payments $\rightarrow$ Products.
2. Delete from the Gateway: Log directly into your external payment processor's dashboard (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) and manually delete or archive the corresponding product/plan from their inventory.

---

title_en: Your Digital Storefront: How to Turn Google Searches Into Booked Dental Patients
source_md:
When someone searches “dentist near me,” your Google Business Profile (GBP) is often the first — and sometimes only — impression you get. It’s your digital storefront. If it’s missing information, outdated, or lacking reviews, you’re losing patients before they even click.

This playbook walks you through how to fully optimize your dental clinic’s profile — and how to automate the workflows that keep it fresh, trusted, and driving bookings.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Step 1: Claim and Complete Your Google Business Profile](#Step-1%3A-Claim-and-Complete-Your-Google-Business-Profile)
- [Step 2: Choose the Right Categories](#Step-2%3A-Choose-the-Right-Categories)
- [Step 3: Nail the Business Info](#Step-3%3A-Nail-the-Business-Info)
- [Step 4: Write a Trust-Building Clinic Description](#Step-4%3A-Write-a-Trust-Building-Clinic-Description)
- [Step 5: Add High-Quality Photos](#Step-5%3A-Add-High-Quality-Photos)
- [Step 6: List Your Services Clearly](#Step-6%3A-List-Your-Services-Clearly)

- [Step 9: Keep Your Profile Active with Posts](#Step-9%3A-Keep-Your-Profile-Active-with-Posts)
- [Final Word](#Final-Word)

---

### **Step 1: Claim and Complete Your Google Business Profile**

- Go to [Google Business Profile Manager](https://business.google.com/)
- Use your official clinic email (ideally matching your domain)
- Search for your clinic name

  - If found: Claim it
  - If not: Create it using accurate NAP info (Name, Address, Phone)

> Tip: Make sure your NAP is identical on your website, Facebook, Yelp, and insurance directories.

[**How to verify your Google listing?**](https://support.google.com/business/answer/7107242?hl=en)

**Claim or create a Google Business Profile**

---

### **Step 2: Choose the Right Categories**

Primary Category:

- **Dentist**

Secondary Categories (only if applicable):

- Cosmetic Dentist
- Emergency Dental Service
- Pediatric Dentist
- Dental Implants Periodontist
- Teeth Whitening Service

Avoid adding categories that don’t match your actual offerings. Irrelevant tags can reduce your profile’s ranking.

**Understand how local search works**

**Improve your local ranking on Google**

---

### **Step 3: Nail the Business Info**

Check that your profile includes:

- Business Name (brand-consistent, no extra keywords)
- Address (Map-pinned and consistent with your site)
- Business Phone Number (no personal numbers)
- Website URL (ideally your GHL booking page or service funnel)
- Hours (accurate — especially for holidays or emergency availability)

**Edit your business description**

---

### **Step 4: Write a Trust-Building Clinic Description**

Use this structure:

- Who you serve (families, professionals, kids)
- What you specialize in (gentle care, cosmetic dentistry, same-day crowns)
- What makes you different (comfort-first experience, sedation options, insurance accepted)

**Example:** "At Riverside Family Dental, we offer complete care in a warm, welcoming environment. From gentle cleanings and Invisalign to same-day emergency care, our team serves families and working professionals in San Antonio with advanced, compassionate dentistry."

---

### **Step 5: Add High-Quality Photos**

According to Google, listings with photos get:

- 42% more direction requests
- 35% more click-throughs to websites

Include:

- Exterior (entrance, signage)
- Reception area
- Operatories and dental tech
- Staff group photos (smiling, professional)
- Before/after smile transformations (with consent)

Keep them bright, professional, and updated quarterly.

**Add photos to your Business Profile**

**Business Profile photo guidelines**

---

### **Step 6: List Your Services Clearly**

Break down each offer:

- Dental Cleaning & Exam – $99 New Patient Offer
- Emergency Appointment – Available Same Day
- Invisalign Consult – Free, Includes 3D Scan
- Teeth Whitening – Packages starting at $199

Use GHL to include your funnel or calendar link directly in service descriptions.

---

### **Step 7: Enable Messaging**

Turn on the "Chat" feature so patients can reach you directly through GBP.

- Use GHL’s unified inbox to respond in real time
- Set up an auto-reply like: “Thanks for messaging [Clinic Name]! We’ll get back to you shortly or you can book here: [Link]”

[**Learn how to integrate your GMB profile with GHL CRM**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001222899-how-to-integrate-your-google-business-profile-formerly-gmb-into-the-crm)

---

### **Step 8: Collect Reviews Automatically with GHL**

- Use GHL workflows to trigger a review request after every completed appointment
- Personalize by treatment type (e.g., “How was your Invisalign consult?”)
- Send via SMS with a direct Google review link

> GHL also lets you monitor and respond to reviews from the same dashboard you manage messages, bookings, and contacts.

### **Step 9: Keep Your Profile Active with Posts**

Google favors active profiles. Use GHL’s Social Planner to:

- Post tips (“3 foods that stain your teeth”), promos (“Whitening sale this week”), or FAQs
- Schedule 1–2 updates per week
- Include a call-to-action like “Book Now” or “Claim Offer” with your calendar link

---

### **Final Word**

Your Google Business Profile isn’t just a listing. It’s your 24/7 marketing assistant — and a high-converting lead source. With the right optimization and the power of GHL behind it, it becomes a booking engine.

Keep it accurate. Keep it active. Let GHL automate the rest.

Next up: Lead generation funnels that turn interest into appointments — without phone tag or friction.

title_en: How to Modify Existing Subscriptions
source_md:
## Overview

Subscriptions can be updated to reflect changes in **products, quantities, or subscription start / end dates**. This helps manage customer needs without cancelling and recreating subscriptions, while keeping billing dates consistent.

## What does this feature do?

The **Modify Subscription** option allows businesses to:

- Add additional products to an existing subscription, provided they share the same billing frequency and currency.
- Remove products so they no longer appear in future billing cycles.
- Adjust the quantity of any product in the subscription (between 1–1000).
- Edit subscription dates:

  - Change the start date if the subscription is scheduled but not yet active.
  - Update the end date for active subscriptions.
- Preview all changes and updated totals before saving.
- The feature currently doesn't allow to prorate the charges, that functionality is coming soon.

---

## What do I need to use this feature?

- Access to **Payments → Subscriptions**.
- A subscription that is in **scheduled, trialing** or **active** status.
- Supported payment providers: **Stripe, Square, NMI, Authorize**

---

## How to modify a subscription

### 

### **Step 1: Access the subscription**

1. Go to **Payments → Subscriptions**.
2. Select the subscription to be modified.
3. Open the menu and click **Update**.
4. Alternatively, you can also open the **Subscription Details** page and view the **Update** option under **Actions**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052169881/original/NrbU-k4ekQ9mhTSx6Ch6YnkZjaLAQcQJhg.png?1755866685)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052167816/original/Jr2IPswjkQ5QVV08f10ImLLBsaQ3K1fDcQ.png?1755865362)

### 

### **Step 2: Make changes**

- To **add a product**, click the**'****+'** button. Products available will match the billing frequency of the subscription.
- To **remove a product**, use the **delete icon** next to the product name.
- To **update quantities**, adjust the number in the **Q****uantity** field.
- To **edit dates**, select the **Start Date** (for Scheduled subscriptions) or update the **End Date** (for Active subscriptions).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052167853/original/5AL29N50Z2_q8TKy3nHmVy9p3C1saefPig.png?1755865395)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052167887/original/RweRJcwNqHRRIk61ZuwIEVca8H1yZTeRlg.png?1755865428)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052167876/original/1u91FfeQwL9IHKr2KRTJAtvBEreQ8yY9nQ.png?1755865415)

### 

### **Step 3: Review and save**

- A preview will display updated products, quantities, dates, and new total amounts.
- Confirm the changes to update the subscription.
- The new settings will apply from the next billing cycle onwards.  
  Note: Functionality to prorate charges is coming soon. Currently the new total would apply on the next charge date.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052167870/original/qsI8GhdSPkukJY_jtJQkGFeIYaIzD03HRw.png?1755865408)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Does changing a product or quantity affect past transactions?**  
No, past transactions remain unchanged. Updates only apply to future billing cycles.

**What happens to the charge date when changes are made?**  
The charge date does not change. All updates take effect on the same billing schedule.

**Can multiple products be added at once?**  
Yes, as long as they share the same billing frequency.

**Where can modification history be found?**  
All changes are logged under the **Subscription Details page** for reference and auditing.

**What happens if the product has a trial period and is now being added to a Subscription?**

- Trial periods would be skipped or not considered if a product is added to an ongoing 'Active' Subscription or if Quantities of the product are changed for an ongoing 'Active' Subscription.
- If the Subscription is in 'Trial' state, the new product will also trial till the original Subscription's trial date and all the charges would apply on the next billing cycle, after the trial ends.

**What happens if the product has a trial period and is now being added to a Subscription?**

- Set-up fee would apply to the total as a one-time charge, applicable on the next billing cycle, if the newly added product has a set-up fee associated with it. Also, if quantities of an existing product are increased and the product has set-up fees, these would be charged for the additional quantities on the next billing cycle.
- If the Subscription is in 'Trial' state, the new product's set-up fee will be charged on the next billing cycle i.e. when the trial ends.

**What happens if the Subscription has an ongoing Coupon?**

If the Subscription has an ongoing Coupon, if the coupon is applicable on the newly added product, it would apply on the new product from the next billing cycle.

Note: An option to change coupons from an ongoing Subscription is coming soon.

**Can I modify a Subscription with Cancelled or Overdue or Unpaid statuses?**

No, only the following Subscription statuses allow modification - Scheduled, Active and Trialing

How can I update a customer’s credit card details in a subscription?  
You can update a customer’s credit card by sharing a secure payment update link from their subscription.

- Go to Payments > Subscriptions in your sub-account.
- Find and select the customer’s subscription.
- Click the three dots (⋮) on the right.
- Select Share Payment Update Link.
- Send the link to the customer by:

  - Copying and sharing it via chat/message, or
  - Using the Email option to send it directly from the platform.

The customer can use this secure link to update their card details on their own.

title_en: Workflow Action: Generate Marketing Audit Report
source_md:
Automatically create a Marketing Audit Report for new or updated contacts so your team can qualify leads faster and start more personalized outreach. This workflow action uses contact details like business name and website to generate an audit you can review, share, and use in sales conversations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Generate Marketing Audit Workflow Action](#What-is-the-Generate-Marketing-Audit-Workflow-Action)
- [Action Name](#Action-Name)
- [Action Description](#Action-Description)
- [Prerequisites](#%E2%80%8BPrerequisites)
- [How It Works](#How-It-Works)
- [Duplicate Prevention](#Duplicate-Prevention)
- [Where to Find the Generated Audit](#Where-to-Find-the-Generated-Audit)
- [Example](#Example)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Generate Marketing Audit Workflow Action**

The Marketing Audit Report Generation workflow action allows you to automatically create a Marketing Audit Report for every new lead (contact) added to your sub-account. With workflow automation, you can instantly enrich new contacts, understand their online presence, and personalize follow-up outreach — all without manual effort.

To use this action, ensure the Prospecting Tool is enabled and subscribed on your sub-account.

```
Note: Previously, marketing audits could only be generated for leads created inside the Prospecting Tool. With this new workflow action, you can now generate audits for any contact from any source — Facebook Ads, funnels, forms, imports, integrations, webinars, or any other channel.
```

---

## **Action Name**

Generate Marketing Audit Report

---

## **Action Description**

This workflow action automatically generates a Marketing Audit Report for a contact by using the details available in their profile, such as:

- Business Name
- Website URL
- Address
- Email
- Phone Number

The more complete the contact’s information is, the more accurate and detailed the audit will be.

### **What is Marketing Audit Report**

The Marketing Audit Report is a powerful, automated snapshot of a business’s local marketing presence. It analyzes key areas like business listings accuracy, website performance, Google Business Profile , SEO rankings, and online reputation.

These insights help you identify gaps in your online presence, understand what’s impacting your growth, and take informed next steps — making the report useful for improving performance, onboarding new customers, or planning future marketing efforts.

---

## **Prerequisites**

1. Your sub-account must have an active Prospecting Tool subscription.
2. Ensure that the Prospecting Tool is enabled in your account.
3. Add the action into a workflow that triggers when a contact is available (recommended trigger: Contact Created).

---

## **How It Works**

1. A contact enters your workflow.
2. The Generate Marketing Audit Report action runs automatically.
3. Prospecting Tool uses the contact’s available business information such as business name, website, email etc to recoganize the right business entity and then run detailed audit for it.
4. The generated report is attached to that prospect inside the Prospecting Tool.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065386384/original/deq9WohD9DTUtUwUY3iKxT1vgaCGalrymA.png?1771612352)

---

## **Duplicate Prevention**

For contacts originally created by the Prospecting Tool, we automatically prevents:

- Duplicate marketing audit reports
- Re-triggering the same audit workflows

This ensures clean data and avoids unnecessary audit generation for leads already handled by the Prospecting Tool.

---

## **Where to Find the Generated Audit**

Once the workflow runs:

1. Navigate to Marketing → Prospecting Tool (if can't see 'Prospecting' tab: it's probably prospecting is not enabled for your account).
2. Open the Prospecting tab.
3. Search for the specific prospect/contact.
4. You’ll see the newly generated Marketing Audit Report for that contact.

---

## **Example**

#### **Use Case:**Audit Every New Lead Automatically

You want to audit all new contacts coming in — from Facebook Ads, funnels, events, referrals, imports, or anywhere else.

1. Create a workflow with Trigger: Contact Created.
2. Add the Generate Marketing Audit Report action.
3. Publish the workflow.

Now, every new contact added to your CRM will automatically:

- Have its business details analyzed
- Receive a custom Marketing Audit Report
- Appear inside the Prospecting Tool for review

This gives your team immediate insights and helps tailor outreach to each lead’s current marketing performance.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I export the Marketing Audit Report as a PDF and customize it?**  
HighLevel supports PDF export customization in the Prospecting Tool so your audit PDFs can match your branding. For more information on exporting and customizing these reports, [click here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006614).

**Q: Can I share the report with a prospect in another language?**  
Yes. Multilingual Prospect Report Sharing can localize the Marketing Audit Report. You can choose a language when generating a share link or sending via Email/SMS

---

title_en: Save Progress for Forms, Surveys & Quizzes
source_md:
Forms & Surveys

# Save Progress for Forms, Surveys & Quizzes

Allow respondents to pause and resume multi-step forms, surveys, and quizzes without losing their work

What You'll Learn

This article explains how the Save Progress feature automatically preserves respondent data in multi-step forms, surveys, and quizzes, enabling them to return and complete their submissions at their convenience.

You'll learn how to enable the feature, how it works for respondents, and how the Resume Progress modal automatically adapts to your branding.

## What is Save Progress?

Save Progress is a feature that automatically preserves respondent data when they leave a multi-step form, survey, or quiz before completing it. When enabled, respondents can close their browser, refresh the page, or navigate away, and their answers are securely stored.

When they return to the same form, survey, or quiz, a Resume Progress modal appears, giving them the option to continue from where they left off or start over with a new submission. This feature is especially valuable for longer forms that require significant time or information gathering.

Save Progress is controlled using the Save Exit Confirmation toggle in the Settings tab and is available for all multi-step forms, surveys, and quizzes in HighLevel.

## Key Benefits

Save Progress improves the respondent experience and increases completion rates by removing the frustration of lost work. Here are the key benefits:

**Automatic Progress Saving** — Respondent data is automatically saved when they leave a multi-step form, survey, or quiz before submitting, with no manual action required.

**Simple Toggle Control** — Enable or disable Save Progress using the Save Exit Confirmation toggle in the Settings tab, giving you full control over when the feature is active.

**Seamless Resumption** — Respondents can return later and pick up exactly where they left off, maintaining their context and reducing frustration.

**Flexible Resume Options** — The Resume Progress modal allows respondents to choose between continuing their saved submission or starting over with a fresh form.

**Automatic Branding Inheritance** — The Resume Progress modal automatically matches your form, survey, or quiz branding, including CTA button color and label font.

**Cross-Device Compatibility** — Save Progress is fully supported across desktop and mobile experiences, ensuring consistent functionality regardless of device.

## How Save Progress Works

When Save Progress is enabled, HighLevel automatically monitors respondent activity and preserves their data if they leave before completing the submission. Here's how the feature works from the respondent's perspective:

Step 1

Respondent Begins Filling Out the Form

A respondent starts completing a multi-step form, survey, or quiz with Save Progress enabled. They answer questions and navigate through multiple steps.

Step 2

Respondent Leaves Before Submitting

The respondent closes the browser, refreshes the page, or navigates to a different website before completing and submitting the form. Their progress is automatically saved.

Step 3

Respondent Returns to the Form

When the respondent returns to the same form, survey, or quiz URL, a "Submission in progress" modal automatically appears on their screen.

Step 4

Respondent Chooses to Continue or Start Over

The modal presents two options: Continue from where they left off, or Start Over with a new submission. The respondent selects their preferred option and proceeds accordingly.

Automatic Behavior

Progress is only saved when the Save Exit Confirmation toggle is enabled. If the feature is disabled, respondents who leave the form will need to start over when they return.

## How to Enable Save Progress

Enabling Save Progress for your multi-step forms, surveys, and quizzes is a straightforward process. Follow these steps to activate the feature:

Step 1

Open Your Form, Survey, or Quiz

Navigate to the form, survey, or quiz for which you want to enable Save Progress. Open the item in edit mode.

Step 2

Go to the Settings Tab

Click on the Settings tab within the form, survey, or quiz builder interface.

Step 3

Enable the Save Exit Confirmation Toggle

Locate the Save Exit Confirmation toggle in the Settings tab. Switch the toggle to the enabled position to activate Save Progress.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077169076/original/F9MqzU5XoKPFz5p-itqeF2W-kBo3eQVddg.png?1785342832)

Step 4

Save Your Changes

Save the form, survey, or quiz to apply your changes. The Save Progress feature is now active and will preserve respondent data going forward.

Note

Existing forms, surveys, and quizzes remain unchanged until you explicitly enable the Save Exit Confirmation toggle. This feature is opt-in and does not activate automatically.

## Resume Progress Modal Branding

The Resume Progress modal automatically inherits branding settings from your form, survey, or quiz, ensuring a consistent visual experience for respondents. This automatic styling applies to two key design elements:

Branding Element 1

CTA Button Color

The call-to-action buttons in the Resume Progress modal (Continue and Start Over) inherit the footer color configured in your form, survey, or quiz settings. This ensures the modal buttons match your existing brand palette without requiring additional configuration.

Branding Element 2

Text Font

All text displayed in the Resume Progress modal uses the label font configured in your form, survey, or quiz settings. This maintains typographic consistency between the modal and the rest of your form experience.

Automatic Configuration

You do not need to configure the Resume Progress modal separately. All branding settings are automatically inherited from your form, survey, or quiz configuration.

title_en: The Affiliate Commander Program
source_md:
Affiliates • Commander Status • LevelUp

HighLevel Affiliate Commander Status

HighLevel Affiliate Commander Status recognizes top-performing affiliates who reach the annual commission requirement. Commanders receive additional recognition, support, and access within the HighLevel affiliate community. Qualification resets annually, so affiliates must meet the current requirement during each qualification period.

What You'll Learn

Learn the current Commander commission requirement, annual qualification period, available perks, and how to monitor your affiliate performance.

Important

Commander Status requires at least **$100,000 in annual affiliate commissions** during the applicable qualification period. It is not a lifetime rank and must be earned again in future annual cycles.

# What Is Affiliate Commander Status?

Affiliate Commander is an elite status awarded to top-performing HighLevel affiliates who generate at least **$100,000 in annual commissions**. Commander Status is based on annual affiliate performance and is not a permanent or lifetime rank.

## Key Benefits of Affiliate Commander Status

Commander Status recognizes significant affiliate performance and gives qualified affiliates additional recognition, access, and support.

- **Performance Recognition:** Be recognized as one of HighLevel's top-performing affiliates.
- **Commander Recognition:** Receive a HighLevel Commander jacket with annual badges.
- **Dedicated Slack Access:** Gain access to a dedicated channel inside the HighLevel workspace.
- **Priority Support:** Access advanced ticket-escalation protocols for you and your referrals.
- **Annual Recognition:** Earn Commander Status through HighLevel's annual affiliate qualification cycle.

## Eligibility and Qualification Requirements

Understanding the annual qualification criteria helps affiliates monitor their progress toward Commander Status throughout the year.

To qualify for Affiliate Commander Status, an affiliate must generate at least **$100,000 in annual commissions** under the HighLevel Affiliate Program during the applicable qualification period.

- Requires at least **$100,000 in annual commissions**.
- Is based on qualifying affiliate performance during the annual cycle.
- Is evaluated annually.
- Is not a lifetime achievement or permanent rank.
- Must be earned again based on performance during future qualification periods.

**Note:** Affiliate commissions and eligibility remain subject to HighLevel's current Affiliate Program Agreement and policies.

## How the Annual Qualification Period Works

HighLevel uses an annual qualification period so Commander Status reflects recent affiliate performance instead of lifetime commission totals.

Current Qualification Period

**September 1 through August 30**

The qualification period resets annually. Affiliates must meet the applicable Commander commission requirement within the relevant annual cycle to qualify.

## Commander Status Perks

Commander perks provide additional recognition and support for affiliates who reach the annual performance requirement.

- **Commander Jacket:** Qualified Commanders receive an exclusive HighLevel Commander jacket with annual badges.
- **Dedicated Slack Channel:** Commanders receive access to a dedicated channel inside the HighLevel workspace.
- **Priority Ticket Escalation:** Commanders receive advanced ticket-escalation protocols for themselves and their referrals.

**Program Updates:** HighLevel may update Commander benefits as the affiliate program and annual recognition program evolve.

## How To Track Your Affiliate Performance

Monitoring your affiliate performance throughout the qualification period helps you track commissions, referrals, and progress toward Commander Status.

1. From **Agency View**, click **Affiliate Portal** in the left navigation menu.
2. Use the available Affiliate Portal tabs to review performance, referral, commission, and payout information.
3. Monitor affiliate activity regularly throughout the annual qualification period.
4. Confirm your payment and affiliate account information remains current.
5. Contact your Affiliate Manager if you need clarification about your Commander qualification status.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081373789/original/LuzHrHDOpT1FSLQNaSSLEhnT3tEHHVwXBA.png?1789863363)

**Affiliate Portal:** Use the portal to access affiliate reporting, referral information, commissions, payment details, and payout history.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much do I need to earn to become an Affiliate Commander?

The current requirement is at least **$100,000 in annual commissions** during the applicable qualification period.

Q: What is the annual Commander qualification period?

The current qualification period runs from **September 1 through August 30** and resets annually.

Q: Is Affiliate Commander Status permanent?

No. Commander Status is not a lifetime rank. Affiliates must continue meeting the applicable annual qualification requirements.

Q: Does earning $100,000 in lifetime commissions automatically qualify me?

No. Commander qualification is based on commissions earned during the applicable annual qualification period, not lifetime commission totals.

Q: What perks do Affiliate Commanders receive?

Current perks include a HighLevel Commander jacket with annual badges, dedicated Slack channel access, and priority ticket-escalation support.

Q: Where can I track my affiliate commissions?

From **Agency View**, open **Affiliate Portal** to review available referral, performance, commission, and payout information.

Q: Who should I contact about my Commander eligibility?

Contact your HighLevel Affiliate Manager for questions about your individual qualification status or current program requirements.

title_en: Documents & Contracts: How to automate sending invoices when documents are signed
source_md:
## What's New?

We are excited to introduce **Recurring Invoice Generation** integrated directly into our 2-in-1 Documents & Contracts feature. This enhancement allows users to automate the creation and management of recurring invoices seamlessly at the time of document signing. Key updates include:

- **Automated Settings Drawer:** When adding a product list to a new template or document, clicking the product list automatically opens the settings drawer for easy configuration.  
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040192610/original/m32qF971fhQ6W0aWKAm1haQRa96V4I8eJw.png?1737463687)
- **Automatic Recurring Type Assignment:** Adding a recurring product changes its type to recurring automatically.
- **Price Type Tags:** Visual tags indicate whether a product is one-time or recurring, helping users differentiate between pricing types.  
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040192575/original/BvTl1r-opmC8DgoyB8z7wzUbyuTU5E24HQ.png?1737463645)
- **Flexible Invoice Scheduling:** Users can now choose to generate invoices immediately upon signing or based on a fixed schedule relative to the signing date.  
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040192590/original/PphDdpE_JVjTz8UCOdPTjOjDc__V-bCtcA.png?1737463657)

## How to Use

### For Templates

1. **Create a New Template:**

   - Navigate to **Payments** > **Documents & Contracts** > **Templates** > **New Template**.  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040192695/original/_2f8RiHPRq3Ck-IfTr1HmJdOpvMFgpdAOQ.png?1737463746)
2. **Add a Product List and Signature:**

   - Add a product list to your template.
   - Insert a signature element where required.  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040192790/original/18VAl-uoP2MKbCWRUUOqI6zYkIFvSCQ4Bg.png?1737463789)
3. **Configure Recurring Products:**

   - Add a recurring product to the product list.
   - The settings drawer will automatically open for configuration.  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040192818/original/XWkZ94CHm5lsYqgW7teiPASepCzdpa3rMA.png?1737463823)
4. **Distinguish Product Types:**

   - The product list will display distinctions between one-time and recurring products.
   - **Note:**
     - **One-Time Products:** Always treated as one-time payments.
     - **Recurring Products with Setup Fee:** Displayed as two line items—one for the recurring payment and another for the one-time setup fee.
     - Only recurring products will be billed in subsequent invoices sent

### Configuring Recurring Invoice settings within the product list

1. **Generate Invoice at Signing:**

   - **Toggle On:**Creates a recurring invoice schedule with the first invoice generated at the time of signing. Subsequent invoices follow the defined frequency (e.g., monthly).
     - *Example:* If a document is signed on January 25th with a monthly schedule, the next invoice is sent on February 25th.
   - **Toggle Off:** Allows users to set a specific date for the invoice to be sent, regardless of the signing date.
2. **Enable Direct Payment:**

   - **Toggle On:** Redirects the primary signer directly to the invoice page after signing and sends an email with the invoice.
   - **Toggle Off:** The invoice is saved as a draft and can be sent manually later.  
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155040192852/original/53u9d00rt6mIJJRGbNWgOoALYyEREYHhfA.png?1737463853)
